    tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
    tokio = { version = "1", features = [
        "rt-multi-thread",
        "macros",
        "io-util",
        "net",
        "sync",
        "time",
        "process",
    ] }
    rmcp = { version = "3", features = ["server", "macros", "schemars", "transport-io"] }
    schemars = "1.0"
    toml = "0.9"
    
    # GPUI is pinned to an exact upstream commit. See config/pins.toml and
    # docs/17-scaffold-and-pins.md. Never move this to a branch or tag.
    gpui = { git = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed", rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988", default-features = false }
    gpui_platform = { git = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed", rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988", default-features = false }
    
    [profile.release]
    opt-level = 3
    lto = "thin"
    codegen-units = 1
    panic = "abort"
    //! Validated operations shared by every debugger surface.
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use schemars::JsonSchema;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(untagged)]
    pub enum SettingValue {
        Boolean(bool),
        Integer(i64),
        Number(f64),
        Text(String),
    }
    
    /// Unknown operations and fields fail before reaching a worker.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(tag = "operation", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub enum DebugCommand {
        SettingsList,
        SettingsGet { name: String },
        SettingsSet { name: String, value: SettingValue },
        SettingsDiff,
        Registers { core: u32 },
        WriteRegister { core: u32, register: u32, value: u32 },
        ReadMemory { address: u32, length: u32 },
        WriteMemory { address: u32, bytes: Vec<u8> },
        Step { core: u32, count: u32 },
        Threads,
        Processes,
        MemoryMap,
        Suspend { thread: Option<u32>, suspended: bool },
        Backtrace { core: u32, limit: u32 },
        BreakpointSet { address: u32, kind: BreakpointKind, length: u32 },
        BreakpointRemove { id: u64 },
        Breakpoints,
        SaveState { name: String },
        LoadState { name: String },
        States,
        Logs { after: u64, limit: u32 },
        Events { after: u64, limit: u32 },
        Perf,
        Continue,
        Pause,
        Advance { frames: u16 },
        LeaseAcquire { owner: String },
        LeaseRelease { owner: String },
        Trace { enabled: bool },
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum BreakpointKind { Execute, Read, Write, Access }
    
    impl DebugCommand {
        pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
            match self {
                Self::Advance { frames } if !(1..=600).contains(frames) => Err("advance 1..600 frames"),
                Self::ReadMemory { address, length } =>
                    range(*address, *length, 4096),
                Self::WriteMemory { address, bytes } =>
                    range(*address, bytes.len().try_into().map_err(|_| "write too large")?, 4096),
                Self::Step { core, count } if *core > 3 || !(1..=100_000).contains(count) =>
                    Err("step requires core 0..3 and count 1..100000"),
                Self::Registers { core } | Self::WriteRegister { core, .. } |
                Self::Backtrace { core, .. } if *core > 3 => Err("invalid core"),
                Self::WriteRegister { register, .. } if *register > 81 => Err("invalid register"),
                Self::Backtrace { limit, .. } if !(1..=128).contains(limit) => Err("backtrace limit 1..128"),
                Self::BreakpointSet { address, length, kind } => {
                    range(*address, *length, 65536)?;
                    if *kind == BreakpointKind::Execute && !matches!(length, 2 | 4) {
                        return Err("execution breakpoint length must be 2 or 4");
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                Self::SaveState { name } | Self::LoadState { name } if
                    name.is_empty() || name.len() > 32 ||
                    !name.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-') =>
                        Err("state name must be 1..32 letters, digits, '_' or '-'"),
                Self::Events { limit, .. } | Self::Logs { limit, .. }
                    if !(1..=128).contains(limit) => Err("stream limit 1..128"),
                _ => Ok(()),
            }
        }
    
        pub fn mutates(&self) -> bool {
            matches!(self, Self::SettingsSet { .. } | Self::WriteRegister { .. } |
                Self::WriteMemory { .. } | Self::Step { .. } | Self::Suspend { .. } |
                Self::BreakpointSet { .. } | Self::BreakpointRemove { .. } |
                Self::LoadState { .. } | Self::SaveState { .. } | Self::Trace { .. } | Self::Continue | Self::Pause | Self::Advance { .. } | Self::LeaseAcquire { .. } | Self::LeaseRelease { .. })
        }
    }
    
    fn range(address: u32, length: u32, maximum: u32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if length == 0 || length > maximum || u64::from(address) + u64::from(length) > 1u64 << 32 {
            Err("invalid or oversized guest range")
        } else { Ok(()) }
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
        #[test]
        fn invalid_commands_are_rejected_before_transport() {
            assert!(DebugCommand::ReadMemory { address: u32::MAX, length: 2 }.validate().is_err());
            assert!(DebugCommand::LoadState { name: "../escape".into() }.validate().is_err());
            assert!(serde_json::from_str::<DebugCommand>(r#"{"operation":"step","core":0,"count":1,"ignored":true}"#).is_err());
            assert!(DebugCommand::ReadMemory { address: u32::MAX, length: 1 }.validate().is_ok());
        }
    }
    //! Local host policy shared by the headless MCP server and the desktop.
    //!
    //! One `Supervisor` owns every session of a LOTUS process. Each session has its
    //! own async lock, so a long bounded run on one session never blocks commands,
    //! status or previews of another. The registry lock is never held across an
    //! await. Desktop and MCP call the same methods; there is one control model.
    //!
    //! Sessions are *primary* (mount a persistent card) or *secondary* (private
    //! scratch copy, discarded on end); see [`crate::card_store`].
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use tokio::task::JoinSet;
    
    use crate::card_store::{CardStore, ScratchEnd};
    use crate::native_session::{Frame, InputState, NativeSession};
    use crate::telemetry::{Actor, Telemetry};
    use crate::SessionState;
    
    /// Sessions per host unless the configuration raises it; four is the tested load.
    pub const DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS: usize = 4;
    /// Upper bound accepted for `max_sessions`.
    pub const MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT: usize = 16;
    pub const MAX_ARTIFACTS: usize = 128;
    /// Stop deadline per worker when the host closes.
    const CLOSE_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
    
    /// Host configuration, never accepted as a tool-call argument.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct HostConfig {
        pub worker: PathBuf,
        pub storage_root: PathBuf,
        /// Approved content, by handle.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub assets: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        /// Approved directories: every `.3dsx` directly inside is `<handle>/<file>`.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub asset_directories: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub allow_control: bool,
        #[serde(default = "default_max_sessions")]
        pub max_sessions: usize,
        /// Validated worker settings applied before loading content.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub profile: BTreeMap<String, lotus_protocol::debug::SettingValue>,
    }
    
    fn default_max_sessions() -> usize {
        DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS
    }
    
    impl HostConfig {
        /// Configuration with no assets, control denied and the default session limit.
        pub fn new(worker: impl Into<PathBuf>, storage_root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
            Self {
                worker: worker.into(),
                storage_root: storage_root.into(),
                assets: BTreeMap::new(),
                asset_directories: BTreeMap::new(),
                allow_control: false,
                max_sessions: DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS,
                profile: BTreeMap::new(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Whether a session's guest writes persist.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum SessionKind {
        /// Mounts `cards/<card>/`: real, persistent SDMC/NAND reads and writes.
        Primary { card: String },
        /// Private scratch root, empty or copied from `parent`; discarded on end.
        Secondary { parent: Option<String> },
    }
    
    /// Identity of a session as listed by every frontend.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
    pub struct SessionInfo {
        pub id: String,
        #[serde(flatten)]
        pub kind: SessionKind,
        /// Approved handle of the loaded content, if any.
        pub asset: Option<String>,
        pub created_unix_ms: u64,
    }
    
    impl SessionInfo {
        /// Card a session belongs to in the session tree, if any.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn card(&self) -> Option<&str> {
            match &self.kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => Some(card),
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => parent.as_deref(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// One session row: identity plus latest gauges.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
    pub struct SessionSummary {
        #[serde(flatten)]
        pub info: SessionInfo,
        pub telemetry: Telemetry,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Artifact {
        pub uri: String,
        pub screen: String,
        pub width: u32,
        pub height: u32,
        pub bytes: usize,
        pub sha256: String,
    }
    
    /// A session's lock domain. Lock order: `native`, then `info` or `telemetry`.
    struct SessionHandle {
        info: Mutex<SessionInfo>,
        root: PathBuf,
        native: tokio::sync::Mutex<NativeSession>,
        telemetry: Mutex<Telemetry>,
        playing: AtomicBool,
        lease: Mutex<Option<String>>,
    }
    
    impl SessionHandle {
        fn info(&self) -> SessionInfo {
            lock(&self.info).clone()
        }
        fn telemetry(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Telemetry> {
            lock(&self.telemetry)
        }
        fn record(&self, actor: Actor, operation: &str) {
            self.telemetry().record(actor, operation);
        }
        fn set_playing(&self, playing: bool) {
            self.playing.store(playing, Ordering::Release);
            self.telemetry().playing = playing;
        }
        fn is_playing(&self) -> bool {
            self.playing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
        }
    }
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Registry {
        sessions: BTreeMap<String, Arc<SessionHandle>>,
        /// Creations in progress, counted against the session limit.
        pending: usize,
        /// Card name to mounting session (or pending creation) ID.
        mounted: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    }
    
    /// No shell execution, arbitrary caller paths or remote listener.
    pub struct Supervisor {
        config: HostConfig,
        cards: CardStore,
        registry: Mutex<Registry>,
        artifacts: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, (Artifact, PathBuf)>>,
        /// Content approved interactively by the desktop user.
        local_assets: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>>,
        focus_request: Mutex<Option<String>>,
    }
    
    impl Supervisor {
        pub fn new(mut config: HostConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
            if !(1..=MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT).contains(&config.max_sessions) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                    format!("max_sessions must be in 1..={MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT}"),
                ));
            }
            config.worker = config.worker.canonicalize()?;
            for path in config.assets.values_mut() {
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            for (handle, path) in &mut config.asset_directories {
                if handle.is_empty() || handle.contains(['/', '\\']) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                        "asset directory handles cannot be empty or contain separators",
                    ));
                }
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            fs::create_dir_all(&config.storage_root)?;
            config.storage_root = config.storage_root.canonicalize()?;
            let cards = CardStore::open(&config.storage_root)?;
            Ok(Self {
                config,
                cards,
                registry: Mutex::default(),
                artifacts: Mutex::default(),
                local_assets: Mutex::default(),
                focus_request: Mutex::default(),
            })
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn max_sessions(&self) -> usize {
            self.config.max_sessions
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn allows_control(&self) -> bool {
            self.config.allow_control
        }
    
        pub fn require_control(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
            if self.config.allow_control {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                    "host has not enabled control for this client",
                ))
            }
        }
    
        /// Session IDs in creation-independent sorted order.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn sessions(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            lock(&self.registry).sessions.keys().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        /// Every session with its latest gauges; never waits on a worker.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn summaries(&self) -> Vec<SessionSummary> {
            self.handles()
                .iter()
                .map(|handle| SessionSummary {
                    info: handle.info(),
                    telemetry: handle.telemetry().clone(),
                })
                .collect()
        }
    
        pub fn summary(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<SessionSummary> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let telemetry = handle.telemetry().clone();
            Ok(SessionSummary {
                info: handle.info(),
                telemetry,
            })
        }
    
        /// Persistent card names.
        pub fn cards(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {
            self.cards.list()
        }
    
        /// Cards currently mounted by a primary session of this host.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn mounted_cards(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
            lock(&self.registry).mounted.clone()
        }
    
        /// Approved content handles: configured, directory-listed and desktop-approved.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn assets(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut handles: Vec<String> = self.config.assets.keys().cloned().collect();
            for (handle, directory) in &self.config.asset_directories {
                let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(directory) else {
                    continue;
                };
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    if is_content_name(&name) && entry.path().is_file() {
                        handles.push(format!("{handle}/{name}"));
                    }
                }
            }
            handles.extend(lock(&self.local_assets).keys().cloned());
            handles.sort();
            handles.dedup();
            handles
        }
    
        /// Approve a file chosen by the local desktop user. Never reachable from MCP.
        pub fn approve_local_asset(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
            let path = path.canonicalize()?;
            let name = path
                .file_name()
                .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
                .filter(|name| is_content_name(name))
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "content must be a .3dsx file")
                })?;
            let mut assets = lock(&self.local_assets);
            let known = assets
                .iter()
                .find(|(_, known)| **known == path)
                .map(|(handle, _)| handle.clone());
            if let Some(handle) = known {
                return Ok(handle);
            }
            let mut handle = format!("local/{name}");
            let mut suffix = 2;
            while assets.contains_key(&handle) || self.config.assets.contains_key(&handle) {
                handle = format!("local/{suffix}-{name}");
                suffix += 1;
            }
            assets.insert(handle.clone(), path);
            Ok(handle)
        }
    
        /// Spawn a worker for `kind`, optionally loading approved content paused.
        pub async fn create(
            &self,
            kind: SessionKind,
            asset: Option<&str>,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = asset.map(|handle| self.resolve_asset(handle)).transpose()?;
            let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
            let reservation = self.reserve(&id, &kind)?;
            let root = match &kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => self.cards.primary_root(card)?,
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => {
                    self.cards.create_scratch(&id, parent.as_deref())?
                }
            };
            let started = async {
                let mut native = NativeSession::spawn(&self.config.worker, &root).await?;
                for (name, value) in &self.config.profile {
                    if let Err(error) = native.debug(&lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand::SettingsSet {
                        name: name.clone(), value: value.clone()
                    }).await {
                        let _ = native.stop().await;
                        return Err(error);
                    }
                }
                if let Some(content) = &content {
                    if let Err(error) = native.load(content).await {
                        let _ = native.stop().await;
                        return Err(error);
                    }
                }
                Ok(native)
            }
            .await;
            let native = match started {
                Ok(native) => native,
                Err(error) => {
                    if matches!(kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                        let _ = self.cards.discard_scratch(&root, ScratchEnd::Abnormal);
                    }
                    return Err(error);
                }
            };
            let info = SessionInfo {
                id: id.clone(),
                kind,
                asset: asset.map(str::to_string),
                created_unix_ms: unix_ms(),
            };
            let mut telemetry = Telemetry::new();
            telemetry.state = native.state();
            telemetry.epoch = native.epoch();
            telemetry.pid = native.pid();
            telemetry.record(actor, "create");
            let handle = Arc::new(SessionHandle {
                info: Mutex::new(info.clone()),
                root,
                native: tokio::sync::Mutex::new(native),
                telemetry: Mutex::new(telemetry),
                playing: AtomicBool::new(false),
                lease: Mutex::new(None),
            });
            reservation.commit(handle);
            Ok(info)
        }
    
        /// Load approved content, replacing what was loaded. Leaves the session paused.
        pub async fn load(&self, id: &str, asset: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            native.load(&content).await?;
            lock(&handle.info).asset = Some(asset.to_string());
            handle.record(actor, "load");
            Ok(handle.info())
        }
    
        /// Run continuously: the pump re-issues bounded runs until paused.
        pub async fn run(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if handle.info().asset.is_none() {
                return Err(io::Error::other("load content before running"));
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if native.state() == SessionState::Paused {
                native.run().await?;
            }
            handle.set_playing(true);
            handle.record(actor, "run");
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn pause(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            handle.record(actor, "pause");
            native.pause().await
        }
    
        /// Advance exactly `frames` (1–600) and stay paused.
        pub async fn advance(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            frames: u16,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, &format!("run_until {frames}"));
            native.advance(frames).await
        }
    
        pub async fn reset(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, "reset");
            native.reset().await
        }
    
        pub async fn input(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            state: InputState,
            owner: &str,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if actor != Actor::Desktop {
                handle.record(actor, "input");
            }
            native.input(state, owner).await
        }
    
        /// End a session. Secondary guest data is deleted; primary data persists.
        pub async fn stop(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "stop");
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let result = if native.state().is_active() {
                match tokio::time::timeout(CLOSE_DEADLINE, native.stop()).await {
                    Ok(result) => result,
                    Err(_) => {
                        native.abort().await;
                        Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "worker stop deadline; terminated"))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Ok(())
            };
            let end = if result.is_ok() && native.state() == SessionState::Stopped {
                ScratchEnd::Clean
            } else {
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal
            };
            drop(native);
            {
                let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
                registry.sessions.remove(id);
                registry.mounted.retain(|_, owner| owner != id);
            }
            if matches!(lock(&handle.info).kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                self.cards.discard_scratch(&handle.root, end)?;
            }
            result
        }
    
        /// Failure injection and emergency termination, limited to this session's job.
        pub async fn abort(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "abort");
            handle.native.lock().await.abort().await;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        /// Query the worker at a safe point and refresh gauges.
        pub async fn status(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let status = native.status().await?;
            observe(&handle, &native, &status);
            Ok(status)
        }
    
        /// Typed debugger entry point shared by CLI, MCP, desktop and GDB.
        pub async fn debug(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.debug_as(id, command, actor_client(actor)).await
        }
    
        pub async fn subscribe(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver<serde_json::Value>> {
            Ok(self.handle(id)?.native.lock().await.subscribe())
        }
    
        /// Connection-specific identity is supplied by a trusted adapter, never by a tool argument.
        pub async fn debug_as(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, client: &str,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            command.validate().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            if command.mutates() { self.require_control()?; }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseAcquire { owner } = command {
                if owner != client { return Err(io::Error::other("lease owner must match this connection")); }
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if lease.as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| owner != client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease held by another client"));
                }
                *lease = Some(client.to_string());
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"lease": client}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseRelease { owner } = command {
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if owner != client || lease.as_deref() != Some(client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease is not owned by this client"));
                }
                *lease = None;
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"released": client}));
            }
            // Acquire native first, then check the lease immediately before the mutation.
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if command.mutates() {
                check_lease(&handle, client)?;
                handle.set_playing(false);
                pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
                handle.record(Actor::Host, client);
            }
            match command {
                DebugCommand::Continue => {
                    let result = native.run().await?;
                    handle.set_playing(true);
                    Ok(result)
                }
                DebugCommand::Pause => native.pause().await,
                DebugCommand::Advance { frames } => native.advance(*frames).await,
                _ => native.debug(command).await,
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn registers(&self, id: &str, core: u32) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            native.registers(core).await
        }
    
        pub async fn memory(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            address: u32,
            length: u16,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            native.memory(address, length).await
        }
    
        /// Latest screens for display, or `None` when the session is busy or blank.
        pub async fn preview(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Vec<Frame>> {
            let handle = self.handle(id).ok()?;
            let mut native = handle.native.try_lock().ok()?;
            let has_frames = handle.telemetry().frames > 0;
            if !matches!(native.state(), SessionState::Running | SessionState::Paused) || !has_frames {
                return None;
            }
            native.capture().await.ok()
        }
    
        pub async fn capture(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<Artifact>> {
            if lock(&self.artifacts).len() + 2 > MAX_ARTIFACTS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "artifact quota reached; restart host to reset catalog",
                ));
            }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let frames = handle.native.lock().await.capture().await?;
            let directory = self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
            for frame in frames {
                let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.bgra"));
                fs::write(&path, &frame.bgra)?;
                let artifact = Artifact {
                    uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                    screen: frame.lease.screen,
                    width: frame.lease.width,
                    height: frame.lease.height,
                    bytes: frame.bgra.len(),
                    sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra)),
                };
                lock(&self.artifacts).insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            lock(&self.artifacts)
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Resolve only catalogued immutable captures, never interpret a URI as a path.
        pub fn read_artifact(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let (artifact, path) = lock(&self.artifacts).get(uri).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown artifact resource")
            })?;
            let data = fs::read(path)?;
            if data.len() != artifact.bytes || format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&data)) != artifact.sha256
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("artifact identity mismatch"));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    
        /// Ask a windowed frontend to show `id`. Headless hosts ignore it.
        pub fn request_focus(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.handle(id)?;
            *lock(&self.focus_request) = Some(id.to_string());
            Ok(())
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn take_focus_request(&self) -> Option<String> {
            lock(&self.focus_request).take()
        }
    
        /// Refresh gauges of every idle session and keep playing sessions running.
        /// Sessions held by another command are marked busy, never waited on.
        pub async fn pump(&self) {
            let mut tasks = JoinSet::new();
            for handle in self.handles() {
                tasks.spawn(pump_session(handle));
            }
            while tasks.join_next().await.is_some() {}
        }
    
        /// Stop every session, bounding each stop; used when a frontend closes.
        pub async fn close(&self) {
            for id in self.sessions() {
                let _ = self.stop(&id, Actor::Host).await;
            }
        }
    
        fn handles(&self) -> Vec<Arc<SessionHandle>> {
            lock(&self.registry).sessions.values().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        fn handle(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Arc<SessionHandle>> {
            lock(&self.registry)
                .sessions
                .get(id)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                        "unknown session for this host; session handles expire when the server exits. Create a new session; use a primary card to keep guest storage",
                    )
                })
        }
    
        fn reserve(&self, id: &str, kind: &SessionKind) -> io::Result<Reservation<'_>> {
            let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
            if registry.sessions.len() + registry.pending >= self.config.max_sessions {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::QuotaExceeded,
                    format!("{}-session limit reached", self.config.max_sessions),
                ));
            }
            let card = match kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => {
                    crate::card_store::validate_name(card)?;
                    if registry.mounted.contains_key(card) {
                        return Err(io::Error::new(
                            io::ErrorKind::ResourceBusy,
                            format!("card '{card}' already has a primary session"),
                        ));
                    }
                    registry.mounted.insert(card.clone(), id.to_string());
                    Some(card.clone())
                }
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => {
                    if let Some(parent) = parent {
                        crate::card_store::validate_name(parent)?;
                    }
                    None
                }
            };
            registry.pending += 1;
            Ok(Reservation {
                supervisor: self,
                id: id.to_string(),
                card,
                committed: false,
            })
        }
    
        fn resolve_asset(&self, handle: &str) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            if let Some(path) = self.config.assets.get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some(path) = lock(&self.local_assets).get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some((directory, name)) = handle.split_once('/') {
                if let Some(root) = self.config.asset_directories.get(directory) {
                    if is_content_name(name) && !name.contains(['/', '\\']) && name != ".." {
                        let path = root.join(name).canonicalize()?;
                        if path.parent() == Some(root.as_path()) && path.is_file() {
                            return Ok(path);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "unknown asset handle",
            ))
        }
    }
    
    /// Holds a session slot and card mount during a slow spawn; released on failure.
    struct Reservation<'a> {
        supervisor: &'a Supervisor,
        id: String,
        card: Option<String>,
        committed: bool,
    }
    
    impl Reservation<'_> {
        fn commit(mut self, handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            registry.sessions.insert(self.id.clone(), handle);
            self.committed = true;
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for Reservation<'_> {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if self.committed {
                return;
            }
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            if let Some(card) = &self.card {
                registry.mounted.remove(card);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async fn pump_session(handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
        let Ok(mut native) = handle.native.try_lock() else {
            handle.telemetry().busy = true;
            return;
        };
        if !native.state().is_active() {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
            telemetry.state = native.state();
            telemetry.fps = 0.0;
            telemetry.speed = 0.0;
            telemetry.memory_bytes = None;
            return;
        }
        let status = match native.status().await {
            Ok(status) => status,
            Err(error) => {
                handle.set_playing(false);
                let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
                telemetry.state = native.state();
                telemetry.last_error = error.to_string();
                return;
            }
        };
        observe(&handle, &native, &status);
        if !handle.is_playing() || native.state() != SessionState::Paused {
            return;
        }
        // A bounded run ended. Resume unless the guest stopped for a reason a retry
        // cannot fix; a host deadline only means the batch ran slowly.
        let reason = status["last_error"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        if !matches!(reason, "" | "host_deadline") {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            return;
        }
        if let Err(error) = native.run().await {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.telemetry().last_error = error.to_string();
        }
    }
    
    fn observe(handle: &SessionHandle, native: &NativeSession, status: &serde_json::Value) {
        let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
        telemetry.playing = handle.is_playing();
        telemetry.observe(status, native.state(), native.epoch(), Instant::now());
        telemetry.pid = native.pid();
        telemetry.memory_bytes = native.working_set();
    }
    
    async fn pause_if_running(native: &mut NativeSession) -> io::Result<()> {
        if native.state() == SessionState::Running {
            native.pause().await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn is_content_name(name: &str) -> bool {
        name.len() > ".3dsx".len()
            && name
                .get(name.len() - 5..)
                .is_some_and(|extension| extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case(".3dsx"))
    }
    
    fn unix_ms() -> u64 {
        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|elapsed| u64::try_from(elapsed.as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX))
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }
    
    /// Registry state stays consistent across a panicking holder: every critical
    /// section is a single map update, so recover the guard instead of cascading.
    fn lock<T>(mutex: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
        mutex.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
    }

        fn host(name: &str, control: bool) -> (PathBuf, Supervisor) {

            fs::create_dir_all(base.join("content")).expect("content dir");
            fs::write(base.join("content/demo.3dsx"), b"3DSX").expect("content");
            fs::write(base.join("content/notes.txt"), b"x").expect("other");
            let mut config = HostConfig::new(std::env::current_exe().expect("exe"), base.join("store"));
            config
                .asset_directories
                .insert("builds".into(), base.join("content"));
            config.allow_control = control;
            (base, Supervisor::new(config).expect("host"))
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn asset_directories_list_only_direct_3dsx_handles() {
            let (base, host) = host("assets", true);
            assert_eq!(host.assets(), vec!["builds/demo.3dsx".to_string()]);
            assert!(host.resolve_asset("builds/demo.3dsx").is_ok());
            for bad in [
                "builds/notes.txt",
                "builds/../content/demo.3dsx",
                "builds/sub/demo.3dsx",
                "other/demo.3dsx",
                "C:/Windows/notepad.exe",
            ] {
                assert!(host.resolve_asset(bad).is_err(), "resolved {bad}");
            }
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }

            let (base, host) = host("local", true);
            let path = base.join("content/demo.3dsx");
            let first = host.approve_local_asset(&path).expect("approve");
            assert_eq!(first, "local/demo.3dsx");
            assert_eq!(host.approve_local_asset(&path).expect("again"), first);
            assert!(host
                .approve_local_asset(&base.join("content/notes.txt"))
                .is_err());
            assert!(host.resolve_asset(&first).is_ok());
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn reservations_enforce_limits_and_single_primary_mount() {
            let (base, host) = host("reserve", true);
            let primary = SessionKind::Primary { card: "dev".into() };
            let held = host.reserve("a", &primary).expect("first mount");
            assert_eq!(
                host.reserve("b", &primary).err().map(|error| error.kind()),
                Some(io::ErrorKind::ResourceBusy)
            );
            drop(held);
            let _again = host.reserve("c", &primary).expect("released on failure");
            let secondary = SessionKind::Secondary { parent: None };
            let _s1 = host.reserve("d", &secondary).expect("slot 2");
            let _s2 = host.reserve("e", &secondary).expect("slot 3");
            let _s3 = host.reserve("f", &secondary).expect("slot 4");
            assert_eq!(
                host.reserve("g", &secondary)
                    .err()
                    .map(|error| error.kind()),

                        parent: Some("../x".into())
                    }
                )

            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }

    fn actor_client(actor: Actor) -> &'static str {
        match actor { Actor::Host => "host", Actor::Desktop => "desktop", Actor::Mcp => "mcp" }
    }
    
    fn check_lease(handle: &SessionHandle, client: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
        if lock(&handle.lease).as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| owner != client) {
            Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease held by another client"))
        } else { Ok(()) }
    }

    //! Validated operations shared by every debugger surface.
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use schemars::JsonSchema;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(untagged)]
    pub enum SettingValue {
        Boolean(bool),
        Integer(i64),
        Number(f64),
        Text(String),
    }
    
    /// Unknown operations and fields fail before reaching a worker.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(tag = "operation", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub enum DebugCommand {
        SettingsList,
        SettingsGet { name: String },
        SettingsSet { name: String, value: SettingValue },
        SettingsDiff,
        Registers { core: u32 },
        WriteRegister { core: u32, register: u32, value: u32 },
        ReadMemory { address: u32, length: u32 },
        WriteMemory { address: u32, bytes: Vec<u8> },
        Step { core: u32, count: u32 },
        Threads,
        Processes,
        MemoryMap,
        Suspend { thread: Option<u32>, suspended: bool },
        Backtrace { core: u32, limit: u32 },
        BreakpointSet { address: u32, kind: BreakpointKind, length: u32 },
        BreakpointRemove { id: u64 },
        Breakpoints,
        SaveState { name: String },
        LoadState { name: String },
        States,
        Logs { after: u64, limit: u32 },
        Events { after: u64, limit: u32 },
        Perf,
        Continue,
        Pause,
        Advance { frames: u16 },
        LeaseAcquire { owner: String },
        LeaseRelease { owner: String },
        Trace { enabled: bool },
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum BreakpointKind { Execute, Read, Write, Access }
    
    impl DebugCommand {
        pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
            match self {
                Self::Advance { frames } if !(1..=600).contains(frames) => Err("advance 1..600 frames"),
                Self::ReadMemory { address, length } =>
                    range(*address, *length, 4096),
                Self::WriteMemory { address, bytes } =>
                    range(*address, bytes.len().try_into().map_err(|_| "write too large")?, 4096),
                Self::Step { core, count } if *core > 3 || !(1..=100_000).contains(count) =>
                    Err("step requires core 0..3 and count 1..100000"),
                Self::Registers { core } | Self::WriteRegister { core, .. } |
                Self::Backtrace { core, .. } if *core > 3 => Err("invalid core"),
                Self::WriteRegister { register, .. } if *register > 81 => Err("invalid register"),
                Self::Backtrace { limit, .. } if !(1..=128).contains(limit) => Err("backtrace limit 1..128"),
                Self::BreakpointSet { address, length, kind } => {
                    range(*address, *length, 65536)?;
                    if *kind == BreakpointKind::Execute && !matches!(length, 2 | 4) {
                        return Err("execution breakpoint length must be 2 or 4");
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                Self::SaveState { name } | Self::LoadState { name } if
                    name.is_empty() || name.len() > 32 ||
                    !name.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-') =>
                        Err("state name must be 1..32 letters, digits, '_' or '-'"),
                Self::Events { limit, .. } | Self::Logs { limit, .. }
                    if !(1..=128).contains(limit) => Err("stream limit 1..128"),
                _ => Ok(()),
            }
        }
    
        pub fn mutates(&self) -> bool {
            matches!(self, Self::SettingsSet { .. } | Self::WriteRegister { .. } |
                Self::WriteMemory { .. } | Self::Step { .. } | Self::Suspend { .. } |
                Self::BreakpointSet { .. } | Self::BreakpointRemove { .. } |
                Self::LoadState { .. } | Self::SaveState { .. } | Self::Trace { .. } | Self::Continue | Self::Pause | Self::Advance { .. } | Self::LeaseAcquire { .. } | Self::LeaseRelease { .. })
        }
    }
    
    fn range(address: u32, length: u32, maximum: u32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if length == 0 || length > maximum || u64::from(address) + u64::from(length) > 1u64 << 32 {
            Err("invalid or oversized guest range")
        } else { Ok(()) }
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
        #[test]
        fn invalid_commands_are_rejected_before_transport() {
            assert!(DebugCommand::ReadMemory { address: u32::MAX, length: 2 }.validate().is_err());
            assert!(DebugCommand::LoadState { name: "../escape".into() }.validate().is_err());
            assert!(serde_json::from_str::<DebugCommand>(r#"{"operation":"step","core":0,"count":1,"ignored":true}"#).is_err());
            assert!(DebugCommand::ReadMemory { address: u32::MAX, length: 1 }.validate().is_ok());
        }
    }
    [workspace]
    resolver = "2"
    members = [
        "crates/protocol",
        "crates/session",
        "crates/trace",
        "crates/debugger",
        "crates/runner",
        "crates/hardware",
        "crates/accuracy",
        "crates/mcp",
        "crates/cli",
        "crates/desktop",
    ]
    
    [workspace.package]
    version = "0.0.1"
    edition = "2021"
    rust-version = "1.98"
    license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
    authors = ["terezi <jules@foxtails.me>"]
    repository = "https://github.com/estyseesghosts/lotus"
    
    [workspace.dependencies]
    # Internal crates.
    lotus-protocol = { path = "crates/protocol", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-session = { path = "crates/session", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-trace = { path = "crates/trace", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-debugger = { path = "crates/debugger", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-runner = { path = "crates/runner", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-hardware = { path = "crates/hardware", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-accuracy = { path = "crates/accuracy", version = "0.0.1" }
    lotus-mcp = { path = "crates/mcp", version = "0.0.1" }
    
    # External crates.
    serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
    serde_json = "1"
    sha2 = "0.10"
    serde_yaml = "0.9"
    thiserror = "2"
    anyhow = "1"
    tracing = "0.1"
    tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
    tokio = { version = "1", features = [
        "rt-multi-thread",
        "macros",
        "io-util",
        "net",
        "sync",
        "time",
        "process",
    ] }
    rmcp = { version = "3", features = ["server", "macros", "schemars", "transport-io"] }
    schemars = "1.0"
    toml = "0.9"
    
    # GPUI is pinned to an exact upstream commit. See config/pins.toml and
    # docs/17-scaffold-and-pins.md. Never move this to a branch or tag.
    gpui = { git = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed", rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988", default-features = false }
    gpui_platform = { git = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed", rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988", default-features = false }
    
    [profile.release]
    opt-level = 3
    lto = "thin"
    codegen-units = 1
    panic = "abort"
    // Worker-side settings and safe-point inspection. No product/UI dependencies.
    #pragma once
    #include <algorithm>
    #include <deque>
    #include <fstream>
    #include <map>
    #include <set>
    #include "ctr_worker/settings_bindings.h"
    #include "core/core.h"
    #include "core/core_timing.h"
    #include "core/hle/kernel/thread.h"
    #include "core/hle/kernel/mutex.h"
    #include "core/perf_stats.h"
    #include "core/frontend/debug_channel.h"
    
    namespace CtrWorker {
    inline void DefaultProfile() {
        Settings::values.graphics_api = Settings::GraphicsAPI::Software;
        Settings::values.is_new_3ds = false;
        Settings::values.output_type = AudioCore::SinkType::Worker;
        Settings::values.use_gdbstub = false;
        Settings::values.init_ticks_type = Settings::InitTicks::Fixed;
        Settings::values.init_ticks_override = 0;
        Settings::values.init_clock = Settings::InitClock::FixedTime;
        Settings::values.init_time = 946684800;
    }
    class DebugTools {
    public:
        using Json = nlohmann::json;
        explicit DebugTools(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root)
            : system(system), root(root), bindings(SettingsBindings()) {}
    
    #ifdef CTR_EXPERIMENTAL
        void Attach() {
            DebugChannel::before_instruction = [this](auto& core, auto* thread) {
                if (stopped) return true;
                if (stepping) return false;
                const auto process = thread->owner_process.lock();
                for (auto& [id, bp] : breakpoints) {
                    if (bp.kind != "execute" || bp.address != core.GetPC()) continue;
                    if (skip_core == core.GetID() && skip_pc == core.GetPC()) {
                        skip_core = 0xffffffff;
                        continue;
                    }
                    ++bp.hits;
                    Stop("breakpoint", {{"breakpoint", id}, {"address", bp.address}, {"core", core.GetID()},
                                       {"thread", thread->thread_id}, {"process", process ? process->process_id : 0}});
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            };
            DebugChannel::memory_access = [this](u32 address, u32 length, bool write) {
                if (stepping || stopped) return;
                for (auto& [id, bp] : breakpoints) {
                    if (bp.kind == "execute" || (bp.kind == "read" && write) ||
                        (bp.kind == "write" && !write)) continue;
                    if (u64(address) < u64(bp.address) + bp.length && u64(bp.address) < u64(address) + length) {
                        ++bp.hits;
                        Stop("watchpoint", {{"breakpoint", id}, {"address", address}, {"write", write},
                            {"core", system.GetRunningCore().GetID()}, {"access_completed", true}});
                        break;
                    }
                }
            };
            DebugChannel::guest_log = [this](u32 address, const std::string& text) {
                Record("guest_log", {{"address", address}, {"text", text.substr(0, 8192)}});
            };
            DebugChannel::exception = [this](u32 pc, u32 type) {
                Stop("exception", {{"pc", pc}, {"exception", type},
                                  {"core", system.GetRunningCore().GetID()}});
            };
            DebugChannel::svc_break = [this](u32 reason) {
                Stop("svc_break", {{"reason", reason}, {"core", system.GetRunningCore().GetID()}});
            };
            DebugChannel::svc = [this](u32 id, bool enter) {
                if (!trace_svc) return;
                Record(enter ? "svc_enter" : "svc_exit",
                       {{"svc", id}, {"core", system.GetRunningCore().GetID()}});
            };
            DebugChannel::hio = [this](u32 address) {
                // libctru PackedGdbHioRequest v1: 152 bytes, independently of Azahar's GDB stub.
                const auto bytes = Read(address, 152);
                if (std::memcmp(bytes.data(), "GDB\0", 4) != 0)
                    throw std::invalid_argument("invalid HIO request magic");
                u32 version;
                std::memcpy(&version, bytes.data()+4, 4);
                if (version != 1) throw std::invalid_argument("unsupported HIO version");
                std::string function(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()+8), 17);
                function = function.substr(0, function.find('\0'));
                u64 params[8];
                std::memcpy(params, bytes.data()+40, sizeof(params));
                s64 retval = -1;
                s32 error = 38;
                if (function == "write" && (params[0] == 1 || params[0] == 2) && params[2] <= 4096 && params[1] <= 0xffffffff) {
                    const auto data = Read(static_cast<u32>(params[1]), params[2]);
                    Record("hio_stdout", {{"fd", params[0]}, {"text", std::string(data.begin(), data.end())}});
                    retval = params[2];
                    error = 0;
                }
                std::vector<u8> reply(16, 0);
                std::memcpy(reply.data(), &retval, 8);
                std::memcpy(reply.data()+8, &error, 4);
                Write(address+136, reply);
            };
        }
        void Detach() {
            DebugChannel::before_instruction = {};
            DebugChannel::memory_access = {};
            DebugChannel::guest_log = {};
            DebugChannel::exception = {};
            DebugChannel::svc_break = {};
            DebugChannel::svc = {};
            DebugChannel::hio = {};
            DebugChannel::single_step = false;
        }
        void Clear() {
            if (system.IsPoweredOn()) {
                const auto process = system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess();
                if (process) for (const auto& [id, bp] : breakpoints)
                    if (bp.kind != "execute") system.Memory().UnregisterWatchpoint(*process, bp.address, bp.length);
            }
            breakpoints.clear();
            stopped = false;
            stepping = false;
            DebugChannel::single_step = false;
        }
        void Resume() {
            if (stopped && stop_reason.contains("core") && stop_reason["reason"] == "breakpoint") {
                skip_core = stop_reason["core"];
                skip_pc = system.GetCore(skip_core).GetPC();
            }
            stopped = false;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < system.GetNumCores(); ++i) system.GetCore(i).ClearBreakFlag();
        }
        void Stop(const char* reason, Json data) {
            if (stopped) return;
            stopped = true;
            data["reason"] = reason;
            stop_reason = data;
            for (u32 i = 0; i < system.GetNumCores(); ++i) {
                system.GetCore(i).SetBreakFlag();
                system.GetCore(i).PrepareReschedule();
            }
            Record("stopped", data);
        }
        void Record(const char* kind, Json data) {
            data["kind"] = kind;
            data["sequence"] = ++event_sequence;
            data["guest_ticks"] = system.IsPoweredOn() ? system.CoreTiming().GetGlobalTicks() : 0;
            if (events.size() == 1024) { events.pop_front(); ++events_lost; }
            events.push_back(data);
            if (notification) notification(data);
        }
        Json Stream(const Json& p, bool logs) {
            const auto after = p.at("after").get<u64>();
            const auto limit = p.at("limit").get<u32>();
            if (!limit || limit > 128) throw std::invalid_argument("stream limit 1..128");
            Json result = Json::array();
            for (const auto& event : events) {
                if (event["sequence"].get<u64>() <= after) continue;
                if (logs && event["kind"] != "guest_log" && event["kind"] != "hio_stdout") continue;
                result.push_back(event);
                if (result.size() == limit) break;
            }
            return {{"events", result}, {"lost_total", events_lost}, {"latest", event_sequence}};
        }
        bool IsStopped() const { return stopped; }
        Json StopReason() const { return stop_reason; }
        std::function<void(const Json&)> notification;
    #endif
    
        Json SettingsSnapshot() {
            Json result = Json::object();
            for (auto& b : bindings) result[b.name] = b.get();
            return result;
        }
        Json Registers(u32 id) {
            if (id >= system.GetNumCores()) throw std::invalid_argument("invalid core");
            auto& core = system.GetCore(id);
            Core::ARM_Interface::ThreadContext context;
            core.SaveContext(context);
            const auto thread = system.Kernel().GetThreadManager(id).GetCurrentThread();
            return {{"core", id}, {"registers", context.cpu_registers}, {"cpsr", context.cpsr},
                    {"vfp", context.fpu_registers}, {"fpscr", context.fpscr}, {"fpexc", context.fpexc},
                    {"thread", thread ? thread->thread_id : 0}, {"mode", context.cpsr & 31},
                    {"safe_point", true}, {"spsr_available", false}};
        }
        void CheckMemory(u32 address, size_t length) {
            const auto process = system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess();
            if (!process || !length || length > 4096 || u64(address) + length > 0x100000000ull)
                throw std::invalid_argument("invalid memory range");
            for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
                const auto addr = address + static_cast<u32>(i);
                const auto vma = process->vm_manager.FindVMA(addr);
                if (vma == process->vm_manager.vma_map.end() ||
                    vma->second.meminfo_state == Kernel::MemoryState::IO ||
                    !system.Memory().IsValidVirtualAddress(*process, addr))
                    throw std::invalid_argument("unmapped or MMIO memory");
            }
        }
        std::vector<u8> Read(u32 address, size_t length) {
            CheckMemory(address, length);
            std::vector<u8> bytes(length);
            system.Memory().ReadBlock(*system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess(), address, bytes.data(), length);
            return bytes;
        }
        void Write(u32 address, const std::vector<u8>& bytes) {
            CheckMemory(address, bytes.size());
            system.Memory().WriteBlock(*system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess(), address,
                                       bytes.data(), bytes.size());
            system.InvalidateCacheRange(address, bytes.size());
        }
        Json Dispatch(const Json& p, const std::string& state) {
            const auto op = p.at("operation").get<std::string>();
            if (op == "settings_list") {
                Json result = Json::array();
                for (auto& b : bindings)
                    result.push_back({{"name", b.name}, {"type", b.get().type_name()},
                        {"default", b.defaults()}, {"value", b.get()}, {"apply", b.apply},
                        {"consumer_sources", b.source}});
                return {{"settings", result}};
            }
            if (op == "settings_diff") {
                Json result = Json::object();
                for (auto& b : bindings)
                    if (b.get() != b.defaults()) result[b.name] = {{"stock", b.defaults()}, {"value", b.get()}};
                return {{"diff", result}};
            }
            if (op == "settings_get" || op == "settings_set") {
                const auto name = p.at("name").get<std::string>();
                auto it = std::find_if(bindings.begin(), bindings.end(),
                                      [&](const auto& b) { return name == b.name; });
                if (it == bindings.end()) throw std::invalid_argument("unknown setting");
                if (op == "settings_set") {
                    if (system.IsPoweredOn() && std::string{it->apply} != "live")
                        throw std::invalid_argument("boot setting requires an unloaded session");
                    const auto& value = p.at("value");
                    if ((name == "use_gdbstub" || name == "enable_rpc_server" ||
                         name == "use_custom_storage") && value != false)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("worker settings cannot enable external listeners or storage");
                    if (name == "output_type" && value != 6)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("worker audio must use its bounded sink");
    #ifndef ENABLE_VULKAN
                    if (name == "graphics_api" && value != 0)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("renderer not compiled");
    #else
                    if (name == "graphics_api" && value != 0 && value != 2)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("worker supports software and Vulkan");
    #endif
                    it->set(value);
                    if (system.IsPoweredOn()) system.ApplySettings();
                }
                return {{"name", name}, {"value", it->get()}, {"apply", it->apply}};
            }
            if (!system.IsPoweredOn()) throw std::runtime_error("load content first");
            const bool paused = state == "paused";
            Json result;
            if (op == "registers") result = Registers(p.at("core").get<u32>());
            else if (op == "read_memory")
                result = {{"address", p.at("address")}, {"bytes", Read(p.at("address"), p.at("length"))}};
            else if (op == "threads" || op == "processes") {
                Json processes = Json::array(), threads = Json::array(), waits = Json::array();
                for (const auto& process : system.Kernel().GetProcessList()) {
                    processes.push_back({{"id", process->process_id}, {"name", process->GetName()},
                                         {"status", static_cast<int>(process->status)}});
                    for (const auto& thread : process->GetThreadList()) {
                        threads.push_back({{"id", thread->thread_id}, {"process", process->process_id},
                            {"name", thread->name}, {"core", thread->processor_id},
                            {"status", static_cast<int>(thread->status)}, {"priority", thread->current_priority},
                            {"pc_saved", thread->context.cpu_registers[15]},
                            {"suspended", !thread->CanSchedule()}, {"wait_address", thread->wait_address}});
                        for (const auto& object : thread->wait_objects) {
                            u32 owner = 0;
                            if (auto mutex = Kernel::DynamicObjectCast<Kernel::Mutex>(object))
                                if (mutex->holding_thread) owner = mutex->holding_thread->thread_id;
                            waits.push_back({{"thread", thread->thread_id}, {"object", object->GetObjectId()},
                                {"type", object->GetTypeName()}, {"name", object->GetName()}, {"owner_thread", owner}});
                        }
                    }
                }
                result = {{"processes", processes}, {"threads", threads}, {"wait_edges", waits}};
            } else if (op == "memory_map") {
                Json regions = Json::array();
                for (const auto& process : system.Kernel().GetProcessList())
                    for (const auto& [base, vma] : process->vm_manager.vma_map)
                        if (vma.type != Kernel::VMAType::Free)
                            regions.push_back({{"process", process->process_id}, {"address", base},
                                {"length", vma.size}, {"permissions", static_cast<u32>(vma.permissions)},
                                {"state", static_cast<u32>(vma.meminfo_state)}});
                result = {{"regions", regions}};
            } else if (op == "perf") {
                const auto stats = system.GetLastPerfStats();
                result = {{"host_seconds", {{"vblank", stats.time_vblank_interval}, {"svc", stats.time_hle_svc},
                    {"ipc", stats.time_hle_ipc}, {"gpu", stats.time_gpu}, {"swap", stats.time_swap}}},
                    {"system_fps", stats.system_fps}, {"game_fps", stats.game_fps},
                    {"speed_ratio", stats.emulation_speed}};
            } else {
    #ifndef CTR_EXPERIMENTAL
                throw std::runtime_error("operation requires CITnLO experimental backend");
    #else
                if (op == "events" || op == "logs") return Stream(p, op == "logs");
                if (op == "trace") { trace_svc = p.at("enabled"); return {{"enabled", trace_svc}}; }
                if (!paused) throw std::invalid_argument("mutation requires paused execution");
    
                if (op == "events" || op == "logs") return Stream(p, op == "logs");
                if (op == "trace") { trace_svc = p.at("enabled"); return {{"svc_trace", trace_svc}}; }
                if (op == "breakpoints") {
                    Json result = Json::array();
                    for (const auto& [id, bp] : breakpoints)
                        result.push_back({{"id", id}, {"address", bp.address}, {"length", bp.length},
                                          {"kind", bp.kind}, {"hits", bp.hits}});
                    return {{"breakpoints", result}, {"execution_mode", "instruction_step_when_armed"},
                            {"watchpoint_precision", "instruction_completed"}, {"maximum", 64}};
                }
                if (op == "breakpoint_set") {
                    if (breakpoints.size() >= 64) throw std::invalid_argument("64-breakpoint cap");
                    const auto address = p.at("address").get<u32>(), length = p.at("length").get<u32>();
                    const auto kind = p.at("kind").get<std::string>();
                    if (!length || length > 65536 || u64(address)+length > 0x100000000ull ||
                        (kind != "execute" && kind != "read" && kind != "write" && kind != "access"))
                        throw std::invalid_argument("invalid breakpoint");
                    if (kind == "execute" && length != 2 && length != 4)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("invalid execution width");
                    if (kind != "execute")
                        system.Memory().RegisterWatchpoint(*system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess(), address, length);
                    const auto id = ++next_breakpoint;
                    breakpoints.emplace(id, Breakpoint{address, length, kind, 0});
                    DebugChannel::single_step = true;
                    return {{"id", id}, {"execution_mode", "instruction_step_when_armed"},
                            {"cost", "high; single instruction dispatch while any breakpoint is armed"}};
                }
                if (op == "breakpoint_remove") {
                    const auto id = p.at("id").get<u64>();
                    auto it = breakpoints.find(id);
                    if (it == breakpoints.end()) throw std::invalid_argument("unknown breakpoint");
                    const auto& bp = it->second;
                    if (bp.kind != "execute")
                        system.Memory().UnregisterWatchpoint(*system.Kernel().GetCurrentProcess(), bp.address, bp.length);
                    breakpoints.erase(it);
                    DebugChannel::single_step = !breakpoints.empty();
                    return {{"removed", id}};
                }
                if (op == "step") {
                    const auto id = p.at("core").get<u32>(), count = p.at("count").get<u32>();
                    if (id >= system.GetNumCores() || count == 0 || count > 100000)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("invalid step bounds");
                    Resume();
                    stepping = true;
                    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(2);
                    u32 done = 0;
                    try {
                        for (; done < count && !stopped && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline; ++done)
                            if (!system.DebugStep(id)) break;
                    } catch (...) { stepping = false; throw; }
                    stepping = false;
                    if (!stopped) Stop("step", {{"core", id}, {"instructions", done}});
                    auto result = Registers(id);
                    result["instructions"] = done;
                    result["other_cores"] = "held";
                    result["stop"] = StopReason();
                    return result;
                }
    
                if (op == "write_memory") {
                    Write(p.at("address"), p.at("bytes").get<std::vector<u8>>());
                    result = {{"written", p.at("bytes").size()}, {"jit_invalidated", true}};
                } else if (op == "write_register") {
                    auto core_id = p.at("core").get<u32>();
                    if (core_id >= system.GetNumCores()) throw std::invalid_argument("invalid core");
                    auto& core = system.GetCore(core_id);
                    const auto index = p.at("register").get<u32>(), value = p.at("value").get<u32>();
                    if (index < 16) core.SetReg(index, value);
                    else if (index == 16) core.SetCPSR(value);
                    else if (index < 81) core.SetVFPReg(index - 17, value);
                    else throw std::invalid_argument("invalid register");
                    core.ClearInstructionCache();
                    result = Registers(core_id);
                } else if (op == "suspend") {
                    const bool suspended = p.at("suspended").get<bool>();
                    for (const auto& process : system.Kernel().GetProcessList())
                        for (const auto& thread : process->GetThreadList())
                            if (p.at("thread").is_null() || thread->thread_id == p.at("thread").get<u32>()) {
                                if (suspended) thread->SetUnscheduleMode(Kernel::UnscheduleMode::FRONTEND);
                                else thread->ClearUnscheduleMode(Kernel::UnscheduleMode::FRONTEND);
                            }
                    system.PrepareReschedule();
                    result = {{"suspended", suspended}};
                } else if (op == "save_state" || op == "load_state" || op == "states") {
                    const auto directory = root / "checkpoints";
                    std::filesystem::create_directories(directory);
                    if (op == "states") {
                        Json names = Json::array();
                        for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(directory))
                            if (entry.path().extension() == ".json") names.push_back(entry.path().stem().string());
                        result = {{"states", names}};
                    } else {
                        const auto name = p.at("name").get<std::string>();
                        if (name.empty() || name.size() > 32 ||
                            name.find_first_not_of("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-") != std::string::npos)
                            throw std::invalid_argument("invalid checkpoint name");
                        const auto path = directory / (name + ".bin"), metadata = directory / (name + ".json");
                        if (system.Kernel().AreAsyncOperationsPending())

    impl NativeSession {
        pub async fn spawn(executable: &Path, root: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
            fs::create_dir_all(root)?;
            let root = native_path(root)?;
            let mut worker =
                ControlledWorker::spawn(&WorkerSpec::new(executable, &root), Duration::from_secs(30))
                    .await?;
            let reply = worker.status().await?;
            if reply.backend != "azahar_native_software" {
                worker.stop().await?;
                return Err(io::Error::other("worker lacks native software capability"));
            }
            fs::write(
                root.join("native-manifest.json"),
                serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
                    "protocol": lotus_protocol::protocol_id(), "backend": reply.backend,
                    "source": reply.data["source"], "backend_name": reply.data["backend_name"],
                    "session": reply.session, "pid": worker.pid(), "epoch": reply.epoch,
                    "lifecycle": "active",
                    "profile": "old3ds/software/hle/dsp-muted/ticks-0/time-2000-01-01",
                }))
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?,
            )?;
            let mut session = Self { worker, root, profile_hash: String::new() };
            if reply.data["debug_api"] == true {
                session.refresh_profile().await?;
            }
            Ok(session)
        }
    
        pub async fn debug(&mut self, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand) -> io::Result<Value> {
            command.validate().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            let mut result = self.operation(Method::Debug,
                serde_json::to_value(command).map_err(io::Error::other)?).await?;
            if matches!(command, lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand::SettingsSet { .. }) {
                self.refresh_profile().await?;
            }
            result["profile_hash"] = self.profile_hash.clone().into();
            Ok(result)
        }
    
        pub fn profile_hash(&self) -> &str { &self.profile_hash }
    
        async fn refresh_profile(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
            let schema = self.operation(Method::Debug,
                serde_json::json!({"operation": "settings_list"})).await?;
            let mut values = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
            for setting in schema["settings"].as_array().ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("invalid settings schema"))? {
                let name = setting["name"].as_str().ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("invalid setting name"))?;
                values.insert(name, setting["value"].clone());
            }
            self.profile_hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(serde_json::to_vec(&values).map_err(io::Error::other)?));
            let path = self.root.join("native-manifest.json");
            let mut manifest: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            manifest["profile_hash"] = self.profile_hash.clone().into();
            manifest["settings"] = serde_json::to_value(values).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            fs::write(path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(io::Error::other)?)?;
            Ok(())
        }

        }

    Use one small PR per ticket unless two changes are tightly inseparable. `INT` = `integration` (AZAHAR), `EXP` = `experimental` (CITnLO), `RUST` = LOTUS. Every PR links its regression test and source SHA. Current implementation and remaining acceptance checks are recorded in [25 — Wave status](25-wave-status.md); tickets below retain their original requirements.
    
    ## Wave 0 — pin sources and reduce integration risk
    
    ### T00 [RUST] Repository skeleton and toolchain lock
    
    **Deliver:** Cargo workspace, empty crates, `rust-toolchain.toml`, source-version manifest, CI format/check. **Check:** `cargo test --workspace` passes; no network downloads at runtime. **Avoid:** implementing service APIs before machine boundary is known.
    
    ### T01 [INT] Fork/worktree policy and stock baseline
    
    **Deliver:** `integration` branch from selected upstream SHA, `experimental` from integration, immutable stock checkout; patch inventory; build matrix. **Check:** stock Azahar builds and launches homebrew fixture; revisions recorded. **Avoid:** moving branches as build inputs without pinned hashes.
    
    ### T02 [RUST] GPUI screen spike, no emulator
