        pub fn subscribe(&self) -> tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver<serde_json::Value> {
            self.events.subscribe()
        }
    
        /// Query the worker without any GUI dependencies.
        pub async fn status(&mut self) -> io::Result<Reply> {
            self.request(Method::Status).await
        }
    
        /// Complete shutdown and reap; kill on any failed exchange or exit deadline.
        pub async fn stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.request(Method::Stop).await?;
            match tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, self.child.wait()).await {
                Ok(Ok(status)) if status.success() => {
                    self.state = SessionState::Stopped;
                    self.release_resources();
                    Ok(())
                }
                _ => {
                    self.fail().await;
                    Err(io::Error::other("worker failed to exit cleanly"))
                }
            }
        }
    
        async fn fail(&mut self) {
            self.state = SessionState::Crashed;
            let _ = self.child.kill().await;
            let _ = self.child.wait().await;
            self.release_resources();
        }
    
        /// Terminate this worker and its contained descendants; retain logs.
        pub async fn abort(&mut self) {
            self.fail().await;
        }
    
        fn release_resources(&mut self) {
            #[cfg(windows)]
            {
                self.job.take();
            }
            self.root_lock.take();
        }
    
        pub async fn command(
            &mut self,
            method: Method,
            params: serde_json::Value,
        ) -> io::Result<Reply> {
            if matches!(self.state, SessionState::Stopped | SessionState::Crashed) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe,
                    "worker is no longer active",
                ));
            }
            let request = Request {
                version_major: lotus_protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION_MAJOR,
                version_minor: lotus_protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION_MINOR,
                request_id: self.next_request,
                session: self.session.clone(),
                epoch: self.epoch,
                method,
                params,
            };
            self.next_request = self
                .next_request
                .checked_add(1)
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("request ID exhausted"))?;
            let result = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, self.exchange(&request)).await;
            let reply = match result {
                Ok(Ok(reply)) => reply,
                Ok(Err(error)) => {
                    self.fail().await;
                    return Err(error);
                }
                Err(_) => {
                    self.fail().await;
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                        "worker exchange deadline exceeded; result unknown",
                    ));
                }
            };
            if !lotus_protocol::is_compatible(reply.version_major, reply.version_minor)
                || reply.request_id != request.request_id
                || reply.session != self.session
                || reply.epoch
                    != self.epoch
                        + u64::from(
                            matches!(method, Method::Load | Method::Reset)
                                && reply.status == Status::Ok,
                        )
                || !matches!(
                    reply.state.as_str(),
                    "idle" | "running" | "paused" | "stopped"
                )
            {
                self.fail().await;
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "invalid worker reply identity, epoch, status or state",
                ));
            }
            self.epoch = reply.epoch;
            self.state = match reply.state.as_str() {
                "running" => SessionState::Running,
                "paused" => SessionState::Paused,
                "stopped" => SessionState::Stopped,
                _ => SessionState::Idle,
            };
            Ok(reply)
        }
    
        async fn request(&mut self, method: Method) -> io::Result<Reply> {
            let reply = self.command(method, serde_json::Value::Null).await?;
            if reply.status != Status::Ok {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                    "worker rejected {method:?}: {:?}",
                    reply.status
                )));
            }
            Ok(reply)
        }
    
        async fn exchange(&mut self, request: &Request) -> io::Result<Reply> {
            self.input.write_all(&control::encode(request)?).await?;
            self.input.flush().await?;
            self.output.recv().await.ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe, "worker output closed"))?
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for ControlledWorker {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            self.reader.abort();
            let _ = self.child.start_kill();
            self.release_resources();
        }
    }

    //! MCP tools over a shared [`Supervisor`].
    //!
    //! The same server runs headless (`lotus-mcp`) or inside the desktop
    //! (`lotus-desktop --mcp`); both frontends then drive the same sessions with
    //! the same tools. Every per-session tool takes the session ID, so sessions
    //! are addressed independently and run concurrently.

    };

    /// Which frontend hosts this server; reported to clients.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum Frontend {
        Headless,
        Windowed,
    }
    
    impl Frontend {
        fn name(self) -> &'static str {
            match self {
                Frontend::Headless => "headless",
                Frontend::Windowed => "windowed",
            }
        }
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct LotusServer {
        tool_router: ToolRouter<Self>,
        host: Option<Arc<Supervisor>>,
        frontend: Frontend,
        scenarios: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
    }
    
    impl Default for LotusServer {
        fn default() -> Self {
            Self::new()
        }
    }
    
    impl LotusServer {
        /// Status-only server: cannot spawn workers or read files.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn new() -> Self {
            Self {
                tool_router: Self::tool_router(),
                host: None,
                frontend: Frontend::Headless,
                scenarios: BTreeMap::new(),
            }
        }
    
        /// Headless server owning a new supervisor.
        pub fn configured(
            config: HostConfig,
            scenarios: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        ) -> io::Result<Self> {
            Ok(Self::shared(
                Arc::new(Supervisor::new(config)?),
                Frontend::Headless,
                scenarios,
            ))
        }
    
        /// Server over a supervisor another frontend also drives.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn shared(
            host: Arc<Supervisor>,
            frontend: Frontend,
            scenarios: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        ) -> Self {
            Self {
                tool_router: Self::tool_router(),
                host: Some(host),
                frontend,
                scenarios,
            }
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn host(&self) -> Option<&Arc<Supervisor>> {
            self.host.as_ref()
        }
    
        pub async fn resource_bytes(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            self.require_host()?.read_artifact(uri)
        }
    
        fn require_host(&self) -> io::Result<&Supervisor> {
            self.host.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                    "native host is not configured",
                )
            })
        }
    }
    
    fn tool_result(value: io::Result<Value>) -> CallToolResult {
        match value {
            Ok(value) => CallToolResult::success(vec![ContentBlock::text(value.to_string())]),
            Err(error) => CallToolResult::error(vec![ContentBlock::text(error.to_string())]),
        }
    }
    
    fn json<T: serde::Serialize>(value: &T) -> io::Result<Value> {
        serde_json::to_value(value).map_err(io::Error::other)
    }
    
    fn resource(artifact: &Artifact) -> Resource {
        Resource::new(&artifact.uri, &artifact.screen)
            .with_mime_type("application/octet-stream")
            .with_size(artifact.bytes as u64)
            .with_description(format!(
                "Native BGRA8 {}x{}, SHA-256 {}",
                artifact.width, artifact.height, artifact.sha256
            ))
    }

                        let directory = path.parent().unwrap_or(std::path::Path::new("."));

                            lotus_runner::execution::repeat(

                            .get(2)

                        let scenario = Scenario::load(path)
                            .with_context(|| format!("cannot load scenario {path}"))?;

                            .validate()
                            .with_context(|| format!("scenario {path} is invalid"))?;

                    }
                    _ => {
                        println!("{USAGE}");

                    }
                }
            }
            "help" | "--help" | "-h" => println!("{USAGE}"),
            other => {
                println!("{USAGE}");
                bail!("unknown command: {other}");
            }
        }
    
        Ok(())

    /// Load the pinned revision manifest.
    fn load_pins() -> Result<Pins> {

            .with_context(|| format!("cannot read {}", path.display()))?;
        toml::from_str(&text).with_context(|| format!("cannot parse {}", path.display()))

    /// Location of the pinned revision manifest.
    fn pins_path() -> PathBuf {
        // The manifest lives in the repository root. Walk up from the crate
        // directory so the CLI works from a source checkout and from a build
        // directory inside the repository.
        let manifest = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
        let mut root = manifest.as_path();
        while let Some(parent) = root.parent() {
            if parent.join("config").join("pins.toml").is_file() {
                return parent.join("config").join("pins.toml");
            }
            root = parent;
        }
        manifest.join("../../config/pins.toml")
    }

        /// Load approved content, replacing what was loaded. Leaves the session paused.
        pub async fn load(&self, id: &str, asset: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            native.load(&content).await?;
            lock(&handle.info).asset = Some(asset.to_string());
            handle.record(actor, "load");
            Ok(handle.info())
        }
    
        /// Run continuously: the pump re-issues bounded runs until paused.
        pub async fn run(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if handle.info().asset.is_none() {
                return Err(io::Error::other("load content before running"));
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if native.state() == SessionState::Paused {
                native.run().await?;
            }
            handle.set_playing(true);
            handle.record(actor, "run");
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn pause(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.record(actor, "pause");
            native.pause().await
        }
    
        /// Advance exactly `frames` (1–600) and stay paused.
        pub async fn advance(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            frames: u16,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, &format!("run_until {frames}"));
            native.advance(frames).await
        }
    
        pub async fn reset(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, "reset");
            native.reset().await
        }

            owner: &str,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if actor != Actor::Desktop {
                handle.record(actor, "input");
            }
            native.input(state, owner).await
        }
    
        /// End a session. Secondary guest data is deleted; primary data persists.
        pub async fn stop(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "stop");
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let result = if native.state().is_active() {
                match tokio::time::timeout(CLOSE_DEADLINE, native.stop()).await {
                    Ok(result) => result,
                    Err(_) => {
                        native.abort().await;
                        Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "worker stop deadline; terminated"))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Ok(())
            };
            let end = if result.is_ok() && native.state() == SessionState::Stopped {
                ScratchEnd::Clean
            } else {
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal
            };
            drop(native);
            {
                let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
                registry.sessions.remove(id);
                registry.mounted.retain(|_, owner| owner != id);
            }

    //! Supervisor for a single inherited private pipe connection.
    //!
    //! All exchanges are serialized by mutable ownership. A failed or timed-out
    //! exchange destroys the connection: a possibly committed request is never retried.
    use std::fs::{self, File};
    use std::io;
    
    use std::process::Stdio;

    use lotus_protocol::control::{self, Method, Reply, Request, Status};

    use tokio::process::{Child, ChildStdin, ChildStdout, Command};
    
    use crate::{SessionState, WorkerSpec};
    
    /// Owns the child and its unshared pipe ends. Drop kills the direct child.
    #[derive(Debug)]
    pub struct ControlledWorker {
        child: Child,
        input: ChildStdin,
        output: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<io::Result<Reply>>,
        events: tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<serde_json::Value>,
        reader: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
        session: String,
        next_request: u64,
        epoch: u64,
        state: SessionState,
        timeout: Duration,
        root_lock: Option<File>,
        #[cfg(windows)]
        job: Option<crate::process_job::ProcessJob>,
    }
    
    impl ControlledWorker {
        /// Launch, retain stderr locally, and complete a bounded handshake.
        pub async fn spawn(spec: &WorkerSpec, timeout: Duration) -> io::Result<Self> {
            if timeout.is_zero() || timeout > Duration::from_secs(30) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                    "timeout must be in (0, 30s]",
                ));
            }
            fs::create_dir_all(&spec.storage_root)?;
            let root_lock = File::options()
                .create(true)
                .truncate(false)
                .read(true)
                .write(true)
                .open(spec.storage_root.join("worker.lock"))?;
            root_lock.try_lock().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            let stderr = File::create(spec.storage_root.join("worker.stderr.log"))?;
            let mut command = Command::new(&spec.executable);
            command
                .args(&spec.args)
                .envs(spec.env.iter().cloned())
                .env("LOTUS_STORAGE_ROOT", &spec.storage_root)
                .stdin(Stdio::piped())
                .stdout(Stdio::piped())
                .stderr(stderr)
                .kill_on_drop(true);
            #[cfg(windows)]
            command.creation_flags(0x0800_0004);
            let mut child = command.spawn()?;
            #[cfg(windows)]
            let job = match crate::process_job::ProcessJob::attach_and_resume(
                child.id().expect("new child has PID"),
            ) {
                Ok(job) => job,
                Err(error) => {
                    let _ = child.kill().await;
                    return Err(error);
                }
            };
            let input = child
                .stdin
                .take()
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("missing child stdin"))?;
            let output = child
                .stdout
                .take()
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("missing child stdout"))?;
            let session = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
            let (replies, output_receiver) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(16);
            let (events, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(256);
            let event_sender = events.clone();
            let expected_session = session.clone();
            let reader = tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut output = output;
                loop {
                    let frame = read_frame(&mut output).await;
                    match frame {
                        Ok(value) if value.get("notification") == Some(&serde_json::Value::Bool(true)) => {
                            if value["session"].as_str() != Some(expected_session.as_str()) ||
                               value["version_major"] != 1 || !value["epoch"].is_u64() {
                                let _ = replies.send(Err(io::Error::other("invalid event identity"))).await;
                                break;
                            }
                            let _ = event_sender.send(value);
                        }
                        value => {
                            let reply = value.and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value::<Reply>(v).map_err(io::Error::other));
                            let failed = reply.is_err();
                            if replies.send(reply).await.is_err() || failed { break; }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
            let mut worker = Self {
                child,
                input,
                output: output_receiver,
                events,
                reader,
                session,
                next_request: 1,
                epoch: 1,
                state: SessionState::Created,
                timeout,
                root_lock: Some(root_lock),
                #[cfg(windows)]
                job: Some(job),
            };
            let hello = worker.command(Method::Hello, serde_json::json!({"notifications": true})).await?;
            if hello.status != Status::Ok { return Err(io::Error::other("worker rejected handshake")); }
            worker.state = SessionState::Idle;
            Ok(worker)
        }

    //! Opt-in loopback RSP adapter. All target operations use the shared debug lease.
    use std::{collections::BTreeMap, io, net::SocketAddr, sync::Arc};
    use lotus_protocol::{debug::{BreakpointKind, DebugCommand as D}, envelope::SessionUuid};
    use lotus_session::supervisor::Supervisor;
    use serde_json::Value;
    use tokio::{io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt}, net::{TcpListener, TcpStream}};
    
    const MAX_PACKET: usize = 16_384;
    
    pub struct Server {
        pub address: SocketAddr,
        task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
    }
    impl Server {
        pub async fn start(host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, port: u16) -> io::Result<Self> {
            host.require_control()?;
            host.summary(&session)?;
            let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port)).await?;
            let address = listener.local_addr()?;
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                while let Ok((socket, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                    let owner = format!("gdb:{}", SessionUuid::generate());
                    if host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseAcquire { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await.is_err() {
                        drop(socket);
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut connection = Connection { socket, host: host.clone(), session: session.clone(),
                        owner, no_ack: false, thread: None, core: 0, breakpoints: BTreeMap::new(), last_stop: "S05".into() };
                    let _ = connection.serve().await;
                    // Drop performs cleanup even if the server task was cancelled.
                }
            });
            Ok(Self { address, task })
        }
    }
    impl Drop for Server { fn drop(&mut self) { self.task.abort(); } }
    
    struct Connection {
        socket: TcpStream,
        host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, owner: String,
        no_ack: bool, thread: Option<u32>, core: u32,
        breakpoints: BTreeMap<(u32, u32, u32), u64>, last_stop: String,
    }
    impl Drop for Connection {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let host = self.host.clone(); let session = self.session.clone(); let owner = self.owner.clone();
            let ids: Vec<_> = self.breakpoints.values().copied().collect();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::Pause, &owner).await;
                for id in ids { let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::BreakpointRemove { id }, &owner).await; }
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::HioForward { enabled: false }, &owner).await;
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseRelease { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await;
            });
        }
    }
    impl Connection {
        async fn debug(&self, command: D) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.host.debug_as(&self.session, &command, &self.owner).await
        }
        async fn serve(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.debug(D::Pause).await?;
            self.debug(D::HioForward { enabled: true }).await?;
            loop {
                let packet = read_packet(&mut self.socket, self.no_ack).await?;
                let detach = packet == b"D" || packet.starts_with(b"D;");
                let kill = packet == b"k" || packet.starts_with(b"vKill;");
                let reply = self.handle(&packet).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| b"E01".to_vec());
                if kill {
                    let _ = self.host.stop(&self.session, lotus_session::telemetry::Actor::Host).await;
                    if packet.starts_with(b"vKill;") { write_packet(&mut self.socket, &reply).await?; }
                    return Ok(());
                }
                write_packet(&mut self.socket, &reply).await?;
                if packet == b"QStartNoAckMode" { self.no_ack = true; }
                if detach { return Ok(()); }
            }
        }
        async fn handle(&mut self, packet: &[u8]) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            // Binary X packets must be handled before interpreting UTF-8.
            if packet.first() == Some(&b'X') {
                let split = packet.iter().position(|b| *b == b':').ok_or_else(bad)?;
                let (address, length) = pair(std::str::from_utf8(&packet[1..split]).map_err(|_| bad())?, ',')?;
                if packet.len()-split-1 != length as usize { return Err(bad()); }
                self.debug(D::WriteMemory { address, bytes: packet[split+1..].to_vec() }).await?;

        async fn select_action_thread(&mut self, p: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            if let Some((_, id)) = p.split_once(':') {
                let id = number(id)?;
                let r = self.debug(D::Threads).await?;
                let thread = r["threads"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)?.iter().find(|t| t["id"] == id).ok_or_else(bad)?;
                self.core = thread["core"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32;
                self.thread = Some(id);
            }
            if let Some(thread) = self.thread {
                let r = self.debug(D::Registers { core: self.core }).await?;
                if r["thread"] != thread { return Err(io::Error::other("selected thread is not scheduled on this core")); }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        async fn continue_until_stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let mut events = self.host.subscribe(&self.session).await?;
            self.debug(D::Continue).await?;
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    event = events.recv() => {
                        let event = event.map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                        if event["data"]["kind"] != "stopped" { continue; }
                        let stop = &event["data"];
                        if stop["reason"] == "frame" {
                            self.debug(D::Continue).await?;
                            continue;
                        }
                        if stop["reason"] == "hio" {
                            write_packet(&mut self.socket, stop["packet"].as_str().ok_or_else(bad)?.as_bytes()).await?;
                            loop {
                                let request = read_packet(&mut self.socket, self.no_ack).await?;
                                if request.first() == Some(&b'F') {
                                    let s = std::str::from_utf8(&request[1..]).map_err(|_| bad())?;
                                    let mut fields = s.split(',');
                                    let result = fields.next().ok_or_else(bad)?;
                                    let value = if let Some(v) = result.strip_prefix('-') { -(i64::from_str_radix(v,16).map_err(|_| bad())?) } else { i64::from_str_radix(result,16).map_err(|_| bad())? };
                                    let errno = fields.next().map(number).transpose()?.unwrap_or(0);
                                    self.debug(D::HioReply { value, errno, interrupted: fields.next() == Some("C") }).await?;
                                    break;
                                }
                                let reply = Box::pin(self.handle(&request)).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| b"E01".to_vec());
                                write_packet(&mut self.socket, &reply).await?;
                            }
                            self.debug(D::Continue).await?;
                            continue;
                        }
                        self.last_stop = stop_reply(stop);
                        return Ok(self.last_stop.as_bytes().to_vec());
                    }
                    byte = self.socket.read_u8() => {
                        match byte? { 3 => { self.debug(D::Pause).await?; self.last_stop = "S02".into(); return Ok(b"S02".to_vec()); }, b'+'|b'-' => {}, _ => return Err(bad()) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        async fn transfer(&self, p: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let fields: Vec<_> = p.split(':').collect();
            if fields.len() != 5 || fields[2] != "read" { return Ok(Vec::new()); }
            let (offset, length) = pair(fields[4], ',')?;
            if length == 0 || length > 4096 { return Err(bad()); }
            let document = match fields[1] {
                "features" if fields[3] == "target.xml" => target_xml(),
                "threads" => {
                    let r = self.debug(D::Threads).await?;
                    let mut xml = String::from("<threads>");
                    for t in r["threads"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)? {
                        xml += &format!("<thread id=\"{:x}\" core=\"{}\" name=\"{}\"/>", t["id"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)?, t["core"], escape_xml(t["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("")));
                    }
                    xml + "</threads>"
                },
                "osdata" => {
                    if fields[3].is_empty() { "<osdata type=\"types\"><item><column name=\"Type\">processes</column><column name=\"Description\">Processes</column></item></osdata>".into() }
                    else if fields[3] == "processes" {
                        let r = self.debug(D::Processes).await?; let mut xml = String::from("<osdata type=\"processes\">");
                        for t in r["processes"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)? { xml += &format!("<item><column name=\"pid\">{}</column><column name=\"command\">{}</column></item>", t["id"], escape_xml(t["name"].as_str().unwrap_or(""))); }
                        xml + "</osdata>"
                    } else { return Ok(Vec::new()); }
                }, _ => return Ok(Vec::new()),
            };
            let bytes = document.as_bytes(); let start = (offset as usize).min(bytes.len()); let end = start.saturating_add(length as usize).min(bytes.len());
            let mut reply = vec![if end == bytes.len() { b'l' } else { b'm' }]; reply.extend_from_slice(&bytes[start..end]); Ok(reply)
        }
    }
    fn stop_reply(stop: &Value) -> String {
        let mut packet = match stop["reason"].as_str().unwrap_or("") {
            "exception" => "T0b".into(), "manual" => "T02".into(), _ => String::from("T05"),
        };
        if let Some(thread) = stop["thread"].as_u64() { packet += &format!("thread:{thread:x};"); }
        if stop["reason"] == "watchpoint" {
            let field = if stop["write"] == true { "watch" } else { "rwatch" };
            if let Some(address) = stop["address"].as_u64() { packet += &format!("{field}:{address:x};"); }
        }
        packet
    }
    fn target_xml() -> String {
        let mut s = String::from("<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><!DOCTYPE target SYSTEM \"gdb-target.dtd\"><target><architecture>arm</architecture><feature name=\"org.gnu.gdb.arm.core\">");
        for i in 0..16 { s += &format!("<reg name=\"{}\" bitsize=\"32\" regnum=\"{i}\" type=\"{}\"/>", match i {13=>"sp".into(),14=>"lr".into(),15=>"pc".into(),_=>format!("r{i}")}, if i==15 {"code_ptr"} else if i==13 {"data_ptr"} else {"uint32"}); }
        s += "<reg name=\"cpsr\" bitsize=\"32\" regnum=\"16\"/></feature><feature name=\"org.gnu.gdb.arm.vfp\">";
        for i in 0..32 { s += &format!("<reg name=\"d{i}\" bitsize=\"64\" type=\"ieee_double\" regnum=\"{}\"/>", 17+i); }
        s + "<reg name=\"fpscr\" bitsize=\"32\" regnum=\"49\"/></feature><feature name=\"org.lotus.arm.system\"><reg name=\"fpexc\" bitsize=\"32\" regnum=\"50\"/></feature></target>"
    }
    fn register_bytes(r: &Value) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        for v in r["registers"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)? { values.push(v.as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32); }
        if values.len()!=16 { return Err(bad()); } values.push(r["cpsr"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32);
        let vfp = r["vfp"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)?; if vfp.len()!=64 { return Err(bad()); }
        for v in vfp { values.push(v.as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32); }
        values.push(r["fpscr"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32); values.push(r["fpexc"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32);
        Ok(values.into_iter().flat_map(u32::to_le_bytes).collect())
    }
    fn register_range(index: u32) -> io::Result<(usize, usize)> { match index { 0..=16 => Ok((index as usize*4,4)),17..=48 => Ok((68+(index as usize-17)*8,8)),49=>Ok((324,4)),50=>Ok((328,4)),_=>Err(bad()) } }
    fn number(s: &str) -> io::Result<u32> { u32::from_str_radix(s,16).map_err(|_| bad()) }
    fn pair(s: &str, separator: char) -> io::Result<(u32,u32)> { let (a,b)=s.split_once(separator).ok_or_else(bad)?; Ok((number(a)?,number(b)?)) }
    fn bad() -> io::Error { io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,"invalid or unsupported RSP request") }
    fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String { bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect() }
    fn unhex(s: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> { if !s.is_ascii() || s.len()%2!=0 || s.len()>8192 { return Err(bad()); } s.as_bytes().chunks_exact(2).map(|b| u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(b).map_err(|_| bad())?,16).map_err(|_| bad())).collect() }
    fn escape_xml(s: &str) -> String { s.replace('&',"&amp;").replace('<',"&lt;").replace('>',"&gt;").replace('"',"&quot;").replace('\'',"&apos;") }
    
    async fn read_packet(socket: &mut TcpStream, no_ack: bool) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        loop {
            let start = socket.read_u8().await?;
            if start==3 { return Ok(vec![3]); }
            if start!=b'$' { continue; }
            let mut payload=Vec::new(); let mut checksum=0u8; let mut escaped=false;
            loop {
                let byte=socket.read_u8().await?;
                if byte==b'#' && !escaped { break; }
                checksum=checksum.wrapping_add(byte);
                if escaped { payload.push(byte^0x20); escaped=false; }
                else if byte==b'}' { escaped=true; } else { payload.push(byte); }
                if payload.len()>MAX_PACKET { return Err(bad()); }
            }
            let mut check=[0u8;2]; socket.read_exact(&mut check).await?;
            if unhex(std::str::from_utf8(&check).map_err(|_| bad())?)? != [checksum] {
                if !no_ack { socket.write_all(b"-").await?; }
                continue;
            }
            if !no_ack { socket.write_all(b"+").await?; }
            return Ok(payload);
        }
    }
    async fn write_packet(socket: &mut TcpStream, payload: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
        let mut packet=vec![b'$']; let mut checksum=0u8;
        for &b in payload {
            if matches!(b,b'$'|b'#'|b'}'|b'*') { packet.push(b'}');packet.push(b^0x20);checksum=checksum.wrapping_add(b'}').wrapping_add(b^0x20); }
            else {packet.push(b);checksum=checksum.wrapping_add(b);}
        }
        packet.extend_from_slice(format!("#{checksum:02x}").as_bytes()); socket.write_all(&packet).await
    }

    /**
     * Send a response indicating an error back to the application.
     *
     * @param error_code The error code to respond back to the app. This typically corresponds to errno.
     *
     * @param retval The return value of the syscall the app requested.
     */
    static void SendErrorReply(int error_code, int retval = -1) {
        auto packet = fmt::format("F{:x},{:x}", retval, error_code);
        SendReply(packet.data());
    }
    
    void SetHioRequest(Core::System& system, Kernel::Process* process, const VAddr addr) {
        if (!IsServerEnabled()) {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "HIO requested but GDB stub is not running");
            return;
        }
    
        if (IsWaitingForHioReply()) {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "HIO requested while already in progress");
            return;
        }
    
        if (HasPendingHioRequest()) {
            LOG_INFO(Debug_GDBStub, "overwriting existing HIO request that was not sent yet");
        }
    
        auto& memory = system.Memory();
    
        if (!memory.IsValidVirtualAddress(*process, addr)) {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "Invalid address for HIO request");
            return;
        }
    
        memory.ReadBlock(*process, addr, &current_hio_request, sizeof(PackedGdbHioRequest));
    
        if (current_hio_request.magic != std::array{'G', 'D', 'B', '\0'}) {
            std::string_view bad_magic{
                current_hio_request.magic.data(),
                current_hio_request.magic.size(),
            };
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "Invalid HIO request sent by application: bad magic '{}'",
                        bad_magic);
    
            current_hio_request_addr = 0;
            current_hio_request = {};
            request_status = Status::NoRequest;
            return;
        }
    
        LOG_DEBUG(Debug_GDBStub, "HIO request initiated at 0x{:X}", addr);
        current_hio_request_addr = addr;
        request_status = Status::NotSent;
    
        // Now halt, so that no further instructions are executed until the request
        // is processed by the client. We will continue after the reply comes back
        Break(SIGTRAP);
        system.GetRunningCore().ClearInstructionCache();
    }
    
    void HandleHioReply(Core::System& system, Kernel::Process* process, const u8* const command_buffer,
                        const u32 command_length) {
        if (!IsWaitingForHioReply()) {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "Got HIO reply but never sent a request");
            return;
        }
    
        // Skip 'F' header
        const u8* command_pos = command_buffer + 1;
    
        if (*command_pos == 0 || *command_pos == ',') {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "bad HIO packet format position 0: {}", *command_pos);
            SendErrorReply(EILSEQ);
            return;
        }
    
        // Set the sign of the retval
        if (*command_pos == '-') {
            command_pos++;
            current_hio_request.retval = -1;
        } else {
            if (*command_pos == '+') {
                command_pos++;
            }
    
            current_hio_request.retval = 1;
        }
    
        const std::string command_str{command_pos, command_buffer + command_length};
        const auto command_parts = Common::SplitString(command_str, ',');
    
        if (command_parts.empty() || command_parts.size() > 3) {
            LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "Unexpected reply packet size: {}", command_parts);
            SendErrorReply(EILSEQ);
            return;
        }
    
        u64 unsigned_retval =
            HexToInt(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(command_parts[0].data()), command_parts[0].size());
        current_hio_request.retval *= unsigned_retval;
    
        if (command_parts.size() > 1) {
            // Technically the errno could be signed but in practice this doesn't happen
            current_hio_request.gdb_errno =
                HexToInt(reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(command_parts[1].data()), command_parts[1].size());

            switch (current_hio_request.param_format[i]) {
            case 'i':
            case 'I':
            case 'p':
                // For pointers and 32-bit ints, truncate down to size before sending
                param = static_cast<u32>(param);
                [[fallthrough]];
    
            case 'l':
            case 'L':
                fmt::format_to(std::back_inserter(packet), ",{:x}", param);
                break;
    
            case 's':
                // strings are written as {pointer}/{length}
                fmt::format_to(std::back_inserter(packet), ",{:x}/{:x}",
                               static_cast<u32>(current_hio_request.parameters[i]),
                               current_hio_request.string_lengths[str_length_idx++]);
                break;
    
            default:
                LOG_WARNING(Debug_GDBStub, "unexpected hio request param format '{}'",
                            current_hio_request.param_format[i]);
                SendErrorReply(EILSEQ);
                return false;
            }
        }
    
        LOG_TRACE(Debug_GDBStub, "HIO request packet: '{}'", packet);
    
        SendReply(packet.data());
        request_status = Status::SentWaitingReply;

        async fn operation(&mut self, method: Method, params: Value) -> io::Result<Value> {
            let Reply { status, data, .. } = self.worker.command(method, params).await?;
            if status != Status::Ok {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!("{method:?}: {status:?}: {data}")));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    }
    
    /// A stale sequence, reset epoch, malformed header or path cannot expose pixels.
    fn read_frame(root: &Path, lease: &FrameLease) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let expected_width = match lease.screen.as_str() {
            "top" => 400,
            "bottom" => 320,
            _ => 0,
        };
        let expected_path = format!("frames/{}-{}.bgra", lease.screen, lease.sequence % 3);
        if expected_width == 0
            || lease.width != expected_width
            || lease.height != 240
            || lease.stride != lease.width * 4
    }

    PresentWindow::PresentWindow(Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window_, const Instance& instance_,
                                 Scheduler& scheduler_, bool low_refresh_rate_)
        : emu_window{emu_window_}, instance{instance_}, scheduler{scheduler_},
          low_refresh_rate{low_refresh_rate_},
          surface{emu_window.GetWindowInfo().type == Frontend::WindowSystemType::Headless
                      ? vk::SurfaceKHR{} : CreateSurface(instance.GetInstance(), emu_window)}, next_surface{surface},
          swapchain{instance, emu_window.GetFramebufferLayout().width,
                    emu_window.GetFramebufferLayout().height, surface, low_refresh_rate_},
          graphics_queue{instance.GetGraphicsQueue()}, present_renderpass{CreateRenderpass()},
          vsync_enabled{Settings::values.use_vsync.GetValue()},
          blit_supported{
              CanBlitToSwapchain(instance.GetPhysicalDevice(), swapchain.GetSurfaceFormat().format)},
          use_present_thread{surface && Settings::values.async_presentation.GetValue()},
          last_render_surface{emu_window.GetWindowInfo().render_surface} {
    
        const u32 num_images = swapchain.GetImageCount();
        const vk::Device device = instance.GetDevice();
    
        const vk::CommandPoolCreateInfo pool_info = {
            .flags = vk::CommandPoolCreateFlagBits::eResetCommandBuffer |
                     vk::CommandPoolCreateFlagBits::eTransient,
            .queueFamilyIndex = instance.GetGraphicsQueueFamilyIndex(),
        };
        command_pool = device.createCommandPool(pool_info);
    
        const vk::CommandBufferAllocateInfo alloc_info = {
            .commandPool = command_pool,
            .level = vk::CommandBufferLevel::ePrimary,
            .commandBufferCount = num_images,
        };
        const std::vector command_buffers = device.allocateCommandBuffers(alloc_info);
    
        swap_chain.resize(num_images);
        for (u32 i = 0; i < num_images; i++) {
            Frame& frame = swap_chain[i];
            frame.cmdbuf = command_buffers[i];
            frame.render_ready = device.createSemaphore({});
            frame.present_done = device.createFence({.flags = vk::FenceCreateFlagBits::eSignaled});
            free_queue.push(&frame);
        }
    
        if (instance.HasDebuggingToolAttached()) {
            for (u32 i = 0; i < num_images; ++i) {
                SetObjectName(device, swap_chain[i].cmdbuf, "Swapchain Command Buffer {}", i);
                SetObjectName(device, swap_chain[i].render_ready,
                              "Swapchain Semaphore: render_ready {}", i);
                SetObjectName(device, swap_chain[i].present_done, "Swapchain Fence: present_done {}",
                              i);
            }
        }
    
        if (use_present_thread) {
            present_thread = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token token) { PresentThread(token); });
        }
    }
    
    PresentWindow::~PresentWindow() {
        scheduler.Finish();
        const vk::Device device = instance.GetDevice();
        // If the window is destroyed before the next_surface is
        // consumed, make sure to destroy it here to prevent a
        // resource leak.
        if (next_surface && next_surface != surface) {
            instance.GetInstance().destroySurfaceKHR(next_surface);
            next_surface = vk::SurfaceKHR{};
        }
        device.destroyCommandPool(command_pool);
        device.destroyRenderPass(present_renderpass);
        for (auto& frame : swap_chain) {
            device.destroyImageView(frame.image_view);
            device.destroyFramebuffer(frame.framebuffer);
            device.destroySemaphore(frame.render_ready);
            device.destroyFence(frame.present_done);
            vmaDestroyImage(instance.GetAllocator(), frame.image, frame.allocation);
        }
    }

    namespace CtrWorker {
    // Three reusable slots. A consumer copies before asking for another capture.
    // No UI acknowledgement or retained guest pointers can stall the core.
    inline nlohmann::json Capture(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root, u64 epoch,
                                  u64 sequence) {
        auto& renderer = system.GPU().Renderer();
        nlohmann::json frames = nlohmann::json::array();
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root / "frames");
        for (const auto& [name, id, width] :
             {std::tuple{"top", VideoCore::ScreenId::TopLeft, 400u},
              std::tuple{"bottom", VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, 320u}}) {
            std::vector<u8> pixels(width * 240 * 4);
            if (Settings::values.graphics_api.GetValue() == Settings::GraphicsAPI::Software) {
                const auto& source = static_cast<SwRenderer::RendererSoftware&>(renderer).Screen(id);
                if (source.width != 240 || source.height != width ||
                    source.pixels.size() != width * 240 * 4)
                    throw std::runtime_error("unsupported framebuffer layout");
                pixels = source.pixels;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < pixels.size(); i += 4) std::swap(pixels[i], pixels[i+2]);
            }
    #ifdef ENABLE_VULKAN
            else {
                auto layout = Layout::SingleFrameLayout(width, 240, id == VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, false);
                layout.render_3d_mode = Settings::StereoRenderOption::Off;
                static_cast<Vulkan::RendererVulkan&>(renderer).CaptureOffscreen(pixels.data(), layout);
            }
    #endif
            const auto relative =
                "frames/" + std::string{name} + "-" + std::to_string(sequence % 3) + ".bgra";
            std::ofstream file{root / relative, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
            file.exceptions(std::ios::failbit | std::ios::badbit);
            // Windows/Linux supported hosts are little endian; wire header uses explicit shifts.
            file.write("LTRF", 4);
            const auto write_le = [&file](u64 value, unsigned bytes) {
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
                    file.put(static_cast<char>(value >> (i * 8)));
            };
            write_le(1, 4);
            write_le(epoch, 8);
            write_le(sequence, 8);
            write_le(width, 4);
            write_le(240, 4);
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(pixels.data()), pixels.size());
            file.close();
            frames.push_back({{"screen", name},
                              {"path", relative},
                              {"epoch", epoch},
                              {"sequence", sequence},
                              {"slot", sequence % 3},
                              {"width", width},
                              {"height", 240},
                              {"stride", width * 4},
                              {"format", "bgra8"},
                              {"orientation", "top_left_row_major"},
                              {"bytes", pixels.size()}});
        }
        return frames;
    }
    } // namespace CtrWorker

        virtual void SwapBuffers() = 0;

        /// specific implementation)
        virtual void TryPresent(int timeout_ms, bool is_secondary) = 0;
        virtual void TryPresent(int timeout_ms) {
            TryPresent(timeout_ms, false);
        }

        virtual void PrepareVideoDumping() {}
    
        /// Cleans up after video dumping is ended
        virtual void CleanupVideoDumping() {}

    """Generate typed native scalar settings bindings from the pinned source.
    Run with the native source root. Output stays in that source worktree.
    Sources are consumer references, not claims that every setting can apply live.

    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import sys
    import json
    
    root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    header = (root / "src/common/settings.h").read_text()
    values = header[header.index("struct Values {"):header.index("extern Values values")]
    pattern = r"(?:Switchable)?Setting<([^;]+?)>\s+(\w+)\s*\{"
    fields = [(m.group(1), m.group(2)) for m in re.finditer(pattern, values)]
    live = {"cpu_clock_percentage", "volume", "frame_limit", "turbo_limit",
            "simulate_headphones_plugged", "factor_3d"}
    consumers = {}
    for directory in ("core", "video_core", "audio_core"):
        for p in sorted((root / "src" / directory).rglob("*.cpp")):
            for line, text in enumerate(p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines(), 1):
                for field in re.findall(r"(?:Settings::)?values\.(\w+)", text):
                    consumers.setdefault(field, []).append(f"{p.relative_to(root).as_posix()}:{line}")
    prefix = r"""// Generated by LOTUS tools/generate-settings.py. Do not edit.
    #pragma once
    #include <functional>

    #include <json.hpp>

    struct SettingBinding {
        const char* name;

        const char* source;
        std::function<SettingsJson()> get;
        std::function<SettingsJson()> defaults;
        std::function<void(const SettingsJson&)> set;
    };
    template<class T> SettingsJson SettingJson(const T& value) {
        if constexpr (std::is_enum_v<T>) return static_cast<std::underlying_type_t<T>>(value);
        else return value;
    }
    template<class S> SettingBinding BindSetting(const char* name, S& setting,
                                                 const char* apply, const char* source) {
        using T = std::decay_t<decltype(setting.GetValue())>;
        return {name, apply, source, [&setting] { return SettingJson(setting.GetValue()); },
            [&setting] { return SettingJson(setting.GetDefault()); },
            [&setting](const SettingsJson& j) {
                if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>) {
                    if (!j.is_boolean()) throw std::invalid_argument("expected boolean");
                } else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T> || std::is_enum_v<T>) {
                    if (!j.is_number_integer()) throw std::invalid_argument("expected integer");
                    if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) {
                        const auto number = j.get<long double>();
                        if (number < std::numeric_limits<T>::lowest() ||
                            number > std::numeric_limits<T>::max())
                            throw std::invalid_argument("integer out of range");
                    }
                } else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
                    if (!j.is_number()) throw std::invalid_argument("expected number");

                    if (!j.is_string() || j.get_ref<const std::string&>().size() > 4096)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("expected bounded string");
                }
                const auto old = setting.GetValue();
                const auto value = j.get<T>();
                setting.SetValue(value);
                if (setting.GetValue() != value) {
                    setting.SetValue(old);
                    throw std::invalid_argument("setting out of range");
                }
            }};
    }
    inline std::vector<SettingBinding> SettingsBindings() {
        std::vector<SettingBinding> result;
    """

        u64 dropped = 0;

        size_t buffered = 0;
    };
    class WorkerSink final : public Sink {
    public:
        inline static std::mutex mutex;
        inline static std::array<s16, 32768> ring{};
        inline static WorkerAudioStats stats;
        unsigned GetNativeSampleRate() const override {
            return native_sample_rate;
        }
        void SetCallback(std::function<void(s16*, std::size_t)>) override {}
        bool ImmediateSubmission() override {
            return true;
        }
        void PushSamples(const void* data, std::size_t count) override {
            const auto* samples = static_cast<const s16*>(data);
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count * 2; ++i) {
                ring[(stats.samples * 2 + i) % ring.size()] = samples[i];
                const auto value = static_cast<u16>(samples[i]);
                stats.hash = (stats.hash ^ (value & 255)) * 1099511628211ull;
                stats.hash = (stats.hash ^ (value >> 8)) * 1099511628211ull;
            }
            stats.samples += count;
            const auto total = stats.buffered + count;
            stats.dropped += total > ring.size() / 2 ? total - ring.size() / 2 : 0;
            stats.buffered = std::min(total, ring.size() / 2);
        }
        static WorkerAudioStats Drain() {
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            const auto snapshot = stats;
            stats.buffered = 0;
            return snapshot;
        }
        static void Reset() {
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            stats = {};
        }
    };

    #include <algorithm>

    namespace AudioCore {
    
    namespace {
    /// Amount of CSND frames to wait until they are outputted on their own
    /// because DSP is not producing any output.
    constexpr u32 CsndFramesBeforeDspIdle = 2;
    /// Max amount of CSND pending samples.
    constexpr std::size_t MaxCsndPendingSamples = samples_per_frame * 4;
    } // namespace
    
    DspInterface::DspInterface(Core::System& system_) : system(system_) {}
    
    DspInterface::~DspInterface() = default;
    
    void DspInterface::SetSink(AudioCore::SinkType sink_type, std::string_view audio_device) {
        // Dispose of the current sink first to avoid contention.
        sink.reset();
    
        sink = AudioCore::GetSinkDetails(sink_type).create_sink(audio_device);
        sink->SetCallback(
            [this](s16* buffer, std::size_t num_frames) { OutputCallback(buffer, num_frames); });
        time_stretcher.SetOutputSampleRate(sink->GetNativeSampleRate());
    }
    
    Sink& DspInterface::GetSink() {
        ASSERT(sink);
        return *sink.get();
    }
    
    void DspInterface::EnableStretching(bool enable) {
        enable_time_stretching = enable;
    }
    
    void DspInterface::OutputFrame(StereoFrame16 frame) {
        std::scoped_lock lock{csnd_mutex};
        MixCsnd(frame);
        PushSamples(frame);
    }
    
    void DspInterface::OutputSample(std::array<s16, 2> sample) {
        std::scoped_lock lock{csnd_mutex};
        MixCsnd({&sample, 1});
        PushSamples({&sample, 1});
    }
    
    void DspInterface::OutputCsndFrame(const StereoFrame16& frame) {
        std::scoped_lock lock{csnd_mutex};
    
        if (dsp_samples_since_csnd_frame == 0) {
            csnd_frames_without_dsp++;
        } else {
            csnd_frames_without_dsp = 0;
        }
        dsp_samples_since_csnd_frame = 0;
    
        csnd_pending.insert(csnd_pending.end(), frame.begin(), frame.end());
    
        if (csnd_frames_without_dsp >= CsndFramesBeforeDspIdle) {
            // The DSP is not running, CSND is the only output.
            const std::vector<std::array<s16, 2>> samples(csnd_pending.begin(), csnd_pending.end());
            csnd_pending.clear();
            PushSamples(samples);
            return;
        }
    
        // The two clocks may drift a little, don't let CSND fall too far behind the DSP output.
        while (csnd_pending.size() > MaxCsndPendingSamples) {
            csnd_pending.pop_front();
        }
    }
    
    void DspInterface::MixCsnd(std::span<std::array<s16, 2>> samples) {
        // TODO(PabloMK7): Implement SIMD mixing here if possible.
        dsp_samples_since_csnd_frame += samples.size();
        for (auto& sample : samples) {
            if (csnd_pending.empty()) {
                break;
            }
            const auto& csnd = csnd_pending.front();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                sample[i] = static_cast<s16>(std::clamp(sample[i] + csnd[i], -0x8000, 0x7FFF));
            }
            csnd_pending.pop_front();
        }
    }
    
    void DspInterface::PushSamples(std::span<const std::array<s16, 2>> samples) {
        if (!sink) {
            return;
        }
    
        if (sink->ImmediateSubmission()) {
            sink->PushSamples(samples.data(), samples.size());
        } else {
            fifo.Push(samples.data(), samples.size());
        }
    
        auto video_dumper = system.GetVideoDumper();
        if (video_dumper && video_dumper->IsDumping()) {
            for (const auto& sample : samples) {
                video_dumper->AddAudioSample(sample);
            }
        }
    }
    
    void DspInterface::DrainFifoBacklog(std::size_t num_frames) {
        // The emulation thread produces a video frame of audio at a time, so the FIFO only needs enough
        // headroom to smooth those bursts. Audio that stays in the FIFO for a whole window without
        // being needed remains queued during a stall or at stream start. That extra data delays all
        // later audio by its length, for the entire session.
        constexpr std::size_t window_frames = native_sample_rate;
        constexpr std::size_t kept_frames = native_sample_rate / 100;
    
        fifo_low_fill = std::min(fifo_low_fill, fifo.Size());
        backlog_window_frames += num_frames;
        if (backlog_window_frames < window_frames) {
            return;
        }
        if (fifo_low_fill > 2 * kept_frames) {
            const std::size_t excess = fifo_low_fill - kept_frames;
            fifo.Pop(excess);
            LOG_DEBUG(Audio, "Dropped {} frames of audio backlog", excess);
        }
        fifo_low_fill = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
        backlog_window_frames = 0;
    }
    
    void DspInterface::OutputCallback(s16* buffer, std::size_t num_frames) {
        // Determine if we should stretch based on the current emulation speed.
        // TODO: Only activate audio stretching when emulation speed goes below 95% threshold
        //       (see #2487) -OS
        if (performing_time_stretching && !enable_time_stretching) {
            // If we just stopped stretching, flush the stretcher before returning to normal output.
            flushing_time_stretcher = true;
        }
        performing_time_stretching = enable_time_stretching.load();
    
        std::size_t frames_written = 0;
        if (performing_time_stretching) {
            const std::vector<s16> in{fifo.Pop()};
            const std::size_t num_in{in.size() / 2};
            frames_written = time_stretcher.Process(in.data(), num_in, buffer, num_frames);
        } else {
            if (flushing_time_stretcher) {
                time_stretcher.Flush();
                frames_written = time_stretcher.Process(nullptr, 0, buffer, num_frames);
                flushing_time_stretcher = false;
    
                // Make sure any frames that did not fit are cleared from the time stretcher,
                // so that they do not bleed into the next time the stretcher is enabled.
                time_stretcher.Clear();
            }
            frames_written += fifo.Pop(buffer, num_frames - frames_written);
            DrainFifoBacklog(num_frames);
        }
    
        if (frames_written > 0) {
            std::memcpy(&last_frame[0], buffer + 2 * (frames_written - 1), 2 * sizeof(s16));
        }
    
        // Hold last emitted frame; this prevents popping.
        for (std::size_t i = frames_written; i < num_frames; i++) {
            std::memcpy(buffer + 2 * i, &last_frame[0], 2 * sizeof(s16));
        }
    
        // Implementation of the hardware volume slider
        // A cubic curve is used to approximate a linear change in human-perceived loudness
        const float linear_volume = std::clamp(Settings::Volume(), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        if (linear_volume != 1.0) {
            const float volume_scale_factor = linear_volume * linear_volume * linear_volume;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < num_frames; i++) {
                buffer[i * 2 + 0] = static_cast<s16>(buffer[i * 2 + 0] * volume_scale_factor);
                buffer[i * 2 + 1] = static_cast<s16>(buffer[i * 2 + 1] * volume_scale_factor);
            }
        }
    }

    #pragma once
    
    #include <memory>

    #include "common/common_types.h"
    
    namespace AudioCore {
    
    class Sink;
    
    enum class SinkType : u32 {
        Auto = 0,
        Null = 1,
        Cubeb = 2,
        OpenAL = 3,
        SDL2 = 4,
        Worker = 6,
    #ifdef HAVE_LIBRETRO
        LibRetro = 5,
    #endif
    };
    
    struct SinkDetails {
        using FactoryFn = std::unique_ptr<Sink> (*)(std::string_view);
        using ListDevicesFn = std::vector<std::string> (*)();
    
        /// Type of this sink.
        SinkType type;
        /// Name for this sink.
        std::string_view name;
        /// A method to call to construct an instance of this type of sink.
        FactoryFn create_sink;
        /// A method to call to list available devices.
        ListDevicesFn list_devices;
    };
    
    /// Lists all available sink types.
    std::vector<SinkDetails> ListSinks();
    
    /// Gets the details of an sink type.
    const SinkDetails& GetSinkDetails(SinkType input_type);

    #include "common/logging/log.h"
    
    namespace AudioCore {
    namespace {
    // sink_details is ordered in terms of desirability, with the best choice at the top.
    constexpr std::array sink_details = {
    #ifdef HAVE_LIBRETRO
        SinkDetails{SinkType::LibRetro, "libretro",
                    [](std::string_view device_id) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> {
                        return std::make_unique<LibRetroSink>(std::string(device_id));
                    },
                    &ListLibretroSinkDevices},
    #endif
    #ifdef HAVE_CUBEB
        SinkDetails{SinkType::Cubeb, "Cubeb",
                    [](std::string_view device_id) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> {
                        return std::make_unique<CubebSink>(device_id);
                    },
                    &ListCubebSinkDevices},
    #endif
    #ifdef HAVE_OPENAL
        SinkDetails{SinkType::OpenAL, "OpenAL",
                    [](std::string_view device_id) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> {
                        return std::make_unique<OpenALSink>(std::string(device_id));
                    },
                    &ListOpenALSinkDevices},
    #endif
    #ifdef HAVE_SDL2
        SinkDetails{SinkType::SDL2, "SDL2",
                    [](std::string_view device_id) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> {
                        return std::make_unique<SDL2Sink>(std::string(device_id));
                    },
                    &ListSDL2SinkDevices},
    #endif
        SinkDetails{SinkType::Null, "None",
                    [](std::string_view device_id) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> {
                        return std::make_unique<NullSink>(device_id);
                    },
                    [] { return std::vector<std::string>{"None"}; }},
    #ifdef CTR_WORKER_AUDIO
        SinkDetails{SinkType::Worker, "Worker muted ring",
                    [](std::string_view) -> std::unique_ptr<Sink> { return std::make_unique<WorkerSink>(); },
                    [] { return std::vector<std::string>{"None"}; }},
    #endif
    };
    } // Anonymous namespace
    
    std::vector<SinkDetails> ListSinks() {
        return {sink_details.begin(), sink_details.end()};
    }
    
    const SinkDetails& GetSinkDetails(SinkType sink_type) {
        auto iter = std::find_if(
            sink_details.begin(), sink_details.end(),
            [sink_type](const auto& sink_detail) { return sink_detail.type == sink_type; });
    
        if (sink_type == SinkType::Auto || iter == sink_details.end()) {
            if (sink_type != SinkType::Auto) {
                LOG_ERROR(Audio, "AudioCore::GetSinkDetails given invalid sink_type {}", sink_type);
            }
            // Auto-select.
            // sink_details is ordered in terms of desirability, with the best choice at the front.
            iter = sink_details.begin();
        }
    
        return *iter;
    }

    //! Local host policy shared by the headless MCP server and the desktop.
    //!
    //! One `Supervisor` owns every session of a LOTUS process. Each session has its
    //! own async lock, so a long bounded run on one session never blocks commands,
    //! status or previews of another. The registry lock is never held across an
    //! await. Desktop and MCP call the same methods; there is one control model.
    //!
    //! Sessions are *primary* (mount a persistent card) or *secondary* (private
    //! scratch copy, discarded on end); see [`crate::card_store`].

    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;

    use tokio::task::JoinSet;
    
    use crate::card_store::{CardStore, ScratchEnd};
    use crate::native_session::{Frame, InputState, NativeSession};
    use crate::telemetry::{Actor, Telemetry};
    use crate::SessionState;
    
    /// Sessions per host unless the configuration raises it; four is the tested load.
    pub const DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS: usize = 4;
    /// Upper bound accepted for `max_sessions`.
    pub const MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT: usize = 16;
    pub const MAX_ARTIFACTS: usize = 128;
    /// Stop deadline per worker when the host closes.
    const CLOSE_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
    
    /// Host configuration, never accepted as a tool-call argument.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct HostConfig {
        pub worker: PathBuf,
        pub storage_root: PathBuf,
        /// Approved content, by handle.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub assets: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        /// Approved directories: every `.3dsx` directly inside is `<handle>/<file>`.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub asset_directories: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub allow_control: bool,
        #[serde(default = "default_max_sessions")]
        pub max_sessions: usize,
        /// Validated worker settings applied before loading content.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub profile: BTreeMap<String, lotus_protocol::debug::SettingValue>,
    }
    
    fn default_max_sessions() -> usize {
        DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS
    }
    
    impl HostConfig {
        /// Configuration with no assets, control denied and the default session limit.
        pub fn new(worker: impl Into<PathBuf>, storage_root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
            Self {
                worker: worker.into(),
                storage_root: storage_root.into(),
                assets: BTreeMap::new(),
                asset_directories: BTreeMap::new(),
                allow_control: false,
                max_sessions: DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS,
                profile: BTreeMap::new(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Whether a session's guest writes persist.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum SessionKind {
        /// Mounts `cards/<card>/`: real, persistent SDMC/NAND reads and writes.
        Primary { card: String },
        /// Private scratch root, empty or copied from `parent`; discarded on end.
        Secondary { parent: Option<String> },
    }
    
    /// Identity of a session as listed by every frontend.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
    pub struct SessionInfo {
        pub id: String,
        #[serde(flatten)]
        pub kind: SessionKind,
        /// Approved handle of the loaded content, if any.
        pub asset: Option<String>,
        pub created_unix_ms: u64,
    }
    
    impl SessionInfo {
        /// Card a session belongs to in the session tree, if any.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn card(&self) -> Option<&str> {
            match &self.kind {

                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => parent.as_deref(),
            }
        }
    }

    }
    
    /// A session's lock domain. Lock order: `native`, then `info` or `telemetry`.
    struct SessionHandle {
        info: Mutex<SessionInfo>,
        root: PathBuf,
        native: tokio::sync::Mutex<NativeSession>,
        telemetry: Mutex<Telemetry>,
        playing: AtomicBool,
        lease: Mutex<Option<String>>,
    }
    
    impl SessionHandle {
        fn info(&self) -> SessionInfo {
            lock(&self.info).clone()
        }
        fn telemetry(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Telemetry> {
            lock(&self.telemetry)
        }
        fn record(&self, actor: Actor, operation: &str) {
            self.telemetry().record(actor, operation);
        }
        fn set_playing(&self, playing: bool) {
            self.playing.store(playing, Ordering::Release);
            self.telemetry().playing = playing;
        }
        fn is_playing(&self) -> bool {
            self.playing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
        }
    }
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Registry {
        sessions: BTreeMap<String, Arc<SessionHandle>>,
        /// Creations in progress, counted against the session limit.
        pending: usize,
        /// Card name to mounting session (or pending creation) ID.
        mounted: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    }
    
    /// No shell execution, arbitrary caller paths or remote listener.
    pub struct Supervisor {

        cards: CardStore,
        registry: Mutex<Registry>,
        artifacts: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, (Artifact, PathBuf)>>,
        /// Content approved interactively by the desktop user.
        local_assets: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>>,
        focus_request: Mutex<Option<String>>,
    }
    
    impl Supervisor {
        pub fn new(mut config: HostConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
            if !(1..=MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT).contains(&config.max_sessions) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                    format!("max_sessions must be in 1..={MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT}"),
                ));
            }
            config.worker = config.worker.canonicalize()?;
            for path in config.assets.values_mut() {
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            for (handle, path) in &mut config.asset_directories {
                if handle.is_empty() || handle.contains(['/', '\\']) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                        "asset directory handles cannot be empty or contain separators",
                    ));
                }
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            fs::create_dir_all(&config.storage_root)?;
            config.storage_root = config.storage_root.canonicalize()?;
            let cards = CardStore::open(&config.storage_root)?;
            Ok(Self {
                config,
                cards,
                registry: Mutex::default(),
                artifacts: Mutex::default(),
                local_assets: Mutex::default(),
                focus_request: Mutex::default(),
            })
        }

        pub fn max_sessions(&self) -> usize {
            self.config.max_sessions
        }

            self.config.allow_control
        }

    class Source final {

         * This is called once every audio frame. This performs per-source processing every frame.
         * @param config The new configuration we've got for this Source from the application.
         * @param adpcm_coeffs ADPCM coefficients to use if config tells us to use them (may contain
         * invalid values otherwise).
         * @return The current status of this Source. This is given back to the emulated application via
         * SharedMemory.
         */
        SourceStatus::Status Tick(SourceConfiguration::Configuration& config,
                                  const s16_le (&adpcm_coeffs)[16]);

         * Mix this source's output into dest, using the gains for the `intermediate_mix_id`-th
         * intermediate mixer.
         * @param dest The QuadFrame32 to mix into.
         * @param intermediate_mix_id The id of the intermediate mix whose gains we are using.
         */
        void MixInto(QuadFrame32& dest, std::size_t intermediate_mix_id);
    
    private:
        const std::size_t source_id;

        /// Internal representation of a buffer for our buffer queue
        struct Buffer {
            PAddr physical_address;
            u32 length;
            u8 adpcm_ps;
            std::array<u16, 2> adpcm_yn;
            bool adpcm_dirty;
            bool is_looping;
            u16 buffer_id;

            Format format;
    
            bool from_queue;
            u32 play_position; // = 0;
            bool has_played;   // = false;
    
        private:
            template <class Archive>
            void serialize(Archive& ar, const unsigned int) {
                ar & physical_address;
                ar & length;
                ar & adpcm_ps;
                ar & adpcm_yn;
                ar & adpcm_dirty;
                ar & is_looping;
                ar & buffer_id;
                ar & mono_or_stereo;

        };
    
        struct BufferOrder {

            }
        };
