    ## PR review form
    
    For each ticket include: `source SHA`, `branch`, `touched native files`, `why implementation belongs here`, `feature flag`, `before/after command or screenshot artifact`, `tests performed`, `hardware verification status`, `host performance A/B`, `known risk`, `rollback`. See templates.
    //! Local host policy shared by the headless MCP server and the desktop.
    //!
    //! One `Supervisor` owns every session of a LOTUS process. Each session has its
    //! own async lock, so a long bounded run on one session never blocks commands,
    //! status or previews of another. The registry lock is never held across an
    //! await. Desktop and MCP call the same methods; there is one control model.
    //!
    //! Sessions are *primary* (mount a persistent card) or *secondary* (private
    //! scratch copy, discarded on end); see [`crate::card_store`].
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use tokio::task::JoinSet;
    
    use crate::card_store::{CardStore, ScratchEnd};
    use crate::native_session::{Frame, InputState, NativeSession};
    use crate::telemetry::{Actor, Telemetry};
    use crate::SessionState;
    
    /// Sessions per host unless the configuration raises it; four is the tested load.
    pub const DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS: usize = 4;
    /// Upper bound accepted for `max_sessions`.
    pub const MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT: usize = 16;
    pub const MAX_ARTIFACTS: usize = 128;
    /// Stop deadline per worker when the host closes.
    const CLOSE_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
    
    /// Host configuration, never accepted as a tool-call argument.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct HostConfig {
        pub worker: PathBuf,
        pub storage_root: PathBuf,
        /// Approved content, by handle.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub assets: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        /// Approved directories: every `.3dsx` directly inside is `<handle>/<file>`.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub asset_directories: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub allow_control: bool,
        #[serde(default = "default_max_sessions")]
        pub max_sessions: usize,
        /// Validated worker settings applied before loading content.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub profile: BTreeMap<String, lotus_protocol::debug::SettingValue>,
    }
    
    fn default_max_sessions() -> usize {
        DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS
    }
    
    impl HostConfig {
        /// Configuration with no assets, control denied and the default session limit.
        pub fn new(worker: impl Into<PathBuf>, storage_root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
            Self {
                worker: worker.into(),
                storage_root: storage_root.into(),
                assets: BTreeMap::new(),
                asset_directories: BTreeMap::new(),
                allow_control: false,
                max_sessions: DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS,
                profile: BTreeMap::new(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Whether a session's guest writes persist.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum SessionKind {
        /// Mounts `cards/<card>/`: real, persistent SDMC/NAND reads and writes.
        Primary { card: String },
        /// Private scratch root, empty or copied from `parent`; discarded on end.
        Secondary { parent: Option<String> },
    }
    
    /// Identity of a session as listed by every frontend.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
    pub struct SessionInfo {
        pub id: String,
        #[serde(flatten)]
        pub kind: SessionKind,
        /// Approved handle of the loaded content, if any.
        pub asset: Option<String>,
        pub created_unix_ms: u64,
    }
    
    impl SessionInfo {
        /// Card a session belongs to in the session tree, if any.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn card(&self) -> Option<&str> {
            match &self.kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => Some(card),
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => parent.as_deref(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// One session row: identity plus latest gauges.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
    pub struct SessionSummary {
        #[serde(flatten)]
        pub info: SessionInfo,
        pub telemetry: Telemetry,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Artifact {
        pub uri: String,
        pub screen: String,
        pub width: u32,
        pub height: u32,
        pub bytes: usize,
        pub sha256: String,
        pub mime_type: String,
    }
    
    /// A session's lock domain. Lock order: `native`, then `info` or `telemetry`.
    struct SessionHandle {
        info: Mutex<SessionInfo>,
        root: PathBuf,
        native: tokio::sync::Mutex<NativeSession>,
        telemetry: Mutex<Telemetry>,
        playing: AtomicBool,
        lease: Mutex<Option<String>>,
        symbols: Mutex<Option<lotus_debugger::symbols::Symbols>>,
    }
    
    impl SessionHandle {
        fn info(&self) -> SessionInfo {
            lock(&self.info).clone()
        }
        fn telemetry(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Telemetry> {
            lock(&self.telemetry)
        }
        fn record(&self, actor: Actor, operation: &str) {
            self.telemetry().record(actor, operation);
        }
        fn set_playing(&self, playing: bool) {
            self.playing.store(playing, Ordering::Release);
            self.telemetry().playing = playing;
        }
        fn is_playing(&self) -> bool {
            self.playing.load(Ordering::Acquire)
        }
    }
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Registry {
        sessions: BTreeMap<String, Arc<SessionHandle>>,
        /// Creations in progress, counted against the session limit.
        pending: usize,
        /// Card name to mounting session (or pending creation) ID.
        mounted: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    }
    
    /// No shell execution, arbitrary caller paths or remote listener.
    pub struct Supervisor {
        config: HostConfig,
        cards: CardStore,
        registry: Mutex<Registry>,
        artifacts: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, (Artifact, PathBuf)>>,
        /// Content approved interactively by the desktop user.
        local_assets: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>>,
        focus_request: Mutex<Option<String>>,
        audio_focus: tokio::sync::Mutex<Option<String>>,
    }
    
    impl Supervisor {
        pub fn new(mut config: HostConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
            if !(1..=MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT).contains(&config.max_sessions) {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                    format!("max_sessions must be in 1..={MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT}"),
                ));
            }
            config.worker = config.worker.canonicalize()?;
            for path in config.assets.values_mut() {
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            for (handle, path) in &mut config.asset_directories {
                if handle.is_empty() || handle.contains(['/', '\\']) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                        "asset directory handles cannot be empty or contain separators",
                    ));
                }
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            fs::create_dir_all(&config.storage_root)?;
            config.storage_root = config.storage_root.canonicalize()?;
            let cards = CardStore::open(&config.storage_root)?;
            Ok(Self {
                config,
                cards,
                registry: Mutex::default(),
                artifacts: Mutex::default(),
                local_assets: Mutex::default(),
                focus_request: Mutex::default(),
                audio_focus: tokio::sync::Mutex::default(),
            })
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn max_sessions(&self) -> usize {
            self.config.max_sessions
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn allows_control(&self) -> bool {
            self.config.allow_control
        }
    
        pub fn require_control(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
            if self.config.allow_control {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                    "host has not enabled control for this client",
                ))
            }
        }
    
        /// Session IDs in creation-independent sorted order.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn sessions(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            lock(&self.registry).sessions.keys().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        /// Every session with its latest gauges; never waits on a worker.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn summaries(&self) -> Vec<SessionSummary> {
            self.handles()
                .iter()
                .map(|handle| SessionSummary {
                    info: handle.info(),
                    telemetry: handle.telemetry().clone(),
                })
                .collect()
        }
    
        pub fn summary(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<SessionSummary> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let telemetry = handle.telemetry().clone();
            Ok(SessionSummary {
                info: handle.info(),
                telemetry,
            })
        }
    
        /// Persistent card names.
        pub fn cards(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {
            self.cards.list()
        }
    
        /// Cards currently mounted by a primary session of this host.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn mounted_cards(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
            lock(&self.registry).mounted.clone()
        }
    
        /// Approved content handles: configured, directory-listed and desktop-approved.
        #[must_use]
        pub fn assets(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            let mut handles: Vec<String> = self.config.assets.keys().cloned().collect();
            for (handle, directory) in &self.config.asset_directories {
                let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(directory) else {
                    continue;
                };
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    if is_content_name(&name) && entry.path().is_file() {
                        handles.push(format!("{handle}/{name}"));
                    }
                }
            }
            handles.extend(lock(&self.local_assets).keys().cloned());
            handles.sort();
            handles.dedup();
            handles
        }
    
        /// Approve a file chosen by the local desktop user. Never reachable from MCP.
        pub fn approve_local_asset(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
            let path = path.canonicalize()?;
            let name = path
                .file_name()
                .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
                .filter(|name| is_content_name(name))
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "content must be a .3dsx file")
                })?;
            let mut assets = lock(&self.local_assets);
            let known = assets
                .iter()
                .find(|(_, known)| **known == path)
                .map(|(handle, _)| handle.clone());
            if let Some(handle) = known {
                return Ok(handle);
            }
            let mut handle = format!("local/{name}");
            let mut suffix = 2;
            while assets.contains_key(&handle) || self.config.assets.contains_key(&handle) {
                handle = format!("local/{suffix}-{name}");
                suffix += 1;
            }
            assets.insert(handle.clone(), path);
            Ok(handle)
        }
    
        /// Spawn a worker for `kind`, optionally loading approved content paused.
        pub async fn create(
            &self,
            kind: SessionKind,
            asset: Option<&str>,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = asset.map(|handle| self.resolve_asset(handle)).transpose()?;
            let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
            let reservation = self.reserve(&id, &kind)?;
            let root = match &kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => self.cards.primary_root(card)?,
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => {
                    self.cards.create_scratch(&id, parent.as_deref())?
                }
            };
            let started = async {
                let mut native = NativeSession::spawn(&self.config.worker, &root).await?;
                for (name, value) in &self.config.profile {
                    if let Err(error) = native.debug(&lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand::SettingsSet {
                        name: name.clone(), value: value.clone()
                    }).await {
                        let _ = native.stop().await;
                        return Err(error);
                    }
                }
                if let Some(content) = &content {
                    if let Err(error) = native.load(content).await {
                        let _ = native.stop().await;
                        return Err(error);
                    }
                }
                Ok(native)
            }
            .await;
            let native = match started {
                Ok(native) => native,
                Err(error) => {
                    if matches!(kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                        let _ = self.cards.discard_scratch(&root, ScratchEnd::Abnormal);
                    }
                    return Err(error);
                }
            };
            let info = SessionInfo {
                id: id.clone(),
                kind,
                asset: asset.map(str::to_string),
                created_unix_ms: unix_ms(),
            };
            let mut telemetry = Telemetry::new();
            telemetry.state = native.state();
            telemetry.epoch = native.epoch();
            telemetry.pid = native.pid();
            telemetry.record(actor, "create");
            let handle = Arc::new(SessionHandle {
                info: Mutex::new(info.clone()),
                root,
                native: tokio::sync::Mutex::new(native),
                telemetry: Mutex::new(telemetry),
                playing: AtomicBool::new(false),
                lease: Mutex::new(None),
                symbols: Mutex::new(None),
            });
            reservation.commit(handle);
            Ok(info)
        }
    
        /// Load approved content, replacing what was loaded. Leaves the session paused.
        pub async fn load(&self, id: &str, asset: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            native.load(&content).await?;
            lock(&handle.info).asset = Some(asset.to_string());
            handle.record(actor, "load");
            Ok(handle.info())
        }
    
        /// Run continuously: the pump re-issues bounded runs until paused.
        pub async fn run(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if handle.info().asset.is_none() {
                return Err(io::Error::other("load content before running"));
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if native.state() == SessionState::Paused {
                native.run().await?;
            }
            handle.set_playing(true);
            handle.record(actor, "run");
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn pause(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "pause");
            native.pause().await
        }
    
        /// Advance exactly `frames` (1–600) and stay paused.
        pub async fn advance(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            frames: u16,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, &format!("run_until {frames}"));
            native.advance(frames).await
        }
    
        pub async fn reset(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            handle.record(actor, "reset");
            native.reset().await
        }
    
        pub async fn input(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            state: InputState,
            owner: &str,
            actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if actor != Actor::Desktop {
                handle.record(actor, "input");
            }
            native.input(state, owner).await
        }
    
        /// End a session. Secondary guest data is deleted; primary data persists.
        pub async fn stop(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "stop");
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let result = if native.state().is_active() {
                match tokio::time::timeout(CLOSE_DEADLINE, native.stop()).await {
                    Ok(result) => result,
                    Err(_) => {
                        native.abort().await;
                        Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "worker stop deadline; terminated"))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Ok(())
            };
            let end = if result.is_ok() && native.state() == SessionState::Stopped {
                ScratchEnd::Clean
            } else {
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal
            };
            drop(native);
            {
                let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
                registry.sessions.remove(id);
                registry.mounted.retain(|_, owner| owner != id);
            }
            if matches!(lock(&handle.info).kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                self.cards.discard_scratch(&handle.root, end)?;
            }
            result
        }
    
        /// Failure injection and emergency termination, limited to this session's job.
        pub async fn abort(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "abort");
            handle.native.lock().await.abort().await;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        /// Query the worker at a safe point and refresh gauges.
        pub async fn status(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let status = native.status().await?;
            observe(&handle, &native, &status);
            Ok(status)
        }
    
        /// Typed debugger entry point shared by CLI, MCP, desktop and GDB.
        pub async fn debug(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.debug_as(id, command, actor_client(actor)).await
        }
    
        pub async fn subscribe(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver<serde_json::Value>> {
            Ok(self.handle(id)?.native.lock().await.subscribe())
        }
    
        /// Connection-specific identity is supplied by a trusted adapter, never by a tool argument.
        pub async fn debug_as(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, client: &str,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            command.validate().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            if command.mutates() || matches!(command, DebugCommand::AudioFocus { .. } | DebugCommand::AudioCapture { .. }) { self.require_control()?; }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if let DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled } = command {
                return self.focus_audio(id, *enabled).await;
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseAcquire { owner } = command {
                if owner != client { return Err(io::Error::other("lease owner must match this connection")); }
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if lease.as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| owner != client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease held by another client"));
                }
                *lease = Some(client.to_string());
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"lease": client}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseRelease { owner } = command {
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if owner != client || lease.as_deref() != Some(client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease is not owned by this client"));
                }
                *lease = None;
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"released": client}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::Disassemble { address,length,thumb } = command {
                let result=native.debug(&DebugCommand::ReadMemory { address:*address,length:*length }).await?;
                let bytes:Vec<u8>=serde_json::from_value(result["bytes"].clone()).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                let text=crate::disassembly::decode(&handle.root,*address,&bytes,*thumb).await?;
                let mut result=serde_json::json!({"address":address,"bytes":bytes,"thumb":thumb,"assembly":text,
                    "paused":result["paused"],"safe_point":true,"rasterizer_cache_flush":true,
                    "profile_hash":native.profile_hash()});
                if let Some(symbols)=lock(&handle.symbols).as_ref() {
                    result["source"]=serde_json::to_value(symbols.locate(*address)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                }
                return Ok(result);
            }
            if let DebugCommand::LoadSymbols { asset } = command {
                check_lease(&handle, client)?;
                let path = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
                if fs::metadata(&path)?.len()>128<<20 { return Err(io::Error::other("ELF exceeds budget")); }
                let bytes = fs::read(path)?;
                let symbols = lotus_debugger::symbols::Symbols::parse(&bytes)?;
                let count = symbols.count();
                *lock(&handle.symbols) = Some(symbols);
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"symbols":count, "elf_sha256":format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(bytes))}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::Symbolize { addresses } = command {
                let symbols=lock(&handle.symbols);
                let symbols=symbols.as_ref().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("load an approved ELF build artifact first"))?;
                let locations: io::Result<Vec<_>>=addresses.iter().map(|address| symbols.locate(*address)).collect();
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"locations":locations?}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::ResolveSymbol { query } = command {
                let symbols=lock(&handle.symbols);
                let symbols=symbols.as_ref().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("load an approved ELF build artifact first"))?;
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"addresses":symbols.resolve(query)?}));
            }
            // The native mutex serializes lease transitions with execution mutations.
            if command.mutates() {
                check_lease(&handle, client)?;
                handle.set_playing(false);
                pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
                handle.record(Actor::Host, client);
            }
            match command {
                DebugCommand::Continue => {
                    let result = native.run().await?;
                    handle.set_playing(true);
                    Ok(result)
                }
                DebugCommand::Pause => native.pause().await,
                DebugCommand::Advance { frames } => native.advance(*frames).await,
                _ => {
                    let mut result = native.debug(command).await?;
                    self.import_debug_artifacts(&handle.root, &mut result)?;
                    if let Some(symbols)=lock(&handle.symbols).as_ref() {
                        if let Some(frames)=result.get_mut("frames").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut) {
                            for frame in frames {
                                if let Some(pc)=frame["pc"].as_u64() {
                                    frame["source"]=serde_json::to_value(symbols.locate(pc as u32)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(result)
                },
            }
        }
    
        fn import_debug_artifacts(&self, root: &Path, result: &mut serde_json::Value) -> io::Result<()> {
            let Some(files)=result["artifacts"].as_array() else { return Ok(()); };
            if files.len()>16 { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact batch exceeds budget")); }
            let root=root.canonicalize()?;
            let mut catalog=lock(&self.artifacts);
            if catalog.len()+files.len()>MAX_ARTIFACTS { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact quota reached")); }
            let directory=self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut published=Vec::new();
            let mut total: u64=catalog.values().map(|(a,_)| a.bytes as u64).sum();
            for file in files {
                let relative=Path::new(file["path"].as_str().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("invalid artifact path"))?);
                if relative.components().any(|part| !matches!(part,std::path::Component::Normal(_))) ||
                    !relative.components().next().is_some_and(|part| ["gpu","audio"].iter().any(|allowed| part.as_os_str()==std::ffi::OsStr::new(allowed))) {
                    return Err(io::Error::other("artifact path outside capture folders"));
                }
                let path=root.join(relative).canonicalize()?;
                if !path.starts_with(&root) { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact escaped session root")); }
                let size=fs::metadata(&path)?.len();
                if size>64<<20 || total+size>512<<20 { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact byte quota reached")); }
                total+=size;
                let bytes=fs::read(&path)?;
                let id=SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let destination=directory.join(&id);
                fs::write(&destination,&bytes)?;
                let artifact=Artifact { uri:format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),screen:file["format"].as_str().unwrap_or("capture").to_string(),
                    width:file["width"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,height:file["height"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                    bytes:bytes.len(),sha256:format!("{:x}",Sha256::digest(&bytes)),mime_type:match file["format"].as_str() {
                        Some("json")=>"application/json",Some("wav")=>"audio/wav",_=>"application/octet-stream"
                    }.into() };
                catalog.insert(artifact.uri.clone(),(artifact.clone(),destination));
                published.push(artifact);
            }
            result["artifacts"]=serde_json::to_value(published).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        /// Host presentation policy; never pauses the guest or changes deterministic capture.
        pub async fn focus_audio(&self, id: &str, enabled: bool) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut focus = self.audio_focus.lock().await;
            if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) && enabled {
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"focused": id}));
            }
            if enabled {
                if let Some(previous) = focus.take() {
                    if let Ok(old) = self.handle(&previous) {
                        old.native.lock().await.debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled: false }).await?;
                    }
                }
            }
            let result = handle.native.lock().await.debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled }).await?;
            if enabled { *focus = Some(id.to_string()); }
            else if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) { *focus = None; }
            Ok(result)
        }
    
        pub async fn registers(&self, id: &str, core: u32) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            native.registers(core).await
        }
    
        pub async fn memory(
            &self,
            id: &str,
            address: u32,
            length: u16,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            native.memory(address, length).await
        }
    
        /// Latest screens for display, or `None` when the session is busy or blank.
        pub async fn preview(&self, id: &str) -> Option<Vec<Frame>> {
            let handle = self.handle(id).ok()?;
            let mut native = handle.native.try_lock().ok()?;
            let has_frames = handle.telemetry().frames > 0;
            if !matches!(native.state(), SessionState::Running | SessionState::Paused) || !has_frames {
                return None;
            }
            native.capture().await.ok()
        }
    
        pub async fn capture(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<Artifact>> {
            if lock(&self.artifacts).len() + 2 > MAX_ARTIFACTS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "artifact quota reached; restart host to reset catalog",
                ));
            }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let frames = handle.native.lock().await.capture().await?;
            let directory = self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
            for frame in frames {
                let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.bgra"));
                fs::write(&path, &frame.bgra)?;
                let artifact = Artifact {
                    uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                    screen: frame.lease.screen,
                    width: frame.lease.width,
                    height: frame.lease.height,
                    bytes: frame.bgra.len(),
                    sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra)),
                    mime_type: "application/octet-stream".into(),
                };
                lock(&self.artifacts).insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            lock(&self.artifacts)
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Resolve only catalogued immutable captures, never interpret a URI as a path.
        pub fn read_artifact(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let (artifact, path) = lock(&self.artifacts).get(uri).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown artifact resource")
            })?;
            let data = fs::read(path)?;
            if data.len() != artifact.bytes || format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&data)) != artifact.sha256
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("artifact identity mismatch"));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    
        /// Ask a windowed frontend to show `id`. Headless hosts ignore it.
        pub fn request_focus(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.handle(id)?;
            *lock(&self.focus_request) = Some(id.to_string());
            Ok(())
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn take_focus_request(&self) -> Option<String> {
            lock(&self.focus_request).take()
        }
    
        /// Refresh gauges of every idle session and keep playing sessions running.
        /// Sessions held by another command are marked busy, never waited on.
        pub async fn pump(&self) {
            let mut tasks = JoinSet::new();
            for handle in self.handles() {
                tasks.spawn(pump_session(handle));
            }
            while tasks.join_next().await.is_some() {}
        }
    
        /// Stop every session, bounding each stop; used when a frontend closes.
        pub async fn close(&self) {
            for id in self.sessions() {
                let _ = self.stop(&id, Actor::Host).await;
            }
        }
    
        fn handles(&self) -> Vec<Arc<SessionHandle>> {
            lock(&self.registry).sessions.values().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        fn handle(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Arc<SessionHandle>> {
            lock(&self.registry)
                .sessions
                .get(id)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                        "unknown session for this host; session handles expire when the server exits. Create a new session; use a primary card to keep guest storage",
                    )
                })
        }
    
        fn reserve(&self, id: &str, kind: &SessionKind) -> io::Result<Reservation<'_>> {
            let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
            if registry.sessions.len() + registry.pending >= self.config.max_sessions {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::QuotaExceeded,
                    format!("{}-session limit reached", self.config.max_sessions),
                ));
            }
            let card = match kind {
                SessionKind::Primary { card } => {
                    crate::card_store::validate_name(card)?;
                    if registry.mounted.contains_key(card) {
                        return Err(io::Error::new(
                            io::ErrorKind::ResourceBusy,
                            format!("card '{card}' already has a primary session"),
                        ));
                    }
                    registry.mounted.insert(card.clone(), id.to_string());
                    Some(card.clone())
                }
                SessionKind::Secondary { parent } => {
                    if let Some(parent) = parent {
                        crate::card_store::validate_name(parent)?;
                    }
                    None
                }
            };
            registry.pending += 1;
            Ok(Reservation {
                supervisor: self,
                id: id.to_string(),
                card,
                committed: false,
            })
        }
    
        fn resolve_asset(&self, handle: &str) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            if let Some(path) = self.config.assets.get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some(path) = lock(&self.local_assets).get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some((directory, name)) = handle.split_once('/') {
                if let Some(root) = self.config.asset_directories.get(directory) {
                    if is_content_name(name) && !name.contains(['/', '\\']) && name != ".." {
                        let path = root.join(name).canonicalize()?;
                        if path.parent() == Some(root.as_path()) && path.is_file() {
                            return Ok(path);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "unknown asset handle",
            ))
        }
    }
    
    /// Holds a session slot and card mount during a slow spawn; released on failure.
    struct Reservation<'a> {
        supervisor: &'a Supervisor,
        id: String,
        card: Option<String>,
        committed: bool,
    }
    
    impl Reservation<'_> {
        fn commit(mut self, handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            registry.sessions.insert(self.id.clone(), handle);
            self.committed = true;
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for Reservation<'_> {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if self.committed {
                return;
            }
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            if let Some(card) = &self.card {
                registry.mounted.remove(card);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async fn pump_session(handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
        let Ok(mut native) = handle.native.try_lock() else {
            handle.telemetry().busy = true;
            return;
        };
        if !native.state().is_active() {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
            telemetry.state = native.state();
            telemetry.fps = 0.0;
            telemetry.speed = 0.0;
            telemetry.memory_bytes = None;
            return;
        }
        let status = match native.status().await {
            Ok(status) => status,
            Err(error) => {
                handle.set_playing(false);
                let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
                telemetry.state = native.state();
                telemetry.last_error = error.to_string();
                return;
            }
        };
        observe(&handle, &native, &status);
        if !handle.is_playing() || native.state() != SessionState::Paused {
            return;
        }
        // A bounded run ended. Resume unless the guest stopped for a reason a retry
        // cannot fix; a host deadline only means the batch ran slowly.
        let stop = status["stop"]["reason"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        if !matches!(stop, "" | "frame") {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            return;
        }
        let reason = status["last_error"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        if !matches!(reason, "" | "host_deadline") {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            return;
        }
        if let Err(error) = native.run().await {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.telemetry().last_error = error.to_string();
        }
    }
    
    fn observe(handle: &SessionHandle, native: &NativeSession, status: &serde_json::Value) {
        let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
        telemetry.playing = handle.is_playing();
        telemetry.observe(status, native.state(), native.epoch(), Instant::now());
        telemetry.pid = native.pid();
        telemetry.memory_bytes = native.working_set();
    }
    
    async fn pause_if_running(native: &mut NativeSession) -> io::Result<()> {
        if native.state() == SessionState::Running {
            native.pause().await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn is_content_name(name: &str) -> bool {
        name.len() > ".3dsx".len()
            && name
                .get(name.len() - 5..)
                .is_some_and(|extension| extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case(".3dsx"))
    }
    
    fn unix_ms() -> u64 {
        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|elapsed| u64::try_from(elapsed.as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX))
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }
    
    /// Registry state stays consistent across a panicking holder: every critical
    /// section is a single map update, so recover the guard instead of cascading.
    fn lock<T>(mutex: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
        mutex.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        fn host(name: &str, control: bool) -> (PathBuf, Supervisor) {
            let base =
                std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("lotus-host-{name}-{}", SessionUuid::generate()));
            fs::create_dir_all(base.join("content")).expect("content dir");
            fs::write(base.join("content/demo.3dsx"), b"3DSX").expect("content");
            fs::write(base.join("content/notes.txt"), b"x").expect("other");
            let mut config = HostConfig::new(std::env::current_exe().expect("exe"), base.join("store"));
            config
                .asset_directories
                .insert("builds".into(), base.join("content"));
            config.allow_control = control;
            (base, Supervisor::new(config).expect("host"))
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn asset_directories_list_only_direct_3dsx_handles() {
            let (base, host) = host("assets", true);
            assert_eq!(host.assets(), vec!["builds/demo.3dsx".to_string()]);
            assert!(host.resolve_asset("builds/demo.3dsx").is_ok());
            for bad in [
                "builds/notes.txt",
                "builds/../content/demo.3dsx",
                "builds/sub/demo.3dsx",
                "other/demo.3dsx",
                "C:/Windows/notepad.exe",
            ] {
                assert!(host.resolve_asset(bad).is_err(), "resolved {bad}");
            }
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn local_approval_is_stable_and_rejects_other_files() {
            let (base, host) = host("local", true);
            let path = base.join("content/demo.3dsx");
            let first = host.approve_local_asset(&path).expect("approve");
            assert_eq!(first, "local/demo.3dsx");
            assert_eq!(host.approve_local_asset(&path).expect("again"), first);
            assert!(host
                .approve_local_asset(&base.join("content/notes.txt"))
                .is_err());
            assert!(host.resolve_asset(&first).is_ok());
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn reservations_enforce_limits_and_single_primary_mount() {
            let (base, host) = host("reserve", true);
            let primary = SessionKind::Primary { card: "dev".into() };
            let held = host.reserve("a", &primary).expect("first mount");
            assert_eq!(
                host.reserve("b", &primary).err().map(|error| error.kind()),
                Some(io::ErrorKind::ResourceBusy)
            );
            drop(held);
            let _again = host.reserve("c", &primary).expect("released on failure");
            let secondary = SessionKind::Secondary { parent: None };
            let _s1 = host.reserve("d", &secondary).expect("slot 2");
            let _s2 = host.reserve("e", &secondary).expect("slot 3");
            let _s3 = host.reserve("f", &secondary).expect("slot 4");
            assert_eq!(
                host.reserve("g", &secondary)
                    .err()
                    .map(|error| error.kind()),
                Some(io::ErrorKind::QuotaExceeded)
            );
            assert!(host
                .reserve(
                    "h",
                    &SessionKind::Secondary {
                        parent: Some("../x".into())
                    }
                )
                .is_err());
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }
    
        #[tokio::test]
        async fn control_permission_gates_every_mutation() {
            let (base, host) = host("readonly", false);
            let kind = SessionKind::Secondary { parent: None };
            assert!(host.create(kind, None, Actor::Mcp).await.is_err());
            assert!(host.run("x", Actor::Mcp).await.is_err());
            assert!(host.stop("x", Actor::Mcp).await.is_err());
            assert!(host.status("x").await.is_err());
            assert!(host.read_artifact("lotus://artifact/../x").is_err());
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(base);
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn invalid_session_limits_are_rejected() {
            let mut config =
                HostConfig::new(std::env::current_exe().expect("exe"), std::env::temp_dir());
            config.max_sessions = MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT + 1;
            assert!(Supervisor::new(config).is_err());
        }
    }
    
    fn actor_client(actor: Actor) -> &'static str {
        match actor { Actor::Host => "host", Actor::Desktop => "desktop", Actor::Mcp => "mcp" }
    }
    
    fn check_lease(handle: &SessionHandle, client: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
        if lock(&handle.lease).as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| owner != client) {
            Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease held by another client"))
        } else { Ok(()) }
    }

    """Build the owned freestanding ARM fixture with clang, or devkitARM GCC.
    The 3DSX segment container follows native loader/3dsx.cpp. Absolute link addresses
    match the worker's homebrew base; relocation tables are intentionally empty.
    """
    from pathlib import Path
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    import shutil
    import struct
    import subprocess
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--gcc", help="devkitARM arm-none-eabi-gcc executable (uses matching objcopy)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures/debugger"
    compiler = args.gcc or shutil.which("clang")
    if not compiler:
        raise SystemExit("clang or --gcc <devkitARM GCC> is required")
    objcopy = str(Path(compiler).with_name("arm-none-eabi-objcopy.exe")) if args.gcc else shutil.which("llvm-objcopy")
    elf = out / "debugger.elf"
    command = [compiler, "-mcpu=mpcore", "-marm", "-mfloat-abi=soft", "-O1", "-g", "-gdwarf-4",
               "-ffreestanding", "-fno-builtin", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer", "-fno-unwind-tables",
               "-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables", "-nostdlib", "-Wl,--build-id=none",
               "-Wl,-T,"+str(source / "link.ld"), str(source / "fixture.c"), "-o", str(elf)]
    if not args.gcc:
        command[1:1] = ["--target=armv6k-none-eabi", "-fuse-ld=lld"]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    segments = []
    for section in ("text", "rodata", "data"):
        path = out / (section + ".bin")
        subprocess.run([objcopy, "--dump-section", "."+section+"="+str(path), str(elf)], check=True)
        segments.append(path.read_bytes())
    header = struct.pack("<IHHIIIIIIIII", 0x58534433, 44, 8, 0, 0,
                         *(len(s) for s in segments), 0, 0, 0, 0)
    rom = header + bytes(24) + b"".join(segments)
    (out / "debugger.3dsx").write_bytes(rom)
    (out / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(compiler=subprocess.check_output([compiler,"--version"],text=True).splitlines()[0],
        command=command, sha256=hashlib.sha256(rom).hexdigest(), elf_sha256=hashlib.sha256(elf.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),indent=2))
    print(out / "debugger.3dsx")

    impl DebugCommand {
        pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
            match self {
                Self::SettingsList { offset, limit } if *offset > 512 || !(1..=32).contains(limit) => Err("invalid settings page"),
                Self::SettingsSet { name, value } if name.len() > 128 ||
                    serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(|_| "invalid setting value")?.len() > 8192 =>
                        Err("setting name or value exceeds budget"),

                    }
                }

                Self::Disassemble { address, length, .. } | Self::ReadMemory { address, length } =>
                    range(*address, *length, 4096),
                Self::WriteMemory { address, bytes } =>
                    range(*address, bytes.len().try_into().map_err(|_| "write too large")?, 4096),
                Self::Step { core, count } if *core > 3 || !(1..=100_000).contains(count) =>
                    Err("step requires core 0..3 and count 1..100000"),
                Self::Registers { core } | Self::WriteRegister { core, .. } |
                Self::Backtrace { core, .. } if *core > 3 => Err("invalid core"),
                Self::WriteRegister { register, .. } | Self::WriteThreadRegister { register, .. } if *register > 82 => Err("invalid register"),
                Self::Backtrace { limit, .. } if !(1..=128).contains(limit) => Err("backtrace limit 1..128"),
                Self::BreakpointSet { address, length, kind } => {

    fn range(address: u32, length: u32, maximum: u32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if length == 0 || length > maximum || u64::from(address) + u64::from(length) > 1u64 << 32 {
            Err("invalid or oversized guest range")
        } else { Ok(()) }
    }

        /// Connection-specific identity is supplied by a trusted adapter, never by a tool argument.
        pub async fn debug_as(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, client: &str,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            command.validate().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            if command.mutates() || matches!(command, DebugCommand::AudioFocus { .. } | DebugCommand::AudioCapture { .. }) { self.require_control()?; }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if let DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled } = command {
                return self.focus_audio(id, *enabled).await;
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseAcquire { owner } = command {
                if owner != client { return Err(io::Error::other("lease owner must match this connection")); }
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if lease.as_ref().is_some_and(|owner| owner != client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease held by another client"));
                }
                *lease = Some(client.to_string());
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"lease": client}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::LeaseRelease { owner } = command {
                let mut lease = lock(&handle.lease);
                if owner != client || lease.as_deref() != Some(client) {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "debug lease is not owned by this client"));
                }
                *lease = None;
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"released": client}));
            }

                let text=crate::disassembly::decode(&handle.root,*address,&bytes,*thumb).await?;
                let mut result=serde_json::json!({"address":address,"bytes":bytes,"thumb":thumb,"assembly":text,
                    "paused":result["paused"],"safe_point":true,"rasterizer_cache_flush":true,
                    "profile_hash":native.profile_hash()});
                if let Some(symbols)=lock(&handle.symbols).as_ref() {
                    result["source"]=serde_json::to_value(symbols.locate(*address)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                }

            }
            if let DebugCommand::LoadSymbols { asset } = command {
                check_lease(&handle, client)?;
                let path = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
                if fs::metadata(&path)?.len()>128<<20 { return Err(io::Error::other("ELF exceeds budget")); }
                let bytes = fs::read(path)?;
                let symbols = lotus_debugger::symbols::Symbols::parse(&bytes)?;
                let count = symbols.count();
                *lock(&handle.symbols) = Some(symbols);
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"symbols":count, "elf_sha256":format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(bytes))}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::Symbolize { addresses } = command {
                let symbols=lock(&handle.symbols);
                let symbols=symbols.as_ref().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("load an approved ELF build artifact first"))?;
                let locations: io::Result<Vec<_>>=addresses.iter().map(|address| symbols.locate(*address)).collect();
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"locations":locations?}));
            }
            if let DebugCommand::ResolveSymbol { query } = command {
                let symbols=lock(&handle.symbols);
                let symbols=symbols.as_ref().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("load an approved ELF build artifact first"))?;
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"addresses":symbols.resolve(query)?}));

            if command.mutates() {
                check_lease(&handle, client)?;
                handle.set_playing(false);
                pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
                handle.record(Actor::Host, client);
            }
            match command {
                DebugCommand::Continue => {
                    let result = native.run().await?;
                    handle.set_playing(true);
                    Ok(result)
                }
                DebugCommand::Pause => native.pause().await,
                DebugCommand::Advance { frames } => native.advance(*frames).await,
                _ => {
                    let mut result = native.debug(command).await?;
                    self.import_debug_artifacts(&handle.root, &mut result)?;
                    if let Some(symbols)=lock(&handle.symbols).as_ref() {

                                if let Some(pc)=frame["pc"].as_u64() {
                                    frame["source"]=serde_json::to_value(symbols.locate(pc as u32)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(result)
                },
            }
        }
    
        fn import_debug_artifacts(&self, root: &Path, result: &mut serde_json::Value) -> io::Result<()> {
            let Some(files)=result["artifacts"].as_array() else { return Ok(()); };
            if files.len()>16 { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact batch exceeds budget")); }
            let root=root.canonicalize()?;
            let mut catalog=lock(&self.artifacts);
            if catalog.len()+files.len()>MAX_ARTIFACTS { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact quota reached")); }
            let directory=self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut published=Vec::new();
            let mut total: u64=catalog.values().map(|(a,_)| a.bytes as u64).sum();
            for file in files {
                let relative=Path::new(file["path"].as_str().ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("invalid artifact path"))?);
                if relative.components().any(|part| !matches!(part,std::path::Component::Normal(_))) ||
                    !relative.components().next().is_some_and(|part| ["gpu","audio"].iter().any(|allowed| part.as_os_str()==std::ffi::OsStr::new(allowed))) {
                    return Err(io::Error::other("artifact path outside capture folders"));
                }
                let path=root.join(relative).canonicalize()?;
                if !path.starts_with(&root) { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact escaped session root")); }
                let size=fs::metadata(&path)?.len();
                if size>64<<20 || total+size>512<<20 { return Err(io::Error::other("artifact byte quota reached")); }
                total+=size;
                let bytes=fs::read(&path)?;
                let id=SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let destination=directory.join(&id);
                fs::write(&destination,&bytes)?;
                let artifact=Artifact { uri:format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),screen:file["format"].as_str().unwrap_or("capture").to_string(),
                    width:file["width"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,height:file["height"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                    bytes:bytes.len(),sha256:format!("{:x}",Sha256::digest(&bytes)),mime_type:match file["format"].as_str() {
                        Some("json")=>"application/json",Some("wav")=>"audio/wav",_=>"application/octet-stream"
                    }.into() };
                catalog.insert(artifact.uri.clone(),(artifact.clone(),destination));
                published.push(artifact);
            }
            result["artifacts"]=serde_json::to_value(published).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            Ok(())
        }

    //! Opt-in loopback RSP adapter. All target operations use the shared debug lease.
    use std::{collections::BTreeMap, io, net::SocketAddr, sync::Arc};
    use lotus_protocol::{debug::{BreakpointKind, DebugCommand as D}, envelope::SessionUuid};
    use lotus_session::supervisor::Supervisor;
    use serde_json::Value;
    use tokio::{io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt}, net::{TcpListener, TcpStream}};
    
    const MAX_PACKET: usize = 16_384;
    
    pub struct Server {
        pub address: SocketAddr,
        task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
    }
    impl Server {
        pub async fn start(host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, port: u16) -> io::Result<Self> {
            host.require_control()?;
            host.summary(&session)?;
            let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port)).await?;
            let address = listener.local_addr()?;
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                while let Ok((socket, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                    let owner = format!("gdb:{}", SessionUuid::generate());
                    if host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseAcquire { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await.is_err() {
                        drop(socket);
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut connection = Connection { socket, host: host.clone(), session: session.clone(),
                        owner, no_ack: false, thread: None, core: 0, breakpoints: BTreeMap::new(), last_stop: "S05".into() };
                    let _ = connection.serve().await;
                    // Drop performs cleanup even if the server task was cancelled.
                }
            });
            Ok(Self { address, task })
        }
    }
    impl Drop for Server { fn drop(&mut self) { self.task.abort(); } }
    
    struct Connection {
        socket: TcpStream,
        host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, owner: String,
        no_ack: bool, thread: Option<u32>, core: u32,
        breakpoints: BTreeMap<(u32, u32, u32), u64>, last_stop: String,
    }
    impl Drop for Connection {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let host = self.host.clone(); let session = self.session.clone(); let owner = self.owner.clone();
            let ids: Vec<_> = self.breakpoints.values().copied().collect();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::Pause, &owner).await;
                for id in ids { let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::BreakpointRemove { id }, &owner).await; }
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::HioForward { enabled: false }, &owner).await;
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseRelease { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await;
            });
        }
    }
    impl Connection {
        async fn debug(&self, command: D) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.host.debug_as(&self.session, &command, &self.owner).await
        }
        async fn serve(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.debug(D::Pause).await?;
            self.debug(D::HioForward { enabled: true }).await?;
            loop {
                let packet = read_packet(&mut self.socket, self.no_ack).await?;
                let detach = packet == b"D" || packet.starts_with(b"D;");
                let kill = packet == b"k" || packet.starts_with(b"vKill;");
                let reply = self.handle(&packet).await.unwrap_or_else(|_| b"E01".to_vec());
                if kill {
                    let _ = self.host.stop(&self.session, lotus_session::telemetry::Actor::Host).await;
                    if packet.starts_with(b"vKill;") { write_packet(&mut self.socket, &reply).await?; }
                    return Ok(());
                }
                write_packet(&mut self.socket, &reply).await?;
                if packet == b"QStartNoAckMode" { self.no_ack = true; }
                if detach { return Ok(()); }
            }
        }

    """Known-address debugger regression tests against an owned ARM ELF/3DSX pair."""
    import argparse
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import struct
    import subprocess
    import time
    from native_debug_probe import Peer
    
    
    def symbols(elf):
        rows = subprocess.check_output(["llvm-nm", "--defined-only", str(elf)], text=True)
        return {parts[2]: int(parts[0], 16) for row in rows.splitlines()
                if len(parts := row.split()) == 3}
    
    
    def wait(peer):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            result = peer.call("status")
            if result["stop"].get("reason"):
                return result
            time.sleep(.01)
        raise TimeoutError("no debugger stop within five seconds")
    
    
    def cpu(worker, rom, root, new):
        syms = symbols(rom.with_suffix(".elf"))
        peer = Peer(worker, root)
        evidence = dict(new_3ds=new, checks={})
        def save(name, result):
            evidence["checks"][name] = result
            (root / "acceptance.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2))
        try:
            peer.call("hello", {"notifications": True})
            peer.debug("settings_set", name="is_new_3ds", value=new)
            peer.call("load", {"path": str(rom)})
            bp = peer.debug("breakpoint_set", address=syms["main"], kind="execute", length=4)
            result = peer.call("run_until", {"frames": 1})
            assert result["stop"]["reason"] == "breakpoint", result
            assert result["stop"]["address"] == syms["main"]
            save("main_breakpoint", result)
            peer.debug("breakpoint_remove", id=bp["id"])
            peer.debug("run_to", core=0, address=syms["lotus_tick_body"])
            result = wait(peer)
            assert result["stop"]["address"] == syms["lotus_tick_body"], result
            assert not peer.debug("breakpoints")["breakpoints"], "temporary breakpoint leaked"
            trace = peer.debug("backtrace", core=0, limit=8)
            assert len(trace["frames"]) >= 3, trace
            assert syms["main"] <= trace["frames"][1]["pc"] < syms["main"] + 128, trace
            save("frame_pointer_backtrace", trace)
            bp = peer.debug("breakpoint_set", address=syms["watched"], kind="write", length=4)
            peer.debug("breakpoint_configure", id=bp["id"], process=None, hit_after=1,
                       condition={"kind":"memory_equals", "address":syms["counter"], "width":4,"value":2}, log=None)
            result = peer.debug("step", core=0, count=100)
            assert result["stop"]["reason"] == "watchpoint", result
            assert result["stop"]["address"] == syms["watched"]
            assert peer.debug("read_memory", address=syms["watched"], length=4)["bytes"] == [2,0,0,0]
            save("watchpoint_during_step", result)
            peer.debug("breakpoint_remove", id=bp["id"])
            peer.debug("save_state", name="roundtrip", worker_frame=0)
            forward = peer.debug("step", core=0, count=20)
            memory = peer.debug("read_memory", address=syms["watched"], length=4)
            peer.debug("load_state", name="roundtrip")
            replay = peer.debug("step", core=0, count=20)
            assert forward["registers"] == replay["registers"], (forward,replay)
            assert memory["bytes"] == peer.debug("read_memory", address=syms["watched"], length=4)["bytes"]
            save("checkpoint_replay", {"registers":replay["registers"],"memory":memory["bytes"],"epoch":peer.epoch})
            logs = peer.debug("logs", after=0, limit=128)
            assert "lotus-fixture:ready" in json.dumps(logs), logs
            save("guest_log", logs)
            for mode, reason in ((1,"exception"),(3,"svc_break"),(4,"exception")):
                peer.call("reset")
                peer.debug("write_memory", address=syms["mode"], bytes=list(struct.pack("<I",mode)))
                result = peer.call("run_until", {"frames":1})
                assert result["stop"]["reason"] == reason, result
                report = peer.debug("crash_report", core=0)
                assert report["failure_domain"] == "guest"
                save(f"crash_mode_{mode}", report)
        finally:
            peer.close()
        return evidence
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("worker", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("rom", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
        args = parser.parse_args()
        for new in (False,True):
            result = cpu(args.worker.resolve(),args.rom.resolve(),args.output.resolve() / ("new" if new else "old"),new)
            print(json.dumps({"new_3ds":new,"checks":list(result["checks"])}),flush=True)

    //! Local host policy shared by the headless MCP server and the desktop.
    //!
    //! One `Supervisor` owns every session of a LOTUS process. Each session has its
    //! own async lock, so a long bounded run on one session never blocks commands,
    //! status or previews of another. The registry lock is never held across an
    //! await. Desktop and MCP call the same methods; there is one control model.
    //!
    //! Sessions are *primary* (mount a persistent card) or *secondary* (private
    //! scratch copy, discarded on end); see [`crate::card_store`].
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

    namespace CtrWorker {
    struct InputState {
        u32 buttons = 0;
        float x = 0;
        float y = 0;
        bool touch = false;
    };
    class Button final : public Input::ButtonDevice {
    public:
        Button(const InputState& state, unsigned index) : state(state), index(index) {}
        bool GetStatus() const override {
            return (state.buttons & (1u << index)) != 0;
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
        unsigned index;
    };
    class ButtonFactory final : public Input::Factory<Input::ButtonDevice> {
    public:
        explicit ButtonFactory(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::ButtonDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage& params) override {
            const auto index = params.Get("index", 0);
            if (index < 0 || index >= Settings::NativeButton::NumButtons)
                return std::make_unique<Input::ButtonDevice>();
            return std::make_unique<Button>(state, index);
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
    };
    class Touch final : public Input::TouchDevice {
    public:
        explicit Touch(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::tuple<float, float, bool> GetStatus() const override {
            return {state.x, state.y, state.touch};
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
    };
    class TouchFactory final : public Input::Factory<Input::TouchDevice> {
    public:
        explicit TouchFactory(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::TouchDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage&) override {
            return std::make_unique<Touch>(state);
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
    };
    inline void RegisterInput(InputState& state) {
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::ButtonDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<ButtonFactory>(state));
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::TouchDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<TouchFactory>(state));
        auto& profile = Settings::values.current_input_profile;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < profile.buttons.size(); ++i)
            profile.buttons[i] = "engine:ctr,index:" + std::to_string(i);
        profile.touch_device = "engine:ctr";
    }
    } // namespace CtrWorker

    //! Opt-in loopback RSP adapter. All target operations use the shared debug lease.
    use std::{collections::BTreeMap, io, net::SocketAddr, sync::Arc};
    use lotus_protocol::{debug::{BreakpointKind, DebugCommand as D}, envelope::SessionUuid};
    use lotus_session::supervisor::Supervisor;
    use serde_json::Value;
    use tokio::{io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt}, net::{TcpListener, TcpStream}};
    
    const MAX_PACKET: usize = 16_384;
    
    pub struct Server {
        pub address: SocketAddr,
        task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
    }
    impl Server {
        pub async fn start(host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, port: u16) -> io::Result<Self> {
            host.require_control()?;
            host.summary(&session)?;
            let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port)).await?;
            let address = listener.local_addr()?;
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                while let Ok((socket, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                    let owner = format!("gdb:{}", SessionUuid::generate());
                    if host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseAcquire { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await.is_err() {
                        drop(socket);
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut connection = Connection { socket, host: host.clone(), session: session.clone(),
                        owner, no_ack: false, thread: None, core: 0, breakpoints: BTreeMap::new(), last_stop: "S05".into() };
                    let _ = connection.serve().await;
                    // Drop performs cleanup even if the server task was cancelled.
                }
            });
            Ok(Self { address, task })
        }
    }
    impl Drop for Server { fn drop(&mut self) { self.task.abort(); } }
    
    struct Connection {
        socket: TcpStream,
        host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, owner: String,
        no_ack: bool, thread: Option<u32>, core: u32,
        breakpoints: BTreeMap<(u32, u32, u32), u64>, last_stop: String,
    }
    impl Drop for Connection {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let host = self.host.clone(); let session = self.session.clone(); let owner = self.owner.clone();
            let ids: Vec<_> = self.breakpoints.values().copied().collect();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::Pause, &owner).await;
                for id in ids { let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::BreakpointRemove { id }, &owner).await; }
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::HioForward { enabled: false }, &owner).await;
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::LeaseRelease { owner: owner.clone() }, &owner).await;
            });
        }
    }

        async fn debug(&self, command: D) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.host.debug_as(&self.session, &command, &self.owner).await

            self.debug(D::Pause).await?;

    std::vector<u8> System::SaveStateBuffer() const {
        std::ostringstream sstream{std::ios_base::binary};
        // Serialize
        oarchive oa{sstream};
        oa&* this;
    
        const std::string& str{sstream.str()};
        const auto data = std::span<const u8>{reinterpret_cast<const u8*>(str.data()), str.size()};
        auto buffer = Common::Compression::CompressDataZSTDDefault(data);
    
        CSTHeader header{};
        header.filetype = header_magic_bytes;
        header.program_id = title_id;
        std::string rev_bytes;
        CryptoPP::StringSource ss(Common::g_scm_rev, true,
                                  new CryptoPP::HexDecoder(new CryptoPP::StringSink(rev_bytes)));
        std::memcpy(header.revision.data(), rev_bytes.data(), sizeof(header.revision));
        header.time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(
                          std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                          .count();
        const std::string build_fullname = Common::g_build_fullname;
        std::memset(header.build_name.data(), 0, sizeof(header.build_name));
        std::memcpy(header.build_name.data(), build_fullname.c_str(),
                    std::min(build_fullname.length(), sizeof(header.build_name) - 1));
    
        const std::string build_version = Common::g_build_version;
        std::memset(header.build_version.data(), 0, sizeof(header.build_version));
        std::memcpy(header.build_version.data(), build_version.c_str(),
                    std::min(build_version.length(), sizeof(header.build_version) - 1));
    
        std::vector<u8> result((u8*)&header, (u8*)&header + sizeof(header));
        std::copy(buffer.begin(), buffer.end(), std::back_inserter(result));
    
        return result;
    }
    
    bool System::LoadStateBuffer(std::vector<u8> buffer) {
        CSTHeader header;
    
        if (buffer.size() < sizeof(header)) {
            LOG_ERROR(Core, "Save state too small");
            return false;
        }
    
        header = *((CSTHeader*)buffer.data());
    
        if (header.filetype != header_magic_bytes) {
            LOG_ERROR(Core, "Invalid save state");
            return false;
        }
    
        if (header.program_id != title_id) {
            LOG_ERROR(Core, "Save state isn't for the current game");
            return false;
        }
        std::string revision = fmt::format("{:02x}", fmt::join(header.revision, ""));
        if (revision != Common::g_scm_rev) {
            LOG_ERROR(Core,
                      "Save state file created from a different revision (core: {}, savestate: {})",
                      Common::g_scm_rev, revision);
            return false;
        }
    
        std::vector<u8> state(buffer.begin() + sizeof(CSTHeader), buffer.end());
        auto decompressed = Common::Compression::DecompressDataZSTD(state);
    
        std::istringstream sstream{
            std::string{reinterpret_cast<char*>(decompressed.data()), decompressed.size()},
            std::ios_base::binary};
        decompressed.clear();
    
        // Deserialize
        iarchive ia{sstream};
        ia&* this;
    
        return true;
    }
