        async fn operation(&mut self, method: Method, params: Value) -> io::Result<Value> {
            let Reply { status, mut data, .. } = self.worker.command(method, params).await?;
            if status != Status::Ok {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!("{method:?}: {status:?}: {data}")));
            }
            if data.is_object() {
                data["profile_hash"] = self.profile_hash.clone().into();
                data["identity"] = self.identity.clone();
                data["epoch"] = self.epoch().into();
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    }
    
    /// A stale sequence, reset epoch, malformed header or path cannot expose pixels.
    fn read_frame(root: &Path, lease: &FrameLease) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let expected_width = match lease.screen.as_str() {
            "top" => 400,
            "bottom" => 320,
            _ => 0,
        };
        let expected_path = format!("frames/{}-{}.bgra", lease.screen, lease.sequence % 3);
        if expected_width == 0
            || lease.width != expected_width
            || lease.height != 240
            || lease.stride != lease.width * 4
            || lease.bytes != (lease.stride * 240) as usize
            || lease.slot != lease.sequence % 3
            || lease.path != expected_path
            || lease.format != "bgra8"
            || lease.orientation != "top_left_row_major"
        {
            return Err(io::Error::other("invalid frame lease"));
        }
        // Bound allocation before reading. The worker is serialized by mutable ownership.
        let path = root.join(expected_path);
        if fs::metadata(&path)?.len() != lease.bytes as u64 + 32 {
            return Err(io::Error::other("invalid frame size"));
        }
        let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(lease.bytes + 32);
        File::open(path)?
            .take(lease.bytes as u64 + 33)
            .read_to_end(&mut data)?;
        let mut expected = Vec::with_capacity(32);
        expected.extend_from_slice(b"LTRF");
        expected.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(&lease.epoch.to_le_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(&lease.sequence.to_le_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(&lease.width.to_le_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(&lease.height.to_le_bytes());
        if data.len() != lease.bytes + 32 || data[..32] != expected {
            return Err(io::Error::other("stale or malformed frame slot"));
        }
        Ok(data[32..].to_vec())
    }
    
    // MinGW std::filesystem rejects Rust's verbatim canonical path syntax.
    fn native_path(path: &Path) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
        let absolute = path.canonicalize()?;
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            let text = absolute
                .to_str()
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("native path must be UTF-8"))?;
            if let Some(unc) = text.strip_prefix(r"\\?\UNC\") {
                return Ok(PathBuf::from(format!(r"\\{unc}")));
            }
            if let Some(disk) = text.strip_prefix(r"\\?\") {
                return Ok(PathBuf::from(disk));
            }
        }
        Ok(absolute)
    }

    //! Bridge between GPUI and the shared supervisor; no emulation on the UI thread.
    //!
    //! A background thread runs a Tokio runtime with four loops: UI commands (each
    //! its own task, so one slow worker never stalls the others), the shared pump
    //! (gauges and continuous running), coalesced live input, and the selected
    //! session's preview. With [`McpMode::Stdio`] the same runtime also serves the
    //! MCP tools over stdio against the same supervisor, so an agent and the person
    //! at the window drive one set of sessions.

    use std::thread::JoinHandle;

    /// Commands from the window. Each completes asynchronously.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub enum Command {
        Create {
            kind: SessionKind,
            asset: Option<String>,
        },
        Load {
            session: String,
            asset: String,
        },
        /// A file the person picked; approved for this host, then loaded.
        /// Without a session, a new parentless secondary is created for it.
        OpenFile {
            session: Option<String>,
            path: PathBuf,
        },
        Select(String),
        Play(String),
        Pause(String),
        /// Advance one frame and stay paused.
        Step(String),
        Reset(String),
        Stop(String),
        Abort(String),
    }
    
    /// Whether the window also serves MCP.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum McpMode {
        Off,
        Stdio,
    }
    
    /// MCP link as shown in the window.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum McpLink {
        #[default]
        Off,
        Attached,
        Closed,

    pub struct Preview {

        /// Registers of the selected session at its last paused frame.
        pub registers: Option<(String, Value)>,
        pub error: String,
        pub mcp: McpLink,
        /// Commands still in flight.
        pub pending: usize,
    }

        async fn select_action_thread(&mut self, p: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            if let Some((_, id)) = p.split_once(':') {
                let id = number(id)?;
                let r = self.debug(D::Threads).await?;
                let thread = r["threads"].as_array().ok_or_else(bad)?.iter().find(|t| t["id"] == id).ok_or_else(bad)?;
                self.core = thread["core"].as_u64().ok_or_else(bad)? as u32;
                self.thread = Some(id);
            }
            if let Some(thread) = self.thread {
                let r = self.debug(D::Registers { core: self.core }).await?;
                if r["thread"] != thread { return Err(io::Error::other("selected thread is not scheduled on this core")); }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        async fn continue_until_stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let mut events = self.host.subscribe(&self.session).await?;
            self.debug(D::Continue).await?;
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    event = events.recv() => {
                        let event = event.map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                        if event["data"]["kind"] != "stopped" { continue; }
                        let stop = &event["data"];

    > bool System::DebugStep(u32 id) {
          if (!IsPoweredOn() || id >= cpu_cores.size()) return false;
          running_core = cpu_cores[id].get();
          kernel->SetRunningCPU(running_core);
          auto& manager = kernel->GetThreadManager(id);
          if (!manager.GetCurrentThread()) {
              running_core->GetTimer().Advance();
              manager.Reschedule();
          }
          if (!manager.GetCurrentThread()) return false;
          running_core->ClearBreakFlag();
          running_core->Step();
          Reschedule();
          return true;
      }

    namespace AudioCore::HLE {
    
    // The application-accessible region of DSP memory consists of two parts. Both are marked as IO and
    // have Read/Write permissions.
    //
    // First Region:  0x1FF50000 (Size: 0x8000)
    // Second Region: 0x1FF70000 (Size: 0x8000)
    //
    // The DSP reads from each region alternately based on the frame counter for each region much like a
    // double-buffer. The frame counter is located as the very last u16 of each region and is
    // incremented each audio tick.
    
    constexpr u32 region0_offset = 0x50000;
    constexpr u32 region1_offset = 0x70000;
    
    /**
     * The DSP is native 16-bit. The DSP also appears to be big-endian. When reading 32-bit numbers from
     * its memory regions, the higher and lower 16-bit halves are swapped compared to the little-endian
     * layout of the ARM11. Hence from the ARM11's point of view the memory space appears to be
     * middle-endian.
     *
     * Unusually this does not appear to be an issue for floating point numbers. The DSP makes the more
     * sensible choice of keeping that little-endian. There are also some exceptions such as the
     * IntermediateMixSamples structure, which is little-endian.
     *
     * This struct implements the conversion to and from this middle-endianness.
     */
    struct u32_dsp {
        u32_dsp() = default;
        operator u32() const {
            return Convert(storage);
        }
        void operator=(u32 new_value) {
            storage = Convert(new_value);
        }
    
    private:
        static constexpr u32 Convert(u32 value) {
            return (value << 16) | (value >> 16);
        }
        u32_le storage;
    
        template <class Archive>
        void serialize(Archive& ar, const unsigned int) {
            ar & storage;
        }
        friend class boost::serialization::access;
    };
    static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable<u32_dsp>::value, "u32_dsp isn't trivially copyable");
    
    // There are 15 structures in each memory region. A table of them in the order they appear in memory
    // is presented below:
    //
    //       #           First Region DSP Address   Purpose                               Control
    //       5           0x8400                     DSP Status                            DSP
    //       9           0x8410                     DSP Debug Info                        DSP
    //       6           0x8540                     Final Mix Samples                     DSP
    //       2           0x8680                     Source Status [24]                    DSP
    //       8           0x8710                     Compressor Table                      Application
    //       4           0x9430                     DSP Configuration                     Application
    //       7           0x9492                     Intermediate Mix Samples              DSP + App
    //       1           0x9E92                     Source Configuration [24]             Application
    //       3           0xA792                     Source ADPCM Coefficients [24]        Application
    //       10          0xA912                     Surround Sound Related
    //       11          0xAA12                     Surround Sound Related
    //       12          0xAAD2                     Surround Sound Related
    //       13          0xAC52                     Surround Sound Related
    //       14          0xAC5C                     Surround Sound Related
    //       0           0xBFFF                     Frame Counter                         Application
    //
    // #: This refers to the order in which they appear in the DspPipe::Audio DSP pipe.
    //    See also: HLE::PipeRead.
    //
    // Note that the above addresses do vary slightly between audio firmwares observed; the addresses
    // are not fixed in stone. The addresses above are only an examplar; they're what this
    // implementation does and provides to applications.
    //
    // Application requests the DSP service to convert DSP addresses into ARM11 virtual addresses using
    // the ConvertProcessAddressFromDspDram service call. Applications seem to derive the addresses for
    // the second region via:
    //     second_region_dsp_addr = first_region_dsp_addr | 0x10000
    //
    // Copyright 2016-2026 Citra Emulator Project / Azahar Emulator Project

    //! Windowed LOTUS.
    //!
    //! `lotus-desktop [--mcp] [host.json]`. With `--mcp` the window also serves the
    //! full MCP toolset on stdio over the same sessions, so an agent can launch
    //! LOTUS as its MCP server while a person watches and uses the same window.
    //! stdout then carries only MCP frames.
    use gpui::{App, AppContext, Bounds, TitlebarOptions, WindowBounds, WindowOptions};
    use lotus_desktop::desktop_controller::McpMode;
    use lotus_desktop::lotus_window::LotusWindow;
    use lotus_session::supervisor::HostConfig;
    
    const USAGE: &str = "usage: lotus-desktop [--mcp] [host.json]";
    
    fn main() {
        let mut mcp = McpMode::Off;
        let mut config_path = None;
        for argument in std::env::args_os().skip(1) {
            if argument == "--mcp" {
                mcp = McpMode::Stdio;
            } else if argument == "--help" || argument == "-h" {
                eprintln!("{USAGE}");
                return;
            } else if config_path.is_none() {
                config_path = Some(argument);
            } else {
                eprintln!("{USAGE}");
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
        let config = config_path.map(|path| {
            let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
                eprintln!(
                    "cannot read host configuration {}: {error}",
                    path.to_string_lossy()
                );
                std::process::exit(2);
            });
            serde_json::from_str::<HostConfig>(&text).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
                eprintln!("invalid host configuration: {error}");
                std::process::exit(2);
            })
        });
        gpui_platform::application().run(move |cx: &mut App| {
            let bounds = Bounds::centered(None, gpui::size(gpui::px(1280.0), gpui::px(880.0)), cx);
            cx.open_window(
                WindowOptions {
                    window_bounds: Some(WindowBounds::Windowed(bounds)),
                    titlebar: Some(TitlebarOptions {
                        title: Some("LOTUS".into()),
                        ..Default::default()
                    }),
                    window_min_size: Some(gpui::size(gpui::px(720.0), gpui::px(560.0))),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                |window, cx| cx.new(|cx| LotusWindow::new(config, mcp, window, cx)),
            )
            .expect("open LOTUS window");
            cx.activate(true);
        });
    }

        pub async fn stop(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "stop");
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let result = if native.state().is_active() {
                match tokio::time::timeout(CLOSE_DEADLINE, native.stop()).await {
                    Ok(result) => result,
                    Err(_) => {
                        native.abort().await;
                        Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "worker stop deadline; terminated"))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Ok(())
            };
            let end = if result.is_ok() && native.state() == SessionState::Stopped {
                ScratchEnd::Clean
            } else {
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal
            };
            drop(native);
            {
                let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
                registry.sessions.remove(id);
                registry.mounted.retain(|_, owner| owner != id);
            }
            if matches!(lock(&handle.info).kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                self.cards.discard_scratch(&handle.root, end)?;
            }
            result
        }

    // trims up to and including the last of ../, ..\, src/, src\ in a string
    constexpr const char* TrimSourcePath(std::string_view source) {
        const auto rfind = [source](const std::string_view match) {
            return source.rfind(match) == source.npos ? 0 : (source.rfind(match) + match.size());
        };
        auto idx = std::max({rfind("src/"), rfind("src\\"), rfind("../"), rfind("..\\")});
        return source.data() + idx;
    }

    class Window final : public Frontend::EmuWindow {

        }

            ++frames;
        }
        u64 frames = 0;
    };
    
    class Keyboard final : public Frontend::SoftwareKeyboard {
    public:
        explicit Keyboard(bool& unsupported) : unsupported(unsupported) {}
        void Execute(const Frontend::KeyboardConfig& config) override {
            SoftwareKeyboard::Execute(config);
            unsupported = true;
            Finalize("", 0);
        }
        void ShowError(const std::string&) override {
            unsupported = true;
        }
    
    private:

    };

    public:

        void Setup(const Frontend::MiiSelectorConfig& config) override {
            Frontend::MiiSelector::Setup(config);
            unsupported = true;
            Finalize(1, {});
        }
    
    private:
        bool& unsupported;
    };
    
    inline void Initialize(Core::System& system, const std::string& root, bool& unsupported) {
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root);
        FileUtil::SetUserPath(root + "/");
        Common::Log::Initialize();
        Common::Log::Start();
        DefaultProfile();
        for (const auto& module : Service::service_module_map)
            Settings::values.lle_modules.emplace(module.name, false);
        system.RegisterSoftwareKeyboard(std::make_shared<Keyboard>(unsupported));
        system.RegisterMiiSelector(std::make_shared<MiiSelector>(unsupported));
        system.RegisterImageInterface(std::make_shared<Frontend::ImageInterface>());
    }

        const auto& resource_limit = current_process->resource_limit;

    #pragma once
    #include <filesystem>
    #include <fstream>
    #include <json.hpp>
    #include "core/core.h"
    #include "video_core/gpu.h"
    #include "video_core/renderer_software/renderer_software.h"
    
    namespace CtrWorker {
    // Three reusable slots. A consumer copies before asking for another capture.
    // No UI acknowledgement or retained guest pointers can stall the core.
    inline nlohmann::json Capture(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root, u64 epoch,
                                  u64 sequence) {
        auto& renderer = system.GPU().Renderer();
        nlohmann::json frames = nlohmann::json::array();
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root / "frames");
        for (const auto& [name, id, width] :
             {std::tuple{"top", VideoCore::ScreenId::TopLeft, 400u},
              std::tuple{"bottom", VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, 320u}}) {
            std::vector<u8> pixels(width * 240 * 4);
            if (Settings::values.graphics_api.GetValue() == Settings::GraphicsAPI::Software) {
                const auto& source = static_cast<SwRenderer::RendererSoftware&>(renderer).Screen(id);
                if (source.width != 240 || source.height != width ||
                    source.pixels.size() != width * 240 * 4)
                    throw std::runtime_error("unsupported framebuffer layout");
                pixels = source.pixels;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < pixels.size(); i += 4) std::swap(pixels[i], pixels[i+2]);
            }
    #ifdef ENABLE_VULKAN
            else {
                auto layout = Layout::SingleFrameLayout(width, 240, id == VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, false);
                layout.render_3d_mode = Settings::StereoRenderOption::Off;
                renderer.CaptureOffscreen(pixels.data(), layout);
            }
    #endif
            const auto relative =
                "frames/" + std::string{name} + "-" + std::to_string(sequence % 3) + ".bgra";
            std::ofstream file{root / relative, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
            file.exceptions(std::ios::failbit | std::ios::badbit);
            // Windows/Linux supported hosts are little endian; wire header uses explicit shifts.
            file.write("LTRF", 4);
            const auto write_le = [&file](u64 value, unsigned bytes) {
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
                    file.put(static_cast<char>(value >> (i * 8)));
            };
            write_le(1, 4);
            write_le(epoch, 8);
            write_le(sequence, 8);
            write_le(width, 4);
            write_le(240, 4);
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(pixels.data()), pixels.size());
            file.close();
            frames.push_back({{"screen", name},
                              {"path", relative},
                              {"epoch", epoch},
                              {"sequence", sequence},
                              {"slot", sequence % 3},
                              {"width", width},
                              {"height", 240},
                              {"stride", width * 4},
                              {"format", "bgra8"},
                              {"orientation", "top_left_row_major"},
                              {"bytes", pixels.size()}});
        }
        return frames;
    }
    } // namespace CtrWorker

    //! Headless LOTUS: the MCP server over stdio, no window.
    //!
    //! Local only: no TCP listener is opened and no remote client can attach. When
    //! the client disconnects every session is stopped, so secondary data is
    //! discarded and primary cards are unlocked.
    
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use lotus_mcp::LotusServer;
    use lotus_session::supervisor::HostConfig;
    use rmcp::ServiceExt;
    
    #[tokio::main]
    async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let server = if let Some(path) = std::env::args_os().nth(1) {
            let config: HostConfig = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(path)?)?;
            LotusServer::configured(config, std::collections::BTreeMap::new())?
        } else {
            LotusServer::new()
        };
        let host = server.host().cloned();
        let pump = host.clone().map(|host| {
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                loop {
                    host.pump().await;
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                }
            })
        });
        let service = server.serve(rmcp::transport::stdio()).await?;
        let result = service.waiting().await;
        if let Some(pump) = pump {
            pump.abort();
        }
        if let Some(host) = host {
            let count = host.sessions().len();
            host.close().await;
            eprintln!("LOTUS closed {count} session(s); primary cards retained, secondary guest data discarded. Session handles expire with this server.");
        }
        result?;
        Ok(())
    }

    """Run a real ARM GDB client through the Rust server on both system profiles."""
    import argparse
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import queue
    import subprocess
    import threading
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("gdb", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("cli", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("worker", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("rom", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for new in (False,True):
        root = args.output.resolve() / ("new" if new else "old")
        root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        config = root / "host.json"
        config.write_text(json.dumps(dict(worker=str(args.worker.resolve()),storage_root=str(root / "host"),
            assets={"rom":str(args.rom.resolve()),"elf":str(args.rom.with_suffix('.elf').resolve())},
            allow_control=True,profile={"is_new_3ds":new})))
        host = subprocess.Popen([str(args.cli.resolve()),"debug",str(config),"rom","--gdb","0"],
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
        try:
            session = json.loads(host.stdout.readline())
            line = host.stderr.readline()
            assert line.startswith("GDB listening on "),line
            address = line.strip().split()[-1]
            commands = ["set pagination off","set confirm off",f"file {args.rom.with_suffix('.elf').resolve().as_posix()}",
                f"target remote {address}","break main","continue","stepi","stepi","break lotus_tick_body",
                "continue","bt","delete breakpoints","watch watched","continue","p/x watched","stepi",
                "delete breakpoints","set variable mode = 5","continue","p hio.result","detach"]
            script = root / "acceptance.gdb"
            script.write_text("\n".join(commands)+"\n")
            result = subprocess.run([str(args.gdb.resolve()),"-nx","-batch","-x",str(script)],
                capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
            (root / "gdb.stdout.log").write_text(result.stdout)
            (root / "gdb.stderr.log").write_text(result.stderr)
            assert result.returncode == 0,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
            assert "lotus-hio:hello" in result.stdout,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
            assert "Hardware watchpoint" in result.stdout
            assert "#1" in result.stdout and "main" in result.stdout
            # The same host's ELF/DWARF API resolves symbols and real source lines.
            def debug(command):
                host.stdin.write(json.dumps(command)+"\n");host.stdin.flush()
                reply = json.loads(host.stdout.readline())
                assert "error" not in reply,reply
                return reply
            debug({"operation":"load_symbols","asset":"elf"})
            addresses = debug({"operation":"resolve_symbol","query":"tick"})["addresses"]
            locations = debug({"operation":"symbolize","addresses":addresses})
            assert locations["locations"][0]["line"] > 0,locations
            (root / "symbols.json").write_text(json.dumps(locations,indent=2))
            print(json.dumps({"new_3ds":new,"gdb":"passed","source_lines":locations}),flush=True)
        finally:
            host.stdin.write("quit\n");host.stdin.flush()
            try:host.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:host.kill();host.wait()

## Assistant

The first real ARM GDB connection exposed a transport bug: before the guest thread was scheduled, Lotus reported thread ID zero, which caused GDB to abort. I’ve corrected the initial thread selection and am rerunning the full break/backtrace/watch/HIO sequence. This is why packet tests alone weren’t enough to count GDB as verified.

    namespace Input {
    
    /// An abstract class template for an input device (a button, an analog input, etc.).
    template <typename StatusType>
    class InputDevice {
    public:
        virtual ~InputDevice() = default;
        virtual StatusType GetStatus() const {
            return {};
        }
    };
    
    /// An abstract class template for a factory that can create input devices.
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    class Factory {
    public:
        virtual ~Factory() = default;
        virtual std::unique_ptr<InputDeviceType> Create(const Common::ParamPackage&) = 0;
    };
    
    namespace Impl {
    
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    using FactoryListType = std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<Factory<InputDeviceType>>>;
    
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    struct FactoryList {
        static FactoryListType<InputDeviceType> list;
    };
    
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    FactoryListType<InputDeviceType> FactoryList<InputDeviceType>::list;
    
    } // namespace Impl
    
    /**
     * Registers an input device factory.
     * @tparam InputDeviceType the type of input devices the factory can create
     * @param name the name of the factory. Will be used to match the "engine" parameter when creating
     *     a device
     * @param factory the factory object to register
     */
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    void RegisterFactory(const std::string& name, std::shared_ptr<Factory<InputDeviceType>> factory) {
        auto pair = std::make_pair(name, std::move(factory));
        if (!Impl::FactoryList<InputDeviceType>::list.insert(std::move(pair)).second) {
            LOG_ERROR(Input, "Factory {} already registered", name);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Unregisters an input device factory.
     * @tparam InputDeviceType the type of input devices the factory can create
     * @param name the name of the factory to unregister
     */
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    void UnregisterFactory(const std::string& name) {
        if (Impl::FactoryList<InputDeviceType>::list.erase(name) == 0) {
            LOG_ERROR(Input, "Factory {} not registered", name);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Create an input device from given parameters.
     * @tparam InputDeviceType the type of input devices to create
     * @param params a serialized ParamPackage string contains all parameters for creating the device
     */
    template <typename InputDeviceType>
    std::unique_ptr<InputDeviceType> CreateDevice(const std::string& params) {
        const Common::ParamPackage package(params);
        const std::string engine = package.Get("engine", "null");
        const auto& factory_list = Impl::FactoryList<InputDeviceType>::list;
        const auto pair = factory_list.find(engine);
        if (pair == factory_list.end()) {
            if (engine != "null") {
                LOG_ERROR(Input, "Unknown engine name: {}", engine);
            }
            return std::make_unique<InputDeviceType>();
        }
        return pair->second->Create(package);
    }
    
    /**
     * A button device is an input device that returns bool as status.
     * true for pressed; false for released.
     */
    using ButtonDevice = InputDevice<bool>;
    
    /**
     * An analog device is an input device that returns a tuple of x and y coordinates as status. The
     * coordinates are within the unit circle. x+ is defined as right direction, and y+ is defined as up
     * direction
     */
    using AnalogDevice = InputDevice<std::tuple<float, float>>;
    
    /**
     * A motion device is an input device that returns a tuple of accelerometer state vector and
     * gyroscope state vector.
     *
     * For both vectors:
     *   x+ is the same direction as LEFT on D-pad.
     *   y+ is normal to the touch screen, pointing outward.
     *   z+ is the same direction as UP on D-pad.
     *
     * For accelerometer state vector
     *   Units: g (gravitational acceleration)
     *
     * For gyroscope state vector:
     *   Orientation is determined by right-hand rule.
     *   Units: deg/sec
     */
    using MotionDevice = InputDevice<std::tuple<Common::Vec3<float>, Common::Vec3<float>>>;
    
    /**
     * A touch device is an input device that returns a tuple of two floats and a bool. The floats are
     * x and y coordinates in the range 0.0 - 1.0, and the bool indicates whether it is pressed.
     */
    using TouchDevice = InputDevice<std::tuple<float, float, bool>>;

    """Opt-in end-to-end stdio smoke: python tests/test_mcp_native.py <server> <config> <asset-handle>."""
    import base64
    import json
    import queue
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import threading
    import time
    
    
    def main():
        server, config, asset = sys.argv[1:]
        messages = queue.Queue()
        flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == "win32" else 0
        with subprocess.Popen([server, config], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                              stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                              creationflags=flags) as process:
            def read():
                for line in process.stdout:
                    messages.put(json.loads(line))
                messages.put(None)
            threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True).start()
            request_id = 0
    
            def send(method, params=None, notification=False):
                nonlocal request_id
                request_id += 1
                message = {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": method}
                if not notification:
                    message["id"] = request_id
                if params is not None:
                    message["params"] = params
                process.stdin.write(json.dumps(message) + "\n")
                process.stdin.flush()
                if notification:
                    return None
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
                while True:
                    reply = messages.get(timeout=max(0.001, deadline - time.monotonic()))
                    assert reply is not None, "server exited early"
                    if reply.get("id") == request_id:
                        assert "error" not in reply, reply
                        return reply["result"]
    
            def tool(name, arguments):
                result = send("tools/call", {"name": name, "arguments": arguments})
                assert not result.get("isError", False), result
                return result
    
            try:
                send("initialize", {"protocolVersion": "2025-03-26", "capabilities": {},
                                    "clientInfo": {"name": "lotus-local-acceptance", "version": "1"}})
                send("notifications/initialized", notification=True)
                names = {entry["name"] for entry in send("tools/list")["tools"]}
                assert {"lotus_create_session", "lotus_run_until", "lotus_capture", "lotus_input"} <= names
                created = tool("lotus_create_session", {"asset": asset})
                session = json.loads(created["content"][0]["text"])["session"]
                tool("lotus_run_until", {"session": session, "frames": 60})
                capture = tool("lotus_capture", {"session": session})
                assert len(capture["content"]) == 2
                for link in capture["content"]:
                    assert link["type"] == "resource_link"
                    resource = send("resources/read", {"uri": link["uri"]})
                    data = base64.b64decode(resource["contents"][0]["blob"], validate=True)
                    assert len(data) == link["size"]
                assert len(send("resources/list")["resources"]) == 2
                denied = send("tools/call", {"name": "lotus_create_session", "arguments": {"asset": "../../arbitrary.3dsx"}})
                assert denied.get("isError")
                tool("lotus_control", {"session": session, "operation": "stop"})
                process.stdin.close()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
                assert process.returncode == 0
                print("MCP stdio/native lifecycle/resources/permissions: passed")
            finally:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()
    //! Primary cards and secondary scratch roots below the host storage root.
    //!
    //! A primary session mounts `cards/<name>/` as its worker root, so Azahar's
    //! `sdmc/`, `nand/` and `sysdata/` (`common_paths.h`) persist between runs. A
    //! secondary session gets `scratch/<session>/`: empty, or a point-in-time host
    //! copy of one card's guest directories. The copy is not coordinated with a
    //! running parent's guest writes. Scratch guest data is deleted when the
    //! secondary ends; worker logs are kept only when it ended abnormally.
    use std::fs::{self, File};
    use std::io;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    
    /// Guest-visible directories copied into a secondary from its parent card.
    pub const GUEST_DIRS: [&str; 3] = ["sdmc", "nand", "sysdata"];
    /// Largest parent copy accepted for one secondary.
    pub const MAX_COPY_BYTES: u64 = 4 << 30;
    /// Host diagnostics retained after an abnormal end.
    const RETAINED: [&str; 3] = ["worker.stderr.log", "log", "native-manifest.json"];
    
    /// Owns the `cards/` and `scratch/` directories of one storage root.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct CardStore {
        cards: PathBuf,
        scratch: PathBuf,
    }
    
    impl CardStore {
        /// Create both directories and discard scratch data left by a previous host.
        pub fn open(storage_root: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
            let store = Self {
                cards: storage_root.join("cards"),
                scratch: storage_root.join("scratch"),
            };
            fs::create_dir_all(&store.cards)?;
            fs::create_dir_all(&store.scratch)?;
            store.sweep()?;
            Ok(store)
        }
    
        /// Card names in sorted order.
        pub fn list(&self) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {
            let mut names = Vec::new();
            for entry in fs::read_dir(&self.cards)? {
                let entry = entry?;
                let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                if entry.file_type()?.is_dir() && validate_name(&name).is_ok() {
                    names.push(name);
                }
            }
            names.sort();
            Ok(names)
        }
    
        /// Root of a primary card, created on first use.
        pub fn primary_root(&self, name: &str) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            validate_name(name)?;
            let root = self.cards.join(name);
            fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;
            if is_locked(&root)? {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::ResourceBusy,
                    format!("card '{name}' is mounted by another LOTUS process"),
                ));
            }
            Ok(root)
        }
    
        /// Create a scratch root, optionally seeded from a card's guest directories.
        pub fn create_scratch(&self, session: &str, parent: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            let root = self.scratch.join(session);
            fs::create_dir(&root)?;
            let Some(parent) = parent else {
                return Ok(root);
            };
            let result = (|| {
                validate_name(parent)?;
                let source = self.cards.join(parent);
                if !source.is_dir() {
                    return Err(io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::NotFound,
                        format!("unknown card '{parent}'"),
                    ));
                }
                let mut budget = MAX_COPY_BYTES;
                for name in GUEST_DIRS {
                    let from = source.join(name);
                    if from.is_dir() {
                        copy_tree(&from, &root.join(name), &mut budget)?;
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            })();
            if let Err(error) = result {
                let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
                return Err(error);
            }
            Ok(root)
        }
    
        /// End a secondary. A clean end removes everything; otherwise logs remain.
        pub fn discard_scratch(&self, root: &Path, end: ScratchEnd) -> io::Result<()> {
            if root.parent() != Some(self.scratch.as_path()) {
                return Err(io::Error::other("refusing to discard a non-scratch root"));
            }
            match end {
                ScratchEnd::Clean => fs::remove_dir_all(root),
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal => discard_guest_data(root),
            }
        }
    
        /// Unlocked scratch roots belong to no live worker: drop their guest data.
        fn sweep(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
            for entry in fs::read_dir(&self.scratch)? {
                let root = entry?.path();
                if root.is_dir() && !is_locked(&root)? {
                    discard_guest_data(&root)?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    /// How a secondary ended, which decides whether its logs are kept.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum ScratchEnd {
        Clean,
        Abnormal,
    }
    
    /// Card names: 1–32 of `a-z 0-9 - _`, starting with a letter or digit.
    pub fn validate_name(name: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
        let valid = (1..=32).contains(&name.len())
            && name.starts_with(|c: char| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit())
            && name
                .chars()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '-' || c == '_');
        if valid {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
                "card name must be 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, '-', '_' and start with a letter or digit",
            ))
        }
    }
    
    /// Whether a live worker holds this root's lock. The worker's lock stays authoritative.
    fn is_locked(root: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {
        let path = root.join("worker.lock");
        if !path.exists() {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        let file = File::options().read(true).write(true).open(path)?;
        match file.try_lock() {
            Ok(()) => Ok(false),
            Err(fs::TryLockError::WouldBlock) => Ok(true),
            Err(fs::TryLockError::Error(error)) => Err(error),
        }
    }

    namespace CiTrace {
    
    class Recorder {
    public:
        struct InitialState {
            std::vector<u32> lcd_registers;
            std::vector<u32> pica_registers;
            std::vector<u32> default_attributes;
            std::vector<u32> vs_program_binary;
            std::vector<u32> vs_swizzle_data;
            std::vector<u32> vs_float_uniforms;
            std::vector<u32> gs_program_binary;
            std::vector<u32> gs_swizzle_data;
            std::vector<u32> gs_float_uniforms;
        };
    
        /**
         * Recorder constructor
         * @param initial_state Initial recorder state
         */
        explicit Recorder(const InitialState& initial_state);
    
        /// Finish recording of this Citrace and save it using the given filename.
        void Finish(const std::string& filename);
    
        /// Mark end of a frame
        void FrameFinished();
    
        /**
         * Store a copy of the given memory range in the recording.
         * @note Use this whenever the GPU is about to access a particular memory region.
         * @note The implementation will make sure to minimize redundant memory updates.
         */
        void MemoryAccessed(const u8* data, u32 size, u32 physical_address);
    
        /**
         * Record a register write.
         * @note Use this whenever a GPU-related MMIO register has been written to.
         */
        void RegisterWritten(u32 physical_address, u32 value);
    
    private:
        // Initial state of recording start
        InitialState initial_state;
    
        // Command stream
        struct StreamElement {
            CTStreamElement data;
    
            /**
             * Extra data to store along "core" data.
             * This is e.g. used for data used in MemoryUpdates.
             */
            std::vector<u8> extra_data;
    
            /// Optional CRC hash (e.g. for hashing memory regions)
            boost::crc_32_type::value_type hash;
    
            /// If true, refer to data already written to the output file instead of extra_data
            bool uses_existing_data;
        };
    
        std::vector<StreamElement> stream;
    
        /**
         * Internal cache which maps hashes of memory contents to file offsets at which those memory
         * contents are stored.
         */
        std::unordered_map<boost::crc_32_type::value_type /*hash*/, u32 /*file_offset*/> memory_regions;
    };
    
    } // namespace CiTrace

    namespace CiTrace {
    
    Recorder::Recorder(const InitialState& initial_state) : initial_state(initial_state) {}
    
    void Recorder::Finish(const std::string& filename) {
        // Setup CiTrace header
        CTHeader header;
        std::memcpy(header.magic, CTHeader::ExpectedMagicWord(), 4);
        header.version = CTHeader::ExpectedVersion();
        header.header_size = sizeof(CTHeader);
    
        // Calculate file offsets
        auto& initial = header.initial_state_offsets;
    
        initial.pica_registers_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.pica_registers.size());
        initial.lcd_registers_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.lcd_registers.size());
        initial.default_attributes_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.default_attributes.size());
        initial.vs_program_binary_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_program_binary.size());
        initial.vs_swizzle_data_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size());
        initial.vs_float_uniforms_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size());
        initial.gs_program_binary_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_program_binary.size());
        initial.gs_swizzle_data_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size());
        initial.gs_float_uniforms_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size());
        header.stream_size = static_cast<u32>(stream.size());
    
        initial.gpu_registers = sizeof(header);
        initial.lcd_registers = initial.gpu_registers + initial.gpu_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.pica_registers = initial.lcd_registers + initial.lcd_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        ;
        initial.default_attributes = initial.pica_registers + initial.pica_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_program_binary =
            initial.default_attributes + initial.default_attributes_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_swizzle_data =
            initial.vs_program_binary + initial.vs_program_binary_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_float_uniforms =
            initial.vs_swizzle_data + initial.vs_swizzle_data_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_program_binary =
            initial.vs_float_uniforms + initial.vs_float_uniforms_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_swizzle_data =
            initial.gs_program_binary + initial.gs_program_binary_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_float_uniforms =
            initial.gs_swizzle_data + initial.gs_swizzle_data_size * sizeof(u32);
        header.stream_offset = initial.gs_float_uniforms + initial.gs_float_uniforms_size * sizeof(u32);
    
        // Iterate through stream elements, update relevant stream element data
        for (auto& stream_element : stream) {
            switch (stream_element.data.type) {
            case MemoryLoad: {
                auto& file_offset = memory_regions[stream_element.hash];
                if (!stream_element.uses_existing_data) {
                    file_offset = header.stream_offset;
                }
                stream_element.data.memory_load.file_offset = file_offset;
                break;
            }
    
            default:
                // Other commands don't use any extra data
                DEBUG_ASSERT(stream_element.extra_data.size() == 0);
                break;
            }
            header.stream_offset += static_cast<u32>(stream_element.extra_data.size());
        }
    
        try {
            // Open file and write header
            FileUtil::IOFile file(filename, "wb");
            std::size_t written = file.WriteObject(header);
            if (written != 1 || file.Tell() != initial.gpu_registers)
                throw "Failed to write header";
    
            // Write initial state
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.pica_registers.data(),
                                      initial_state.pica_registers.size());
            if (written != initial_state.pica_registers.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.default_attributes)
                throw "Failed to write Pica registers";
    
            written =
                file.WriteArray(initial_state.lcd_registers.data(), initial_state.lcd_registers.size());
            if (written != initial_state.lcd_registers.size() || file.Tell() != initial.pica_registers)
                throw "Failed to write LCD registers";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.default_attributes.data(),
                                      initial_state.default_attributes.size());
            if (written != initial_state.default_attributes.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_program_binary)
                throw "Failed to write default vertex attributes";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_program_binary.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_program_binary.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_program_binary.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_swizzle_data)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader program binary";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_float_uniforms)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader swizzle data";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_program_binary)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader float uniforms";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_program_binary.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_program_binary.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_program_binary.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_swizzle_data)
                throw "Failed to write geomtry shader program binary";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_float_uniforms)
                throw "Failed to write geometry shader swizzle data";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_float_uniforms + sizeof(u32) * initial.gs_float_uniforms_size)
                throw "Failed to write geometry shader float uniforms";
    
            // Iterate through stream elements, write "extra data"
            for (const auto& stream_element : stream) {
                if (stream_element.extra_data.size() == 0)
                    continue;
    
                written =
                    file.WriteBytes(stream_element.extra_data.data(), stream_element.extra_data.size());
                if (written != stream_element.extra_data.size())
                    throw "Failed to write extra data";
            }
    
            if (file.Tell() != header.stream_offset)
                throw "Unexpected end of extra data";

    namespace CtrWorker {
    struct InputState {
        u32 buttons = 0;
        float x = 0;
        float y = 0;
        bool touch = false;
        std::array<float,2> circle{}, cstick{};
        Common::Vec3<float> acceleration{}, gyroscope{};
    };
    class Analog final : public Input::AnalogDevice {
    public:
        Analog(const InputState& state, bool cstick) : state(state), cstick(cstick) {}
        std::tuple<float,float> GetStatus() const override {
            auto value = cstick ? state.cstick : state.circle;
            const float length = std::hypot(value[0],value[1]);
            if (length>1.f) { value[0]/=length; value[1]/=length; }
            return {value[0],value[1]};
        }
    private:
        const InputState& state; bool cstick;
    };
    class AnalogFactory final : public Input::Factory<Input::AnalogDevice> {
    public:
        explicit AnalogFactory(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::AnalogDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage& p) override {
            return std::make_unique<Analog>(state,p.Get("index",0)==1);
        }
    private: const InputState& state;
    };
    class Motion final : public Input::MotionDevice {
    public:
        explicit Motion(const InputState& state):state(state) {}
        std::tuple<Common::Vec3<float>,Common::Vec3<float>> GetStatus() const override {
            return {state.acceleration,state.gyroscope};
        }
    private: const InputState& state;
    };
    class MotionFactory final : public Input::Factory<Input::MotionDevice> {
    public:
        explicit MotionFactory(const InputState& state):state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::MotionDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage&) override {
            return std::make_unique<Motion>(state);
        }
    private: const InputState& state;
    };
    class Button final : public Input::ButtonDevice {
    public:
        Button(const InputState& state, unsigned index) : state(state), index(index) {}
        bool GetStatus() const override {
            return (state.buttons & (1u << index)) != 0;
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
        unsigned index;
    };
    class ButtonFactory final : public Input::Factory<Input::ButtonDevice> {
    public:
        explicit ButtonFactory(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::ButtonDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage& params) override {
            const auto index = params.Get("index", 0);
            if (index < 0 || index >= Settings::NativeButton::NumButtons)
                return std::make_unique<Input::ButtonDevice>();
            return std::make_unique<Button>(state, index);
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
    };
    class Touch final : public Input::TouchDevice {
    public:
        explicit Touch(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::tuple<float, float, bool> GetStatus() const override {

        }
    
    private:

    };

    public:
        explicit TouchFactory(const InputState& state) : state(state) {}
        std::unique_ptr<Input::TouchDevice> Create(const Common::ParamPackage&) override {
            return std::make_unique<Touch>(state);
        }
    
    private:
        const InputState& state;
    };
    inline void RegisterInput(InputState& state) {
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::ButtonDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<ButtonFactory>(state));
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::TouchDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<TouchFactory>(state));
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::AnalogDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<AnalogFactory>(state));
        Input::RegisterFactory<Input::MotionDevice>("ctr", std::make_shared<MotionFactory>(state));
        auto& profile = Settings::values.current_input_profile;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < profile.buttons.size(); ++i)
            profile.buttons[i] = "engine:ctr,index:" + std::to_string(i);
        profile.touch_device = "engine:ctr";
        profile.analogs[Settings::NativeAnalog::CirclePad] = "engine:ctr,index:0";
        profile.analogs[Settings::NativeAnalog::CStick] = "engine:ctr,index:1";
        profile.motion_device = "engine:ctr";
    }
    } // namespace CtrWorker

        /// Host presentation policy; never pauses the guest or changes deterministic capture.
        pub async fn focus_audio(&self, id: &str, enabled: bool) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut focus = self.audio_focus.lock().await;
            if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) && enabled {
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"focused": id}));
            }
            if enabled {
                if let Some(previous) = focus.take() {
                    if let Ok(old) = self.handle(&previous) {
                        old.native.lock().await.debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled: false }).await?;
                    }
                }
            }
            let result = handle.native.lock().await.debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled }).await?;
            if enabled { *focus = Some(id.to_string()); }
            else if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) { *focus = None; }
            Ok(result)
        }

    std::vector<InputDetails> ListInputs() {
        return {input_details.begin(), input_details.end()};
    }
    
    const InputDetails& GetInputDetails(InputType input_type) {
        auto iter = std::find_if(
            input_details.begin(), input_details.end(),
            [input_type](const auto& input_detail) { return input_detail.type == input_type; });
    
        if (input_type == InputType::Auto || iter == input_details.end()) {
            if (input_type != InputType::Auto) {
                LOG_ERROR(Audio, "AudioCore::GetInputDetails given invalid input_type {}", input_type);
            }
            // Auto-select.
            // input_details is ordered in terms of desirability, with the best choice at the front.
            iter = input_details.begin();
        }
    
        return *iter;
    }

    /// Copy regular files and directories; links are refused rather than followed.
    fn copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path, budget: &mut u64) -> io::Result<()> {
        fs::create_dir_all(to)?;
        for entry in fs::read_dir(from)? {
            let entry = entry?;
            let kind = entry.file_type()?;
            let target = to.join(entry.file_name());
            if kind.is_dir() {
                copy_tree(&entry.path(), &target, budget)?;
            } else if kind.is_file() {
                let size = entry.metadata()?.len();
                *budget = budget.checked_sub(size).ok_or_else(|| {
                    io::Error::new(
                        io::ErrorKind::QuotaExceeded,
                        "parent card exceeds the 4 GiB secondary copy limit",
                    )
                })?;
                fs::copy(entry.path(), target)?;
            } else {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!(
                    "refusing to copy link {}",
                    entry.path().display()
                )));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// An abstract class standing for a camera. All camera implementations should inherit from this.
    class CameraInterface {
    public:
        virtual ~CameraInterface();
    
        /// Starts the camera for video capturing.
        virtual void StartCapture() = 0;
    
        /// Stops the camera for video capturing.
        virtual void StopCapture() = 0;
    
        /**
         * Sets the video resolution from raw CAM service parameters.
         * For the meaning of the parameters, please refer to Service::CAM::Resolution. Note that the
         * actual camera implementation doesn't need to respect all the parameters. However, the width
         * and the height parameters must be respected and be used to determine the size of output
         * frames.
         * @param resolution The resolution parameters to set
         */
        virtual void SetResolution(const Service::CAM::Resolution& resolution) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Configures how received frames should be flipped by the camera.
         * @param flip Flip applying to the frame
         */
        virtual void SetFlip(Service::CAM::Flip flip) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Configures what effect should be applied to received frames by the camera.
         * @param effect Effect applying to the frame
         */
        virtual void SetEffect(Service::CAM::Effect effect) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Sets the output format of the all frames received after this function is called.
         * @param format Output format of the frame
         */
        virtual void SetFormat(Service::CAM::OutputFormat format) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Sets the recommended framerate of the camera.
         * @param frame_rate Recommended framerate
         */
        virtual void SetFrameRate(Service::CAM::FrameRate frame_rate) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Receives a frame from the camera.
         * This function should be only called between a StartCapture call and a StopCapture call.
         * @returns A std::vector<u16> containing pixels. The total size of the vector is width * height
         *     where width and height are set by a call to SetResolution.
         */
        virtual std::vector<u16> ReceiveFrame() = 0;
    
        /**
         * Test if the camera is opened successfully and can receive a preview frame. Only used for
         * preview. This function should be only called between a StartCapture call and a StopCapture
         * call.
         * @returns true if the camera is opened successfully and false otherwise
         */
        virtual bool IsPreviewAvailable() = 0;
    };
    
    } // namespace Camera

    //! Explicitly approved private assets, copied only to fixed native locations.
    use std::{fs, io, path::Path};
    use lotus_protocol::debug::AssetKind;
    
    pub fn mount(root: &Path, source: &Path, kind: AssetKind) -> io::Result<()> {
        let (relative, maximum) = match kind {
            AssetKind::DspFirmware => ("sdmc/3ds/dspfirm.cdc", 4<<20),
            AssetKind::Otp => ("sysdata/otp.bin", 0x100),
            AssetKind::SecureInfo => ("nand/rw/sys/SecureInfo_A", 4096),
            AssetKind::LocalFriendCodeSeed => ("nand/rw/sys/LocalFriendCodeSeed_B",4096),
            AssetKind::Movable => ("nand/private/movable.sed",4096),
            AssetKind::MicWav => ("media/mic.wav",64<<20),
            AssetKind::Nfc => ("media/nfc.bin",128<<10),
        };
        let size=fs::metadata(source)?.len();
        if size==0 || size>maximum { return Err(io::Error::other("private asset exceeds its type's size limit")); }
        let bytes=fs::read(source)?;
        if matches!(kind,AssetKind::DspFirmware) { validate_dsp(&bytes)?; }
        let root=root.canonicalize()?;
        let destination=root.join(relative);
        let parent=destination.parent().expect("fixed path has parent");
        // Check each existing component before creating anything under it.
        let mut checked=root.clone();
        for component in Path::new(relative).parent().expect("fixed parent").components() {
            checked.push(component);
            if checked.exists() && !checked.canonicalize()?.starts_with(&root) {
                return Err(io::Error::other("asset destination escaped session root"));
            }
        }
        fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        if !parent.canonicalize()?.starts_with(&root) ||
            fs::symlink_metadata(&destination).is_ok_and(|m|m.file_type().is_symlink()) {
            return Err(io::Error::other("asset destination escaped session root"));
        }
        fs::write(destination,bytes)
    }
    
    fn validate_dsp(bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
        let invalid=||io::Error::other("invalid DSP1 firmware asset");
        if bytes.len()<0x300 || &bytes[0x100..0x104]!=b"DSP1" || bytes[0x10e]>10 { return Err(invalid()); }
        let size=u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[0x104..0x108].try_into().map_err(|_|invalid())?) as usize;
        if size>bytes.len() || size<0x300 { return Err(invalid()); }
        for index in 0..usize::from(bytes[0x10e]) {
            let start=0x120+index*0x30;
            let offset=u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[start..start+4].try_into().map_err(|_|invalid())?) as u64;
            let length=u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[start+8..start+12].try_into().map_err(|_|invalid())?) as u64;
            if offset+length>size as u64 { return Err(invalid()); }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)] mod tests {
        use super::*;
        #[test] fn rejects_truncated_or_out_of_bounds_dsp_segments() {
            assert!(validate_dsp(&[]).is_err());
            let mut data=vec![0;0x300]; data[0x100..0x104].copy_from_slice(b"DSP1");
            data[0x104..0x108].copy_from_slice(&0x300u32.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(validate_dsp(&data).is_ok());
            data[0x10e]=1;data[0x120..0x124].copy_from_slice(&0x301u32.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(validate_dsp(&data).is_err());
        }
    }

    // Deterministic finite PCM WAV microphone source. Silence follows end-of-file.
    #pragma once
    #include <algorithm>
    #include <fstream>
    #include <filesystem>
    #include <span>
    #include "audio_core/input.h"
    
    namespace AudioCore {
    class InjectedInput final : public Input {
    public:
        inline static std::vector<s16> samples;
        inline static u32 source_rate=32728;
        static void Load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
            const auto size=std::filesystem::file_size(path);
            if(size<44||size>(64u<<20))throw std::invalid_argument("WAV size budget");
            std::vector<u8> bytes(size);std::ifstream file(path,std::ios::binary);
            file.exceptions(std::ios::failbit|std::ios::badbit);file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()),size);
            auto word=[&](size_t at,unsigned count)->u32 {
                if(at+count>bytes.size())throw std::invalid_argument("truncated WAV");
                u32 value=0;for(unsigned i=0;i<count;++i)value|=u32(bytes[at+i])<<(8*i);return value;
            };
            if(std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"RIFF",4)||std::memcmp(bytes.data()+8,"WAVE",4))
                throw std::invalid_argument("expected RIFF WAV");
            u32 channels=0,rate=0;std::span<const u8> pcm;
            for(size_t offset=12,count=0;offset+8<=size && count<4096;++count) {
                const auto length=word(offset+4,4);const auto start=offset+8;
                if(u64(start)+length>size)throw std::invalid_argument("truncated WAV chunk");
                if(!std::memcmp(bytes.data()+offset,"fmt ",4)) {
                    if(length<16||word(start,2)!=1||word(start+14,2)!=16)throw std::invalid_argument("WAV must be PCM16");
                    channels=word(start+2,2);rate=word(start+4,4);
                    if((channels!=1&&channels!=2)||rate<8000||rate>96000||word(start+12,2)!=channels*2)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("WAV format range");
                } else if(!std::memcmp(bytes.data()+offset,"data",4))pcm=std::span(bytes).subspan(start,length);
                offset=start+length+(length&1);
            }
            if(!channels||!rate||pcm.empty()||pcm.size()%(channels*2))throw std::invalid_argument("missing WAV PCM");
            std::vector<s16> decoded;decoded.reserve(pcm.size()/(channels*2));
            for(size_t i=0;i<pcm.size();i+=channels*2) {
                auto sample=[&](size_t at){return static_cast<s16>(u16(pcm[at])|(u16(pcm[at+1])<<8));};
                decoded.push_back(channels==1?sample(i):static_cast<s16>((s32(sample(i))+sample(i+2))/2));
            }
            samples=std::move(decoded);source_rate=rate;
        }
        void StartSampling(const InputParameters& p) override { parameters=p;phase=0;sampling=true; }
        void StopSampling() override { sampling=false; }
        bool IsSampling() override { return sampling; }
        void AdjustSampleRate(u32 rate) override { parameters.sample_rate=rate;phase=0; }
        Samples Read() override {
            if(!sampling)return {};
            Samples output;output.reserve(32);
            for(unsigned i=0;i<16;++i) {
                const auto index=phase/std::max(parameters.sample_rate,1u);
                const s16 value=index<samples.size()?samples[index]:0;
                phase+=source_rate;
                const u16 encoded=parameters.sign==Signedness::Unsigned?static_cast<u16>(s32(value)+32768):static_cast<u16>(value);
                if(parameters.sample_size==8)output.push_back(encoded>>8);
                else {output.push_back(encoded&255);output.push_back(encoded>>8);}
            }
            return output;
        }
    private:
        u64 phase=0;bool sampling=false;
    };

    """Local stdio MCP test client, with bounded waits and a retained JSONL transcript."""
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import queue
    import subprocess
    import threading
    import time
    
    class Client:
        def __init__(self, executable, config, transcript):
            self.process = subprocess.Popen([str(executable),str(config)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
            self.messages=queue.Queue(64);self.sequence=0
            self.transcript=Path(transcript).open("w",encoding="utf-8")
            def read():
                try:
                    for line in self.process.stdout:self.messages.put(json.loads(line))
                finally:self.messages.put(None)
            threading.Thread(target=read,daemon=True).start()
            self.send("initialize",{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},
                "clientInfo":{"name":"lotus-debugger-acceptance","version":"1"}})
            self.send("notifications/initialized",notification=True)
    
        def record(self,direction,data):
            self.transcript.write(json.dumps({"direction":direction,"message":data})+"\n")
            self.transcript.flush()
    
        def send(self,method,params=None,notification=False):
            self.sequence+=1
            message={"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":method}
            if not notification:message["id"]=self.sequence
            if params is not None:message["params"]=params
            self.record("request",message)
            self.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(message)+"\n");self.process.stdin.flush()
            if notification:return
            deadline=time.monotonic()+40
            while True:
                reply=self.messages.get(timeout=max(.001,deadline-time.monotonic()))
                assert reply is not None,"MCP server exited early"
                self.record("response",reply)
                if reply.get("id")==self.sequence:
                    assert "error" not in reply,reply
                    return reply["result"]
    
        def tool(self,name,arguments,expected_error=False):
            result=self.send("tools/call",{"name":name,"arguments":arguments})
            assert bool(result.get("isError"))==expected_error,result
            if result.get("content") and result["content"][0].get("type")=="text":
                text=result["content"][0]["text"]
                try:return json.loads(text)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:return text
            return result
    
        def close(self):
            self.process.stdin.close()
            try:self.process.wait(timeout=12)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:self.process.kill();self.process.wait();raise
            finally:
                self.transcript.close()
            assert self.process.returncode==0,self.process.stderr.read()

    """Diagnose owned guest bugs using only MCP tool/resource calls.
    python tests/test_mcp_debugger.py <server> <host.json> <rom-handle> <elf-handle> <output>
    """
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import socket
    import sys
    import time
    from mcp_client import Client
    
    server,config,rom,elf,output=sys.argv[1:]
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    client=Client(server,config,output/"transcript.jsonl")
    try:
        for new in (False,True):
            card="debug-new" if new else "debug-old"
            info=client.tool("lotus_create_session",{"kind":"primary","card":card})
            session=info["session"]
            def debug(operation,**params):
                return client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":operation,**params}})
            debug("settings_set",name="is_new_3ds",value=new)
            client.tool("lotus_load",{"session":session,"asset":rom})
            debug("load_symbols",asset=elf)
            def address(query):
                found=debug("resolve_symbol",query=query)["addresses"]
                assert len(found)==1,(query,found)
                return found[0]
            main=address("main");mode=address("mode");canary=address("canary")
            location=debug("symbolize",addresses=[main])["locations"][0]
            assert location["line"] and debug("resolve_symbol",query=f"fixture.c:{location['line']}")["addresses"]
            bp=debug("breakpoint_set",address=main,kind="execute",length=4)
            stopped=client.tool("lotus_run_until",{"session":session,"frames":1})
            assert stopped["stop"]["reason"]=="breakpoint",stopped
            debug("breakpoint_remove",id=bp["id"])
            # A second controller can inspect but cannot mutate while GDB owns the lease.
            listener=client.tool("lotus_gdb",{"session":session,"operation":"start"})
            host,port=listener["address"].rsplit(':',1)
            sock=socket.create_connection((host,int(port)),timeout=3)
            payload=b"qSupported";sock.sendall(b'$'+payload+b'#'+f'{sum(payload)%256:02x}'.encode())
            data=b''
            while b'#' not in data:data+=sock.recv(8192)
            assert b'PacketSize=' in data,data
            debug("registers",core=0)
            denied=client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":"pause"}},expected_error=True)
            assert "lease" in str(denied),denied
            sock.close()
            for attempt in range(50):
                result=client.send("tools/call",{"name":"lotus_debug","arguments":{"session":session,"command":{"operation":"pause"}}})
                if not result.get("isError"):break
                time.sleep(.02)
            else:raise AssertionError("GDB disconnect leaked the debug lease")
            client.tool("lotus_gdb",{"session":session,"operation":"stop"})
            for bug,reason in ((1,"exception"),(2,"watchpoint"),(3,"svc_break"),(4,"exception")):
                client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":session,"operation":"reset"})
                if bug==2:debug("breakpoint_set",address=canary+4,kind="write",length=4)
                debug("write_memory",address=mode,bytes=[bug,0,0,0])
                stopped=client.tool("lotus_run_until",{"session":session,"frames":1})
                assert stopped["stop"]["reason"]==reason,stopped
                report=debug("crash_report",core=0)
                assert report["failure_domain"]=="guest"
                if bug==1:assert stopped["stop"]["address"]==0,stopped
                if bug==2:

    class DiskFile : public FileBackend {
    public:
        DiskFile(FileUtil::IOFile&& file_, const Mode& mode_,
                 std::unique_ptr<DelayGenerator> delay_generator_)
            : file(new FileUtil::IOFile(std::move(file_))) {
            delay_generator = std::move(delay_generator_);
            mode.hex = mode_.hex;
        }
    
        ResultVal<std::size_t> Read(u64 offset, std::size_t length, u8* buffer) const override;
        ResultVal<std::size_t> Write(u64 offset, std::size_t length, bool flush, bool update_timestamp,
                                     const u8* buffer) override;
        u64 GetSize() const override;
        bool SetSize(u64 size) const override;
        bool Close() override;
    
        void Flush() const override {
            file->Flush();
        }
    
    protected:
        Mode mode;
        std::unique_ptr<FileUtil::IOFile> file;
    
        DiskFile() = default;
    
    private:
        template <class Archive>
        void serialize(Archive& ar, const unsigned int) {
            ar& boost::serialization::base_object<FileBackend>(*this);
            ar & mode.hex;
            ar & file;
        }
        friend class boost::serialization::access;
    };
    
    class DiskDirectory : public DirectoryBackend {
    public:
        explicit DiskDirectory(const std::string& path);
    
        ~DiskDirectory() override {
            Close();
        }
    
        u32 Read(u32 count, Entry* entries) override;
    
        bool Close() override {
            return true;
        }
    
    protected:
        FileUtil::FSTEntry directory{};
    
        // We need to remember the last entry we returned, so a subsequent call to Read will continue
        // from the next one.  This iterator will always point to the next unread entry.
        std::vector<FileUtil::FSTEntry>::iterator children_iterator;
    
    private:
        DiskDirectory() = default;
    
        template <class Archive>
        void serialize(Archive& ar, const unsigned int) {
            ar& boost::serialization::base_object<DirectoryBackend>(*this);
            ar & directory;
            u64 child_index;
            if (Archive::is_saving::value) {
                child_index = children_iterator - directory.children.begin();
            }
            ar & child_index;
            if (Archive::is_loading::value) {
                children_iterator = directory.children.begin() + child_index;
            }
        }
        friend class boost::serialization::access;
    };

              return false;
          }

          if (index == std::string::npos) {

          }

## Assistant

Session forking exposed a storage risk in Azahar’s savestate format: several archive paths are stored as absolute paths. A restored fork could therefore write through the parent’s storage. I’ve changed those paths to use Azahar’s relocatable path wrapper in the experimental branch and added a checkpoint format version. The fork test will check memory and storage isolation. Bounded rewind support is also going in, with instruction history for explicit steps and frame checkpoints during continuous runs.

        /// Query the worker at a safe point and refresh gauges.
        pub async fn status(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let status = native.status().await?;
            observe(&handle, &native, &status);
            Ok(status)
        }
    
        /// Typed debugger entry point shared by CLI, MCP, desktop and GDB.
        pub async fn debug(
            &self, id: &str, command: &lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand, actor: Actor,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            self.debug_as(id, command, actor_client(actor)).await
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            lock(&self.artifacts)
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Resolve only catalogued immutable captures, never interpret a URI as a path.
        pub fn read_artifact(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let (artifact, path) = lock(&self.artifacts).get(uri).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown artifact resource")
            })?;
            let data = fs::read(path)?;
            if data.len() != artifact.bytes || format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&data)) != artifact.sha256
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("artifact identity mismatch"));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    
        /// Ask a windowed frontend to show `id`. Headless hosts ignore it.
        pub fn request_focus(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.handle(id)?;
            *lock(&self.focus_request) = Some(id.to_string());
            Ok(())
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn take_focus_request(&self) -> Option<String> {
            lock(&self.focus_request).take()
        }

            for handle in self.handles() {

            }
