        } initial_state_offsets;
    
        u32 stream_offset;
        u32 stream_size;
    };
    
    enum CTStreamElementType : u32 {
        FrameMarker = 0xE1,
        MemoryLoad = 0xE2,

    };
    
    struct CTMemoryLoad {
        u32 file_offset;
        u32 size;
        u32 physical_address;
        u32 pad;
    };
    
    struct CTRegisterWrite {
        u32 physical_address;
        u32 value;
    };
    
    struct CTStreamElement {
        CTStreamElementType type;
    
        union {
            CTMemoryLoad memory_load;
            CTRegisterWrite register_write;
        };
    };

    //! Scenario definition and validation.
    //!
    //! A scenario is a reproducible, bounded run: fixed content, fixed input
    //! schedule, a stop condition and explicit assertions. Every scenario is
    //! validated before it runs, because an unbounded scenario can exhaust the
    //! host or hang a test suite.
    
    use lotus_session::worker::WorkerFlavor;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use std::path::Path;
    use thiserror::Error;
    pub mod execution;
    
    /// Maximum frames a scenario may request.
    pub const MAX_SCENARIO_FRAMES: u64 = 100_000;
    /// Maximum wall clock time a scenario may request, in seconds.
    pub const MAX_SCENARIO_WALL_SECONDS: u64 = 3_600;
    /// Maximum bytes a single capture may request.
    pub const MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES: u64 = 512 * 1024 * 1024;
    
    /// Errors raised while loading or validating a scenario.
    #[derive(Debug, Error)]
    pub enum ScenarioError {
        /// The file could not be read.
        #[error("cannot read scenario {path}: {source}")]
        Io {
            /// Scenario path.
            path: String,
            /// Underlying error.
            #[source]
            source: std::io::Error,
        },
        /// The file is not valid YAML for this schema.
        #[error("cannot parse scenario: {0}")]
        Parse(#[source] serde_yaml::Error),
        /// The scenario is not valid.
        #[error("invalid scenario: {0}")]
        Invalid(String),
    }
    
    /// Content loaded by a scenario.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Content {
        /// Content kind, e.g. `homebrew_3dsx`.
        pub kind: String,
        /// Path of the content relative to the scenario file.
        pub path_handle: String,
        /// Expected SHA-256 of the content, if known.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub sha256: Option<String>,
    }
    
    /// Emulation profile of a scenario.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Profile {
        /// Console model.
        pub model: String,
        /// Render backend.
        pub renderer: String,
        /// Azahar branch flavour.
        pub worker_flavor: WorkerFlavor,
        /// Initial deterministic tick value.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub deterministic_initial_ticks: Option<u64>,
        /// Audio output mode; `discard` still runs the DSP.
        #[serde(default = "default_audio_output")]
        pub audio_output: String,
    }
    
    fn default_audio_output() -> String {
        "discard".to_string()
    }
    
    /// Storage isolation of a scenario.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Storage {
        /// Storage mode, e.g. `isolated_copy`.
        pub mode: String,
        /// Base snapshot the run starts from.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub base_snapshot: Option<String>,
    }
    
    /// Input schedule entry.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct InputEvent {
        /// Frame the event is injected at.
        pub at_frame: u64,
        /// Button name.
        pub button: String,
        /// `down`, `up` or `press`.
        pub action: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub x: Option<u16>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub y: Option<u16>,
    }
    
    /// Input ownership and schedule.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Input {
        /// Owner of input during the run; `scenario` disables live input.
        pub owner: String,
        /// Scheduled events.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub schedule: Vec<InputEvent>,
    }
    
    /// Stop condition of a scenario.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Stop {
        /// Maximum number of frames.
        pub max_frames: u64,
        /// Wall clock limit in seconds.
        pub wall_timeout_seconds: u64,
    }
    
    /// When a capture is taken.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct CaptureWhen {
        /// Frame the capture is taken at.
        pub frame: Option<u64>,
        /// Event name that triggers the capture.
        pub event: Option<String>,
    }
    
    /// A single capture request.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

        /// Trigger.

    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Runs the fast checks: build, tests, formatter, clippy, CLI and pins.
    
    .DESCRIPTION
        This is the check that a fresh checkout is healthy. It does not need a
        ROM, a GPU or a display.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [switch]$SkipBuild
    )
    
    # Native tools write progress to stderr; that must not be treated as a
    # terminating error. Failures are detected through the exit codes.
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    if (Get-Variable -Name PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    }
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    
    function Invoke-Step {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Action
        )
    
        Write-Host "==> $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & $Action
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "FAILED: $Name" -ForegroundColor Red
            exit 1
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $SkipBuild) {
        Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo build' -Action {
            cargo build --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') 2>&1 | Out-Host
        }
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo test' -Action {
        cargo test --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --workspace 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo fmt --check' -Action {
        cargo fmt --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --all -- --check 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo clippy' -Action {
        cargo clippy --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --workspace --all-targets 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }

    //! Bounded local control messages. Large images never travel on this channel.
    use std::io::{self, Read, Write};
    
    use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    
    /// Maximum encoded control message, checked before allocation.
    pub const MAX_CONTROL_BYTES: u32 = 65_536;
    
    /// Commands implemented by the supervisor spike.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum Method {
        Hello,
        Debug,
        Status,
        Stop,
        Load,
        Run,
        RunUntil,
        Pause,
        Reset,
        Capture,
        Input,
        ReadMemory,
        Registers,
    }
    
    /// Completion status; OK always means completed, never merely queued.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum Status {
        Ok,
        InvalidArgument,
        Unsupported,
        NotReady,
        StaleEpoch,
        PermissionDenied,
    }
    
    /// Request envelope for one inherited private pipe connection.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct Request {
        pub version_major: u16,
        pub version_minor: u16,
        pub request_id: u64,
        pub session: String,
        pub epoch: u64,
        pub method: Method,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub params: serde_json::Value,
    }
    
    /// Response envelope. Mock identity is explicit and has no emulator capabilities.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct Reply {
        pub version_major: u16,
        pub version_minor: u16,
        pub request_id: u64,
        pub session: String,
        pub epoch: u64,
        pub status: Status,
        pub state: String,
        pub backend: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub data: serde_json::Value,
    }
    
    /// Encode a JSON control message behind a little-endian u32 byte count.
    pub fn encode<T: Serialize>(value: &T) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
        let payload = serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        let length = u32::try_from(payload.len()).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        validate_length(length)?;
        let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(payload.len() + 4);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&length.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&payload);
        Ok(bytes)
    }
    
    /// Reject invalid lengths before allocating payload storage.
    pub fn validate_length(length: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
        if length == 0 || length > MAX_CONTROL_BYTES {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                "invalid control length",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Read exactly one bounded message; truncation is an error.
    pub fn read<T: DeserializeOwned>(reader: &mut impl Read) -> io::Result<T> {
        let mut prefix = [0; 4];
        reader.read_exact(&mut prefix)?;
        let length = u32::from_le_bytes(prefix);
        validate_length(length)?;
        let mut payload = vec![0; length as usize];
        reader.read_exact(&mut payload)?;
        serde_json::from_slice(&payload).map_err(io::Error::other)
    }

    Movie::ValidationResult Movie::ValidateHeader(const CTMHeader& header) const {
        if (header_magic_bytes != header.filetype) {
            LOG_ERROR(Movie, "Playback file does not have valid header");
            return ValidationResult::Invalid;
        }
    
        std::string revision = fmt::format("{:02x}", fmt::join(header.revision, ""));
        if (revision != Common::g_scm_rev) {
            LOG_WARNING(
                Movie, // Refers to Citra intentionally, movie may be from Citra instead of Azahar
                "This movie was created on a different version of Citra, playback may desync");
            return ValidationResult::RevisionDismatch;
        }
    
        return ValidationResult::OK;
    }
    
    Movie::ValidationResult Movie::ValidateInput(std::span<const u8> input, u64 expected_count) const {
        return GetInputCount(input) == expected_count ? ValidationResult::OK
                                                      : ValidationResult::InputCountDismatch;
    }
    
    void Movie::SaveMovie() {
        LOG_INFO(Movie, "Saving recorded movie to '{}'", record_movie_file);
        FileUtil::IOFile save_record(record_movie_file, "wb");
    
        if (!save_record.IsGood()) {
            LOG_ERROR(Movie, "Unable to open file to save movie");
            return;
        }
    
        CTMHeader header = {};
        header.filetype = header_magic_bytes;
        header.program_id = program_id;
        header.clock_init_time = init_time;
        header.timing_base_ticks = base_ticks;
        header.id = id;
    
        std::memcpy(header.author.data(), record_movie_author.data(),
                    std::min(header.author.size(), record_movie_author.size()));
    
        header.rerecord_count = rerecord_count;
        header.input_count = GetInputCount(recorded_input);
    
        std::string rev_bytes;
        CryptoPP::StringSource(Common::g_scm_rev, true,
                               new CryptoPP::HexDecoder(new CryptoPP::StringSink(rev_bytes)));
        std::memcpy(header.revision.data(), rev_bytes.data(), sizeof(CTMHeader::revision));
    
        save_record.WriteBytes(&header, sizeof(CTMHeader));
        save_record.WriteBytes(recorded_input.data(), recorded_input.size());
    
        if (!save_record.IsGood()) {
            LOG_ERROR(Movie, "Error saving movie");
        }
    }

        return {header->program_id, std::string{author.data()}, header->rerecord_count,

    void Movie::Shutdown() {
        if (play_mode == PlayMode::Recording) {

        current_byte = 0;

                draw=stopped["stop"]["draw"]
                listing=peer.debug("gpu_draws")
                entry=next(row for row in listing["draws"] if row["draw"]==draw)
                assert entry["vertices"]>0,listing
                capture=peer.debug("gpu_draw",draw=draw)
                frozen=json.loads((root/capture["artifacts"][0]["path"]).read_text())
                assert frozen["draw"]==draw and frozen["command"]==stopped["stop"]["command"],frozen
                trace=peer.debug("shader_trace",draw=draw,vertex=0)
                instructions=json.loads((root/trace["artifacts"][0]["path"]).read_text())
                assert 0<trace["instructions"]<=8192 and not instructions["truncated"],trace
                assert any("dest_f32_bits" in row for row in instructions["instructions"]),instructions
                surfaces=[]
                for texture in frozen["resources"]:
                    if "error" in texture:continue
                    surface=peer.debug("surface",address=texture["address"],width=texture["width"],
                                       height=texture["height"],format=texture["format"])
                    artifact=surface["artifacts"][0]
                    assert (root/artifact["path"]).stat().st_size==texture["width"]*texture["height"]*4
                    surfaces.append({key:surface[key] for key in ("address","width","height","source_xxh3_64")})
                report={"new_3ds":new,"renderer":"vulkan" if vulkan else "software","stop":stopped["stop"],
                    "draw":entry,"shader_instructions":trace["instructions"],"surfaces":surfaces}
                (root/"acceptance.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
                print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
            finally:peer.close()

    """MCP-only predicate, reverse and isolated-fork checks using the owned fixture."""
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys
    import time
    from mcp_client import Client
    
    server,config,rom,elf,output=sys.argv[1:]
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    client=Client(server,config,output/"transcript.jsonl")
    try:
        for new in (False,True):
            session=client.tool("lotus_create_session",{"kind":"primary","card":"flow-new" if new else "flow-old"})["session"]
            def debug(operation,session=session,**params):
                return client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":operation,**params}})
            def wait(session=session):
                deadline=time.monotonic()+22
                while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    value=client.tool("lotus_session_status",{"session":session})
                    if value.get("stop",{}).get("reason")=="predicate":return value
                    time.sleep(.02)
                raise TimeoutError(value)
            debug("settings_set",name="is_new_3ds",value=new)
            client.tool("lotus_load",{"session":session,"asset":rom})
            debug("load_symbols",asset=elf)
            def address(name):return debug("resolve_symbol",query=name)["addresses"][0]
            body=address("lotus_tick_body");watched=address("watched");counter=address("counter")
            debug("run_until",predicate={"kind":"pc","core":0,"address":body},frames=2,timeout_ms=5000)
            stopped=wait();assert stopped["stop"]["pc"]==body,stopped
            debug("rewind_configure",enabled=True,capacity=32,budget_mib=64)
            bp=debug("breakpoint_set",address=watched,kind="write",length=4)
            first=debug("step",core=0,count=100)
            assert first["stop"]["reason"]=="watchpoint",first
            assert debug("read_memory",address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]==[2,0,0,0]
            reverse=debug("reverse_continue")
            assert reverse["stop"]["reverse"] and reverse["stop"]["reason"]=="watchpoint",reverse
            assert debug("read_memory",address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]==[0x44,0x33,0x22,0x11]
            replay=debug("step",core=0,count=1)
            assert replay["stop"]["address"]==first["stop"]["address"],replay
            debug("reverse_step",core=0)
            debug("breakpoint_remove",id=bp["id"])
            forks=debug("fork",count=2)["forks"]
            before=debug("read_memory",address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]
            for child in forks:
                assert debug("read_memory",session=child["id"],address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]==before
            debug("write_memory",session=forks[0]["id"],address=watched,bytes=[9,0,0,0])
            assert debug("read_memory",address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]==before
            assert debug("read_memory",session=forks[1]["id"],address=watched,length=4)["bytes"]==before
            child=forks[0]["id"]
            debug("run_until",session=child,predicate={"kind":"memory","core":0,"address":counter,"width":4,"value":6},frames=2,timeout_ms=5000)
            result=wait(child)
            assert result["stop"]["predicate"]["value"]==6,result
            assert debug("read_memory",session=child,address=counter,length=4)["bytes"]==[6,0,0,0]
            for child in forks:client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":child["id"],"operation":"stop"})
            debug("rewind_configure",enabled=False,capacity=32,budget_mib=64)
            for predicate in ({"kind":"log","regex":"lotus-fixture:ready"},{"kind":"svc","id":0x3d,"enter":True},
                              {"kind":"frame","frame":2}):
                client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":session,"operation":"reset"})
                debug("run_until",predicate=predicate,frames=3,timeout_ms=5000)
                result=wait();assert result["stop"]["predicate"]["kind"]==predicate["kind"],result
            client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":session,"operation":"stop"})
            print(f"{'New' if new else 'Old'} 3DS MCP predicates/reverse-watchpoint/fork isolation passed",flush=True)
    finally:client.close()

        pub async fn capture(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<Artifact>> {
            if lock(&self.artifacts).len() + 2 > MAX_ARTIFACTS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "artifact quota reached; restart host to reset catalog",
                ));
            }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let frames = handle.native.lock().await.capture().await?;
            let directory = self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
            for frame in frames {
                let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.bgra"));
                fs::write(&path, &frame.bgra)?;
                let artifact = Artifact {
                    uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                    screen: frame.lease.screen,
                    width: frame.lease.width,
                    height: frame.lease.height,
                    bytes: frame.bgra.len(),
                    sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra)),
                    mime_type: "application/octet-stream".into(),
                };
                lock(&self.artifacts).insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            lock(&self.artifacts)
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Resolve only catalogued immutable captures, never interpret a URI as a path.
        pub fn read_artifact(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let (artifact, path) = lock(&self.artifacts).get(uri).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown artifact resource")
            })?;
            let data = fs::read(path)?;
            if data.len() != artifact.bytes || format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&data)) != artifact.sha256
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("artifact identity mismatch"));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    
        /// Ask a windowed frontend to show `id`. Headless hosts ignore it.
        pub fn request_focus(&self, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.handle(id)?;
            *lock(&self.focus_request) = Some(id.to_string());
            Ok(())
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn take_focus_request(&self) -> Option<String> {
            lock(&self.focus_request).take()
                .collect()
        }
    
        pub async fn stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            let result = self.worker.stop().await;
            if result.is_err() { self.worker.abort().await; }
            self.mark_closed(if result.is_ok() { "closed" } else { "crashed" })?;
            result
        }
    
        /// Explicit failure injection and emergency termination, limited to this job.
        pub async fn abort(&mut self) {
            self.worker.abort().await;
            let _ = self.mark_closed("crashed");
        }
    
        fn mark_closed(&self, lifecycle: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            let path = self.root.join("native-manifest.json");
            let mut manifest: Value =
                serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            manifest["lifecycle"] = lifecycle.into();
            manifest["pid"] = Value::Null;
            fs::write(path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(io::Error::other)?)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {
            &self.root
        }

    //! Bounded execution of the implemented homebrew/software scenario subset.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Checkpoint {
        pub frame: u64,
        pub screen: String,
        pub sha256: String,
        pub bytes: usize,
        pub artifact: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct RunReport {
        pub name: String,
        pub backend: String,
        pub content_sha256: String,
        pub worker_executable_sha256: String,
        pub source: String,
        pub frames: u64,
        pub checkpoints: Vec<Checkpoint>,
        pub final_status: Value,
        pub host_elapsed_ms: u128,
        pub evidence: String,
    }
    
    /// SHA-256 without loading an entire executable/content asset into memory.
    pub fn file_hash(path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
        let mut input = File::open(path)?;
        let mut hash = Sha256::new();
        let mut buffer = [0; 65536];
        loop {
            let count = input.read(&mut buffer)?;
            if count == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hash.update(&buffer[..count]);
        }
        Ok(format!("{:x}", hash.finalize()))
    }
    
    fn invalid(message: impl Into<String>) -> io::Error {
        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, message.into())
    }
    
    /// Reject unsupported promises before creating a worker or an artifact directory.
    pub fn validate_execution(scenario: &Scenario) -> io::Result<()> {
        scenario
            .validate()
            .map_err(|error| invalid(error.to_string()))?;
        if scenario.content.kind != "homebrew_3dsx"
            || scenario.profile.model != "old3ds"
            || scenario.profile.renderer != "software"
            || scenario.profile.audio_output != "discard"
            || scenario.profile.deterministic_initial_ticks.unwrap_or(0) != 0
            || scenario.storage.mode != "isolated_copy"
            || scenario.storage.base_snapshot.is_some()
            || scenario.input.owner != "scenario"
        {
            return Err(invalid("executor requires homebrew_3dsx, old3ds/software, discard, ticks 0, empty isolated_copy, scenario input"));
        }
        if scenario.input.schedule.len() > 4096 || scenario.captures.len() > 64 {
            return Err(invalid("scenario event/capture count limit"));
        }
        for event in &scenario.input.schedule {
            validate_event(event)?;
        }
        for capture in &scenario.captures {
            let frame = capture
                .when
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|when| when.frame)
                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("only frame capture triggers are supported"))?;
            if frame == 0
                || frame > scenario.stop.max_frames
                || capture
                    .when
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|when| when.event.is_some())
                || capture
                    .include
                    .iter()
                    .any(|item| item != "top_raw_frame" && item != "bottom_raw_frame")
                || capture.max_bytes.is_some_and(|bytes| bytes < 691200)
            {
                return Err(invalid(
                    "capture requires bounded native top/bottom screens",
                ));
            }
        }
        if scenario
            .assertions
            .iter()
            .any(|assertion| !matches!(assertion.kind.as_str(), "no_worker_crash" | "frame_count"))
        {
            return Err(invalid("event assertions require the future trace backend"));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn button_mask(button: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        let index = match button.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "a" => 0,
            "b" => 1,
            "x" => 2,
            "y" => 3,
            "up" => 4,
            "down" => 5,
            "left" => 6,
            "right" => 7,
            "l" => 8,
            "r" => 9,
            "start" => 10,
            "select" => 11,
            "zl" => 14,
            "zr" => 15,
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some(1 << index)
    }
    
    fn validate_event(event: &InputEvent) -> io::Result<()> {
        if !matches!(event.action.as_str(), "down" | "up" | "press") {
            return Err(invalid("unknown input action"));
        }
        if event.button == "touch" {
            if event.x.is_none_or(|x| x >= 320) || event.y.is_none_or(|y| y >= 240) {
                return Err(invalid("touch requires native x/y coordinates"));
            }
        } else if button_mask(&event.button).is_none() {
            return Err(invalid("unknown button"));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn apply_input(state: &mut InputState, event: &InputEvent) {
        let pressed = event.action != "up";
        if event.button == "touch" {
            state.x = event.x.expect("validated touch x");
            state.y = event.y.expect("validated touch y");
            state.touch = pressed;
        } else {
            let mask = button_mask(&event.button).expect("validated button");
            if pressed {
                state.buttons |= mask;
            } else {
                state.buttons &= !mask;
            }
        }
    }

        executable: &Path,
        output: &Path,
    ) -> io::Result<RunReport> {
        validate_execution(scenario)?;
        let content = scenario_directory
            .join(&scenario.content.path_handle)
            .canonicalize()?;

    //! Fresh-root profile comparisons. A divergence is an observation, never a bug verdict.
    use super::*;
    use lotus_protocol::debug::MatrixProfile;
    
    impl Supervisor {
        pub(super) async fn matrix(&self,id:&str,profiles:&[MatrixProfile],frames:u16,checkpoints:&[u16],repeats:u8,client:&str)->io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let parent=self.handle(id)?;
            let asset=parent.info().asset.ok_or_else(||io::Error::other("matrix requires approved loaded content"))?;
            {
                let mut native=parent.native.lock().await;check_lease(&parent,client)?;
                parent.set_playing(false);pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            }
            // Resolve every selector before starting any target.
            for profile in profiles {
                if profile.backend.as_ref().is_some_and(|name|!self.config.workers.contains_key(name)) {
                    return Err(io::Error::other("matrix backend is not a configured worker handle"));
                }
            }
            let deadline=Instant::now()+Duration::from_secs(180);
            let mut rows=Vec::new();
            for profile in profiles {
                let worker=profile.backend.as_ref().and_then(|name|self.config.workers.get(name)).map(PathBuf::as_path);
                let mut runs=Vec::new();
                for repeat in 0..repeats {
                    if Instant::now()>=deadline { return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,"matrix host deadline")); }
                    let info=self.create_seeded(SessionKind::Secondary { parent:None },None,Actor::Host,None,worker).await?;
                    let run=async {
                        let handle=self.handle(&info.id)?;
                        let mut native=handle.native.lock().await;
                        native.apply_profile(&profile.settings).await?;
                        native.load(&self.resolve_asset(&asset)?).await?;
                        let mut at=0;let mut snapshots=Vec::new();
                        for checkpoint in checkpoints {
                            let status=native.advance(checkpoint-at).await?;at=*checkpoint;
                            if status["frames"]!=*checkpoint { return Err(io::Error::other("matrix stopped before its aligned checkpoint")); }
                            let screens=native.capture().await?.into_iter().map(|frame|serde_json::json!({
                                "screen":frame.lease.screen,"width":frame.lease.width,"height":frame.lease.height,
                                "sha256":format!("{:x}",Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra))})).collect::<Vec<_>>();
                            let registers=native.registers(0).await?;
                            snapshots.push(serde_json::json!({"frame":checkpoint,"screens":screens,"registers":registers["registers"]}));
                            if Instant::now()>=deadline { return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,"matrix host deadline")); }
                        }
                        if at<frames {native.advance(frames-at).await?;}
                        let status=native.status().await?;
                        Ok::<_,io::Error>(serde_json::json!({"repeat":repeat,"profile_hash":native.profile_hash(),
                            "identity":status["identity"],"renderer":status["identity"]["renderer"],
                            "checkpoints":snapshots,"final_status":status}))
                    }.await;
                    let stopped=self.stop(&info.id,Actor::Host).await;
                    let value=run?;stopped?;runs.push(value);
                }
                let deterministic=runs.windows(2).all(|pair|pair[0]["checkpoints"]==pair[1]["checkpoints"]);
                rows.push(serde_json::json!({"name":profile.name,"repeatable_at_checkpoints":if repeats>1 {Some(deterministic)}else{None},"runs":runs}));
            }
            let mut comparisons=Vec::new();
            for left in 0..rows.len() {for right in left+1..rows.len() {
                let a=rows[left]["runs"][0]["checkpoints"].as_array().expect("owned snapshots");
                let b=rows[right]["runs"][0]["checkpoints"].as_array().expect("owned snapshots");
                let earliest=a.iter().zip(b).find(|(a,b)|a["screens"]!=b["screens"]||a["registers"]!=b["registers"]);
                let stable=rows[left]["repeatable_at_checkpoints"]==true && rows[right]["repeatable_at_checkpoints"]==true;
                comparisons.push(serde_json::json!({"left":rows[left]["name"],"right":rows[right]["name"],
                    "earliest_sampled_divergence":earliest.map(|(a,_)|a["frame"].clone()),
                    "repeatability_confirmed":stable,"verdict":"observation; requires an independent reference to identify a bug"}));
            }}
            let report=serde_json::json!({"profiles":rows,"comparisons":comparisons,
                "alignment":"presented guest frames; CPU state and screen hashes compared separately from host time",
                "source_session":id,"asset":asset,"evidence":"verified emulator run"});
            let artifact=self.publish_json(&report)?;
            Ok(serde_json::json!({"report":report,"artifacts":[artifact]}))
        }
    
        pub(super) fn publish_json(&self,value:&serde_json::Value)->io::Result<Artifact> {
            let bytes=serde_json::to_vec_pretty(value).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            let mut catalog=lock(&self.artifacts);
            let total:usize=catalog.values().map(|(a,_)|a.bytes).sum();
            if bytes.len()>8<<20 || catalog.len()>=MAX_ARTIFACTS || total+bytes.len()>512<<20 { return Err(io::Error::other("report artifact quota reached")); }
            let id=SessionUuid::generate().to_string();let directory=self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;let path=directory.join(format!("{id}.json"));fs::write(&path,&bytes)?;
            let artifact=Artifact {uri:format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),screen:"report".into(),width:0,height:0,
                bytes:bytes.len(),sha256:format!("{:x}",Sha256::digest(&bytes)),mime_type:"application/json".into()};
            catalog.insert(artifact.uri.clone(),(artifact.clone(),path));Ok(artifact)
        }
    }

    std::string& Module::GetMacAddress() {
        if (!mac_address.empty()) {
            return mac_address;
        }
    
        FileUtil::IOFile mac_address_file(
            fmt::format("{}/mac.txt", FileUtil::GetUserPath(FileUtil::UserPath::SysDataDir)), "rb");
        if (!mac_address_file.IsOpen() || mac_address_file.GetSize() > 100) {
            LOG_INFO(Service_CFG, "Cannot open mac address file for read, generating a new one");
            mac_address = GenerateRandomMAC();
            SaveMacAddress();
            return mac_address;
        }
    
        size_t file_size = mac_address_file.GetSize();
        mac_address.resize(file_size);
        mac_address_file.ReadBytes(mac_address.data(), file_size);
        if (mac_address != MacToString(MacToU64(mac_address))) {
            LOG_WARNING(Service_CFG, "Imvalid saved MAC address, generating a new one");
            mac_address = GenerateRandomMAC();
            SaveMacAddress();
            return mac_address;
        }
    
        return mac_address;
    }

        /// Load approved content, replacing what was loaded. Leaves the session paused.
        pub async fn load(&self, id: &str, asset: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<SessionInfo> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let content = self.resolve_asset(asset)?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            if let DebugCommand::StorageBrowse { area,path,offset,limit }=command {
                let mut result=self.browse_storage(&handle.root,*area,path,*offset,*limit)?;
                native.decorate(&mut result);return Ok(result);
            }
            if let DebugCommand::InstallCia { asset } | DebugCommand::ContentTransform { asset,.. }=command {
                check_lease(&handle,client)?;handle.set_playing(false);pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
                let kind=if matches!(command,DebugCommand::InstallCia { .. }) {lotus_protocol::debug::AssetKind::Cia}else{lotus_protocol::debug::AssetKind::Rom};
                crate::assets::mount(&handle.root,&self.resolve_asset(asset)?,kind)?;
                let mut result=native.debug(command).await?;
                self.import_debug_artifacts(&handle.root,&mut result)?;return Ok(result);
            }
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            pause_if_running(&mut native).await?;
            native.load(&content).await?;
            lock(&handle.info).asset = Some(asset.to_string());
            handle.record(actor, "load");
            Ok(handle.info())
        }
    
        /// Run continuously: the pump re-issues bounded runs until paused.
        pub async fn run(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            if handle.info().asset.is_none() {
                return Err(io::Error::other("load content before running"));
            }
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            check_lease(&handle, actor_client(actor))?;
            if native.state() == SessionState::Paused {
                native.run().await?;
            }
            handle.set_playing(true);

        #[tool(
            description = "Capture two native screens; return immutable bounded artifact resources, not inline pixels."
        )]
        pub async fn lotus_capture(&self, Parameters(args): Parameters<SessionArgs>) -> CallToolResult {
            let result = async { self.require_host()?.capture(&args.session).await }.await;
            match result {
                Ok(artifacts) => CallToolResult::success(
                    artifacts
                        .iter()
                        .map(|artifact| ContentBlock::resource_link(resource(artifact)))
                        .collect(),
                ),
                Err(error) => tool_result(Err(error)),
            }
        }
    
        #[tool(

        )]

            &self,
            Parameters(args): Parameters<SessionArgs>,
        ) -> CallToolResult {
            tool_result(self.require_host().and_then(|host| {
                host.request_focus(&args.session)?;
                Ok(serde_json::json!({"frontend": self.frontend.name()}))
            }))
        }

    impl ServerHandler for LotusServer {
        fn get_info(&self) -> ServerConfig {
            ServerConfig::new(ServerCapabilities::builder().enable_tools().enable_resources().build())
                .with_instructions("LOTUS owns isolated AZAHAR/CITnLO sessions, each its own worker process, addressed by session ID and run concurrently. Primary sessions persist a card's SD/NAND; secondary sessions are disposable copies. Only configured asset/session handles are accepted. Host permission controls mutations. Captures are local resources; no shell or arbitrary filesystem tools. In a windowed LOTUS the person sees the same sessions.")
        }
    
        async fn list_resources(
            &self,
            _: Option<PaginatedRequestParams>,
            _: RequestContext<RoleServer>,
        ) -> Result<ListResourcesResult, ErrorData> {
            let resources = self
                .host
                .as_deref()
                .map(Supervisor::artifacts)
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .iter()
                .map(resource)
                .collect();
            Ok(ListResourcesResult::with_all_items(resources))
        }
    
        async fn read_resource(
            &self,
            request: ReadResourceRequestParams,
            _: RequestContext<RoleServer>,
        ) -> Result<ReadResourceResponse, ErrorData> {
            let bytes = self
                .resource_bytes(&request.uri)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| ErrorData::invalid_params(error.to_string(), None))?;
            let mime = self.require_host().map_err(|error|ErrorData::invalid_params(error.to_string(),None))?
                .artifacts().into_iter().find(|a|a.uri==request.uri).map(|a|a.mime_type)
                .unwrap_or_else(||"application/octet-stream".into());
            let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(bytes);
            Ok(ReadResourceResult::new(vec![
                ResourceContents::blob(encoded, request.uri).with_mime_type(mime)
            ])
            .into())
        }
    }

    //! Generated contract for the shared CLI, MCP and desktop debug-command parser.
    pub fn schema()->serde_json::Value {
        serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(crate::debug::DebugCommand)).expect("schema serializes")
    }
    pub fn operations()->Vec<String> {
        let schema=schema();
        let mut names=schema["oneOf"].as_array().expect("tagged command union").iter()
            .map(|command|command["properties"]["operation"]["const"].as_str().expect("operation tag").to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        names.sort();names
    }
    pub fn parity()->String {
        let mut text=String::from("# 32 — Generated debugger command parity\n\nGenerated by `cargo run -p lotus-protocol --example export-debug`.\nAll commands use the shared typed parser and Supervisor dispatch.\nThis table records reachability, not native-backend acceptance.\n\n| Operation | CLI JSON line | MCP tool |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n");
        for name in operations(){text+=&format!("| `{name}` | `ctr-cli debug`: `{name}` | `lotus_debug`: `{name}` |\n");}
        text+="\nWorker-envelope routes: hello is negotiated when creating a session; status,\nload, reset, stop, continue (run), advance (run_until), capture_scaled\n(capture), input_state (input), read_memory and registers are available above.\n\nRuntime bounds are additionally enforced by `DebugCommand::validate`.\n";text
    }

        }
    }

    static inline bool ndspWaitForIrq(u64 timeout_ns)
    {
        LightLock_Lock(&ndspMutex);
    
        // BUG: Official sw has a race condition here when entering sleep mode. DSP state might
        // have already been torn down, and thus this ends up waiting on an invalid (0) handle.
        // There's code that tries to panic if an error happens, however said error handler fails
        // to actually panic because it checks that the result code level is specifically 'Fatal'.
        // Note that the "invalid handle" result code has a 'Permanent' level...
        // We will instead handle invalid handles properly and immediately return.
        bool waitOk = false;
        if (irqEvent)
        {
            Result rc = svcWaitSynchronization(irqEvent, timeout_ns);
            if (R_FAILED(rc))
                svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC); // Shouldn't happen.
    
            waitOk = R_DESCRIPTION(rc) != RD_TIMEOUT;
        }
    
        if (waitOk)
            svcClearEvent(irqEvent);
    
        LightLock_Unlock(&ndspMutex);
        return waitOk;
    }

    void __attribute__((weak)) __libctru_init(void (*retAddr)(void))
    {
        // Store the return address
        __system_retAddr = envIsHomebrew() ? retAddr : NULL;
    
        // Initialize the synchronization subsystem
        __sync_init();
    
        // Initialize newlib support system calls
        __system_initSyscalls();
    
        // Allocate application and linear heaps
        __system_allocateHeaps();
    
        // Build argc/argv if present
        __system_initArgv();
    }
    #include <3ds/svc.h>

    #include <3ds/env.h>
    #include <3ds/os.h>
    #include <3ds/result.h>
    
    #define HEAP_SPLIT_SIZE_CAP  (24 << 20) // 24MiB
    #define LINEAR_HEAP_SIZE_CAP (32 << 20) // 32MiB
    #define HEAP_AREA_SIZE       (OS_HEAP_AREA_END - OS_HEAP_AREA_BEGIN) // 96 MiB
    
    extern char* fake_heap_start;
    extern char* fake_heap_end;
    
    u32 __ctru_heap;
    u32 __ctru_linear_heap;
    
    __attribute__((weak)) u32 __ctru_heap_size        = 0;
    __attribute__((weak)) u32 __ctru_linear_heap_size = 0;
    
    void __attribute__((weak)) __system_allocateHeaps(void) {
        Result rc;
    
        // Retrieve handle to the resource limit object for our process
        Handle reslimit = 0;
        rc = svcGetResourceLimit(&reslimit, CUR_PROCESS_HANDLE);
        if (R_FAILED(rc))
            svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC);
    
        // Retrieve information about total/used memory
        s64 maxCommit = 0, currentCommit = 0;
        ResourceLimitType reslimitType = RESLIMIT_COMMIT;
        svcGetResourceLimitLimitValues(&maxCommit, reslimit, &reslimitType, 1); // for APPLICATION this is equal to APPMEMALLOC at all times
        svcGetResourceLimitCurrentValues(&currentCommit, reslimit, &reslimitType, 1);
        svcCloseHandle(reslimit);
    
        // Calculate how much remaining free memory is available
        u32 remaining = (u32)(maxCommit - currentCommit) &~ 0xFFF;
    
        if (__ctru_heap_size + __ctru_linear_heap_size > remaining)
            svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC);
    
        bool auto_app_sz    = __ctru_heap_size == 0;
        bool auto_linear_sz = __ctru_linear_heap_size == 0;
    
        if (auto_app_sz && auto_linear_sz) {
            // Split available memory equally between linear and application heaps (with rounding in favor of the latter)
            __ctru_linear_heap_size = (remaining / 2) & ~0xFFF;
            __ctru_heap_size = remaining - __ctru_linear_heap_size;
    
            // If the application heap size is bigger than the cap, prefer to grow linear heap instead
            if (__ctru_heap_size > HEAP_SPLIT_SIZE_CAP) {
                __ctru_heap_size = HEAP_SPLIT_SIZE_CAP;
                __ctru_linear_heap_size = remaining - __ctru_heap_size;
    
                // However if the linear heap size is bigger than the cap, prefer to grow application heap
                if (__ctru_linear_heap_size > LINEAR_HEAP_SIZE_CAP) {
                    __ctru_linear_heap_size = LINEAR_HEAP_SIZE_CAP;
                    __ctru_heap_size = remaining - __ctru_linear_heap_size;
                }
            }
        } else if (auto_app_sz) {
            __ctru_heap_size = remaining - __ctru_linear_heap_size;
        } else if (auto_linear_sz) {
            __ctru_linear_heap_size = remaining - __ctru_heap_size;
        }
    
        if (__ctru_heap_size > HEAP_AREA_SIZE) {
            if (auto_linear_sz) {
                __ctru_linear_heap_size += __ctru_heap_size - HEAP_AREA_SIZE;
            }
            __ctru_heap_size = HEAP_AREA_SIZE;
        }
    
        // Allocate the application heap
        rc = svcControlMemory(&__ctru_heap, OS_HEAP_AREA_BEGIN, 0x0, __ctru_heap_size, MEMOP_ALLOC, MEMPERM_READ | MEMPERM_WRITE);
        if (R_FAILED(rc))
            svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC);
    
        // Allocate the linear heap
        rc = svcControlMemory(&__ctru_linear_heap, 0x0, 0x0, __ctru_linear_heap_size, MEMOP_ALLOC_LINEAR, MEMPERM_READ | MEMPERM_WRITE);
        if (R_FAILED(rc))
            svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC);
    
        // Mappable allocator init
        mappableInit(OS_MAP_AREA_BEGIN, OS_MAP_AREA_END);
    
        // Set up newlib heap
        fake_heap_start = (char*)__ctru_heap;
        fake_heap_end = fake_heap_start + __ctru_heap_size;
    
    }

    #include <stdlib.h>

    static void __panic(void)
    {
        svcBreak(USERBREAK_PANIC);
        for (;;);
    }
    
    static void _thread_begin(void* arg)
    {
        Thread t = (Thread)arg;
        initThreadVars(t);
        t->ep(t->arg);
        threadExit(0);
    }
    
    Thread threadCreate(ThreadFunc entrypoint, void* arg, size_t stack_size, int prio, int core_id, bool detached)
    {
        // The stack must be 8-aligned at minimum.
        size_t align =  __tdata_align > 8 ? __tdata_align : 8;
    
        size_t stackoffset = alignTo(sizeof(struct Thread_tag), align);
        size_t allocsize = alignTo(stackoffset + stack_size, align);
    
        size_t tlssize = __tls_end-__tls_start;
        size_t tlsloadsize = __tdata_lma_end-__tdata_lma;
        size_t tbsssize = tlssize - tlsloadsize;
    
        // memalign seems to have an implicit requirement that (size % align) == 0.
        // Without this, it seems to return NULL whenever (align > 8).
        size_t size = alignTo(allocsize + tlssize, align);

    void dspHook(dspHookCookie* cookie, dspHookFn callback)
    {
        if (!callback) return;
    
        dspHookCookie* hook = &dspFirstHook;
        *cookie = *hook; // Structure copy.
        hook->next = cookie;
        hook->callback = callback;
    }
    
    void dspUnhook(dspHookCookie* cookie)
    {
        dspHookCookie* hook;
        for (hook = &dspFirstHook; hook; hook = hook->next)
        {
            if (hook->next == cookie)
            {
                *hook = *cookie; // Structure copy.
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    """Guest DSP/PCM acceptance. No synthetic host samples or bundled firmware."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import wave
    from native_debug_probe import Peer
    from debugger_acceptance import symbols
    
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("worker",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("rom",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--audible",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    addresses=symbols(args.rom.with_suffix('.elf'))
    reports=[]
    for new in (False,True):
        hashes=[]
        for repeat in range(3):
            root=args.output.resolve()/f"{'new' if new else 'old'}-{repeat}"
            peer=Peer(args.worker.resolve(),root)
            try:
                peer.call("hello",{"notifications":True})
                peer.debug("settings_set",name="is_new_3ds",value=new)
                peer.call("load",{"path":str(args.rom.resolve())})
                peer.debug("audio_capture",enabled=True)
                if args.audible and repeat==0:peer.debug("audio_focus",enabled=True)
                status=peer.call("run_until",{"frames":60})
                stage=peer.debug("read_memory",address=addresses["stage"],length=4)["bytes"]
                failure=peer.debug("read_memory",address=addresses["failure"],length=4)["bytes"]
                assert stage==[5,0,0,0] and failure==[0,0,0,0],(stage,failure,status)
                capture=peer.debug("audio_capture",enabled=False)
                with wave.open(str(root/"audio/capture.wav"),'rb') as wav:
                    assert wav.getframerate()==32728 and wav.getnchannels()==2 and wav.getsampwidth()==2
                    samples=wav.readframes(wav.getnframes())
                assert any(samples) and len(samples)>32728*2, (status,capture,len(samples))
                digest=hashlib.sha256(samples).hexdigest();hashes.append(digest)
                dsp=peer.debug("dsp_inspect")
                assert any(region["voices"][0]["playing"] for region in dsp["regions"]),dsp
                report={"new_3ds":new,"repeat":repeat,"pcm_bytes":len(samples),"sha256":digest,
                    "audio_samples":status["audio_samples"],"voice":dsp["regions"][0]["voices"][0],
                    "sample_rate":32728,"stage":stage}
                (root/"acceptance.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));reports.append(report)
                print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
            finally:peer.close()
        assert len(set(hashes))==1,hashes
    (args.output/"report.json").write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))

        WorkerSink() { active = this; if (focused) SetFocus(true); }
        ~WorkerSink() override { output.reset(); active = nullptr; }
        unsigned GetNativeSampleRate() const override { return native_sample_rate; }
        void SetCallback(std::function<void(s16*, std::size_t)> cb) override {
            callback = std::move(cb);

        }
        bool ImmediateSubmission() override { return !output; }
        // Raw samples are captured once in DspInterface, before volume or time stretching.
        void PushSamples(const void*, std::size_t) override {}
        static void SetFocus(bool enabled) {
            if (!active) { focused = enabled; return; }
            active->output.reset();
            focused = false;
            if (enabled) {
                const auto& details = GetSinkDetails(SinkType::Cubeb);
                if (details.type != SinkType::Cubeb) throw std::runtime_error("Cubeb host output unavailable");
                active->output = details.create_sink(Settings::values.output_device.GetValue());
                active->output->SetCallback(active->callback);
                focused = true;
            }
        }
        static void Record(const void* data, std::size_t count) {
            const auto* samples = static_cast<const s16*>(data);
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < count * 2; ++i) {
                ring[(stats.samples * 2 + i) % ring.size()] = samples[i];
                const auto value = static_cast<u16>(samples[i]);
                stats.hash = (stats.hash ^ (value & 255)) * 1099511628211ull;
                stats.hash = (stats.hash ^ (value >> 8)) * 1099511628211ull;
            }
            if (capture.is_open()) {
                constexpr size_t limit = 64u << 20;
                const auto bytes = std::min(count * 4, limit - capture_bytes);
                capture.write(static_cast<const char*>(data), bytes);
                capture_bytes += static_cast<u32>(bytes);
                if (bytes < count * 4) capture_full = true;
            }
            stats.samples += count;
            const auto total = stats.buffered + count;
            stats.dropped += total > ring.size() / 2 ? total - ring.size() / 2 : 0;
            stats.buffered = std::min(total, ring.size() / 2);
        }
        static void Header(u32 bytes) {
            const auto le = [](u32 v, unsigned count) {
                for (unsigned i=0;i<count;++i) capture.put(static_cast<char>(v >> (8*i)));

            capture.seekp(0); capture.write("RIFF",4);le(bytes+36,4);capture.write("WAVEfmt ",8);
            le(16,4);le(1,2);le(2,2);le(native_sample_rate,4);le(native_sample_rate*4,4);
            le(4,2);le(16,2);capture.write("data",4);le(bytes,4);
        }
        static void CaptureStart(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            if (capture.is_open()) throw std::invalid_argument("audio capture already active");
            capture.open(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
            if (!capture) throw std::runtime_error("cannot create WAV capture");
            capture.exceptions(std::ios::badbit | std::ios::failbit);
            capture_bytes = 0;capture_full = false;Header(0);
        }
        static u32 CaptureStop() {
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};
            if (!capture.is_open()) return capture_bytes;
            Header(capture_bytes);capture.flush();capture.close();return capture_bytes;
        }
        static WorkerAudioStats Drain() {
            std::scoped_lock lock{mutex}; const auto snapshot=stats;stats.buffered=0;return snapshot;
        }
        static void Reset() { CaptureStop(); std::scoped_lock lock{mutex};stats={}; }
    private:

        std::unique_ptr<Sink> output;

    void CubebSink::SetCallback(std::function<void(s16*, std::size_t)> cb) {

    long CubebSink::Impl::DataCallback(cubeb_stream* stream, void* user_data, const void* input_buffer,
                                       void* output_buffer, long num_frames) {
        auto* impl = static_cast<Impl*>(user_data);
        auto* buffer = static_cast<s16*>(output_buffer);
    
        if (!impl || !impl->cb) {
            LOG_DEBUG(Audio_Sink, "Missing internal data and/or audio callback, emitting zeroes.");
            std::memset(output_buffer, 0, num_frames * 2 * sizeof(s16));
        } else {
            impl->cb(buffer, num_frames);
        }
    
        return num_frames;
    }
    
    void CubebSink::Impl::StateCallback(cubeb_stream* stream, void* user_data, cubeb_state state) {
        switch (state) {
        case CUBEB_STATE_STARTED:
            LOG_INFO(Audio_Sink, "Cubeb Audio Stream Started");
            break;
        case CUBEB_STATE_STOPPED:
            LOG_INFO(Audio_Sink, "Cubeb Audio Stream Stopped");
            break;
        case CUBEB_STATE_DRAINED:
            LOG_INFO(Audio_Sink, "Cubeb Audio Stream Drained");
            break;
        case CUBEB_STATE_ERROR:
            LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "Cubeb Audio Stream Errored");
            break;
        }
    }
    
    void CubebSink::Impl::LogCallback(char const* format, ...) {
        std::array<char, 512> buffer{};
        std::va_list args;
        va_start(args, format);
    #ifdef _MSC_VER
        vsprintf_s(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format, args);
    #else
        vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format, args);
    #endif
        va_end(args);
        buffer.back() = '\0';
        LOG_DEBUG(Audio_Sink, "{}", buffer.data());
    }

        if (cubeb_init(&ctx, "Azahar Output Device Enumerator", nullptr) != CUBEB_OK) {
            LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "cubeb_init failed");
            return {};
        }
    
        cubeb_device_collection collection;
        if (cubeb_enumerate_devices(ctx, CUBEB_DEVICE_TYPE_OUTPUT, &collection) == CUBEB_OK) {
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < collection.count; i++) {
                const cubeb_device_info& device = collection.device[i];
                if (device.state == CUBEB_DEVICE_STATE_ENABLED && device.friendly_name) {
                    device_list.emplace_back(device.friendly_name);
                }
            }
            cubeb_device_collection_destroy(ctx, &collection);
        } else {
            LOG_WARNING(Audio_Sink, "Audio output device enumeration not supported.");
        }

    // Native process frontend. No Qt, SDL, Libretro or product-layer dependencies.
    #include <chrono>
    #include <iostream>
    #include <string_view>
    #include "core/core.h"
    #include "ctr_worker/control.h"
    #include "ctr_worker/frames.h"
    #include "ctr_worker/frontend.h"
    
    int main(int argc, char** argv) {
        if (argc == 2 && std::string_view{argv[1]} == "--self-test") {
            AudioCore::WorkerSink::Reset();
            AudioCore::WorkerSink sink;
            std::vector<s16> samples(80000, 123);
            AudioCore::WorkerSink::Record(samples.data(), 40000);
            const auto audio = AudioCore::WorkerSink::Drain();
            if (audio.samples != 40000 || audio.buffered != 16384 || audio.dropped != 23616 ||
                AudioCore::WorkerSink::Drain().buffered != 0)
                return 1;
            CtrWorker::InputState state;
            CtrWorker::Button button{state, 0};
            CtrWorker::Touch touch{state};
            state.buttons = 1;
            state.touch = true;
            state.x = 0.5f;
            state.y = 0.5f;
            if (!button.GetStatus() || !std::get<2>(touch.GetStatus()))
                return 1;
            state = {};
            if (button.GetStatus() || std::get<2>(touch.GetStatus()))
                return 1;
            std::cout << "input_disconnect_and_bounded_audio=ok\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if (argc == 1) {
            const auto* root = std::getenv("LOTUS_STORAGE_ROOT");
            if (!root || !*root) {
                std::cerr << "LOTUS_STORAGE_ROOT is required\n";
                return 2;
            }
            return CtrWorker::Control{root}.Run();
        }
        if (argc == 2 && std::string_view{argv[1]} == "--version") {
            std::cout << "ctr-worker protocol=1.0 source=" << CTR_SOURCE_SHA << '\n';
            return 0;
        }
        if (argc == 2 && std::string_view{argv[1]} == "--probe-core") {
            const auto& system = Core::System::GetInstance();
            std::cout << "native_core_initialized=" << system.IsPoweredOn() << '\n';
            return 0;
        }
        if (argc == 4 && std::string_view{argv[1]} == "--boot") {
            auto& system = Core::System::GetInstance();
            bool unsupported = false;
            CtrWorker::Initialize(system, argv[3], unsupported);
            CtrWorker::Window window;
            auto result = system.Load(window, argv[2]);
            std::cout << "load_status=" << static_cast<unsigned>(result) << std::endl;
            const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(20);
            while (result == Core::System::ResultStatus::Success && window.frames < 60 &&
                   !unsupported && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
                result = system.RunLoop();
            std::cout << "presented_frames=" << window.frames
                      << " result=" << static_cast<unsigned>(result)
                      << " unsupported_applet=" << unsupported << std::endl;
            if (window.frames >= 60)
                std::cout << CtrWorker::Capture(system, argv[3], 1, window.frames).dump() << std::endl;
            if (system.IsPoweredOn())
                system.Shutdown();
            Common::Log::Stop();
            return result == Core::System::ResultStatus::Success && window.frames >= 60 && !unsupported
                       ? 0
                       : 1;
        }
        std::cerr
            << "usage: ctr-worker --version | --probe-core | --boot <homebrew.3dsx> <private-root>\n";
        return 2;
    }

        static long DataCallback(cubeb_stream* stream, void* user_data, const void* input_buffer,

        static void StateCallback(cubeb_stream* stream, void* user_data, cubeb_state state);
        static void LogCallback(char const* fmt, ...);
    };
    
    CubebSink::CubebSink(std::string_view target_device_name) : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {
        if (cubeb_init(&impl->ctx, "Azahar Output", nullptr) != CUBEB_OK) {
            LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "cubeb_init failed");
            return;
        }
    
        if (cubeb_set_log_callback(CUBEB_LOG_NORMAL, &Impl::LogCallback) != CUBEB_OK) {
            LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "cubeb_set_log_callback failed");
            return;
        }
    
        cubeb_stream_params params = {
            .format = CUBEB_SAMPLE_S16LE,
            .rate = native_sample_rate,
            .channels = 2,
            .layout = CUBEB_LAYOUT_STEREO,
        };
        // The device's audio effects can add tens of ms of latency. Only WASAPI uses this.
        if (Settings::values.bypass_audio_effects.GetValue()) {
            params.prefs = CUBEB_STREAM_PREF_RAW;
        }
    
        u32 minimum_latency = 100 * native_sample_rate / 1000; // Firefox default
        if (cubeb_get_min_latency(impl->ctx, &params, &minimum_latency) != CUBEB_OK) {
            LOG_WARNING(Audio_Sink,
                        "Error getting minimum output latency, falling back to default latency.");
        }
    
        cubeb_devid output_device = nullptr;
        if (target_device_name != auto_device_name && !target_device_name.empty()) {
            cubeb_device_collection collection;
            if (cubeb_enumerate_devices(impl->ctx, CUBEB_DEVICE_TYPE_OUTPUT, &collection) == CUBEB_OK) {
                const auto collection_end{collection.device + collection.count};
                const auto device{
                    std::find_if(collection.device, collection_end, [&](const cubeb_device_info& info) {
                        return info.friendly_name != nullptr &&
                               target_device_name == info.friendly_name;
                    })};
                if (device != collection_end) {
                    output_device = device->devid;
                }
                cubeb_device_collection_destroy(impl->ctx, &collection);
            } else {
                LOG_WARNING(Audio_Sink,
                            "Audio output device enumeration not supported, using default device.");
            }
        }
    
        auto stream_err = cubeb_stream_init(impl->ctx, &impl->stream, "AzaharAudio", nullptr, nullptr,
                                            output_device, &params, std::max(512u, minimum_latency),
                                            &Impl::DataCallback, &Impl::StateCallback, impl.get());
        if (stream_err != CUBEB_OK) {
            switch (stream_err) {
            case CUBEB_ERROR:
            default:
                LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "Error initializing cubeb stream ({})", stream_err);
                break;
            case CUBEB_ERROR_INVALID_FORMAT:
                LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "Invalid format when initializing cubeb stream");
                break;
            case CUBEB_ERROR_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE:
                LOG_CRITICAL(Audio_Sink, "Device unavailable when initializing cubeb stream");
                break;
            }
            return;

    #pragma once

    /**
     * This class is an interface for an audio sink. An audio sink accepts samples in stereo signed
     * PCM16 format to be output. Sinks *do not* handle resampling and expect the correct sample rate.
     * They are dumb outputs.
     */
    class Sink {
    public:
        virtual ~Sink() = default;
    
        /// The native rate of this sink. The sink expects to be fed samples that respect this.
        /// (Units: samples/sec)
        virtual unsigned int GetNativeSampleRate() const = 0;
    
        /**
         * Set callback for samples
         * @param samples Samples in interleaved stereo PCM16 format.
         * @param sample_count Number of samples.
         */
        virtual void SetCallback(std::function<void(s16*, std::size_t)> cb) = 0;
    
        /**
         * Override and set this to true if the sink wants audio data submitted
         * immediately rather than requesting audio on demand
         * @return true if audio data should be pushed to the sink
         */
        virtual bool ImmediateSubmission() {
            return false;
        }
    
        /**
         * Push audio samples directly to the sink, bypassing the FIFO.
         * Only called when ImmediateSubmission() returns true.
         * @param data Pointer to stereo PCM16 samples (each sample is L+R pair)
         * @param num_samples Number of stereo samples
         */
        virtual void PushSamples(const void* data, std::size_t num_samples) {}
    };
    
    } // namespace AudioCore

      static void ndspSync(void)

    # Implementer rules — read before touching code
    
    ## Order of authority
    
    1. Measured physical-hardware behavior > independent hardware trace > documented specification > existing emulator behavior > hypothesis.
    2. User's explicit decisions: native Azahar integration (**not Libretro**), Rust + GPUI, multiple isolated workers, two Azahar branches (`integration`, `experimental`).
    3. Preserve compatibility and successful baselines before speculative accuracy changes.
    
    ## Attribution
    
    Agents never insert their own branding as a commit attribution or co-attribution. All commits are authored solely by the git identity already set on the authors computer. For example, the project owner's git identity should always be `terezi <jules@foxtails.me>`.
    
    ## Documentation
    
    Agents should keep documentation and comments as brief as possible. This does not mean spare on technical details. Explain what it is, what it's doing, how it works, what it isn't, and the relevant necessary information.
    
    Agents must keep documentation consistent.
    
    Agents must always be able to refer back to primary sources (such as 3DBrew, the citra wiki, source code citations from azahar) to justify changes or decisions. Agents are encouraged to use secondary sources, such as Coffeepot, for easy lookup of information - coffeepot, however, should not be your citation.
    
    ## Branch discipline
    
    - `integration`: only smallest viable native worker/front-end hooks, configurable build target, deterministic control queue, frame/audio/input adapters, and proven bug fixes required for integration. No GPU timing redesign or pervasive tracing. Regular upstream merges.
    - `experimental`: based on `integration`; structured tracing, debugger controls, snapshot experiments, timing models, hardware-fidelity experiments. Never merge `experimental` wholesale into `integration`.
    - Any item that seems essential to integration but introduces accuracy behavior changes needs an ADR and separate two-step PR.
    - Freeze upstream baseline SHA and CMake options in each test report. One independent worktree/build directory per branch. Never build both using one configured CMake cache.
    
    ## Evidence and debugging
    
    - Never confuse host milliseconds, virtual 3DS ticks, and empirically inferred hardware cycles.
    - Never claim a new accuracy feature without a hardware witness, an independent reference, and a counterexample where the old behavior differed.
    - Any cross-thread mutable emulated-state read MUST run at a defined safe point or return a labeled approximate telemetry snapshot.
    - Instrument with bounded buffers, severity filters and loss counters. Avoid `printf` in hot paths. Measure instrumentation-on/off overhead.
    - A GPU draw capture must describe the actual command/state at the draw, not a post-frame memory reconstruction. Pre-draw hashes must be computed by the draw or use frozen memory snapshots; never hash unrelated time-dependent registers as image identity.
    - Label examples explicitly: **verified compiled**, **verified hardware**, **verified emulator**, **source inspected**, or **proposed**. No unverifiable green check marks.
    
    ## Implementation quality
    
    - Prefer a narrow PR with a runnable acceptance test over a broad refactor.
    - Keep the C++ worker free of GPUI, MCP, and agent concepts.
    - Keep FFI structs plain, fixed-width and versioned; do not expose `std::string`, `std::vector`, `Core::System*` or internal layouts across IPC.
    - No unsandboxed remote RPC listener by default. MCP/control access local-only and scoped to explicitly created workers.
    - Treat ROMs, firmware, save data, logs and captures as sensitive user assets. Do not upload them, bundle them, or include them in bug reports without consent.
    - On worker crash, retain logs and metadata, invalidate frame-buffer leases, terminate child descendants and release per-instance locks.
    - Do not implement experimental multi-instance support by embedding two Azahar `Core::System`s in one process: globals and lifetime assumptions are not cleared.
    - Avoid speculative architectural abstractions that lack a second backend or a concrete test.
    
    ## Definition of done for every PR
    
    1. Explain touched subsystem, expected change, and branch rationale.
    2. Enumerate upstream source revision and build flags; tests and known untested platforms.
    3. Include a test that would fail without the change (or justify an instrumentation-only PR).
    4. Record guest output hash/checkpoints and host overhead for performance-relevant changes.
    5. Confirm clean shutdown, second launch, and two parallel workers if shared process/storage infrastructure changed.
    6. Update docs/source-map and protocol schema for altered interfaces.
    7. Make limitations explicit; retain rollback flag for risk-bearing work.

    # 29 — Wave 3 plan: comprehensive agentic debugger
    
    Status: **implementation in progress**, 2026-11-16. Development evidence and
    remaining acceptance work are in [31](31-wave-3-progress.md). Tickets and their Deliver/Check/Avoid terms
    are in [15](15-implementation-tickets.md); this document holds the goal,
    decisions, Azahar parity matrix and milestone order. No item here is
    complete; source facts below are **source inspected** at the native pin in
    `config/pins.toml`.
    
    ## Goal
    
    LOTUS + CITnLO must meet or exceed every debugging, configuration and
    inspection capability of Azahar, exposed uniformly through the worker
    protocol, CLI, MCP and desktop, so that an agent can find and explain guest
    bugs without the Qt frontend. "Exceed" means capabilities Azahar lacks:
    rewind, session forking, predicate stops, symbol-aware debugging, matrix
    runs, and a single arbitrated control model across GDB, MCP and desktop.
    
    ## Decisions (owner, 2026-11-15)
    
    | ADR | Decision | Consequence |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | ADR-008 | **GDB server is written in Rust** (`crates/gdb`) on top of the Lotus debug API; Azahar's stub is not used | CITnLO workers build with `ENABLE_GDBSTUB=OFF`; HIO is rerouted to the worker debug channel. Multi-session, non-stop and reverse execution become possible |
    | ADR-009 | **Offscreen Vulkan worker from the start of Wave 3**; software renderer stays as default-safe fallback and oracle | New headless presentation path; `graphics_api`, `resolution_factor`, `physical_device` and hardware-renderer GPU debugging become real |
    | ADR-006 (unchanged) | **Old 3DS is the default profile**; New 3DS is a fully supported, explicitly labeled profile | Every test that touches CPU, scheduling or memory layout runs on both profiles |
    | ADR-010 | **Settings schema and transport live in `integration`**; debugger and accuracy toggles that change behavior are exposed but not altered there | Both AZAHAR and CITnLO accept profiles; default profile reproduces today's behavior byte for byte (proven by T24 check) |
    | ADR-011 | **Audio is in Wave 3**: audible output, capture, HLE/LLE DSP and mic injection | Supersedes the muted-only profile in [25](25-wave-status.md) |
    
    ADR-010 rationale: a settings channel is a frontend adapter (allowed in
    `integration` by [03](03-azahar-branches.md)); keeping it there means the
    AZAHAR backend can serve as a control in matrix runs (T41) with identical
    profiles. Any setting whose *default* would differ from stock still needs its
    own ADR.
    
    ## Source facts that constrain the design
    
    | Fact | Source | Effect |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | Azahar GDB stub binds `INADDR_ANY` | `src/core/gdbstub/gdbstub.cpp:2125` | Violates local-only rule; another reason for ADR-008. Build-flag test must prove the stub is absent |
    | HIO request enters via `svcBreak`-family path into `GDBStub::SetHioRequest` | `src/core/hle/kernel/svc.cpp:1178`, `gdbstub/hio.h` (152-byte `PackedGdbHioRequest`, libctru layout) | CITnLO patch forwards the request address to the debug channel; Rust server implements the `F` reply |
    | Worker forces software renderer, Old 3DS, stub off | `src/ctr_worker/frontend.h:61-64` | Defaults move into the T24 default profile instead of hard-coded writes |
    | `is_new_3ds` read at boot (memory mode, cores) | `src/core/core.cpp:401,461` | Apply class `boot` |
    | `cpu_clock_percentage` applied live | `System::ApplySettings`, `core.cpp:876` | Apply class `live` |
    | Vulkan instance accepts `WindowSystemType::Headless`, but `PresentWindow` always creates a surface | `vk_instance.cpp:136`, `vk_present_window.cpp:104` | T45 adds an offscreen presenter with readback into the frame ring |
    | LLE DSP selected from `audio_emulation` at system init | `core.cpp:661-662` | Apply class `boot`; firmware is a user asset in the session root, never bundled |
    | CFG values (username, birthday, language, country, sound mode, play coins) live in CFG save data, not `Settings::values` | `configure_system.ui`, `hle/service/cfg` | Apply class `cfg-savedata`; written through the CFG module before boot |
    
    Every other setting's apply class is determined in T24 by reading where it is
    consumed; none is assumed.
    
    ## Parity matrix
    
    Azahar column names its frontend action, setting or interface. Each row must
    be reachable from worker protocol, CLI and MCP (T44 enforces this);
    desktop coverage follows in T17.
    
    ### Execution and CPU
    
    | Azahar | LOTUS | Ticket |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | Pause / Resume / Stop / Restart | Existing, plus typed stop reasons and debug lease | T25 |
    | Debug Step, Advance Frame | Instruction step, step over/out, run-to, frame advance; per-core semantics stated | T14c |
    | GDB `Z0/Z1` breakpoints | Execute breakpoints with conditions, hit counts, logpoints | T14a |
    | GDB `Z2/Z3/Z4` watchpoints | Read/write/access watchpoints with cost estimate and cap | T14b |
    | GDB `g/G/p/P/m/M`, RPC Read/WriteMemory | Register and memory read/write, JIT invalidation | T14d |
    | Registers widget | Snapshot including CPSR/SPSR, VFP, mode, thread | T14d |
    | (none) disassembly | ARM/Thumb disassembly with raw bytes and symbols | T14d, T14h |
    | GDB stub (whole) incl. HIO, `qXfer:threads`, `osdata`, `vCont`, attach next process | Rust RSP server, loopback only, per-session port | T26 |
    | `use_cpu_jit`, `use_fastinterp` | Profile settings (JIT / fast interpreter / interpreter) | T24 |

    | Compress/Decompress ROM, ROM bundles | Content tools | T31 |
