    | Profiler (microprofile), `record_frame_times`, RPC GetPerfStats | Perf stats, frame times, scopes; host and guest time separate | T32 |
    
    ### State, replay and input
    
    | Azahar | LOTUS | Ticket |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | Quick Save/Load, slots, RPC Save/LoadState | Named savestates keyed by pin + profile hash | T28 |
    | Record/Play/Close Movie, read-only mode | Movies integrated with scenarios; determinism check | T29 |
    | RPC SetInput (Home, Power, touch, circle pad) | All buttons incl. Home/Power, C-stick/ZL/ZR, circle pad, 3D and volume sliders, gyro/accelerometer, IR | T30 |
    | Camera config, mic input, `simulate_headphones_plugged` | Image/WAV injection, headphone state | T30, T46 |
    | (none) | Rewind, reverse step/continue (GDB `bs`/`bc`) | T38 |
    | (none) | Fork new sessions from a savestate | T39 |
    
    ### GPU and video
    
    | Azahar | LOTUS | Ticket |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `graphics_api`, `physical_device`, `use_gles`, `resolution_factor`, texture filter/sampling, anti-aliasing | Profile settings; real on offscreen Vulkan | T45, T24 |
    | `renderer_debug` (validation layers) | Vulkan validation output into the log stream | T45, T27 |
    | PICA breakpoints (7 events in `debug_utils.h`) | Stop on each event, with draw/command identity | T33 |
    | Command list viewer, `pica_debugging`, `dump_command_buffers` | Command stream capture and viewer | T34, T15 |
    | Vertex shader debugger | Per-vertex inputs/outputs and instruction trace | T34 |
    | Surface viewer, `dump_textures`, custom/preload textures | Surface viewer for any address/format; texture dump | T35, T16 |
    | Graphics tracing (CiTrace) | Record and replay | T36 |
    | `simulate_3ds_gpu_timings`, `delay_game_render_thread_us`, `shaders_accurate_mul`, `use_shader_jit`, `use_hw_shader`, shader caches, async shader compilation/presentation, skip duplicate frames, frames-ahead limit | Profile settings labeled with time domain; no accuracy claim | T37, T24 |
    | Capture Screenshot, RPC Take/ReadScreenshot | Native capture (exists) plus upscaled capture | T45 |
    | Dump Video (FFmpeg) | Frame + audio dump | T46 |
    | Layouts, stereo 3D, post-processing/anaglyph shaders, background colour, cardboard | Reachable through generic settings; display-only, no tooling | T24 |
    
    ### Audio
    
    | Azahar | LOTUS | Ticket |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `audio_emulation` HLE / LLE / LLE multithreaded | Boot profile; LLE requires user-supplied `dspfirm.cdc` in the session root | T46 |
    | `output_type`, `output_device`, `volume`, mute | Audible output for the focused session only; others muted by default | T46 |
    | `enable_audio_stretching`, `enable_realtime_audio`, `bypass_audio_effects` | Profile settings | T46 |
    | `input_type`, `input_device` | Mic from host device or injected WAV | T46 |
    | (none) | WAV capture of DSP output; HLE DSP voice/source state inspector | T46, T47 |
    
    ### Out of scope
    
    Network rooms/multiplayer, Artic Base, web service and telemetry, Discord:
    non-goals in [01](01-product-contract.md). Their settings remain reachable
    through T24 with no tooling. Qt-only UI preferences (themes, hotkeys, game
    list) have no equivalent.
    
    ## Milestones
    
    Order is dependency order; each milestone ends with a recorded status in
    [25](25-wave-status.md).
    
    | Milestone | Tickets | Exit check |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | **3.0 Foundations** | T24 settings/profiles, T25 stop model/event stream/debug lease, T45 offscreen Vulkan, T46 audio, T26 RSP skeleton against the mock worker | Default profile reproduces Wave 2 hashes; Old and New 3DS fixture boots on software and Vulkan; audible + captured audio from a fixture; GDB client connects to mock and reads registers |
    | **3.1 CPU, kernel, system** | T14a–h, T26 full, T27–T32 | devkitARM `arm-none-eabi-gdb` session (break, bt, watch, HIO printf) passes on both profiles; deterministic three-run hashes with movie + determinism profile |
    | **3.2 GPU** | T33–T37, T15, T16 | PICA event stops, command capture and shader trace match on software and Vulkan for the GPU fixture |
    | **3.3 Beyond Azahar** | T38–T43, T47, T18 | Agent test suite (T43) solved through MCP alone |
    | **3.4 Surfaces** | T17, T44 | CI fails if any protocol method lacks CLI/MCP surface; parity matrix generated |
    
    ## Cross-cutting rules for Wave 3
    
    - Every report records backend, pin, profile hash and renderer.
    - Every debug result states whether execution was paused and whether a
      rasterizer cache flush was forced ([07](07-debugger-core.md)).
    - Time domains (host ms, guest ticks, inferred cycles) are never mixed.
    - New 3DS results are labeled; Old 3DS is the default in every example.
    - Instrumentation is bounded, has loss counters and an on/off overhead A/B.
    - User assets (DSP firmware, console unique data, system files) stay in the
      session root and are never bundled or uploaded.

    # Pinned dependency revisions for Lotus.
    #
    # Every external source this project builds against is pinned to an exact
    # commit. Moving a pin is a deliberate act: update the file, update
    # Cargo.lock or the submodule pointer in the same commit, and record why.
    #
    # Verified by scripts/verify-pins.ps1.
    
    [azahar]
    # Upstream project.
    repository = "https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar.git"
    # Single fork that carries the two long lived branches.
    fork = "https://github.com/estyseesghosts/azahar.git"
    # Upstream commit the fork is based on.
    upstream_commit = "11eceda5e0e682a1f44e396bf954a1b9137097ca"
    # Branch with upstream minimal native worker hooks.
    integration_branch = "integration"
    integration_commit = "05773bbb5380bc5094fcd8eacf189fdc5d6360bb"
    # Branch with tracing, debugger and accuracy experiments.
    experimental_branch = "experimental"
    experimental_commit = "05773bbb5380bc5094fcd8eacf189fdc5d6360bb"
    # Vendored checkout of the pinned Azahar source.
    vendor_path = "vendor/azahar"
    
    [gpui]
    # GPUI lives in the Zed repository.
    repository = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed.git"
    # Exact commit the GPUI crates are taken from.
    rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988"
    # Version of the gpui crate at that commit.
    crate_version = "0.2.2"
    
    [rust]
    # Toolchain used by every crate in the workspace.
    channel = "1.98.1"
    # Host triple the toolchain was installed for.
    host = "x86_64-pc-windows-gnu"
    """Build the owned freestanding ARM fixture with clang, or devkitARM GCC.
    The 3DSX segment container follows native loader/3dsx.cpp. Absolute link addresses
    match the worker's homebrew base; relocation tables are intentionally empty.
    """
    from pathlib import Path
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    import shutil
    import struct
    import subprocess
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture",choices=["debugger","audio"],default="debugger")
    parser.add_argument("--gcc", help="devkitARM arm-none-eabi-gcc executable (uses matching objcopy)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fixtures = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures"
    source = fixtures / args.fixture
    compiler = args.gcc or shutil.which("clang")
    if not compiler:
        raise SystemExit("clang or --gcc <devkitARM GCC> is required")
    objcopy = str(Path(compiler).with_name("arm-none-eabi-objcopy.exe")) if args.gcc else shutil.which("llvm-objcopy")
    elf = out / (args.fixture+".elf")
    command = [compiler, "-mcpu=mpcore", "-marm", "-mfloat-abi=soft", "-O1", "-g", "-gdwarf-4",
               "-ffreestanding", "-fno-builtin", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer", "-fno-unwind-tables",
               "-fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables", "-nostdlib", "-Wl,--build-id=none",
               "-Wl,-T,"+str(fixtures / "debugger/link.ld"), str(source / "fixture.c"), "-o", str(elf)]
    if not args.gcc:
        command[1:1] = ["--target=armv6k-none-eabi", "-fuse-ld=lld"]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    segments = []
    for section in ("text", "rodata", "data"):
        path = out / (section + ".bin")
        subprocess.run([objcopy, "--dump-section", "."+section+"="+str(path), str(elf)], check=True)
        segments.append(path.read_bytes())
    header = struct.pack("<IHHIIIIIIIII", 0x58534433, 44, 8, 0, 0,
                         *(len(s) for s in segments), 0, 0, 0, 0)
    rom = header + bytes(24) + b"".join(segments)
    (out / (args.fixture+".3dsx")).write_bytes(rom)
    (out / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(compiler=subprocess.check_output([compiler,"--version"],text=True).splitlines()[0],
        command=command, sha256=hashlib.sha256(rom).hexdigest(), elf_sha256=hashlib.sha256(elf.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),indent=2))
    print(out / (args.fixture+".3dsx"))

    static unsigned char child_stack[4096] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
    
    static u32 create_mutex(u32 locked) {
        register u32 r0 __asm__("r0")=0,r1 __asm__("r1")=locked;
        __asm__ volatile("svc 0x13":"+r"(r0),"+r"(r1)::"r2","r3","memory");
        if(r0)for(;;);return r1;
    }
    static void wait_mutex(u32 handle) {
        register u32 r0 __asm__("r0")=handle,r2 __asm__("r2")=~0u,r3 __asm__("r3")=~0u;
        __asm__ volatile("svc 0x24":"+r"(r0),"+r"(r2),"+r"(r3)::"r1","memory");
    }
    static void create_thread(void (*entry)(void),u32 core) {
        register u32 r0 __asm__("r0")=0x20,r1 __asm__("r1")=(u32)entry,r2 __asm__("r2")=0,
            r3 __asm__("r3")=(u32)(child_stack+sizeof(child_stack)),r4 __asm__("r4")=core;
        __asm__ volatile("svc 8":"+r"(r0),"+r"(r1),"+r"(r2),"+r"(r3),"+r"(r4)::"memory");
        if(r0)for(;;);
    }
    __attribute__((noinline)) void deadlock_child(void) {
        wait_mutex(mutex_b);thread_phase=1;wait_mutex(mutex_a);for(;;);
    }
    __attribute__((noinline)) void deadlock_main(void) {
        mutex_a=create_mutex(1);mutex_b=create_mutex(0);create_thread(deadlock_child,0);
        while(!thread_phase);wait_mutex(mutex_b);for(;;);
    }
    __attribute__((noinline)) void race_child(void) {
        u32 old=raced_counter;thread_phase=1;while(thread_phase!=2);
        raced_counter=old+1;thread_phase=3;for(;;);
    }

            while(thread_phase!=3);

    """Diagnose owned guest bugs using only MCP tool/resource calls.
    python tests/test_mcp_debugger.py <server> <host.json> <rom-handle> <elf-handle> <output>
    """
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import socket
    import sys
    import time
    from mcp_client import Client
    
    server,config,rom,elf,output=sys.argv[1:]
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    client=Client(server,config,output/"transcript.jsonl")
    try:
        for new in (False,True):
            card="debug-new" if new else "debug-old"
            info=client.tool("lotus_create_session",{"kind":"primary","card":card})
            session=info["session"]
            def debug(operation,**params):
                return client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":operation,**params}})
            debug("settings_set",name="is_new_3ds",value=new)
            client.tool("lotus_load",{"session":session,"asset":rom})
            debug("load_symbols",asset=elf)
            def address(query):
                found=debug("resolve_symbol",query=query)["addresses"]
                assert len(found)==1,(query,found)
                return found[0]
            main=address("main");mode=address("mode");canary=address("canary")
            location=debug("symbolize",addresses=[main])["locations"][0]
            assert location["line"] and debug("resolve_symbol",query=f"fixture.c:{location['line']}")["addresses"]
            bp=debug("breakpoint_set",address=main,kind="execute",length=4)
            stopped=client.tool("lotus_run_until",{"session":session,"frames":1})
            assert stopped["stop"]["reason"]=="breakpoint",stopped
            debug("breakpoint_remove",id=bp["id"])
            # A second controller can inspect but cannot mutate while GDB owns the lease.
            listener=client.tool("lotus_gdb",{"session":session,"operation":"start"})
            host,port=listener["address"].rsplit(':',1)
            sock=socket.create_connection((host,int(port)),timeout=3)
            payload=b"qSupported";sock.sendall(b'$'+payload+b'#'+f'{sum(payload)%256:02x}'.encode())
            data=b''
            while b'#' not in data:data+=sock.recv(8192)
            assert b'PacketSize=' in data,data
            debug("registers",core=0)
            denied=client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":"pause"}},expected_error=True)
            assert "lease" in str(denied),denied
            sock.close()
            for attempt in range(50):
                result=client.send("tools/call",{"name":"lotus_debug","arguments":{"session":session,"command":{"operation":"pause"}}})
                if not result.get("isError"):break
                time.sleep(.02)
            else:raise AssertionError("GDB disconnect leaked the debug lease")
            client.tool("lotus_gdb",{"session":session,"operation":"stop"})
            for bug,reason in ((1,"exception"),(2,"watchpoint"),(3,"svc_break"),(4,"exception"),(5,"svc_break")):
                client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":session,"operation":"reset"})
                if bug==2:debug("breakpoint_set",address=canary+4,kind="write",length=4)
                debug("write_memory",address=mode,bytes=[bug,0,0,0])
                stopped=client.tool("lotus_run_until",{"session":session,"frames":1})
                assert stopped["stop"]["reason"]==reason,stopped
                report=debug("crash_report",core=0)
                assert report["failure_domain"]=="guest"
                if bug==1:assert stopped["stop"]["address"]==0,stopped
                if bug==2:
                    assert stopped["stop"]["address"]==canary+4,stopped
                    assert debug("read_memory",address=canary+4,length=4)["bytes"]==[0xad,0xb,0,0]
                if bug==5:assert "lotus-hio:hello" in json.dumps(debug("logs",after=0,limit=128))
                (output/f"{'new' if new else 'old'}-bug-{bug}.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
            client.tool("lotus_control",{"session":session,"operation":"reset"})
            debug("write_memory",address=mode,bytes=[6,0,0,0])
            client.tool("lotus_run_until",{"session":session,"frames":1})
            deadlock=debug("deadlocks")

    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('stock', 'integration', 'experimental')]
        [string]$Branch = 'integration',
        [ValidateSet('Debug', 'Release')]
        [string]$Profile = 'Release',
        [string]$AzaharRoot,
        [string]$BuildDirectory,
        [switch]$Oracle,
        [int]$Parallel = 4
    )
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Pins.psm1') -Force
    $pins = Read-Pins -Path (Join-Path $root 'config/pins.toml')
    $expected = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { $pins['azahar']['upstream_commit'] } else { $pins['azahar'][$Branch + '_commit'] }
    if (-not $AzaharRoot) { $AzaharRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $root) ('azahar-' + $Branch) }
    $AzaharRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $AzaharRoot).Path
    $actual = & git -C $AzaharRoot rev-parse HEAD
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual -ne $expected) { throw "Source pin mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual" }
    $dirty = & git -C $AzaharRoot status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $dirty) { throw 'Build inputs must be committed and clean' }
    if (-not $BuildDirectory) { $BuildDirectory = Join-Path $root ('build/azahar-' + $Branch + '-native') }
    $BuildDirectory = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BuildDirectory)
    $cache = Join-Path $BuildDirectory 'CMakeCache.txt'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache) {
        $source = Select-String -LiteralPath $cache -Pattern '^CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=(.*)$'
        if (-not $source -or [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($source.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value) -ne $AzaharRoot) {
            throw "Cache belongs to a different source tree: $cache"
        }
    }
    $worker = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { 'OFF' } else { 'ON' }
    $flags = @('-G', 'Ninja', "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$Profile", "-DENABLE_CTR_WORKER=$worker",
        '-DCMAKE_PROJECT_citra_INCLUDE=',
        '-DENABLE_QT=OFF', '-DENABLE_LIBRETRO=OFF', '-DENABLE_SDL2=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_WEB_SERVICE=OFF', '-DENABLE_SCRIPTING=OFF', '-DENABLE_ROOM=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_ROOM_STANDALONE=OFF', '-DENABLE_OPENAL=OFF', '-DENABLE_CUBEB=ON',
        '-DENABLE_LIBUSB=OFF', '-DENABLE_SOFTWARE_RENDERER=ON', '-DENABLE_VULKAN=ON',
        '-DENABLE_OPENGL=OFF', '-DENABLE_GDBSTUB=OFF', '-DENABLE_LTO=OFF', '-DCITRA_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=OFF')
    if ($Branch -eq 'stock') {
        $flags = $flags | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^-DENABLE_(CUBEB|VULKAN|GDBSTUB)=' }
        $flags += @('-DENABLE_CUBEB=OFF', '-DENABLE_VULKAN=OFF')
    }
    $target = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { 'citra_core' } else { 'ctr-worker' }
    if ($Branch -ne 'stock') {
        $backendName = if ($Branch -eq 'integration') { 'AZAHAR' } else { 'CITnLO' }
        $flags += "-DCTR_BACKEND_NAME=$backendName"
    }
    if ($Oracle) {
        if ($Branch -ne 'stock') { throw 'The independent oracle must use stock source' }
        $inject = (Join-Path $root 'workers/oracle/inject.cmake').Replace('\', '/')
        $flags += "-DCMAKE_PROJECT_citra_INCLUDE=$inject"
        $target = 'lotus-stock-oracle'
    }
    & cmake -S $AzaharRoot -B $BuildDirectory @flags
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native configuration failed' }
    & cmake --build $BuildDirectory --target $target --parallel $Parallel
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native build failed' }
    @{ source = $actual; branch = $Branch; source_root = $AzaharRoot; target = $target;
       cmake_flags = $flags; compiler = (& g++ --version | Select-Object -First 1);
       host = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSDescription
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content (Join-Path $BuildDirectory 'lotus-build-manifest.json')

    """MCP-only predicate, reverse and isolated-fork checks using the owned fixture."""
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys

    from mcp_client import Client
    
    server,config,rom,elf,output=sys.argv[1:]

    try:
        for new in (False,True):

            def debug(operation,session=session,**params):
                return client.tool("lotus_debug",{"session":session,"command":{"operation":operation,**params}})
            def wait(session=session):
                deadline=time.monotonic()+22
                while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    value=client.tool("lotus_session_status",{"session":session})["status"]
                    if value.get("stop",{}).get("reason")=="predicate":return value
                    time.sleep(.02)

            debug("settings_set",name="is_new_3ds",value=new)
            client.tool("lotus_load",{"session":session,"asset":rom})

    ## Research confidence conventions
    
    - **Source-inspected:** exact existing code/public docs were read; correctness of our future integration is not yet established.
    - **Known behavior:** verified by tests on pinned current emulator or 3DS hardware; attach raw proof and revision.
    - **Proposed:** new architecture/API or example syntax not present upstream; compile/test required.
    - **Inferred:** supported but not directly measured; list alternative explanation.
    - **Unknown:** insufficient evidence; require a concrete discriminating experiment.

        pub(super) fn browse_storage(
            &self,
            root: &Path,
            area: lotus_protocol::debug::StorageArea,
            path: &str,
            offset: u32,
            limit: u32,
        ) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            let base = root
                .join(match area {
                    lotus_protocol::debug::StorageArea::Nand => "nand",
                    lotus_protocol::debug::StorageArea::Sdmc => "sdmc",
                })
                .canonicalize()?;
            let relative = Path::new(path);
            if relative
                .components()
                .any(|c| !matches!(c, std::path::Component::Normal(_)))
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("storage path must stay below its area"));
            }
            let directory = base.join(relative).canonicalize()?;
            if !directory.starts_with(&base) {
                return Err(io::Error::other("storage path escaped session root"));
            }
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            for entry in fs::read_dir(directory)? {
                if entries.len() == 10000 {
                    return Err(io::Error::other(
                        "directory listing exceeds 10000-entry budget",
                    ));
                }
                let entry = entry?;
                let kind = entry.file_type()?;
                entries.push(
                    serde_json::json!({"name":entry.file_name().to_string_lossy(),
                    "kind":if kind.is_symlink(){"link"}else if kind.is_dir(){"directory"}else{"file"},
                    "bytes":if kind.is_file(){Some(entry.metadata()?.len())}else{None}}),
                );
            }
            entries.sort_by(|a, b| a["name"].as_str().cmp(&b["name"].as_str()));
            let total = entries.len();
            Ok(serde_json::json!({"area":area,"path":path,"total":total,
                "entries":entries.into_iter().skip(offset as usize).take(limit as usize).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                "next":if (offset as usize)+(limit as usize)<total{Some(offset+limit)}else{None}}))
        }

    //! Local host policy shared by the headless MCP server and the desktop.
    //!
    //! One `Supervisor` owns every session of a LOTUS process. Each session has its
    //! own async lock, so a long bounded run on one session never blocks commands,
    //! status or previews of another. The registry lock is never held across an
    //! await. Desktop and MCP call the same methods; there is one control model.
    //!
    //! Sessions are *primary* (mount a persistent card) or *secondary* (private
    //! scratch copy, discarded on end); see [`crate::card_store`].
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use tokio::task::JoinSet;
    
    use crate::card_store::{CardStore, ScratchEnd};
    use crate::native_session::{Frame, InputState, NativeSession};
    use crate::telemetry::{Actor, Telemetry};
    use crate::SessionState;
    mod experiments;
    
    /// Sessions per host unless the configuration raises it; four is the tested load.
    pub const DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS: usize = 4;
    /// Upper bound accepted for `max_sessions`.
    pub const MAX_SESSIONS_LIMIT: usize = 16;
    pub const MAX_ARTIFACTS: usize = 128;
    /// Stop deadline per worker when the host closes.
    const CLOSE_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
    
    /// Host configuration, never accepted as a tool-call argument.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct HostConfig {
        pub worker: PathBuf,
        pub storage_root: PathBuf,
        /// Approved content, by handle.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub assets: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        /// Approved directories: every `.3dsx` directly inside is `<handle>/<file>`.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub asset_directories: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub allow_control: bool,
        #[serde(default = "default_max_sessions")]
        pub max_sessions: usize,
        /// Validated worker settings applied before loading content.
        #[serde(default)]
        pub profile: BTreeMap<String, lotus_protocol::debug::SettingValue>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub workers: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
    }
    
    fn default_max_sessions() -> usize {
        DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS
    }
    
    impl HostConfig {
        /// Configuration with no assets, control denied and the default session limit.
        pub fn new(worker: impl Into<PathBuf>, storage_root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
            Self {
                worker: worker.into(),
                storage_root: storage_root.into(),
                assets: BTreeMap::new(),
                asset_directories: BTreeMap::new(),
                allow_control: false,
                max_sessions: DEFAULT_MAX_SESSIONS,
                profile: BTreeMap::new(),
                workers: BTreeMap::new(),
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Whether a session's guest writes persist.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum SessionKind {
        /// Mounts `cards/<card>/`: real, persistent SDMC/NAND reads and writes.
        Primary { card: String },
        /// Private scratch root, empty or copied from `parent`; discarded on end.
        Secondary { parent: Option<String> },
    }

    }

    namespace CiTrace {
    
    class Recorder {
    public:
        struct InitialState {
            std::vector<u32> lcd_registers;
            std::vector<u32> pica_registers;
            std::vector<u32> default_attributes;
            std::vector<u32> vs_program_binary;
            std::vector<u32> vs_swizzle_data;
            std::vector<u32> vs_float_uniforms;
            std::vector<u32> gs_program_binary;
            std::vector<u32> gs_swizzle_data;
            std::vector<u32> gs_float_uniforms;
        };
    
        /**
         * Recorder constructor
         * @param initial_state Initial recorder state
         */
        explicit Recorder(const InitialState& initial_state);
    
        /// Finish recording of this Citrace and save it using the given filename.
        void Finish(const std::string& filename);
    
        /// Mark end of a frame
        void FrameFinished();
    
        /**
         * Store a copy of the given memory range in the recording.
         * @note Use this whenever the GPU is about to access a particular memory region.
         * @note The implementation will make sure to minimize redundant memory updates.
         */
        void MemoryAccessed(const u8* data, u32 size, u32 physical_address);
    
        /**
         * Record a register write.
         * @note Use this whenever a GPU-related MMIO register has been written to.
         */
        void RegisterWritten(u32 physical_address, u32 value);
    
    private:
        // Initial state of recording start
        InitialState initial_state;
    
        // Command stream
        struct StreamElement {
            CTStreamElement data;
    
            /**
             * Extra data to store along "core" data.
             * This is e.g. used for data used in MemoryUpdates.
             */
            std::vector<u8> extra_data;
    
            /// Optional CRC hash (e.g. for hashing memory regions)
            boost::crc_32_type::value_type hash;
    
            /// If true, refer to data already written to the output file instead of extra_data
            bool uses_existing_data;
        };
    
        std::vector<StreamElement> stream;
    
        /**
         * Internal cache which maps hashes of memory contents to file offsets at which those memory
         * contents are stored.
         */
        std::unordered_map<boost::crc_32_type::value_type /*hash*/, u32 /*file_offset*/> memory_regions;
    };

    Recorder::Recorder(const InitialState& initial_state) : initial_state(initial_state) {}
    
    void Recorder::Finish(const std::string& filename) {
        // Setup CiTrace header
        CTHeader header;
        std::memcpy(header.magic, CTHeader::ExpectedMagicWord(), 4);
        header.version = CTHeader::ExpectedVersion();
        header.header_size = sizeof(CTHeader);
    
        // Calculate file offsets
        auto& initial = header.initial_state_offsets;
    
        initial.pica_registers_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.pica_registers.size());
        initial.lcd_registers_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.lcd_registers.size());
        initial.default_attributes_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.default_attributes.size());
        initial.vs_program_binary_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_program_binary.size());
        initial.vs_swizzle_data_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size());
        initial.vs_float_uniforms_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size());
        initial.gs_program_binary_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_program_binary.size());
        initial.gs_swizzle_data_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size());
        initial.gs_float_uniforms_size = static_cast<u32>(initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size());
        header.stream_size = static_cast<u32>(stream.size());
    
        initial.gpu_registers = sizeof(header);
        initial.lcd_registers = initial.gpu_registers + initial.gpu_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.pica_registers = initial.lcd_registers + initial.lcd_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        ;
        initial.default_attributes = initial.pica_registers + initial.pica_registers_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_program_binary =
            initial.default_attributes + initial.default_attributes_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_swizzle_data =
            initial.vs_program_binary + initial.vs_program_binary_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.vs_float_uniforms =
            initial.vs_swizzle_data + initial.vs_swizzle_data_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_program_binary =
            initial.vs_float_uniforms + initial.vs_float_uniforms_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_swizzle_data =
            initial.gs_program_binary + initial.gs_program_binary_size * sizeof(u32);
        initial.gs_float_uniforms =
            initial.gs_swizzle_data + initial.gs_swizzle_data_size * sizeof(u32);
        header.stream_offset = initial.gs_float_uniforms + initial.gs_float_uniforms_size * sizeof(u32);
    
        // Iterate through stream elements, update relevant stream element data
        for (auto& stream_element : stream) {
            switch (stream_element.data.type) {
            case MemoryLoad: {
                auto& file_offset = memory_regions[stream_element.hash];
                if (!stream_element.uses_existing_data) {
                    file_offset = header.stream_offset;
                }
                stream_element.data.memory_load.file_offset = file_offset;
                break;
            }
    
            default:
                // Other commands don't use any extra data
                DEBUG_ASSERT(stream_element.extra_data.size() == 0);
                break;
            }
            header.stream_offset += static_cast<u32>(stream_element.extra_data.size());
        }
    
        try {
            // Open file and write header
            FileUtil::IOFile file(filename, "wb");
            std::size_t written = file.WriteObject(header);
            if (written != 1 || file.Tell() != initial.gpu_registers)
                throw "Failed to write header";
    
            // Write initial state
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.pica_registers.data(),
                                      initial_state.pica_registers.size());
            if (written != initial_state.pica_registers.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.default_attributes)
                throw "Failed to write Pica registers";
    
            written =
                file.WriteArray(initial_state.lcd_registers.data(), initial_state.lcd_registers.size());
            if (written != initial_state.lcd_registers.size() || file.Tell() != initial.pica_registers)
                throw "Failed to write LCD registers";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.default_attributes.data(),
                                      initial_state.default_attributes.size());
            if (written != initial_state.default_attributes.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_program_binary)
                throw "Failed to write default vertex attributes";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_program_binary.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_program_binary.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_program_binary.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_swizzle_data)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader program binary";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_swizzle_data.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.vs_float_uniforms)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader swizzle data";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.data(),
                                      initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size());
            if (written != initial_state.vs_float_uniforms.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_program_binary)
                throw "Failed to write vertex shader float uniforms";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_program_binary.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_program_binary.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_program_binary.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_swizzle_data)
                throw "Failed to write geomtry shader program binary";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_swizzle_data.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_float_uniforms)
                throw "Failed to write geometry shader swizzle data";
    
            written = file.WriteArray(initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.data(),
                                      initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size());
            if (written != initial_state.gs_float_uniforms.size() ||
                file.Tell() != initial.gs_float_uniforms + sizeof(u32) * initial.gs_float_uniforms_size)
                throw "Failed to write geometry shader float uniforms";
    
            // Iterate through stream elements, write "extra data"
            for (const auto& stream_element : stream) {
                if (stream_element.extra_data.size() == 0)
                    continue;
    
                written =
                    file.WriteBytes(stream_element.extra_data.data(), stream_element.extra_data.size());
                if (written != stream_element.extra_data.size())
                    throw "Failed to write extra data";
            }
    
            if (file.Tell() != header.stream_offset)
                throw "Unexpected end of extra data";
    
            // Write actual stream elements
            for (const auto& stream_element : stream) {
                if (1 != file.WriteObject(stream_element.data))
                    throw "Failed to write stream element";
            }
        } catch (const char* str) {
            LOG_ERROR(HW_GPU, "Writing CiTrace file failed: {}", str);
        }
    }
    
    void Recorder::FrameFinished() {
        stream.push_back({{FrameMarker}});
    }
    
    void Recorder::MemoryAccessed(const u8* data, u32 size, u32 physical_address) {
        StreamElement element = {{MemoryLoad}};
        element.data.memory_load.size = size;
        element.data.memory_load.physical_address = physical_address;
    
        // Compute hash over given memory region to check if the contents are already stored internally
        boost::crc_32_type result;
        result.process_bytes(data, size);
        element.hash = result.checksum();
    
        element.uses_existing_data = (memory_regions.find(element.hash) != memory_regions.end());
        if (!element.uses_existing_data) {
            element.extra_data.resize(size);
            std::memcpy(element.extra_data.data(), data, size);
            memory_regions.insert({element.hash, 0}); // file offset will be initialized in Finish()
        }
    
        stream.push_back(element);
    }
    
    void Recorder::RegisterWritten(u32 physical_address, u32 value) {
        StreamElement element = {{RegisterWrite}};
        element.data.register_write.physical_address = physical_address;
        element.data.register_write.value = value;
    
        stream.push_back(element);
    }

    class DebugTools {
    public:
        using Json = nlohmann::json;
        explicit DebugTools(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root)
            : system(system), root(root), bindings(SettingsBindings()) {}
    
    #ifdef CTR_EXPERIMENTAL
        void Attach() {
            system.Movie().SetRecordingBudget(32u<<20);
            Common::Log::SetObserver([this](const Common::Log::Entry& entry) {
                QueueEvent("native_log", {{"host_microseconds",entry.timestamp.count()},
                    {"severity",Common::Log::GetLevelName(entry.log_level)},
                    {"category",Common::Log::GetLogClassName(entry.log_class)},
                    {"file",entry.filename ? entry.filename : ""},{"line",entry.line_num},
                    {"message",entry.message.substr(0,8192)},{"time_domain","host_monotonic"}});
            });
            gpu = std::make_unique<GpuTools>(system,root,
                [this](const char* kind,Json data){Record(kind,std::move(data));},
                [this](const char* reason,Json data){Stop(reason,std::move(data));});
            DebugChannel::before_instruction = [this](auto& core, auto* thread) {
                if (stopped) return true;
                if (stepping) return false;
                if(!predicate.is_null() && predicate.value("core",0u)==core.GetID()) {
                    const auto kind=predicate.value("kind","");bool matches=false;
                    if(kind=="pc")matches=core.GetPC()==predicate.at("address").get<u32>();
                    if(kind=="memory")matches=Matches({{"kind","memory_equals"},{"address",predicate.at("address")},
                        {"width",predicate.at("width")},{"value",predicate.at("value")}},core);
                    if(matches){Stop("predicate",{{"predicate",predicate},{"pc",core.GetPC()},{"core",core.GetID()}});return true;}
                }
                const auto process = thread->owner_process.lock();
                for (auto& [id, bp] : breakpoints) {
                    if (bp.kind != "execute" || bp.address != core.GetPC()) continue;
                    if (skip_core == core.GetID() && skip_pc == core.GetPC()) {
                        skip_core = 0xffffffff;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (bp.process && (!process || *bp.process != process->process_id)) continue;
                    ++bp.hits;
                    if (bp.hits < bp.hit_after || !Matches(bp.condition, core)) continue;

    class GPU {
    public:
        explicit GPU(Core::System& system, Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window,
                     Frontend::EmuWindow* secondary_window);
        ~GPU();
    
        /// Sets the function to call for signalling GSP interrupts.
        void SetInterruptHandler(Service::GSP::InterruptHandler handler);
    
        /// Notify rasterizer that any caches of the specified region should be flushed to Switch memory
        void FlushRegion(PAddr addr, u32 size);
    
        /// Notify rasterizer that any caches of the specified region should be invalidated
        void InvalidateRegion(PAddr addr, u32 size);
    
        /// Flushes and invalidates all memory in the rasterizer cache and removes any leftover state.
        void ClearAll(bool flush);
    
        /// Executes the provided GSP command.
        Result Execute(const Service::GSP::Command& command);
    
        /// Updates GPU display framebuffer configuration using the specified parameters.
        void SetBufferSwap(u32 screen_id, const Service::GSP::FrameBufferInfo& info);
    
        /// Sets the LCD color fill configuration for the top and bottom screens.
        void SetColorFill(const Pica::ColorFill& fill);
    
        /// Reads a word from the GPU virtual address.
        u32 ReadReg(VAddr addr);
    
        /// Writes the provided value to the GPU virtual address.
        void WriteReg(VAddr addr, u32 data);
    
        /// Returns a mutable reference to the renderer.
        [[nodiscard]] VideoCore::RendererBase& Renderer();
    
        /// Returns a mutable reference to the PICA GPU.
        [[nodiscard]] Pica::PicaCore& PicaCore();
    
        /// Returns an immutable reference to the PICA GPU.
        [[nodiscard]] const Pica::PicaCore& PicaCore() const;
    
        /// Returns a mutable reference to the GSP command debugger.
        [[nodiscard]] GraphicsDebugger& Debugger();

        /// Recreates the renderer (for GL context reset in libretro)
        void RecreateRenderer(Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window, Frontend::EmuWindow* secondary_window);

        void ReleaseRenderer();

    constexpr VAddr VADDR_LCD = 0x1ED02000;

    class DelayGenerator {
    private:
        DelayGenerator() = default;
    
        // Average transfer speed based on measurements taken from real
        // hardware. 4 different modes have been taken into consideration:
        // RAM -> RAM, RAM -> VRAM, VRAM -> RAM and VRAM -> VRAM.
        // Furthermore, measurements are split into DMA transfers and tex
        // copies. For simplicity, we will assume fills are as fast as
        // texture copies.
    
        static constexpr double mibps_to_ns_per_byte(double mib_per_sec) {
            return 1'000'000'000.0 / (mib_per_sec * 1024.0 * 1024.0);
        }
    
        static constexpr std::array<std::array<double, 4>, 2> speed_mibps = {
            {{
                 190.0, // DMA RAMTORAM
                 310.0, // DMA RAMTOVRAM
                 380.0, // DMA VRAMTORAM
                 380.0, // DMA VRAMTOVRAM
             },
             {
                 450.0,  // TEX RAMTORAM
                 3100.0, // TEX RAMTOVRAM
                 5400.0, // TEX VRAMTORAM
                 5400.0, // TEX VRAMTOVRAM
             }}};
    
    public:
        enum class CopyMode {
            RAMTORAM,
            RAMTOVRAM,
            VRAMTORAM,
            VRAMTOVRAM,
        };
    
        static CopyMode GetCopyMode(bool input_vram, bool output_vram) {
            if (!input_vram && !output_vram) {
                return CopyMode::RAMTORAM;
            } else if (!input_vram && output_vram) {
                return CopyMode::RAMTOVRAM;
            } else if (input_vram && !output_vram) {
                return CopyMode::VRAMTORAM;
            } else {
                return CopyMode::VRAMTOVRAM;
            }
        }
    
        static u64 CalculateDelayNanoseconds(CopyMode mode, bool is_textre, size_t size) {
            double base_ns_per_byte =
                mibps_to_ns_per_byte(speed_mibps[is_textre][static_cast<u32>(mode)]);
    
            return static_cast<u64>(size * base_ns_per_byte);
        }
    };

    GPU::GPU(Core::System& system, Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window,

        : right_eye_disabler{std::make_unique<RightEyeDisabler>(*this)},

        impl->timing.ScheduleEvent(FRAME_TICKS, impl->vblank_event);

        impl->pica.BindRasterizer(impl->rasterizer);

            };

            impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::DMA, delay);

        case CommandId::SubmitCmdList: {
            auto& params = command.submit_gpu_cmdlist;
            auto& cmdbuffer = regs.internal.pipeline.command_buffer;
    
            // Write to the command buffer GPU registers.
            // The GSP module uses address 0 when the buffer is not in GPU visible memory.
            const PAddr address = VirtualToPhysicalAddress(params.address, params.size).value_or(0);
            cmdbuffer.addr[0].Assign(address >> 3);
            cmdbuffer.size[0].Assign(params.size >> 3);
            cmdbuffer.trigger[0] = 1;
    
            // Trigger processing of the command list
            SubmitCmdList(0);
            break;
        }
        case CommandId::MemoryFill: {
            auto& params = command.memory_fill;
            auto& memfill = regs.memory_fill_config;
    
            const auto translate = [this](u32 start, u32 end) -> std::optional<PAddr> {
                if (start >= end) {
                    return std::nullopt;
                }
                return VirtualToPhysicalAddress(start, end - start);
            };
    
            // Write to the memory fill GPU registers.
            // If both buffers are set GSP dispatches PSC0 only.
            const bool has_both_bufs = params.start1 != 0 && params.start2 != 0;
            if (params.start1 != 0) {
                const auto start = translate(params.start1, params.end1);
                if (!start) {
                    result = ResultInvalidGpuBuffer;
                    break;
                }
                memfill[0].address_start = *start >> 3;
                memfill[0].address_end = (*start + params.end1 - params.start1) >> 3;
                memfill[0].value_32bit = params.value1;
                memfill[0].control = params.control1;
                MemoryFill(0, has_both_bufs ? std::numeric_limits<u32>::max() : 0);
            }
            if (params.start2 != 0) {
                const auto start = translate(params.start2, params.end2);
                if (!start) {
                    result = ResultInvalidGpuBuffer;
                    break;
                }
                memfill[1].address_start = *start >> 3;
                memfill[1].address_end = (*start + params.end2 - params.start2) >> 3;
                memfill[1].value_32bit = params.value2;
                memfill[1].control = params.control2;
                MemoryFill(1, has_both_bufs ? 0 : 1);
            }
            break;
        }
        case CommandId::DisplayTransfer: {
            auto& params = command.display_transfer;
            auto& display_transfer = regs.display_transfer_config;
    
            // Write to the transfer engine GPU registers.
            // The GSP module uses address 0 when the buffer is not in GPU visible memory (only the
            // first byte is checked).
            display_transfer.input_address =
                VirtualToPhysicalAddress(params.in_buffer_address, 1).value_or(0) >> 3;
            display_transfer.output_address =
                VirtualToPhysicalAddress(params.out_buffer_address, 1).value_or(0) >> 3;
            display_transfer.input_size = params.in_buffer_size;
            display_transfer.output_size = params.out_buffer_size;
            display_transfer.flags = params.flags;
            display_transfer.trigger.Assign(1);
    
            // Trigger the display transfer.
            MemoryTransfer();
            break;
        }
        case CommandId::TextureCopy: {
            auto& params = command.texture_copy;
            auto& texture_copy = regs.display_transfer_config;
    
            // Write to the transfer engine GPU registers.
            // The GSP module uses address 0 when the buffer is not in GPU visible memory.
            texture_copy.input_address =
                VirtualToPhysicalAddress(params.in_buffer_address, params.size).value_or(0) >> 3;
            texture_copy.output_address =
                VirtualToPhysicalAddress(params.out_buffer_address, params.size).value_or(0) >> 3;
            texture_copy.texture_copy.size = params.size;
            texture_copy.texture_copy.input_size = params.in_width_gap;
            texture_copy.texture_copy.output_size = params.out_width_gap;
            texture_copy.flags = params.flags;
            texture_copy.trigger.Assign(1);
    
            // Trigger the texture copy.
            MemoryTransfer();
            break;
        }
        case CommandId::CacheFlush: {
            // Rasterizer flushing handled elsewhere in CPU read/write and other GPU handlers
            // Use command.cache_flush.regions to implement this handler
            break;
        }
        default:
            LOG_ERROR(HW_GPU, "Unknown command {:#08X}", command.id.Value());
            result = ResultUnknownGxCommand;
        }
    
        // Notify debugger that a GSP command was processed.
        if (impl->debug_context) {
            impl->debug_context->OnEvent(Pica::DebugContext::Event::GSPCommandProcessed, &command);
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    void GPU::SetBufferSwap(u32 screen_id, const Service::GSP::FrameBufferInfo& info) {
        // The GSP module does not apply a framebuffer outside GPU visible memory. The right address
        // is used only for the top screen in stereoscopic mode and when it is not zero.
        // Otherwise the left address is used for both eyes.
        const auto phys_address_left = VirtualToPhysicalAddress(info.address_left, info.stride);
        if (!phys_address_left) {
            return;
        }
    
        // Update framebuffer properties.
        auto& framebuffer = impl->pica.regs.framebuffer_config[screen_id];
        if (screen_id == 0) {
            const bool stereoscopic = (info.format & 0x70) == 0x20;
            const PAddr phys_address_right =
                (!stereoscopic || info.address_right == 0)
                    ? *phys_address_left
                    : VirtualToPhysicalAddress(info.address_right, info.stride).value_or(0);
            if (info.active_fb == 0) {
                framebuffer.address_right1 = phys_address_right;
            } else {
                framebuffer.address_right2 = phys_address_right;
            }
        }
        if (info.active_fb == 0) {
            framebuffer.address_left1 = *phys_address_left;
        } else {
            framebuffer.address_left2 = *phys_address_left;
        }
    
        framebuffer.stride = info.stride;
        framebuffer.format = (framebuffer.format & 0xFFFF0000) | (info.format & 0xFFFF);
        framebuffer.active_fb = info.shown_fb & 0xFF;
    
        // Notify debugger about the buffer swap.
        if (impl->debug_context) {
            impl->debug_context->OnEvent(Pica::DebugContext::Event::BufferSwapped, nullptr);
        }
    
        if (screen_id == 0) {
            MicroProfileFlip();
            impl->system.perf_stats->EndGameFrame();
            right_eye_disabler->ReportEndFrame();
        }
    }
    
    void GPU::SetColorFill(const Pica::ColorFill& fill) {
        impl->pica.regs_lcd.color_fill_top = fill;
        impl->pica.regs_lcd.color_fill_bottom = fill;
    }
    
    u32 GPU::ReadReg(VAddr addr) {
        switch (addr & 0xFFFFF000) {
        case VADDR_LCD: {
            const u32 offset = addr - VADDR_LCD;
            const u32 index = offset / sizeof(u32);
            ASSERT(addr % sizeof(u32) == 0);
            ASSERT(index < Pica::RegsLcd::NumIds());
            return impl->pica.regs_lcd[index];
        }
        case VADDR_GPU:
        case VADDR_GPU + 0x1000: {
    
    void GPU::WriteReg(VAddr addr, u32 data) {
        switch (addr & 0xFFFFF000) {
        case VADDR_LCD: {
            const u32 offset = addr - VADDR_LCD;
            const u32 index = offset / sizeof(u32);
            ASSERT(addr % sizeof(u32) == 0);
            ASSERT(index < Pica::RegsLcd::NumIds());
            impl->pica.regs_lcd[index] = data;
            break;
        }
        case VADDR_GPU:
        case VADDR_GPU + 0x1000: {
            const u32 offset = addr - VADDR_GPU;
            const u32 index = offset / sizeof(u32);
    
            ASSERT(addr % sizeof(u32) == 0);
            ASSERT(index < Pica::PicaCore::Regs::NUM_REGS);
            impl->pica.regs.reg_array[index] = data;
    
            // Handle registers that trigger GPU actions
            switch (index) {
            case GPU_REG_INDEX(memory_fill_config[0].trigger):
                MemoryFill(0, 0);
                break;
            case GPU_REG_INDEX(memory_fill_config[1].trigger):
                MemoryFill(1, 1);
                break;
            case GPU_REG_INDEX(display_transfer_config.trigger):
                MemoryTransfer();
                break;
            case GPU_REG_INDEX(internal.pipeline.command_buffer.trigger[0]):
                SubmitCmdList(0);
                break;
            case GPU_REG_INDEX(internal.pipeline.command_buffer.trigger[1]):
                SubmitCmdList(1);
                break;
            default:
                break;
            }
            break;
        }
        default:
            UNREACHABLE_MSG("Write to unknown GPU address {:#08X}", addr);
        }
    }

    void GPU::ApplyPerProgramSettings(u64 program_ID) {
        auto hack = Common::Hacks::hack_manager.GetHack(
            Common::Hacks::HackType::ACCURATE_MULTIPLICATION, program_ID);
        bool use_accurate_mul = Settings::values.shaders_accurate_mul.GetValue();
        if (hack) {
            switch (hack->mode) {
            case Common::Hacks::HackAllowMode::DISALLOW:
                use_accurate_mul = false;
                break;
            case Common::Hacks::HackAllowMode::FORCE:
                use_accurate_mul = true;
                break;
            case Common::Hacks::HackAllowMode::ALLOW:
            default:
                break;
            }
        }
        impl->rasterizer->SetAccurateMul(use_accurate_mul);
    }
    
    void GPU::SubmitCmdList(u32 index) {
        // Check if a command list was triggered.
        auto& config = impl->pica.regs.internal.pipeline.command_buffer;
        if (!config.trigger[index]) {
            return;
        }
    
        MICROPROFILE_SCOPE(GPU_CmdlistProcessing);
    
        // Forward command list processing to the PICA core.
        const PAddr addr = config.GetPhysicalAddress(index);
        const u32 size = config.GetSize(index);
    
        // Do not process the list if the memory range is not sane.
        auto& memory = impl->system.Memory();
        const u8* head = memory.GetPhysicalPointer(addr);
        if (!head || (size != 0 && memory.GetPhysicalPointer(addr + size - 1) != head + size - 1)) {
            LOG_ERROR(HW_GPU, "Invalid command list address 0x{:08X} (size 0x{:X})", addr, size);
            impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::P3D, 0);
            config.trigger[index] = 0;
            return;
        }
    
        impl->pica.ProcessCmdList(addr, size,
                                  !right_eye_disabler->ShouldAllowCmdQueueTrigger(addr, size));
        config.trigger[index] = 0;
    }
    
    void GPU::MemoryFill(u32 index, u32 intr_index) {
        // Check if a memory fill was triggered.
        auto& config = impl->pica.regs.memory_fill_config[index];
        if (!config.trigger) {
            return;
        }
    
        // Perform memory fill.
        if (!impl->rasterizer->AccelerateFill(config)) {
            impl->sw_blitter->MemoryFill(config);
        }
    
        // Treat fill as texture transfer from VRAM
        u64 delay = DelayGenerator::CalculateDelayNanoseconds(
            DelayGenerator::GetCopyMode(true, config.IsVRAM()), true,
            config.GetEndAddress() - config.GetStartAddress());
    
        // It seems that it won't signal interrupt if "address_start" is zero.
        // TODO: hwtest this
        if (config.GetStartAddress() != 0) {
            if (intr_index == 0) {
                impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::PSC0, delay);
            } else if (intr_index == 1) {
                impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::PSC1, delay);
            }
        }
    
        // Reset "trigger" flag and set the "finish" flag
        // This was confirmed to happen on hardware even if "address_start" is zero.
        config.trigger.Assign(0);
        config.finished.Assign(1);
    }
    
    void GPU::MemoryTransfer() {
        // Check if a transfer was triggered.
        auto& config = impl->pica.regs.display_transfer_config;
        if (!config.trigger.Value()) {
            return;
        }
    
        MICROPROFILE_SCOPE(GPU_DisplayTransfer);
    
        // Notify debugger about the display transfer.
        if (impl->debug_context) {
            impl->debug_context->OnEvent(Pica::DebugContext::Event::IncomingDisplayTransfer, nullptr);
        }
    
        u64 delay{};
        // Perform memory transfer
        if (config.is_texture_copy) {
            if (!impl->rasterizer->AccelerateTextureCopy(config)) {
                impl->sw_blitter->TextureCopy(config);
            }
            delay = DelayGenerator::CalculateDelayNanoseconds(
                DelayGenerator::GetCopyMode(config.IsInputVRAM(), config.IsOutputVRAM()), true,
                config.texture_copy.size);
        } else {
            if (right_eye_disabler->ShouldAllowDisplayTransfer(config.GetPhysicalInputAddress(),
                                                               config.input_height)) {
                if (!impl->rasterizer->AccelerateDisplayTransfer(config)) {
                    impl->sw_blitter->DisplayTransfer(config);
                }
            }
            delay = DelayGenerator::CalculateDelayNanoseconds(
                DelayGenerator::GetCopyMode(config.IsInputVRAM(), config.IsOutputVRAM()), true,
                config.input_width * config.input_height * BytesPerPixel(config.input_format));
        }
    
        // Complete transfer.
        config.trigger.Assign(0);
        impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::PPF, delay);
    }

                ShaderRegs gs;

                INSERT_PADDING_WORDS(0x20);
            };
            std::array<u32, NUM_REGS> reg_array;
        };
    
        /// Map register indices to names readable by humans
        static const char* GetRegisterName(u16 index);
    };

    class DelayGenerator {
    private:
        // A GPU is a very complex system, the timings resulting from
        // a 3D draw depend on many factors, including triangle counts,
        // texture sizes and format, shader complexity, cache
        // and memory layout, etc. At this point in time, we don't
        // have enough information nor implemented hw emulation
        // capabilities to achieve a proper timing estimate.
        //
        // Instead, we will try to measure how complex a scene is based
        // on the amount of geometry that is drawn, the amount of GPU
        // commands and the shader complexity. We will ignore all
        // the other factors for now.
    
        // Using Mario Kart 7 as the reference, it is understood that on
        // average the console can handle around 20k triangles per frame.
        // This game uses standard GPU features, with no fancy stuff,
        // so we can consider it an average. To prevent hurting performance,
        // we will also assume the GPU is twice as powerful. Afterall we only
        // want timing accuracy to fix bugs at this point.
        // This average already takes into account shader complexity averages.
        static constexpr float nanoseconds_per_triangle = 800.f / 2;
    
        // Of the total amount of submitted triangles, many of them will be culled.
        // This heavily depends on the specific scene, so we will assume 35% of the
        // triangles being culled. Furthermore, the culled triangles will take way less
        // processing time as they will skip most of the pipeline processing, so we
        // can assume that a culled triangle will only take about 20% of the time.
        static constexpr float culled_triangle_threshold = 0.35f; // 35%
        static constexpr float culled_triangle_time_cost = 0.20f; // 20%
    
        // We will assume that each command will take around 6 cycles @ 268MHz
        // There are no real measurements to support this claim, but it sounds
        // reasonable. TODO: Measure on real HW.
        static constexpr float nanoseconds_per_command = 22.4f;
    
    public:
        inline void AddCommands(size_t commands) {
            command_count += commands;
        }
    
        inline void AddVertices(size_t vertices, PipelineRegs::TriangleTopology topology) {
            size_t triangles{};
            if (topology == PipelineRegs::TriangleTopology::Fan ||
                topology == PipelineRegs::TriangleTopology::Strip) {
                triangles = (vertices >= 3) ? (vertices - 2) : 1;
            } else {
                // Geometry shaders produce more vertices per given vertex,
                // but they are not that relevant for timing emulation.
                triangles = vertices / 3;
            }
    
            triangle_count += triangles;
        }
    
        u64 CalculateAndResetDelay() {
            float result = command_count * nanoseconds_per_command;
    
            result += (1.f - culled_triangle_threshold) * triangle_count * nanoseconds_per_triangle;
            result += culled_triangle_threshold * triangle_count *
                      (nanoseconds_per_triangle * culled_triangle_time_cost);
    
            triangle_count = 0;
            command_count = 0;
    
            return static_cast<u64>(result);
        }
    
    private:
        size_t triangle_count{};
        size_t command_count{};
    
        friend class boost::serialization::access;
        template <class Archive>
        void serialize(Archive& ar, const u32 file_version) {
            ar & triangle_count;
            ar & command_count;
        }
    };

    void GPU::VBlankCallback(std::uintptr_t user_data, s64 cycles_late) {
        // Signal to GSP that GPU interrupt has occurred
        impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::PDC0, 0);
        impl->signal_interrupt(Service::GSP::InterruptId::PDC1, 0);
    
        // Present renderered frame.
        impl->renderer->SwapBuffers();
    
        // Reschedule recurrent event
        impl->timing.ScheduleEvent(FRAME_TICKS - cycles_late, impl->vblank_event);
    }
    
    void GPU::RecreateRenderer(Frontend::EmuWindow& emu_window, Frontend::EmuWindow* secondary_window) {
        // Reset the renderer (this will destroy OpenGL resources)
        impl->renderer.reset();
    
        // Create a new renderer
        impl->renderer =
            VideoCore::CreateRenderer(emu_window, secondary_window, impl->pica, impl->system);
        impl->rasterizer = impl->renderer->Rasterizer();
    
        // Rebind the rasterizer to the PICA GPU
        impl->pica.BindRasterizer(impl->rasterizer);
    
        // Update the sw_blitter with the new rasterizer
        impl->sw_blitter = std::make_unique<SwRenderer::SwBlitter>(impl->memory, impl->rasterizer);
    
        // Re-apply per-game configuration and reload disk shader cache
        u64 program_id{};
        impl->system.GetAppLoader().ReadProgramId(program_id);
        ApplyPerProgramSettings(program_id);
        if (Settings::values.use_disk_shader_cache) {
            impl->renderer->Rasterizer()->LoadDefaultDiskResources(false, nullptr);
        }
    
        // Mark ALL GPU registers as dirty so current state gets uploaded to new renderer
        impl->pica.dirty_regs.SetAllDirty();
    
        // Also mark shader setups as dirty so uniforms get re-uploaded and
        // stale pointers to the old rasterizer's JIT cache are cleared.
        impl->pica.vs_setup.uniforms_dirty = true;
        impl->pica.vs_setup.cached_shader = nullptr;
        impl->pica.gs_setup.uniforms_dirty = true;
        impl->pica.gs_setup.cached_shader = nullptr;
    
        // Mark all cached LUT/table state in pica as dirty
        impl->pica.lighting.lut_dirty = impl->pica.lighting.LutAllDirty;
        impl->pica.fog.lut_dirty = true;
        impl->pica.proctex.table_dirty = impl->pica.proctex.TableAllDirty;
    }
    
    void GPU::ReleaseRenderer() {
        // Just reset the renderer to release OpenGL resources
        // Don't null out rasterizer pointer as it will become dangling
        impl->renderer.reset();
        impl->sw_blitter.reset();
        LOG_INFO(HW_GPU, "Renderer released for context destroy");
    }

    """Bounded wire-level acceptance probe; private roots, no uploaded user assets."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import queue
    import struct
    import subprocess
    import threading
    import time
    import uuid
    
    
    class Peer:
        def __init__(self, worker, root):
            root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            self.root = root
            self.stderr = (root / "probe.stderr.log").open("wb")
            self.process = subprocess.Popen([str(worker)], env={**os.environ, "LOTUS_STORAGE_ROOT": str(root)}, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=self.stderr)
            self.session = uuid.uuid4().hex
            self.epoch = 1
            self.sequence = 0
            self.notifications = []
            self.output = queue.Queue(32)
            self.reader = threading.Thread(target=self.read, daemon=True)
            self.reader.start()
    
        def read(self):
            try:
                while True:
                    header = self.process.stdout.read(4)
                    if len(header) != 4:
                        raise EOFError("worker closed stdout")
                    length, = struct.unpack("<I", header)
                    assert 0 < length <= 65536
                    self.output.put(json.loads(self.process.stdout.read(length)))
            except Exception as error:
                self.output.put(error)
    
        def call(self, method, params=None, expected="ok"):
            self.sequence += 1
            data = json.dumps(dict(version_major=1, version_minor=0, request_id=self.sequence,
                                   session=self.session, epoch=self.epoch, method=method, params=params)).encode()
            self.process.stdin.write(struct.pack("<I", len(data)) + data)
            self.process.stdin.flush()
            while True:
                reply = self.output.get(timeout=35)
                if isinstance(reply, Exception):
                    raise reply
                assert reply["session"] == self.session
                if reply.get("notification"):
                    self.notifications.append(reply)
                    continue
                assert reply["request_id"] == self.sequence, reply
                self.epoch = reply["epoch"]
                self.state = reply["state"]
                assert reply["status"] == expected, reply
                return reply["data"]
    
        def debug(self, operation, **params):
            return self.call("debug", dict(operation=operation, **params))
    
        def close(self):
            try:
                if self.process.poll() is None:
                    try:self.call("stop")
                    except (EOFError,OSError):pass
                self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            finally:
                if self.process.poll() is None:
                    self.process.kill()
                    self.process.wait()
                self.stderr.close()
    
    
    def probe(worker, asset, root, experimental, new, vulkan, frames=60):
        peer = Peer(worker, root)
        start = time.monotonic()
        try:
            peer.call("hello")  # Regression: omitted notification negotiation remains legal.
            peer.call("hello", {"notifications": True})
            settings = []
            offset = 0
            while True:
                page = peer.debug("settings_list", offset=offset, limit=32)
                settings.extend(page["settings"])
                offset = page["next"]
                if offset is None:
                    break
            assert len(settings) >= 125
            peer.debug("settings_set", name="is_new_3ds", value=new)
            peer.debug("settings_set", name="graphics_api", value=2 if vulkan else 0)
            peer.call("load", {"path": str(asset)})
            peer.call("debug", {"operation": "settings_set", "name": "is_new_3ds", "value": not new}, "invalid_argument")
            result = peer.call("run_until", {"frames": frames})
            capture = peer.call("capture")
            hashes = {}
            for lease in capture["frames"]:
                data = (root / lease["path"]).read_bytes()
                assert data[:4] == b"LTRF" and len(data) == lease["bytes"] + 32
                hashes[lease["screen"]] = hashlib.sha256(data[32:]).hexdigest()
            registers = peer.debug("registers", core=0)
            assert len(registers["registers"]) == 16 and len(registers["vfp"]) == 64
            threads = peer.debug("threads")
            if experimental:
                peer.call("pause")
                pc = registers["registers"][15]
                # A one-instruction self-loop makes breakpoint/skip semantics independent of app scheduling.
                peer.debug("write_memory", address=pc & ~3, bytes=[254, 255, 255, 234])
                peer.debug("write_register", core=0, register=15, value=pc & ~3)
                bp = peer.debug("breakpoint_set", address=pc & ~3, kind="execute", length=4)
                stopped = peer.call("run_until", {"frames": 1})
                assert stopped["stop"]["reason"] == "breakpoint", stopped
                assert stopped["stop"]["breakpoint"] == bp["id"]
                peer.debug("breakpoint_remove", id=bp["id"])
                step = peer.debug("step", core=0, count=1)
                assert step["instructions"] == 1 and step["stop"]["reason"] == "step", step
            return dict(new_3ds=new, renderer="vulkan" if vulkan else "software", source=result["source"],
                        hashes=hashes, threads=len(threads["threads"]), seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                        notifications=len(peer.notifications), root=str(root))
        finally:
            peer.close()
            for log in [root / "probe.stderr.log", *root.glob("log/*.txt")]:
                assert "Failed to find title id for ROM (Error 0)" not in log.read_text(errors="replace"), log
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        parser.add_argument("worker", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("asset", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("--experimental", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument("--vulkan", action="store_true")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        reports = []
        for new in (False, True):
            report = probe(args.worker.resolve(), args.asset.resolve(),
                           args.output.resolve() / ("new" if new else "old"),
                           args.experimental, new, args.vulkan)
            reports.append(report)
            print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)
        (args.output / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(reports, indent=2))

    // CiTrace v1 GPU action replay. The paired checkpoint preserves LUTs and other
    // initial GPU state absent from the upstream v1 header. CPU execution stays held.
    #pragma once
    #include <map>
    #include "common/hash.h"
    #include "core/tracer/recorder.h"
    #include "core/frontend/debug_channel.h"
    #include "video_core/gpu.h"

    namespace CtrWorker {
    class GpuTrace {
    public:
        using Json = nlohmann::json;
        GpuTrace(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root) : system(system),root(root) {
            DebugChannel::gpu_action=[this](u32 action,u32 index){Action(action,index);};
        }
        ~GpuTrace(){DebugChannel::gpu_action={};}
        void Clear(){recorder.reset();pages.clear();frames=0;}
        Json Start() {
            Clear();
            CiTrace::Recorder::InitialState initial;
            auto& pica=system.GPU().PicaCore();
            const auto copy=[](std::vector<u32>& dest,const auto& source){
                static_assert(sizeof(source)%4==0);
                dest.resize(sizeof(source)/4);std::memcpy(dest.data(),&source,sizeof(source));
            };
            copy(initial.pica_registers,pica.regs);copy(initial.lcd_registers,pica.regs_lcd);
            copy(initial.vs_program_binary,pica.vs_setup.GetProgramCode());
            copy(initial.vs_swizzle_data,pica.vs_setup.GetSwizzleData());
            // The checkpoint, not these optional v1 fields, restores packed float24,
            // default attributes, geometry pipeline and LUT state without conversion.
            recorder=std::make_unique<CiTrace::Recorder>(initial);
            return Status();
        }
        Json Status() const {
            return {{"recording",bool(recorder)},{"frames",frames},
                {"elements",recorder?recorder->Elements():0},{"data_bytes",recorder?recorder->DataBytes():0},
                {"dropped",recorder?recorder->Dropped():0},{"truncated",recorder&&recorder->Truncated()},
                {"element_cap",262144},{"data_budget_bytes",48u<<20},
                {"capture_cost","opt-in full GPU-visible memory page scan per GPU action"},
                {"initial_state","paired lotus-citrace checkpoint; includes LUTs and shader state"}};
        }
        Json Stop() {
            if(!recorder)throw std::invalid_argument("no active CiTrace recording");
            auto result=Status();
            std::filesystem::create_directories(root/"gpu");
            recorder->Finish((root/"gpu/trace.ctf").string());
            result["artifacts"]=Json::array({{{"path","gpu/trace.ctf"},{"format","citrace"}}});
            recorder.reset();pages.clear();result["recording"]=false;return result;
        }
        static bool PhysicalRange(u32 address,u32 size,bool new3ds) {
            const u64 end=u64(address)+size;
            return size&&((address>=Memory::VRAM_PADDR&&end<=u64(Memory::VRAM_PADDR)+Memory::VRAM_SIZE)||
                (address>=Memory::FCRAM_PADDR&&end<=u64(Memory::FCRAM_PADDR)+(new3ds?Memory::FCRAM_N3DS_SIZE:Memory::FCRAM_SIZE)));
        }
        struct Validated {
            std::vector<u8> bytes;
            CiTrace::CTHeader header;
            std::vector<CiTrace::CTStreamElement> stream;
        };
        Validated Read() {
            const auto path=root/"gpu/trace.ctf";
            const auto size=std::filesystem::file_size(path);
            if(size<sizeof(CiTrace::CTHeader)||size>(64u<<20))throw std::invalid_argument("CiTrace file size budget");
            Validated trace;trace.bytes.resize(size);
            std::ifstream file(path,std::ios::binary);file.exceptions(std::ios::badbit|std::ios::failbit);
            file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(trace.bytes.data()),size);
            std::memcpy(&trace.header,trace.bytes.data(),sizeof(trace.header));
            const auto& h=trace.header;
            if(std::memcmp(h.magic,"CiTr",4)||h.version!=1||h.header_size!=sizeof(h)||h.stream_size>262144||
                h.stream_offset<sizeof(h)||u64(h.stream_offset)+u64(h.stream_size)*sizeof(CiTrace::CTStreamElement)!=size)
                throw std::invalid_argument("invalid CiTrace header/stream bounds");
            std::array<u32,20> ranges{};std::memcpy(ranges.data(),&h.initial_state_offsets,sizeof(ranges));
            for(u32 i=0;i<20;i+=2)if(ranges[i]<sizeof(h)||u64(ranges[i])+u64(ranges[i+1])*4>h.stream_offset)
                throw std::invalid_argument("invalid CiTrace initial-state bounds");
            trace.stream.resize(h.stream_size);
            std::memcpy(trace.stream.data(),trace.bytes.data()+h.stream_offset,trace.stream.size()*sizeof(CiTrace::CTStreamElement));
            for(const auto& entry:trace.stream) {
                if(entry.type==CiTrace::MemoryLoad) {
                    const auto& m=entry.memory_load;
                    if(m.size>4096||m.file_offset<sizeof(h)||u64(m.file_offset)+m.size>h.stream_offset||
                        !PhysicalRange(m.physical_address,m.size,Settings::values.is_new_3ds))

                } else if(entry.type==CiTrace::RegisterWrite) {

                    if(!dest||system.Memory().GetPhysicalPointer(m.physical_address+m.size-1)!=dest+m.size-1)

            }

                {"format","CiTrace v1 + paired checkpoint"},{"cpu_executed",false},
                {"rasterizer_cache_flush",true}};
        }

        bool Trigger(u32 index)const {
            return index==GPU_REG_INDEX(memory_fill_config[0].trigger)||index==GPU_REG_INDEX(memory_fill_config[1].trigger)||
                index==GPU_REG_INDEX(display_transfer_config.trigger)||
                index==GPU_REG_INDEX(internal.pipeline.command_buffer.trigger[0])||
                index==GPU_REG_INDEX(internal.pipeline.command_buffer.trigger[1]);
        }
        void Action(u32 action,u32 index) {
            if(!recorder||recorder->Truncated())return;
            auto& gpu=system.GPU();auto& pica=gpu.PicaCore();
            // Flush before observing pages; the scan also captures CPU updates and
            // DMA results that bypass MMIO. Unchanged pages add no stream entries.
            for(const auto [base,size]:{std::pair<u32,u32>{Memory::VRAM_PADDR,Memory::VRAM_SIZE},
                {Memory::FCRAM_PADDR,Settings::values.is_new_3ds?Memory::FCRAM_N3DS_SIZE:Memory::FCRAM_SIZE}}) {
                gpu.FlushRegion(base,size);
                for(u32 offset=0;offset<size;offset+=4096) {
                    const auto address=base+offset;const auto* data=system.Memory().GetPhysicalPointer(address);
                    if(!data)continue;
                    const auto hash=Common::ComputeHash64(data,4096);
                    auto found=pages.find(address);
                    if(found!=pages.end()&&found->second==hash)continue;
                    recorder->MemoryAccessed(data,4096,address);pages[address]=hash;
                    if(recorder->Truncated())return;
                }
