            // Emit configuration before the trigger; all other triggers are omitted.
            for(u32 i=0;i<pica.regs.reg_array.size();++i)if(!Trigger(i))
                recorder->RegisterWritten(0x10400000+i*4,pica.regs.reg_array[i]);
            for(u32 i=0;i<Pica::RegsLcd::NumIds();++i)recorder->RegisterWritten(0x10202000+i*4,pica.regs_lcd[i]);
            if(action==0){recorder->FrameFinished();++frames;return;}
            const u32 trigger=action==1?GPU_REG_INDEX(internal.pipeline.command_buffer.trigger[0])+index:
                action==2?GPU_REG_INDEX(memory_fill_config[0].trigger)+index*4:GPU_REG_INDEX(display_transfer_config.trigger);
            recorder->RegisterWritten(0x10400000+trigger*4,pica.regs.reg_array[trigger]);
        }
        Core::System& system;std::filesystem::path root;
        std::unique_ptr<CiTrace::Recorder> recorder;
        std::map<u32,u64> pages;
        u64 frames=0;
    };

                peer.call("hello",{"notifications":True})
                for name,value in {"is_new_3ds":new,"graphics_api":2 if vulkan else 0,"use_hw_shader":False}.items():
                    peer.debug("settings_set",name=name,value=value)

                listing=peer.debug("gpu_draws")

                assert frozen["draw"]==draw and frozen["command"]==stopped["stop"]["command"],frozen
                trace=peer.debug("shader_trace",draw=draw,vertex=0)

                assert 0<trace["instructions"]<=8192 and not instructions["truncated"],trace
                assert any("dest_f32_bits" in row for row in instructions["instructions"]),instructions

    fn range(address: u32, length: u32, maximum: u32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if length == 0 || length > maximum || u64::from(address) + u64::from(length) > 1u64 << 32 {
            Err("invalid or oversized guest range")
        } else {
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        pub async fn stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            let result = self.worker.stop().await;
            if result.is_err() {
                self.worker.abort().await;
            }
            self.mark_closed(if result.is_ok() { "closed" } else { "crashed" })?;
            result
        }
    
        /// Explicit failure injection and emergency termination, limited to this job.
        pub async fn abort(&mut self) {
            self.worker.abort().await;
            let _ = self.mark_closed("crashed");
        }
    
        fn mark_closed(&self, lifecycle: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            let path = self.root.join("native-manifest.json");
            let mut manifest: Value =
                serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path)?).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            manifest["lifecycle"] = lifecycle.into();
            manifest["pid"] = Value::Null;
            fs::write(
                path,
                serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(io::Error::other)?,
            )
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {
            &self.root
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn state(&self) -> SessionState {
            self.worker.state()
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn epoch(&self) -> u64 {
            self.worker.epoch()
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn pid(&self) -> Option<u32> {
            self.worker.pid()
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn working_set(&self) -> Option<u64> {
            self.worker.working_set()
        }
    
        pub fn read_lease(&self, lease: &FrameLease) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            if !matches!(
                self.worker.state(),
                SessionState::Paused | SessionState::Running
            ) || self.worker.epoch() != lease.epoch
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("frame lease invalidated by lifecycle"));
            }
            read_frame(&self.root, lease)
        }
    
        async fn operation(&mut self, method: Method, params: Value) -> io::Result<Value> {
            let Reply {
                status, mut data, ..
            } = self.worker.command(method, params).await?;
            if status != Status::Ok {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!("{method:?}: {status:?}: {data}")));
            }
            if data.is_object() {
                data["profile_hash"] = self.profile_hash.clone().into();
                data["identity"] = self.identity.clone();
                data["epoch"] = self.epoch().into();
                self.decorate(&mut data);
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    }

    """Record native GPU actions, replay with CPU held, compare actual frame bytes."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import struct
    import time
    from native_debug_probe import Peer
    
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("worker",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("rom",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output",type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    
    def hashes(peer):
        return {frame["screen"]:hashlib.sha256((peer.root/frame["path"]).read_bytes()[32:]).hexdigest()
                for frame in peer.call("capture")["frames"]}
    
    for new in (False,True):
        for vulkan in (False,True):
            root=args.output.resolve()/f"{'new' if new else 'old'}-{'vulkan' if vulkan else 'software'}"
            peer=Peer(args.worker.resolve(),root)
            try:
                peer.call("hello",{"notifications":True})
                for name,value in {"is_new_3ds":new,"graphics_api":2 if vulkan else 0}.items():
                    peer.debug("settings_set",name=name,value=value)
                peer.call("load",{"path":str(args.rom.resolve())})
                peer.call("run_until",{"frames":60})
                start=time.monotonic()
                peer.call("run_until",{"frames":2})
                baseline_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
                peer.debug("citrace_start")
                start=time.monotonic()
                peer.call("run_until",{"frames":2})
                recording_seconds=time.monotonic()-start
                original=hashes(peer)
                recorded=peer.debug("citrace_stop")
                assert recorded["frames"]==2 and not recorded["truncated"],recorded
                trace=root/recorded["artifacts"][0]["path"]
                data=trace.read_bytes()
                assert data[:4]==b'CiTr' and len(data)<64*1024*1024
                header=struct.unpack_from('<27I',data)
                assert header[1]==1 and header[2]==108
                stream_offset,stream_size=header[-2:]
                assert stream_offset+stream_size*20==len(data)
                assert stream_size==recorded["elements"]
                replay=peer.debug("citrace_replay")
                assert replay["frames"]==2 and replay["cpu_executed"] is False,replay
                actual=hashes(peer)
                assert original==actual,(original,actual)
                # Replaying the same trace again starts from its paired initial state.
                peer.debug("citrace_replay")
                assert hashes(peer)==original
                # Malformed data must be rejected before loading the initial state.
                corrupt=bytearray(data);struct.pack_into('<I',corrupt,104,0xffffffff)
                trace.write_bytes(corrupt)
                peer.call("debug",{"operation":"citrace_replay"},expected="invalid_argument")
                trace.write_bytes(data)
                report=dict(new_3ds=new,renderer="vulkan" if vulkan else "software",hashes=original,
                            recorded=recorded,replay=replay,baseline_host_seconds=baseline_seconds,
                            recording_host_seconds=recording_seconds,file_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
                (root/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
                print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
            finally:peer.close()

                if(type=="draw")matched=std::string{kind}=="pica" && data.value("event",~0u)==2 && data.value("draw",0ull)>=predicate.at("draw").get<u64>();
                if(type=="log" && (std::string{kind}=="guest_log" || std::string{kind}=="hio_stdout" || std::string{kind}=="native_log")) {
                    const auto text=data.value("text",data.value("message",std::string{}));

        Json Stream(const Json& p, bool logs) {
            const auto after = p.at("after").get<u64>();
            const auto limit = p.at("limit").get<u32>();
            if (!limit || limit > 128) throw std::invalid_argument("stream limit 1..128");
            Json result = Json::array();
            for (const auto& event : events) {
                if (event["sequence"].get<u64>() <= after) continue;
                if (logs && event["kind"] != "guest_log" && event["kind"] != "hio_stdout" && event["kind"] != "native_log") continue;
                if (!result.empty() && result.dump().size()+event.dump().size()>48000) break;
                result.push_back(event);
                if (result.size() == limit) break;
            }
            return {{"events", result}, {"lost_total", events_lost}, {"pending_lost_total",pending_lost.load()},
                    {"latest", event_sequence}, {"next",result.empty()?event_sequence:result.back().at("sequence").get<u64>()},
                    {"history_gap",!events.empty() && after+1<events.front().at("sequence").get<u64>()}};
        }

            let total: usize = catalog.values().map(|(a, _)| a.bytes).sum();

            }
            let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();

            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.json"));
            fs::write(&path, &bytes)?;
            let artifact = Artifact {
                uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                screen: "report".into(),
                width: 0,
                height: 0,
                bytes: bytes.len(),
                sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&bytes)),
                mime_type: "application/json".into(),
            };
            catalog.insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
            Ok(artifact)
        }

    class Client:

                "clientInfo":{"name":"lotus-debugger-acceptance","version":"1"}})
            self.send("notifications/initialized",notification=True)

            self.transcript.write(json.dumps({"direction":direction,"message":data})+"\n")

        def send(self,method,params=None,notification=False):

                self.record("response",reply)

                    return reply["result"]

                text=result["content"][0]["text"]
                try:return json.loads(text)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:return text
            return result
    
        def close(self):
            self.process.stdin.close()
            try:self.process.wait(timeout=12)

        pub fn create_scratch(&self, session: &str, parent: Option<&str>) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            let root = self.scratch.join(session);

    template <class Archive>
    void Movie::serialize(Archive& ar, const unsigned int file_version) {
        // Only serialize what's needed to make savestates useful for TAS:
        u64 _current_byte = static_cast<u64>(current_byte);
        ar & _current_byte;
        current_byte = static_cast<std::size_t>(_current_byte);
        ar & current_input;
    
        std::vector<u8> recorded_input_ = recorded_input;
        ar & recorded_input_;
    
        ar & init_time;
        ar & base_ticks;
    
        if (Archive::is_loading::value) {
            u64 savestate_movie_id;
            ar & savestate_movie_id;
            if (id != savestate_movie_id) {
                if (savestate_movie_id == 0) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("You must close your movie to load this state");
                } else {
                    throw std::runtime_error("You must load the same movie to load this state");
                }
            }
        } else {
            ar & id;
        }
    
        // Whether the state was made in MovieFinished state
        bool post_movie = play_mode == PlayMode::MovieFinished;
        ar & post_movie;
    
        if (Archive::is_loading::value && id != 0) {
            if (!read_only) {
                recorded_input = std::move(recorded_input_);
            }
    
            if (post_movie) {
                play_mode = PlayMode::MovieFinished;
                return;
            }
    
            if (read_only) {
                if (play_mode == PlayMode::Recording) {
                    SaveMovie();
                }
                if (recorded_input_.size() >= recorded_input.size()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Future event savestate not allowed in R/O mode");
                }
                // Ensure that the current movie and savestate movie are in the same timeline
                if (std::mismatch(recorded_input_.begin(), recorded_input_.end(),
                                  recorded_input.begin())
                        .first != recorded_input_.end()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Timeline mismatch not allowed in R/O mode");
                }
    
                play_mode = PlayMode::Playing;
                total_input = GetInputCount(recorded_input);
            } else {
                play_mode = PlayMode::Recording;
                rerecord_count++;
            }
        }
    }

        /// End a session. Secondary guest data is deleted; primary data persists.
        pub async fn stop(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "stop");
            let mut native = handle.native.lock().await;
            let result = if native.state().is_active() {
                match tokio::time::timeout(CLOSE_DEADLINE, native.stop()).await {
                    Ok(result) => result,
                    Err(_) => {
                        native.abort().await;
                        Err(io::Error::new(
                            io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                            "worker stop deadline; terminated",
                        ))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Ok(())
            };
            let end = if result.is_ok() && native.state() == SessionState::Stopped {
                ScratchEnd::Clean
            } else {
                ScratchEnd::Abnormal
            };
            drop(native);
            {
                let mut registry = lock(&self.registry);
                registry.sessions.remove(id);
                registry.mounted.retain(|_, owner| owner != id);
            }
            if matches!(lock(&handle.info).kind, SessionKind::Secondary { .. }) {
                self.cards.discard_scratch(&handle.root, end)?;
            }
            result
        }

        pub async fn abort(&self, id: &str, actor: Actor) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            handle.set_playing(false);
            handle.record(actor, "abort");
            handle.native.lock().await.abort().await;
            Ok(())
        }

            let status = native.status().await?;
            observe(&handle, &native, &status);

            let mut native = handle.native.try_lock().ok()?;
            let has_frames = handle.telemetry().frames > 0;

        pub async fn capture_scaled(&self, id: &str, scale: u32) -> io::Result<Vec<Artifact>> {
            if lock(&self.artifacts).len() + 2 > MAX_ARTIFACTS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "artifact quota reached; restart host to reset catalog",
                ));
            }
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let frames = handle.native.lock().await.capture_scaled(scale).await?;
            let directory = self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
            for frame in frames {
                let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.bgra"));
                fs::write(&path, &frame.bgra)?;
                let artifact = Artifact {
                    uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                    screen: frame.lease.screen,
                    width: frame.lease.width,
                    height: frame.lease.height,
                    bytes: frame.bgra.len(),
                    sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra)),
                    mime_type: "application/octet-stream".into(),
                };
                lock(&self.artifacts).insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            lock(&self.artifacts)
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }

        pub async fn focus_audio(&self, id: &str, enabled: bool) -> io::Result<serde_json::Value> {
            use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand;
            self.require_control()?;
            let handle = self.handle(id)?;
            let mut focus = self.audio_focus.lock().await;
            if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) && enabled {
                return Ok(serde_json::json!({"focused": id}));

            if enabled {
                if let Some(previous) = focus.take() {
                    if let Ok(old) = self.handle(&previous) {
                        old.native
                            .lock()
                            .await
                            .debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled: false })

                    }
                }
            }
            let result = handle
                .native
                .lock()
                .await
                .debug(&DebugCommand::AudioFocus { enabled })
                .await?;
            if enabled {
                *focus = Some(id.to_string());
            } else if focus.as_deref() == Some(id) {
                *focus = None;
            }
            Ok(result)
        }

    //! Opt-in loopback RSP adapter. All target operations use the shared debug lease.
    use lotus_protocol::{
        debug::{BreakpointKind, DebugCommand as D},
        envelope::SessionUuid,
    };
    use lotus_session::supervisor::Supervisor;
    use serde_json::Value;
    use std::{collections::BTreeMap, io, net::SocketAddr, sync::Arc};
    use tokio::{
        io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt},
        net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    };
    
    const MAX_PACKET: usize = 16_384;
    
    pub struct Server {
        pub address: SocketAddr,
        task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
    }
    impl Server {
        pub async fn start(host: Arc<Supervisor>, session: String, port: u16) -> io::Result<Self> {
            host.require_control()?;
            host.summary(&session)?;
            let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port)).await?;
            let address = listener.local_addr()?;
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                while let Ok((socket, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                    let owner = format!("gdb:{}", SessionUuid::generate());
                    if host
                        .debug_as(
                            &session,
                            &D::LeaseAcquire {
                                owner: owner.clone(),
                            },
                            &owner,
                        )
                        .await
                        .is_err()
                    {
                        drop(socket);
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut connection = Connection {
                        socket,
                        host: host.clone(),
                        session: session.clone(),
                        owner,
                        no_ack: false,
                        thread: None,
                        core: 0,
                        breakpoints: BTreeMap::new(),
                        last_stop: "S05".into(),
                        cleaned: false,
                    };
                    let _ = connection.serve().await;
                    connection.cleanup(false).await;
                    // Drop performs cleanup even if the server task was cancelled.
                }
            });
            Ok(Self { address, task })
        }
    }
    impl Drop for Server {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            self.task.abort();
        }
    }
    
    struct Connection {
        socket: TcpStream,
        host: Arc<Supervisor>,
        session: String,
        owner: String,
        no_ack: bool,
        thread: Option<u32>,
        core: u32,
        breakpoints: BTreeMap<(u32, u32, u32), u64>,
        last_stop: String,
        cleaned: bool,
    }
    impl Drop for Connection {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if self.cleaned {
                return;
            }
            let host = self.host.clone();
            let session = self.session.clone();
            let owner = self.owner.clone();
            let ids: Vec<_> = self.breakpoints.values().copied().collect();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _ = host.debug_as(&session, &D::Pause, &owner).await;
                for id in ids {
                    let _ = host
                        .debug_as(&session, &D::BreakpointRemove { id }, &owner)
                        .await;
                }
                let _ = host
                    .debug_as(&session, &D::HioForward { enabled: false }, &owner)
                    .await;
                let _ = host
                    .debug_as(
                        &session,
                        &D::LeaseRelease {
                            owner: owner.clone(),
                        },
                        &owner,
                    )
                    .await;
            });
        }
    }
    impl Connection {
        async fn cleanup(&mut self, resume: bool) {
            if self.cleaned {
                return;
            }
            let _ = self.debug(D::Pause).await;

    namespace CtrWorker {
    // Three reusable slots. A consumer copies before asking for another capture.
    // No UI acknowledgement or retained guest pointers can stall the core.
    inline nlohmann::json Capture(Core::System& system, const std::filesystem::path& root, u64 epoch,
                                  u64 sequence, u32 scale=1) {
        if(!scale||scale>4)throw std::invalid_argument("capture scale 1..4");
        auto& renderer = system.GPU().Renderer();
        nlohmann::json frames = nlohmann::json::array();
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root / "frames");
        for (const auto& [name, id, native_width] :
             {std::tuple{"top", VideoCore::ScreenId::TopLeft, 400u},
              std::tuple{"bottom", VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, 320u}}) {
            const auto width=native_width*scale,height=240*scale;
            std::vector<u8> pixels(width * height * 4);
            if (Settings::values.graphics_api.GetValue() == Settings::GraphicsAPI::Software) {
                const auto& source = static_cast<SwRenderer::RendererSoftware&>(renderer).Screen(id);
                if (source.width != 240 || source.height != native_width ||
                    source.pixels.size() != native_width * 240 * 4)
                    throw std::runtime_error("unsupported framebuffer layout");
                for(u32 y=0;y<height;++y)for(u32 x=0;x<width;++x) {
                    const auto input=((y/scale)*native_width+x/scale)*4,output=(y*width+x)*4;
                    pixels[output]=source.pixels[input+2];pixels[output+1]=source.pixels[input+1];
                    pixels[output+2]=source.pixels[input];pixels[output+3]=source.pixels[input+3];
                }
            }
    #ifdef ENABLE_VULKAN
            else {
                auto layout = Layout::SingleFrameLayout(width, height, id == VideoCore::ScreenId::Bottom, false);
                layout.render_3d_mode = Settings::StereoRenderOption::Off;
                renderer.CaptureOffscreen(pixels.data(), layout);
            }
    #endif
            const auto relative =
                "frames/" + std::string{name} + "-" + std::to_string(sequence % 3) + ".bgra";
            std::ofstream file{root / relative, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc};
            file.exceptions(std::ios::failbit | std::ios::badbit);
            // Windows/Linux supported hosts are little endian; wire header uses explicit shifts.
            file.write("LTRF", 4);
            const auto write_le = [&file](u64 value, unsigned bytes) {
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
                    file.put(static_cast<char>(value >> (i * 8)));
            };
            write_le(1, 4);
            write_le(epoch, 8);
            write_le(sequence, 8);
            write_le(width, 4);
            write_le(height, 4);
            file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(pixels.data()), pixels.size());
            file.close();
            frames.push_back({{"screen", name},
                              {"path", relative},
                              {"epoch", epoch},
                              {"sequence", sequence},
                              {"slot", sequence % 3},
                              {"width", width},
                              {"height", height},
                              {"stride", width * 4},
                              {"format", "bgra8"},
                              {"orientation", "top_left_row_major"},
                              {"bytes", pixels.size()}});
        }
        return frames;
    }

    void RendererVulkan::LimitFramesAheadOfGpu() {

    }
    
    void RendererVulkan::CaptureOffscreen(void* pixels, const Layout::FramebufferLayout& layout) {
        bool complete = false;

        RenderScreenshot();

            RenderScreenshotWithStagingCopy();
        }
    
        settings.screenshot_complete_callback(false);

    /**
     * Most physical addresses which GPU registers refer to are 8-byte aligned.
     * This function should be used to get the address from a raw register value.
     */
    constexpr u32 DecodeAddressRegister(u32 register_value) {
        return register_value * 8;
    }
    
    /// Components are laid out in reverse byte order, most significant bits first.
    enum class PixelFormat : u32 {
        RGBA8 = 0,
        RGB8 = 1,
        RGB565 = 2,
        RGB5A1 = 3,
        RGBA4 = 4,
    };
    
    constexpr u32 BytesPerPixel(Pica::PixelFormat format) {
        switch (format) {
        case Pica::PixelFormat::RGBA8:
            return 4;
        case Pica::PixelFormat::RGB8:
            return 3;
        case Pica::PixelFormat::RGB565:
        case Pica::PixelFormat::RGB5A1:
        case Pica::PixelFormat::RGBA4:
            return 2;
        default:
            UNREACHABLE();
        }
    
        return 0;
    }

    # Build, test, package and release (Windows x64)
    
    Authoritative commands. CI ([windows.yml](../.github/workflows/windows.yml)) runs
    the same steps; **verified compiled** there (run 43795955719, 2026-11-16). The
    local-checkout variant below differs only in paths. MSVC, Linux and macOS are
    untested. Rationale and release contents: [26](26-portable-release.md).
    
    ## 0. Just run it
    
    Extract `LOTUS-v0.0.1-windows-x64.zip` from the GitHub release into a writable
    folder (spaces are fine). Run `LOTUS.cmd` (CITnLO) or `LOTUS-AZAHAR.cmd`; pick
    your own `.3dsx`. No installer, registry or toolchain. Data stays in `data/`;
    keep it when upgrading. Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Binaries
    are unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn.
    
    ## 1. Prerequisites
    
    | Tool | Version | Notes |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | Windows | 11 x64 | Direct3D 11 |
    | Git | any recent | submodule support |
    | Python | 3.11+ (CI: 3.14) | `tomllib`, `hashlib.file_digest` |
    | rustup | any | installs the pin in `rust-toolchain.toml` (`1.98.1-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`) automatically |
    | `gh` | optional | CI dispatch and logs |
    
    GCC, CMake, Ninja and the FXC shader compiler are **not** taken from the system.
    The next step downloads hash-verified copies into a private directory.
    
    ## 2. Checkout and tools
    
    ```powershell
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/estyseesghosts/lotus.git
    cd lotus
    python scripts/setup-build-tools.py build/tools    # WinLibs GCC 16.2.0 r2 (+CMake/Ninja), SDK 10.0.28000.2705 fxc
    $env:PATH = "$PWD\build\tools\winlibs\mingw64\bin;$env:PATH"
    $env:GPUI_FXC_PATH = "$PWD\build\tools\sdk\c\bin\10.0.28000.0\x64\fxc.exe"
    scripts/bootstrap.ps1      # pinned toolchain, submodules, Cargo fetch, pin check (idempotent)
    ```
    
    Do this in every new shell: PATH and `GPUI_FXC_PATH` are not persisted. The
    submodule fetch is large. Without FXC, GPUI's `build.rs` fails in `--release`.
    Pins: `config/pins.toml`; check with `scripts/verify-pins.ps1`.
    
    ## 3. Rust (desktop, CLI, MCP)
    
    ```powershell
    scripts/smoke.ps1                                   # fast: build, tests, fmt, clippy, CLI, pins; no ROM/GPU/display
    cargo fmt --all -- --check
    cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
    cargo build --locked --release --bins               # target/release: lotus-desktop, ctr-cli, lotus-mcp
    cargo test --locked --release --workspace
    ```
    
    Always pass `--locked`. Native tests are `#[ignore]` by default; an ignored run
    is not a pass (see §5).
    
    Run headless with `lotus-mcp host.json`, windowed with `lotus-desktop host.json`,
    or windowed and agent-driven with `lotus-desktop --mcp host.json` (host config:
    [23](23-local-mcp.md); sessions: [30](30-sessions-and-interface.md)).
    
    ## 4. Native runtimes (AZAHAR and CITnLO)
    
    `build-azahar.ps1` refuses a source whose `HEAD` differs from `config/pins.toml`
    or that is dirty, and refuses a CMake cache configured for another source root.
    Use **one source checkout and one build directory per branch**; never share a
    cache. Mirror CI so the `vendor/azahar` submodule stays untouched:
    
    ```powershell
    Import-Module ./scripts/Pins.psm1
    $pins = Read-Pins config/pins.toml
    foreach ($branch in 'integration','experimental') {
        $src = "build/native-source-$branch"; $out = "build/native-$branch"
        git clone --no-checkout $pins['azahar']['fork'] $src
        git -C $src checkout --detach $pins['azahar']["${branch}_commit"]
        git -C $src submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1
        ./scripts/build-azahar.ps1 -Branch $branch -AzaharRoot $src -BuildDirectory $out -Parallel 2
        & "./$out/bin/Release/ctr-worker.exe" --self-test
        python tests/test_native_protocol.py "$out/bin/Release/ctr-worker.exe"
    }
    ```
    
    `integration` is AZAHAR, `experimental` is CITnLO. At the v0.0.1 pins both point
    to the same commit, so they differ only by `-DCTR_BACKEND_NAME`. Flags (software
    renderer, Qt/SDL/Libretro/Vulkan/OpenGL off, LTO off) are fixed in the script and
    recorded in `lotus-build-manifest.json`. First clean build: about 35–45 min on a

    ### T34 [EXP+RUST] Command list and shader inspection
    
    **Deliver:** command list viewer data, register/uniform state at a draw, vertex shader per-vertex inputs/outputs and instruction trace; `dump_command_buffers`. **Check:** shader trace matches the shader interpreter output for the fixture. **Avoid:** tracing all vertices by default.
    
    ### T16 [EXP] Resource lineage and GPU image capture
    
    **Deliver:** texture/surface source versions, transfer events, native pixel/diff images, renderer sync. **Check:** CPU overwrite between two draws distinguishes resource versions, no false identical hashes. **Avoid:** equating host texture format with original 3DS bytes.
    
    ### T35 [EXP+RUST] Surface and texture viewer
    
    **Deliver:** decode any address/format/size; texture dump; custom texture settings. **Check:** decoded fixture textures match known bytes. **Avoid:** reading GPU-backed pages without recording cache sync.
    
    ### T36 [EXP+RUST] CiTrace record and replay
    
    **Deliver:** record/replay through `core/tracer`. **Check:** replayed trace reproduces captured frame. **Avoid:** unbounded trace files.
    
    ### T37 [EXP] GPU timing and shader settings
    
    **Deliver:** `simulate_3ds_gpu_timings`, `delay_game_render_thread_us`, `shaders_accurate_mul`, shader JIT/interpreter, hardware shaders and caches exposed with time-domain labels. **Check:** each setting changes the documented observable on a fixture. **Avoid:** any accuracy claim without hardware evidence.
    
    ### 3.3 Beyond Azahar
    
    ### T38 [RUST+EXP] Rewind
    
    **Deliver:** snapshot ring plus input log; reverse step/continue; GDB `bs`/`bc`. **Check:** reverse-continue to a watchpoint reaches the same write as a forward run. **Avoid:** unbounded snapshot memory.
    
    ### T39 [RUST] Fork sessions from a savestate
    
    **Deliver:** N sibling workers from one state with independent roots and optional profile overrides. **Check:** forks diverge only by injected differences. **Avoid:** sharing writable storage between forks.
    
    ### T40 [RUST+EXP] `run_until` predicates
    
    **Deliver:** PC reached, memory condition, SVC, log regex, frame N, draw ID; bounded with timeouts. **Check:** each predicate stops the fixture at the expected point. **Avoid:** unbounded waits.
    
    ### T18 [RUST+EXP] Differential run analysis
    
    **Deliver:** aligned checkpoint, frame and draw structural diffs; report earliest reliable divergence; corpus runner across stock/integration/experimental. **Check:** synthetic deliberate divergence detected; no nondeterminism misdiagnosed as definite bug. **Avoid:** reliance solely on screenshot visual comparison.
    
    ### T41 [RUST] Profile matrix runs
    
    **Deliver:** one scenario across JIT/interpreter, Old/New 3DS, accurate-mul, GPU timings, software/Vulkan and backends; earliest divergence per pair via T18. **Check:** a known JIT-sensitive fixture is flagged. **Avoid:** treating a divergence as a bug without a reference.
    
    ### T42 [RUST+EXP] Memory scanning
    
    **Deliver:** narrowing value search (exact, changed, unchanged, range), typed views, pointer chains. **Check:** fixture variable located in bounded passes. **Avoid:** scanning MMIO.
    
    ### T47 [EXP+RUST] DSP inspector
    
    **Deliver:** HLE DSP source/voice/mixer state snapshots. **Check:** fixture voice parameters read back. **Avoid:** claims about LLE internals.
    
    ### T43 [RUST] Agent debugging test suite
    
    **Deliver:** devkitARM fixtures with known bugs (null dereference, deadlock, New-3DS-only race, wrong texture, heap overwrite, HIO output). **Check:** each is diagnosed through MCP alone, with the transcript retained. **Avoid:** fixtures that depend on commercial assets.

    **Deliver:** CPU/kernel/GPU lanes, draw-state diffs, texture/shader tables, snapshot selector, stable source labels; panels for settings, breakpoints, threads, IPC, logs and audio. **Check:** 100k-event trace opens without blocking GPUI event loop; resource usage bounded. **Avoid:** expensive polling for hidden panels.

## Assistant

CiTrace now passes on all four combinations: Old/New 3DS × software/Vulkan, with matching screen bytes on repeated replay. The Vulkan mismatch came from recording GPU-produced memory as though it were new CPU input; replaying it discarded renderer state.

I’m documenting the replay limit explicitly: it uses a paired checkpoint for initial state, and the resulting GPU view cannot resume CPU execution until a checkpoint is restored or the session is reset.

    //! Bridge between GPUI and the shared supervisor; no emulation on the UI thread.
    //!
    //! A background thread runs a Tokio runtime with four loops: UI commands (each
    //! its own task, so one slow worker never stalls the others), the shared pump
    //! (gauges and continuous running), coalesced live input, and the selected
    //! session's preview. With [`McpMode::Stdio`] the same runtime also serves the
    //! MCP tools over stdio against the same supervisor, so an agent and the person
    //! at the window drive one set of sessions.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
    use std::sync::mpsc::{self, SyncSender, TryRecvError};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
    use std::thread::JoinHandle;
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
    
    use lotus_mcp::server::{Frontend, LotusServer};

    /// Commands from the window. Each completes asynchronously.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub enum Command {
        Create {
            kind: SessionKind,
            asset: Option<String>,
        },
        Load {
            session: String,
            asset: String,
        },
        /// A file the person picked; approved for this host, then loaded.
        /// Without a session, a new parentless secondary is created for it.
        OpenFile {
            session: Option<String>,
            path: PathBuf,
        },
        Select(String),
        Play(String),
        Pause(String),
        /// Advance one frame and stay paused.
        Step(String),
        Reset(String),
        Stop(String),
        Abort(String),
    }
    
    /// Whether the window also serves MCP.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum McpMode {
        Off,
        Stdio,
    }
    
    /// MCP link as shown in the window.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum McpLink {
        #[default]
        Off,
        Attached,
        Closed,
    }
    
    /// Newest screens of one session; `sequence` changes with every capture.
    pub struct Preview {
        pub session: String,
        pub sequence: u64,
        pub frames: Vec<Frame>,
    }
    
    /// Latest published state. The window takes `preview` when it changes.
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub struct Update {
        pub sessions: Vec<SessionSummary>,
        pub cards: Vec<String>,
        pub assets: Vec<String>,
        pub max_sessions: usize,
        pub control: bool,
        pub selected: String,
        pub preview: Option<Preview>,
        /// Registers of the selected session at its last paused frame.
        pub registers: Option<(String, Value)>,
        pub error: String,
        pub mcp: McpLink,
        /// Commands still in flight.
        pub pending: usize,
    }
    
    pub struct DesktopController {
        pub commands: SyncSender<Command>,
        pub latest: Arc<Mutex<Update>>,
        pub input: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, InputState>>>,
        /// Fetch registers while paused only when the inspector is open.
        pub inspector: Arc<AtomicBool>,
        host: Arc<Supervisor>,
        shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,
        thread: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    }

    const INPUT_PERIOD: Duration = Duration::from_millis(8);
    const CATALOG_PERIOD: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);

    impl Render for LotusWindow {
        fn render(&mut self, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> impl IntoElement {
            let stage = self.render_stage(window, cx);
            let gauges = self
                .selected_summary()
                .filter(|summary| summary.info.asset.is_some())
                .map(|summary| gauges::gauge_strip(&summary.telemetry));
            let main = div()
                .relative()
                .flex()
                .flex_col()
                .flex_1()
            let mut sequence = 0u64;
            let mut audio_selected = String::new();
            let mut registers_key = None;
            let mut catalog_at: Option<Instant> = None;
            while !self.shutdown.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                if !self.drain_commands(&receiver) {
                    break;
                }
                if let Some(id) = self.host.take_focus_request() {
                    lock(&self.published).selected = id;
                }
                if catalog_at.is_none_or(|at| at.elapsed() >= CATALOG_PERIOD) {
                    let cards = self.host.cards().unwrap_or_default();
                    let assets = self.host.assets();
                    let mut update = lock(&self.published);
                    update.cards = cards;
                    update.assets = assets;
                    catalog_at = Some(Instant::now());
                }
                let sessions = self.host.summaries();
                let selected = {
                    let mut update = lock(&self.published);
                    if !sessions.iter().any(|s| s.info.id == update.selected) {
                        update.selected = sessions
                            .first()
                            .map(|s| s.info.id.clone())
                            .unwrap_or_default();
                    }
                    update.sessions = sessions.clone();
                    update.pending = self.pending.load(Ordering::Acquire);
                    update.selected.clone()
                };
                if !selected.is_empty() {
                    if audio_selected != selected
                        && self.host.allows_control()
                        && self.host.focus_audio(&selected, true).await.is_ok()
                    {
                        audio_selected = selected.clone();
                    }
                    if let Some(frames) = self.host.preview(&selected).await {
                        sequence += 1;
                        lock(&self.published).preview = Some(Preview {
                            session: selected.clone(),
                            sequence,
                            frames,
                        });
                    }
                    let paused = sessions
                        .iter()
                        .find(|s| s.info.id == selected)
                        .filter(|s| s.telemetry.state == SessionState::Paused && !s.telemetry.playing);
                    let key = paused.map(|s| (selected.clone(), s.telemetry.epoch, s.telemetry.frames));
                    if self.inspector.load(Ordering::Acquire) && key.is_some() && key != registers_key {
                        if let Ok(value) = self.host.registers(&selected, 0).await {
                            lock(&self.published).registers = Some((selected.clone(), value));
                            registers_key = key;
                        }
                    } else if key.is_none() {
                        registers_key = None;
                    }
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(TICK).await;
            }
            for task in background {
                task.abort();
            }
            self.host.close().await;
        }
    
        /// Returns false once the window side has gone away.
        fn drain_commands(&self, receiver: &mpsc::Receiver<Command>) -> bool {
            for _ in 0..32 {
                let command = match receiver.try_recv() {
                    Ok(command) => command,
                    Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => return true,
                    Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => return false,
                };
                if let Command::Select(id) = command {
                    lock(&self.published).selected = id;
                    continue;
                }
                self.pending.fetch_add(1, Ordering::AcqRel);
                let loops = self.clone();
                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let result = loops.execute(command).await;
                    let mut update = lock(&loops.published);
                    match result {
                        Ok(()) => update.error.clear(),
                        Err(error) => update.error = error.to_string(),
                    }
                    loops.pending.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel);
                });
            }
            true
        }
    
        async fn execute(&self, command: Command) -> io::Result<()> {
            let host = &self.host;
            let actor = Actor::Desktop;
            match command {
                Command::Create { kind, asset } => {
                    let info = host.create(kind, asset.as_deref(), actor).await?;
                    lock(&self.published).selected = info.id.clone();
                    if info.asset.is_some() {
                        host.run(&info.id, actor).await?;
                    }
                }
                Command::Load { session, asset } => {
                    host.load(&session, &asset, actor).await?;
                    host.run(&session, actor).await?;
                }
                Command::OpenFile { session, path } => {
                    let asset = host.approve_local_asset(&path)?;
                    let session = match session {
                        Some(session) => {
                            host.load(&session, &asset, actor).await?;
                            session
                        }
                        None => {
                            let kind = SessionKind::Secondary { parent: None };
                            host.create(kind, Some(&asset), actor).await?.id
                        }
                    };
                    lock(&self.published).selected = session.clone();
                    host.run(&session, actor).await?;
                }
                Command::Select(_) => {}
                Command::Play(id) => host.run(&id, actor).await?,
                Command::Pause(id) => {
                    host.pause(&id, actor).await?;
                }
                Command::Step(id) => {
                    host.advance(&id, 1, actor).await?;
                }
                Command::Reset(id) => {
                    host.reset(&id, actor).await?;
                }
                Command::Stop(id) => host.stop(&id, actor).await?,
                Command::Abort(id) => host.abort(&id, actor).await?,
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn pump_loop(self) {
            loop {
                self.host.pump().await;
                tokio::time::sleep(PUMP_PERIOD).await;
            }
        }
    
        /// Complete input states coalesce here, independent of the command bound.
        async fn input_loop(self) {
            loop {
                let states = std::mem::take(&mut *lock(&self.input));
                for (id, state) in states {
                    let _ = self.host.input(&id, state, "live", Actor::Desktop).await;
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(INPUT_PERIOD).await;
            }
        }

    //! Bounded structured event capture.
    //!
    //! Events are produced by the worker, ordered by a worker-local sequence
    //! number and consumed by the debugger, the runner and the trace viewer.
    //! Capture is always bounded: a full buffer drops the oldest event and
    //! counts the loss, because a silent truncation would make a trace look
    //! complete when it is not.
    
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use std::collections::VecDeque;
    
    /// Category of a captured event.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum EventCategory {
        /// Worker lifecycle event.
        Worker,
        /// A PICA200 command list was submitted.
        GpuSubmitCmdList,
        /// A PICA200 draw call.
        GpuDraw,
        /// CPU sampling or breakpoint event.
        Cpu,
        /// Guest memory access.
        Memory,
        /// HLE service call.
        ServiceCall,
        /// Kernel IPC.
        KernelIpc,
        /// Emulated exception.
        Exception,
    }
    
    impl EventCategory {
        /// Stable identifier used in manifests and assertions.
        pub fn id(&self) -> &'static str {
            match self {
                EventCategory::Worker => "worker",
                EventCategory::GpuSubmitCmdList => "gpu.submit_cmdlist",
                EventCategory::GpuDraw => "gpu.draw",
                EventCategory::Cpu => "cpu",
                EventCategory::Memory => "memory",
                EventCategory::ServiceCall => "service_call",
                EventCategory::KernelIpc => "kernel.ipc",
                EventCategory::Exception => "exception",
            }
        }
    
        /// Look up a category by its stable identifier.
        pub fn from_id(id: &str) -> Option<Self> {
            Some(match id {
                "worker" => Self::Worker,
                "gpu.submit_cmdlist" => Self::GpuSubmitCmdList,
                "gpu.draw" => Self::GpuDraw,
                "cpu" => Self::Cpu,
                "memory" => Self::Memory,
                "service_call" => Self::ServiceCall,
                "kernel.ipc" => Self::KernelIpc,
                "exception" => Self::Exception,
                _ => return None,
            })
        }
    }

        fn resolve_asset(&self, handle: &str) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
            if let Some(path) = self.config.assets.get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some(path) = lock(&self.local_assets).get(handle) {
                return Ok(path.clone());
            }
            if let Some((directory, name)) = handle.split_once('/') {
                if let Some(root) = self.config.asset_directories.get(directory) {
                    if is_content_name(name) && !name.contains(['/', '\\']) && name != ".." {
                        let path = root.join(name).canonicalize()?;
                        if path.parent() == Some(root.as_path()) && path.is_file() {
                            return Ok(path);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "unknown asset handle",
            ))
        }
    }
    
    /// Holds a session slot and card mount during a slow spawn; released on failure.
    struct Reservation<'a> {
        supervisor: &'a Supervisor,
        id: String,
        card: Option<String>,
        committed: bool,
    }
    
    impl Reservation<'_> {
        fn commit(mut self, handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            registry.sessions.insert(self.id.clone(), handle);
            self.committed = true;
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for Reservation<'_> {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if self.committed {
                return;
            }
            let mut registry = lock(&self.supervisor.registry);
            registry.pending -= 1;
            if let Some(card) = &self.card {
                registry.mounted.remove(card);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async fn pump_session(handle: Arc<SessionHandle>) {
        let Ok(mut native) = handle.native.try_lock() else {
            handle.telemetry().busy = true;
            return;
        };
        if !native.state().is_active() {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
            telemetry.state = native.state();
            telemetry.fps = 0.0;
            telemetry.speed = 0.0;
            telemetry.memory_bytes = None;
            return;
        }
        let status = match native.status().await {
            Ok(status) => status,
            Err(error) => {
                handle.set_playing(false);
                let mut telemetry = handle.telemetry();
                telemetry.state = native.state();
                telemetry.last_error = error.to_string();
                return;
            }
        };
        observe(&handle, &native, &status);
        if !handle.is_playing() || native.state() != SessionState::Paused {
            return;
        }
        // A bounded run ended. Resume unless the guest stopped for a reason a retry
        // cannot fix; a host deadline only means the batch ran slowly.
        let stop = status["stop"]["reason"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
        if !matches!(stop, "" | "frame") {
            handle.set_playing(false);
            return;
        }
        let reason = status["last_error"].as_str().unwrap_or("");

                controller
                    .inspector
                    .store(inspector == Inspector::Open, Ordering::Release);
            }
        }
    
        fn open_file(&mut self, session: Option<String>, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            self.menu = Menu::Closed;
            let paths = cx.prompt_for_paths(PathPromptOptions {
                files: true,
                directories: false,
                multiple: false,
                prompt: Some("Open homebrew (.3dsx)".into()),
            });
            cx.spawn(async move |this, cx| {
                let Ok(Ok(Some(paths))) = paths.await else {
                    return;
                };
                if let Some(path) = paths.into_iter().next() {
                    let _ = this.update(cx, |view, _| view.send(Command::OpenFile { session, path }));
                }
            })
            .detach();
        }
    
        fn publish_input(&mut self) {
            let Some(controller) = &self.controller else {
                return;
            };
            if let Ok(mut inputs) = controller.input.lock() {
                if self.sessions.iter().any(|s| s.info.id == self.selected) {
                    inputs.insert(self.selected.clone(), self.input);
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn release_input(&mut self) {
            self.input = InputState::default();
            self.publish_input();
        }
    
        fn key_down(&mut self, event: &KeyDownEvent) {
            let modifiers = &event.keystroke.modifiers;
            if modifiers.control {
                match event.keystroke.key.as_str() {
                    "b" => {
                        self.sidebar = match self.sidebar {
                            Sidebar::Expanded => Sidebar::Collapsed,
                            Sidebar::Collapsed => Sidebar::Expanded,
                        };
                    }
                    "i" => self.set_inspector(match self.inspector {
                        Inspector::Open => Inspector::Closed,
                        Inspector::Closed => Inspector::Open,
                    }),
                    // Ctrl+O needs a context and is handled in the root listener.
                    _ => {}
                }
                return;
            }
            match event.keystroke.key.as_str() {
                "space" if !event.is_held => self.toggle_run(),
                "." if !event.is_held => self.step(),
                "escape" => self.menu = Menu::Closed,
                key => self.button(key, true),
            }
        }
    
        fn button(&mut self, key: &str, down: bool) {
            let mask = match key {
                "z" => 1,
                "x" => 2,
                "a" => 4,
                "s" => 8,
                "up" => 16,
                "down" => 32,
                "left" => 64,
                "right" => 128,
                "q" => 256,
                "w" => 512,
                "enter" => 1024,
                "backspace" => 2048,
                _ => return,
            };
            if down {
                self.input.buttons |= mask;
            } else {
                self.input.buttons &= !mask;
            }
            self.publish_input();
        }
    
        fn touch(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
            let coordinate = self
                .bottom_rect
                .lock()
                .ok()
                .and_then(|rect| rect.as_ref().and_then(|rect| rect.map_logical(x, y)));
            if let Some((x, y)) = coordinate {
                self.input.x = x;
                self.input.y = y;
                self.input.touch = true;
            } else {
                self.input.touch = false;
            }
            self.publish_input();
        }
    
        fn release_touch(&mut self) {
            self.input.touch = false;
            self.publish_input();
        }

        /// Replaced frames leave the sprite atlas immediately so streaming stays bounded.
        fn replace_images(&mut self, images: Vec<Arc<RenderImage>>, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            for old in std::mem::replace(&mut self.images, images) {

            }

    impl Render for LotusWindow {
        fn render(&mut self, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> impl IntoElement {
            let stage = self.render_stage(window, cx);
            let gauges = self
                .selected_summary()
                .filter(|summary| summary.info.asset.is_some())
                .map(|summary| gauges::gauge_strip(&summary.telemetry));
            let main = div()
                .relative()
                .flex()
                .flex_col()
                .flex_1()
                .min_w_0()
                .h_full()
                .child(self.render_toolbar(cx))
                .children(self.render_error(cx))
                .child(stage)
                .children(gauges)
                .when(self.menu == Menu::Load, |main| {
                    main.child(self.render_load_menu(cx))
                });
            div()
                .id("lotus")
                .flex()
                .size_full()
                .bg(theme::background())
                .text_color(theme::text())
                .font_family(theme::FONT)
                .text_sm()
                .track_focus(&self.focus)
                .on_mouse_down(
                    MouseButton::Left,
                    cx.listener(|view, _, window, cx| window.focus(&view.focus, cx)),
                )
                .on_key_down(cx.listener(|view, event: &KeyDownEvent, _, cx| {
                    if event.keystroke.modifiers.control && event.keystroke.key == "o" {
                        let session = view
                            .selected_summary()
                            .filter(|summary| summary.telemetry.state.is_active())
                            .map(|summary| summary.info.id.clone());
                        view.open_file(session, cx);
                        return;
                    }
                    view.key_down(event);
                }))
                .on_key_up(cx.listener(|view, event: &KeyUpEvent, _, _| {
                    view.button(&event.keystroke.key, false)
                }))
                .child(self.render_sidebar(cx))
                .child(main)
                .when(self.inspector == Inspector::Open, |root| {
                    root.child(self.render_inspector())
                })
        }
    }
    
    /// Largest scale at which both screens fit `width` x `height`, at least 0.5.
    #[must_use]
    fn fit_scale(layout: ScreenLayout, width: f32, height: f32) -> f32 {
        // `f32::min` ignores NaN, so reject non-finite space before comparing axes.
        if !width.is_finite() || !height.is_finite() {
            return 1.0;
        }
        let (needed_width, needed_height) = match layout {
            ScreenLayout::Stacked => (400.0, 480.0),
            ScreenLayout::SideBySide => (720.0, 240.0),
        };
        let gap_width = if layout == ScreenLayout::SideBySide {
            SCREEN_GAP
        } else {
            0.0
        };
        let gap_height = if layout == ScreenLayout::Stacked {
            SCREEN_GAP
        } else {
            0.0
        };
        let scale = ((width - gap_width) / needed_width).min((height - gap_height) / needed_height);
        if scale.is_finite() {
            scale.max(0.5)
        } else {
            1.0
        }
    }
    
    fn state_name(summary: &SessionSummary) -> &'static str {
        match summary.telemetry.state {
            SessionState::Running => "running",
            SessionState::Paused if summary.telemetry.playing => "running",
            SessionState::Paused => "paused",
            SessionState::Idle => "idle",
            SessionState::Created => "starting",
            SessionState::Stopped => "stopped",
            SessionState::Crashed => "crashed",
        }
    }
    
    fn state_colour(summary: &SessionSummary) -> Rgba {
        match state_name(summary) {
            "running" => theme::success(),
            "paused" => theme::warning(),
            "crashed" => theme::error(),
            _ => theme::text_muted(),
        }
    }

    //! A scrollable list of elements with uniform height, optimized for large lists.
    //! Rather than use the full taffy layout system, uniform_list simply measures
    //! the first element and then lays out all remaining elements in a line based on that
    //! measurement. This is much faster than the full layout system, but only works for
    //! elements with uniform height.
    
    use crate::{
        AnyElement, App, AvailableSpace, Bounds, ContentMask, Element, ElementId, Entity,
        GlobalElementId, Hitbox, InspectorElementId, InteractiveElement, Interactivity, IntoElement,
        IsZero, LayoutId, ListSizingBehavior, Overflow, Pixels, Point, ScrollHandle, Size,
        StyleRefinement, Styled, Window, point, px, size,
    };
    use smallvec::SmallVec;
    use std::{cell::RefCell, cmp, ops::Range, rc::Rc};
    
    use super::ListHorizontalSizingBehavior;
    
    /// uniform_list provides lazy rendering for a set of items that are of uniform height.
    /// When rendered into a container with overflow-y: hidden and a fixed (or max) height,
    /// uniform_list will only render the visible subset of items.
    #[track_caller]
    pub fn uniform_list<R>(
        id: impl Into<ElementId>,
        item_count: usize,
        f: impl 'static + Fn(Range<usize>, &mut Window, &mut App) -> Vec<R>,
    ) -> UniformList
    where
        R: IntoElement,
    {
        let id = id.into();
        let mut base_style = StyleRefinement::default();
        base_style.overflow.y = Some(Overflow::Scroll);
    
        let render_range = move |range: Range<usize>, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut App| {
            f(range, window, cx)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|component| component.into_any_element())
                .collect()
        };
    
        UniformList {
            item_count,
            item_to_measure_index: 0,
            render_items: Box::new(render_range),
            decorations: Vec::new(),
            interactivity: Interactivity {
                element_id: Some(id),
                base_style: Box::new(base_style),
                ..Interactivity::new()
            },
            scroll_handle: None,
            sizing_behavior: ListSizingBehavior::default(),
            horizontal_sizing_behavior: ListHorizontalSizingBehavior::default(),
        }
    }
    
    /// A list element for efficiently laying out and displaying a list of uniform-height elements.
    pub struct UniformList {
        item_count: usize,
        item_to_measure_index: usize,
        render_items: Box<
            dyn for<'a> Fn(Range<usize>, &'a mut Window, &'a mut App) -> SmallVec<[AnyElement; 64]>,
        >,
        decorations: Vec<Box<dyn UniformListDecoration>>,
        interactivity: Interactivity,
        scroll_handle: Option<UniformListScrollHandle>,
        sizing_behavior: ListSizingBehavior,
        horizontal_sizing_behavior: ListHorizontalSizingBehavior,
    }
    
    /// Frame state used by the [UniformList].
    pub struct UniformListFrameState {
        items: SmallVec<[AnyElement; 32]>,
        decorations: SmallVec<[AnyElement; 2]>,
    }
    
    /// A handle for controlling the scroll position of a uniform list.
    /// This should be stored in your view and passed to the uniform_list on each frame.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
    pub struct UniformListScrollHandle(pub Rc<RefCell<UniformListScrollState>>);
    
    /// Where to place the element scrolled to.
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub enum ScrollStrategy {
        /// Place the element at the top of the list's viewport.
        Top,
        /// Attempt to place the element in the middle of the list's viewport.
        /// May not be possible if there's not enough list items above the item scrolled to:
        /// in this case, the element will be placed at the closest possible position.
        Center,
        /// Attempt to place the element at the bottom of the list's viewport.
        /// May not be possible if there's not enough list items above the item scrolled to:
        /// in this case, the element will be placed at the closest possible position.
        Bottom,
        /// If the element is not visible attempt to place it at:
        /// - The top of the list's viewport if the target element is above currently visible elements.
        /// - The bottom of the list's viewport if the target element is above currently visible elements.
        Nearest,
    }

            SelectAll,
            Home,
            End,
            ShowCharacterPalette,
            Paste,
            Cut,
            Copy,
            Quit,
        ]
    );
    
    struct TextInput {
        focus_handle: FocusHandle,
        content: SharedString,
        placeholder: SharedString,
        selected_range: Range<usize>,
        selection_reversed: bool,
        marked_range: Option<Range<usize>>,
        last_layout: Option<ShapedLine>,
        last_bounds: Option<Bounds<Pixels>>,
        is_selecting: bool,
    }
    
    impl TextInput {
        fn left(&mut self, _: &Left, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            if self.selected_range.is_empty() {
                self.move_to(self.previous_boundary(self.cursor_offset()), window, cx);
            } else {
                self.move_to(self.selected_range.start, window, cx)
            }
        }
    
        fn right(&mut self, _: &Right, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            if self.selected_range.is_empty() {
                self.move_to(self.next_boundary(self.selected_range.end), window, cx);
            } else {
                self.move_to(self.selected_range.end, window, cx)
            }
        }
    
        fn select_left(&mut self, _: &SelectLeft, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            self.select_to(self.previous_boundary(self.cursor_offset()), window, cx);
        }
    
        fn select_right(&mut self, _: &SelectRight, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            self.select_to(self.next_boundary(self.cursor_offset()), window, cx);
        }
    
        fn select_all(&mut self, _: &SelectAll, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) {
            self.move_to(0, window, cx);
            self.select_to(self.content.len(), window, cx)
        }

    //! Owned inspector rows. Parsing, formatting and trace loading run off the GPUI thread.
    use std::{io, path::Path, sync::Arc};
    use lotus_protocol::debug::DebugCommand as D;
    use serde_json::Value;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    #[repr(usize)]
    pub enum Panel { Cpu, Threads, Breakpoints, Memory, Settings, Ipc, Logs, Gpu, Audio, States, Timeline, Result }
    impl Panel {
        pub const ALL: [Self;12] = [Self::Cpu,Self::Threads,Self::Breakpoints,Self::Memory,Self::Settings,
            Self::Ipc,Self::Logs,Self::Gpu,Self::Audio,Self::States,Self::Timeline,Self::Result];
        pub fn at(index:usize)->Self {Self::ALL.get(index).copied().unwrap_or(Self::Cpu)}
        pub fn label(self)->&'static str {match self {
            Self::Cpu=>"CPU",Self::Threads=>"Threads",Self::Breakpoints=>"Breakpoints",Self::Memory=>"Memory",
            Self::Settings=>"Settings",Self::Ipc=>"IPC",Self::Logs=>"Logs",Self::Gpu=>"GPU",Self::Audio=>"Audio",
            Self::States=>"Snapshots",Self::Timeline=>"Timeline",Self::Result=>"Result"}}
        pub fn command(self,offset:u32)->Option<D> {Some(match self {
            Self::Cpu=>D::Registers{core:0},Self::Threads=>D::Threads,Self::Breakpoints=>D::Breakpoints,
            Self::Memory=>D::MemoryMap,Self::Settings=>D::SettingsList{offset,limit:32},
            Self::Ipc|Self::Timeline=>D::Events{after:u64::from(offset),limit:128},Self::Logs=>D::Logs{after:u64::from(offset),limit:128},
            Self::Gpu=>D::GpuDraws,Self::Audio=>D::DspInspect,Self::States=>D::States,Self::Result=>return None})}
    }
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct Row {pub lane:&'static str,pub key:String,pub value:String,pub action:Option<D>}
    #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    pub struct Inspection {pub rows:Arc<Vec<Row>>,pub source:String,pub next:Option<u32>,pub lost:u64}
    const ROW_CAP:usize=100_000;
    const TEXT_BUDGET:usize=32<<20;
    fn clipped(text:&str,limit:usize)->String {
        if text.len()<=limit{return text.to_owned();}
        let mut end=limit;while !text.is_char_boundary(end){end-=1;}
        format!("{}…",&text[..end])
    }
    fn lane(event:&Value)->&'static str {match event["kind"].as_str().unwrap_or("") {
        "pica"=>"GPU","ipc"|"svc_enter"|"svc_exit"=>"kernel","guest_log"|"hio_stdout"|"native_log"=>"log",_=>"CPU"}}
    impl Inspection {
        pub fn from_value(value:&Value,panel:Panel)->Self {
            let mut rows=Vec::new();let mut budget=TEXT_BUDGET;
            fn flatten(value:&Value,key:String,rows:&mut Vec<Row>,budget:&mut usize,depth:u32) {
                if rows.len()>=8192||*budget<2048{return;}
                if depth<10 {match value {
                    Value::Object(map)=>{for (name,value) in map {flatten(value,format!("{key}.{name}"),rows,budget,depth+1);}return;},
                    Value::Array(values)=>{for (i,value) in values.iter().enumerate(){flatten(value,format!("{key}[{i}]"),rows,budget,depth+1);}return;},_=>{}}}
                let key=clipped(&key,256);let text=clipped(&value.to_string(),1024);*budget-=key.len()+text.len();
                rows.push(Row{lane:"state",key,value:text,action:None});
            }
            if matches!(panel,Panel::Timeline|Panel::Logs|Panel::Ipc) {
                if let Some(events)=value["events"].as_array() {for event in events {
                    if panel==Panel::Ipc&&event["kind"]!="ipc" {continue;}
                    rows.push(Self::event(event));
                }}
            } else if panel==Panel::Settings {
                if let Some(settings)=value["settings"].as_array() {for setting in settings {
                    let name=setting["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("");let v=&setting["value"];
                    rows.push(Row{lane:"setting",key:name.into(),value:format!("{} · {} · {}",v,setting["apply"],setting["consumer_sources"]),
                        action:v.as_bool().map(|v|D::SettingsSet{name:name.into(),value:lotus_protocol::debug::SettingValue::Boolean(!v)})});
                }}
            } else if panel==Panel::States {
                if let Some(names)=value["states"].as_array(){for name in names.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str) {
                    rows.push(Row{lane:"snapshot",key:name.into(),value:"Restore checkpoint (pauses execution)".into(),action:Some(D::LoadState{name:name.into()})});
                }}
            } else if panel==Panel::Gpu {
                if let Some(draws)=value["draws"].as_array(){for draw in draws {
                    rows.push(Row{lane:"GPU",key:format!("draw {}",draw["draw"]),value:format!("command {} · {} vertices · inspect frozen state",draw["command"],draw["vertices"]),
                        action:draw["draw"].as_u64().map(|draw|D::GpuDraw{draw})});
                }}
            } else {flatten(value,String::new(),&mut rows,&mut budget,0);}
            Self{rows:Arc::new(rows),source:format!("{} · {} · epoch {} · paused {} · cache flush {}",
                value["identity"]["backend_name"],value["profile_hash"],value["epoch"],value["paused"],value["rasterizer_cache_flush"]),
                next:value["next"].as_u64().and_then(|n|n.try_into().ok()),lost:value["lost_total"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0)}
        }
        fn event(event:&Value)->Row {Row{lane:lane(event),
            key:format!("#{} · tick {}",event["sequence"],event["guest_ticks"]),value:clipped(&event.to_string(),1024),action:None}}
        pub fn load_trace(path:&Path)->io::Result<Self> {
            use std::io::BufRead;
            let file=std::fs::File::open(path)?;
            if file.metadata()?.len()>64<<20{return Err(io::Error::other("trace exceeds 64 MiB"));}
            Self::parse_trace(std::io::BufReader::new(file))
        }
        fn parse_trace(reader:impl io::BufRead)->io::Result<Self> {
            let mut rows=Vec::new();let mut bytes=0;let mut lost=0;
            for line in reader.lines() {
                let line=line?;if line.len()>65536{return Err(io::Error::other("trace row exceeds 64 KiB"));}
                if line.trim().is_empty(){continue;}
                let event:Value=serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                let event=event.get("data").unwrap_or(&event);let row=Self::event(event);
                bytes+=row.key.len()+row.value.len();
                if rows.len()==ROW_CAP||bytes>TEXT_BUDGET {lost+=1;continue;}
                rows.push(row);
            }
            Ok(Self{source:"Imported JSONL · guest ticks kept separate from host timestamps".into(),rows:Arc::new(rows),next:None,lost})
        }
    }
    #[cfg(test)]mod tests {
        use super::*;
        #[test]fn large_trace_is_bounded_and_preserves_lanes() {
            let line=b"{\"kind\":\"ipc\",\"guest_ticks\":123,\"sequence\":4}\n";
            let mut data=Vec::new();for _ in 0..100001{data.extend_from_slice(line);}
            let trace=Inspection::parse_trace(io::Cursor::new(data)).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(trace.rows.len(),100000);assert_eq!(trace.lost,1);assert_eq!(trace.rows[0].lane,"kernel");
        }
        #[test]fn settings_only_offer_typed_boolean_edits() {
            let view=Inspection::from_value(&serde_json::json!({"settings":[{"name":"use_cpu_jit","value":true}]}),Panel::Settings);
            assert!(matches!(view.rows[0].action,Some(D::SettingsSet{..})));
        }
    }

        id: impl Into<SharedString>,
        label: &'static str,
        tone: Tone,
        enabled: bool,

        let base = div()

            .items_center()
            .h(px(30.0))
            .px_3()
            .rounded(px(6.0))
            .text_sm()
            .font_weight(FontWeight::MEDIUM)
            .child(label);

            Tone::Primary => base.bg(theme::text()).text_color(theme::background()),
            Tone::Plain => base
                .border_1()
                .border_color(theme::border())
                .text_color(theme::text()),
            Tone::Danger => base
                .border_1()
                .border_color(theme::border())
                .text_color(theme::error()),
        };
        if enabled {
            base.cursor_pointer().hover(move |style| match tone {
                Tone::Primary => style.opacity(0.88),
                Tone::Plain | Tone::Danger => style
                    .bg(theme::surface_hover())
                    .border_color(theme::border_strong()),
            })
        } else {
            base.opacity(0.4)
        }

        pub fn load_trace(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
            use std::io::BufRead;
            let file = std::fs::File::open(path)?;
            if file.metadata()?.len() > 64 << 20 {
                return Err(io::Error::other("trace exceeds 64 MiB"));
            }
            Self::parse_trace(std::io::BufReader::new(file))
        }
        fn parse_trace(reader: impl io::BufRead) -> io::Result<Self> {
            let mut rows = Vec::new();
            let mut bytes = 0;
            let mut lost = 0;
            for line in reader.lines() {
                let line = line?;
                if line.len() > 65536 {
                    return Err(io::Error::other("trace row exceeds 64 KiB"));
                }
                if line.trim().is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                let event: Value = serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
                let event = event.get("data").unwrap_or(&event);
                let row = Self::event(event);
                bytes += row.key.len() + row.value.len();
                if rows.len() == ROW_CAP || bytes > TEXT_BUDGET {
                    lost += 1;
                    continue;
                }
                rows.push(row);
            }
            Ok(Self {
                source: "Imported JSONL · guest ticks kept separate from host timestamps".into(),
                rows: Arc::new(rows),
                next: None,
                lost,
            })
        }
    }
