    class Window final : public Frontend::EmuWindow {
    public:
        Window() {
            UpdateCurrentFramebufferLayout(400, 480);
        }
        void PollEvents() override {
            ++frames;
        }
        u64 frames = 0;
    };
    
    class Keyboard final : public Frontend::SoftwareKeyboard {
    public:
        explicit Keyboard(bool& unsupported) : unsupported(unsupported) {}
        void Execute(const Frontend::KeyboardConfig& config) override {
            SoftwareKeyboard::Execute(config);
            unsupported = true;
            Finalize("", 0);
        }
        void ShowError(const std::string&) override {
            unsupported = true;
        }
    
    private:
        bool& unsupported;
    };
    
    class MiiSelector final : public Frontend::MiiSelector {
    public:
        explicit MiiSelector(bool& unsupported) : unsupported(unsupported) {}
        void Setup(const Frontend::MiiSelectorConfig& config) override {
            Frontend::MiiSelector::Setup(config);
            unsupported = true;
            Finalize(1, {});
        }
    
    private:
        bool& unsupported;
    };
    
    inline void Initialize(Core::System& system, const std::string& root, bool& unsupported) {
        std::filesystem::create_directories(root);
        FileUtil::SetUserPath(root + "/");
        Common::Log::Initialize();
        Common::Log::Start();
        DefaultProfile();
        for (const auto& module : Service::service_module_map)
            Settings::values.lle_modules.emplace(module.name, false);
        system.RegisterSoftwareKeyboard(std::make_shared<Keyboard>(unsupported));
        system.RegisterMiiSelector(std::make_shared<MiiSelector>(unsupported));
        system.RegisterImageInterface(std::make_shared<Frontend::ImageInterface>());
    }

    """Owned DSP handshake and PCM captures. Optional firmware stays in private roots."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import shutil
    import wave
    from native_debug_probe import Peer
    from debugger_acceptance import symbols
    
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('worker',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('rom',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('output',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--firmware',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--mode',choices=['hle','lle','lle-mt'],default='hle')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode!='hle' and not args.firmware:parser.error('LLE requires --firmware <private dspfirm.cdc>')
    addresses=symbols(args.rom.with_suffix('.elf'))
    for new in (False,True):
        hashes=[]
        for repeat in range(3):
            peer=Peer(args.worker.resolve(),args.output.resolve()/f"{'new' if new else 'old'}-{repeat}")
            try:
                peer.call('hello')
                peer.debug('settings_set',name='is_new_3ds',value=new)
                peer.debug('settings_set',name='audio_emulation',value={'hle':0,'lle':1,'lle-mt':2}[args.mode])
                if args.firmware:
                    destination=peer.root/'sdmc/3ds/dspfirm.cdc';destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                    shutil.copyfile(args.firmware,destination)
                peer.call('load',{'path':str(args.rom.resolve())})
                if args.mode!='hle':peer.debug('dsp_load_firmware')
                peer.debug('audio_capture',enabled=True)
                status=peer.call('run_until',{'frames':60})
                stage=peer.debug('read_memory',address=addresses['stage'],length=4)['bytes']
                failure=peer.debug('read_memory',address=addresses['failure'],length=4)['bytes']
                assert stage==[5,0,0,0] and not any(failure),(stage,failure,status)
                capture=peer.debug('audio_capture',enabled=False)
                with wave.open(str(peer.root/capture['artifacts'][0]['path']),'rb') as file:
                    assert (file.getnchannels(),file.getsampwidth(),file.getframerate())==(2,2,32728)
                    pcm=file.readframes(file.getnframes())
                assert len(pcm)>1000 and any(pcm),'DSP produced no nonzero PCM'
                digest=hashlib.sha256(pcm).hexdigest();hashes.append(digest)
                report=dict(new_3ds=new,mode=args.mode,repeat=repeat,pcm_bytes=len(pcm),pcm_sha256=digest,
                            source=status['source'],stage=stage[0])
                (peer.root/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
                print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
            finally:peer.close()
        assert len(set(hashes))==1,('DSP captures were not repeatable',new,hashes)

    #include <dds-ktx.h>
    #include <lodepng.h>
    #include "common/file_util.h"
    #include "common/logging/log.h"
    #include "core/frontend/image_interface.h"
    
    namespace Frontend {
    
    bool ImageInterface::DecodePNG(std::vector<u8>& dst, u32& width, u32& height,
                                   std::span<const u8> src) {
        const u32 lodepng_ret = lodepng::decode(dst, width, height, src.data(), src.size());
        if (lodepng_ret) {
            LOG_ERROR(Frontend, "Failed to decode because {}", lodepng_error_text(lodepng_ret));
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    bool ImageInterface::DecodeDDS(std::vector<u8>& dst, u32& width, u32& height, ddsktx_format& format,
                                   std::span<const u8> src) {
        ddsktx_texture_info tc{};
        const int size = static_cast<int>(src.size());
    
        if (!ddsktx_parse(&tc, src.data(), size, nullptr)) {
            LOG_ERROR(Frontend, "Failed to decode");
            return false;
        }
        width = tc.width;
        height = tc.height;
        format = tc.format;
    
        ddsktx_sub_data sub_data{};
        ddsktx_get_sub(&tc, &sub_data, src.data(), size, 0, 0, 0);
    
        dst.resize(sub_data.size_bytes);
        std::memcpy(dst.data(), sub_data.buff, sub_data.size_bytes);
    
        return true;
    }
    
    bool ImageInterface::EncodePNG(const std::string& path, u32 width, u32 height,
                                   std::span<const u8> src) {
        std::vector<u8> out;
        const u32 lodepng_ret = lodepng::encode(out, src.data(), width, height);
        if (lodepng_ret) {
            LOG_ERROR(Frontend, "Failed to encode {} because {}", path,
                      lodepng_error_text(lodepng_ret));
            return false;
        }
    
        FileUtil::IOFile file{path, "wb"};
        if (file.WriteBytes(out.data(), out.size()) != out.size()) {
            LOG_ERROR(Frontend, "Failed to save encode to path {}", path);
            return false;
        }
    
        return true;
    }

    void DSP_DSP::UnloadComponent(Kernel::HLERequestContext& ctx) {
        IPC::RequestParser rp(ctx);
    
        system.DSP().UnloadComponent();
    
        IPC::RequestBuilder rb = rp.MakeBuilder(1, 0);
        rb.Push(ResultSuccess);
    
        LOG_INFO(Service_DSP, "called");
    }
    
    void DSP_DSP::FlushDataCache(Kernel::HLERequestContext& ctx) {
        IPC::RequestParser rp(ctx);
        [[maybe_unused]] const VAddr address = rp.Pop<u32>();
        [[maybe_unused]] const u32 size = rp.Pop<u32>();
        const auto process = rp.PopObject<Kernel::Process>();
    
        IPC::RequestBuilder rb = rp.MakeBuilder(1, 0);
        rb.Push(ResultSuccess);
    
        LOG_TRACE(Service_DSP, "called address=0x{:08X}, size=0x{:X}, process={}", address, size,
                  process->process_id);
    }
    
    void DSP_DSP::InvalidateDataCache(Kernel::HLERequestContext& ctx) {
        IPC::RequestParser rp(ctx);
        [[maybe_unused]] const VAddr address = rp.Pop<u32>();
        [[maybe_unused]] const u32 size = rp.Pop<u32>();
        const auto process = rp.PopObject<Kernel::Process>();
    
        IPC::RequestBuilder rb = rp.MakeBuilder(1, 0);
        rb.Push(ResultSuccess);
    
        LOG_TRACE(Service_DSP, "called address=0x{:08X}, size=0x{:X}, process={}", address, size,
                  process->process_id);
    }
    
    void DSP_DSP::RegisterInterruptEvents(Kernel::HLERequestContext& ctx) {
        IPC::RequestParser rp(ctx);
        const u32 interrupt = rp.Pop<u32>();
        const u32 channel = rp.Pop<u32>();
        auto event = rp.PopObject<Kernel::Event>();
    
        ASSERT_MSG(interrupt < static_cast<u32>(InterruptType::Count) &&
                       channel < AudioCore::num_dsp_pipe,
                   "Invalid type or pipe: interrupt = {}, channel = {}", interrupt, channel);
    
        const InterruptType type = static_cast<InterruptType>(interrupt);
